namespace DevExpress.XtraReports.Native
{
	public class ReportPrintToolInternal : IReportPrintTool, IReportTool, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IReport report;

		private Window previewWindow;

		private bool disposed;

		private bool? approved;

		List<ParameterInfo> IReportPrintTool.ParametersInfo => null;

		public ReportPrintToolInternal(IReport report)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)report, "report");
			this.report = report;
		}

		public void ShowPreview(Window ownerWindow)
		{
			ShowPreviewCore(ownerWindow, isModal: false);
		}

		public void ShowPreviewDialog(Window ownerWindow)
		{
			ShowPreviewCore(ownerWindow, isModal: true);
		}

		public void Print()
		{
			PrintHelper.PrintDirect(report);
		}

		public void Print(string printerName)
		{
			XtraReportPreviewModel xtraReportPreviewModel = new XtraReportPreviewModel(report);
			xtraReportPreviewModel.PrintDirect(printerName);
		}

		public bool? PrintDialog()
		{
			return PrintHelper.Print(report);
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.ShowPreview(object ownerWindow)
		{
			ShowPreview(ownerWindow as Window);
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.ClosePreview()
		{
			if (previewWindow != null)
			{
				previewWindow.Close();
			}
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.ShowPreviewDialog(object ownerWindow)
		{
			ShowPreviewDialog(ownerWindow as Window);
		}

		bool? IReportPrintTool.ShowPageSetupDialog(object ownerWindow)
		{
			return new PageSettingsConfiguratorService().Configure(((IDocumentSource)report).PrintingSystemBase.PageSettings, ownerWindow as Window);
		}

		void IReportTool.CreateDocument(float progressRange, bool buildForInstantPreview)
		{
			if (report is CachedReportSource)
			{
				((ILink)report).CreateDocument(buildForInstantPreview);
			}
			else
			{
				GetCreator(approveParameters: true).Create(progressRange, buildForInstantPreview);
			}
		}

		Task IReportTool.CreateDocumentAsync(float progressRange, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (report is CachedReportSourceBase)
			{
				return report.CreateDocumentAsync(token);
			}
			return GetCreator(approveParameters: true).CreateAsync(progressRange, token);
		}

		private DocumentCreator GetCreator(bool approveParameters)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (approveParameters)
			{
				return new DocumentCreator(report, (Func<IEnumerable<Parameter>, bool, CancellationToken, bool>)ApproveParameters);
			}
			return new DocumentCreator(report, (Func<IEnumerable<Parameter>, bool, CancellationToken, bool>)null);
		}

		bool IReportTool.ApproveParameters(IEnumerable<Parameter> parameters, bool requestParameters, CancellationToken token)
		{
			return ApproveParameters(parameters, requestParameters, token);
		}

		private bool ApproveParameters(IEnumerable<Parameter> parameters, bool requestParameters, CancellationToken token)
		{
			bool? flag = (approved = !requestParameters || approved.HasValue);
			return flag.Value;
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.ShowPreview()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("Use ShowPreview(object ownerWindow) method instead.");
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.ShowPreviewDialog()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("Use ShowPreviewDialog(object ownerWindow) method instead.");
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.ShowRibbonPreview(object lookAndFeel)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.ShowRibbonPreview()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.CloseRibbonPreview()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.ShowRibbonPreviewDialog(object lookAndFeel)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		void IReportPrintTool.ShowRibbonPreviewDialog()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private void ShowPreviewCore(Window ownerWindow, bool isModal)
		{
			if (ownerWindow == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ownerWindow");
			}
			CreateDocumentIfEmpty(buildPagesInBackground: true);
			previewWindow = CreatePreviewWindow(ownerWindow);
			if (isModal)
			{
				previewWindow.ShowDialog();
			}
			else
			{
				previewWindow.Show();
			}
		}

		private Window CreatePreviewWindow(Window ownerWindow)
		{
			DocumentPreviewWindow documentPreviewWindow = new DocumentPreviewWindow
			{
				Owner = ownerWindow
			};
			documentPreviewWindow.PreviewControl.DocumentSource = report;
			return (Window)(object)documentPreviewWindow;
		}

		private void CreateDocumentIfEmpty(bool buildPagesInBackground)
		{
			if (((IDocumentSource)report).PrintingSystemBase.Document.PageCount == 0)
			{
				((ILink)report).CreateDocument(buildPagesInBackground);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposed)
			{
				if (disposing && (object)report.PrintTool == this)
				{
					report.PrintTool = null;
				}
				disposed = true;
			}
		}
	}
}

	internal class BrickContainerBaseXamlExporter : BrickXamlExporterBase
	{
		public override void WriteBrickToXaml(XamlWriter writer, BrickBase brick, XamlExportContext exportContext, RectangleF clipRect, Action<XamlWriter> declareNamespaces, Action<XamlWriter, object> writeCustomProperties)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Canvas);
			BrickContainerBase val = (BrickContainerBase)brick;
			if (val.Brick != null)
			{
				float value = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((BrickBase)val.Brick).Width);
				float value2 = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((BrickBase)val.Brick).Height);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Width, value);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Height, value2);
			}
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.CanvasLeft, GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(brick.X + brick.InnerBrickListOffset.X));
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.CanvasTop, GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(brick.Y + brick.InnerBrickListOffset.Y));
			if (val.Brick != null)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Tag, DocumentMapTreeViewNodeHelper.GetTagByIndices(BrickPagePairHelper.GetIndicesByBrick(exportContext.Page, val.Brick), exportContext.PageNumber - 1));
			}
		}

		public override void WriteEndTags(XamlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		protected override XamlBrickExportMode GetBrickExportMode()
		{
			return XamlBrickExportMode.ChildElements;
		}
	}

		{

			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.CanvasLeft, value);
			float value2 = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(brick.Y + brick.InnerBrickListOffset.Y);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.CanvasTop, value2);
			if (!brick.NoClip)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.CanvasClip);

				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Rect, value3);
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

	internal class BrickImageXamlExporter : VisualBrickXamlExporter
	{
		protected override void WriteBrickToXamlCore(XamlWriter writer, VisualBrick brick, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			if (brick == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("brick");
			}
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Image);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Source, exportContext.ResourceMap.ImageResourcesDictionary[(BrickBase)(object)brick]);
			if (exportContext.Compatibility == XamlCompatibility.WPF)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.RenderOptionsBitmapScalingMode, XamlNames.Fant);
			}
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public override bool RequiresImageResource()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override XamlBrickExportMode GetBrickExportMode()
		{
			return XamlBrickExportMode.Content;
		}
	}
	public abstract class BrickXamlExporterBase
	{
		public XamlBrickExportMode BrickExportMode => GetBrickExportMode();

		public virtual bool RequiresImageResource()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool RequiresBorderStyle()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public abstract void WriteBrickToXaml(XamlWriter writer, BrickBase brick, XamlExportContext exportContext, RectangleF clipRect, Action<XamlWriter> declareNamespaces, Action<XamlWriter, object> writeCustomProperties);

		public abstract void WriteEndTags(XamlWriter writer);

		protected abstract XamlBrickExportMode GetBrickExportMode();

		public virtual float GetGraphicsDpi()
		{
			return 300f;
		}
	}
	internal class CheckBoxBrickXamlExporter : VisualBrickXamlExporter
	{
		public const string checkedCheckBoxTemplateKey = "checkedCheckBoxTemplate";

		public const string uncheckedCheckBoxTemplateKey = "uncheckedCheckBoxTemplate";

		public const string indeterminateCheckBoxTemplateKey = "indeterminateCheckBoxTemplate";

		protected override void WriteBrickToXamlCore(XamlWriter writer, VisualBrick brick, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			CheckBoxBrick val = (CheckBoxBrick)(object)((brick is CheckBoxBrick) ? brick : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("brick");
			}
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.ContentPresenter);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.ContentTemplate, $"{{StaticResource {GetCheckTemplate(val.GetCheckValue())}}}");
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		protected override XamlBrickExportMode GetBrickExportMode()
		{
			return XamlBrickExportMode.Content;
		}

		private static string GetCheckTemplate(bool? isChecked)
		{
			if (!isChecked.HasValue)
			{
				return "indeterminateCheckBoxTemplate";
			}
			if (isChecked != true)
			{
				return "uncheckedCheckBoxTemplate";
			}
			return "checkedCheckBoxTemplate";
		}
	}

	internal class ImageBrickXamlExporter : VisualBrickXamlExporter
	{
		protected override void WriteBrickToXamlCore(XamlWriter writer, VisualBrick brick, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			//IL_00c5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ImageBrick val = (ImageBrick)(object)((brick is ImageBrick) ? brick : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("brick");
			}
			if (exportContext.ResourceMap.ImageResourcesDictionary.ContainsKey((BrickBase)(object)val))
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Image);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Source, exportContext.ResourceMap.ImageResourcesDictionary[(BrickBase)(object)val]);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.VerticalAlignment, GetVerticalAlignment(val));
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.HorizontalAlignment, GetHorizontalAlignment(val));
				if (0 == 0)
				{
					SizeF sizeF = CalculateImageSize(val, NeedSqueeze(val), exportContext.Page.Document.ScaleFactor);
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Width, sizeF.Width);
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Height, sizeF.Height);
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Stretch, GetStretchModeName(val.SizeMode, exportContext.Page.Document.ScaleFactor));
				}
				if (exportContext.Compatibility == XamlCompatibility.WPF)
				{
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.RenderOptionsBitmapScalingMode, XamlNames.Fant);
				}
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		public override bool RequiresImageResource()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override XamlBrickExportMode GetBrickExportMode()
		{
			return XamlBrickExportMode.Content;
		}

		private SizeF CalculateImageSize(ImageBrick imageBrick, bool needSqueeze, float scaleFactor)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a8: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00ab: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b1: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c6: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00b7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bd: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)imageBrick.SizeMode == 0 || (int)imageBrick.SizeMode == 3 || (!needSqueeze && (int)imageBrick.SizeMode == 5))
			{
				if (imageBrick.UseImageResolution)
				{
					float num = imageBrick.Image.Width;
					float num2 = imageBrick.Image.Height;
					num *= 96f / imageBrick.Image.HorizontalResolution;
					num2 *= 96f / imageBrick.Image.VerticalResolution;
					return MathMethods.Scale(new SizeF(num, num2), scaleFactor);
				}
				float width = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((BrickBase)imageBrick).Width);
				float height = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((BrickBase)imageBrick).Height);
				return new SizeF(width, height);
			}
			if ((int)imageBrick.SizeMode == 2 || (int)imageBrick.SizeMode == 1 || (int)imageBrick.SizeMode == 4 || (needSqueeze && (int)imageBrick.SizeMode == 5) || (int)imageBrick.SizeMode == 6)
			{
				RectangleF borderBoundsInPixels = GetBorderBoundsInPixels((VisualBrick)(object)imageBrick);
				return new SizeF(borderBoundsInPixels.Width, borderBoundsInPixels.Height);
			}
			return SizeF.Empty;
		}

		private static bool NeedSqueeze(ImageBrick imageBrick)
		{
			SizeF sizeF = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((BrickBase)imageBrick).Size);
			if (!((float)imageBrick.Image.Width > sizeF.Width))
			{
				return (float)imageBrick.Image.Height > sizeF.Height;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static string GetVerticalAlignment(ImageBrick imageBrick)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			ImageSizeMode sizeMode = imageBrick.SizeMode;

			case 3:

		}

		private static string GetStretchModeName(ImageSizeMode sizeMode, float scaleFactor)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch (sizeMode - 1)
			{
			case 3:
			case 4:
				return XamlNames.StretchUniform;
			case 0:
				return XamlNames.StretchFill;
			default:
				if (scaleFactor != 1f)
				{
					return XamlNames.StretchUniformToFill;
				}
				return XamlNames.StretchNone;
			}
		}

	internal class LineBrickXamlExporter : VisualBrickXamlExporter
	{
		protected override void WriteBrickToXamlCore(XamlWriter writer, VisualBrick brick, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			LineBrick val = (LineBrick)(object)((brick is LineBrick) ? brick : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("brick");
			}
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Line);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Style, $"{{StaticResource {exportContext.ResourceMap.LineStylesDictionary[val]}}}");
			RectangleF lineClientRectInPixels = GetLineClientRectInPixels(val);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.X1, val.GetPoint1(lineClientRectInPixels).X);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Y1, val.GetPoint1(lineClientRectInPixels).Y);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.X2, val.GetPoint2(lineClientRectInPixels).X);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Y2, val.GetPoint2(lineClientRectInPixels).Y);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.StrokeDashArray, VisualBrick.GetDashPattern(val.LineStyle));
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static RectangleF GetLineClientRectInPixels(LineBrick lineBrick)
		{
			RectangleF result = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(new RectangleF(PointF.Empty, ((BrickBase)lineBrick).Size));
			result.Width = result.Width - VisualBrickXamlExporter.GetBorderWidth((BorderSide)1, (VisualBrick)(object)lineBrick) - VisualBrickXamlExporter.GetBorderWidth((BorderSide)4, (VisualBrick)(object)lineBrick);
			result.Height = result.Height - VisualBrickXamlExporter.GetBorderWidth((BorderSide)2, (VisualBrick)(object)lineBrick) - VisualBrickXamlExporter.GetBorderWidth((BorderSide)8, (VisualBrick)(object)lineBrick);
			return result;
		}

		protected override XamlBrickExportMode GetBrickExportMode()
		{
			return XamlBrickExportMode.Content;
		}
	}
	internal class PageInfoTextBrickXamlExporter : TextBrickXamlExporter

		}
	}
	internal class PageXamlExporter : BrickXamlExporterBase
	{
		public override void WriteBrickToXaml(XamlWriter writer, BrickBase brick, XamlExportContext exportContext, RectangleF clipRect, Action<XamlWriter> declareNamespaces, Action<XamlWriter, object> writeCustomProperties)
		{
			Page val = (Page)(object)((brick is Page) ? brick : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("brick");
			}
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Canvas, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation");
			writer.WriteNamespace(XamlNsPrefix.x, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml");
			writer.WriteNamespace(XamlNsPrefix.system, "clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib");
			writer.WriteNamespace(XamlNsPrefix.dxpn, "http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/printingcore/xtraprinting/native");
			if (!XamlExporter.InheritParentFlowDirection)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.FlowDirection, XamlNames.FlowDirectionLeftToRight);
			}
			declareNamespaces(writer);
			if (val.Document != null)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Background, val.Document.PrintingSystem.Graph.PageBackColor);
			}
			float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(val.PageSize.Width);
			float num2 = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(val.PageSize.Height);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Width, num);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Height, num2);
			if (exportContext.Compatibility == XamlCompatibility.WPF)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.SnapsToDevicePixels, true.ToString());
			}
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.UseLayoutRounding, false.ToString());
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.CanvasClip);
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.RectangleGeometry);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Rect, new RectangleF(0f, 0f, num, num2));
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			WriteResources(writer, exportContext);
			WatermarkXamlExporter.WriteToXaml(writer, val, exportContext);
		}

		public override void WriteEndTags(XamlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		protected override XamlBrickExportMode GetBrickExportMode()
		{
			return XamlBrickExportMode.ChildElements;
		}

		private static void WriteResources(XamlWriter writer, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.CanvasResources);
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.ResourceDictionary);
			WriteBorderStyles(writer, exportContext.ResourceCache.BorderStyles, exportContext);
			WriteBorderDashStyles(writer, exportContext.ResourceCache.BorderDashStyles);
			WriteTextBlockStyles(writer, exportContext.ResourceCache.TextBlockStyles, exportContext.Compatibility, exportContext.TextMeasurementSystem);
			WriteLineStyles(writer, exportContext.ResourceCache.LineStyles);
			WriteImageResources(writer, exportContext.ResourceCache.ImageResources, exportContext.ResourceMap.ImageResourcesDictionary.Count != 0, exportContext.Compatibility, exportContext.EmbedImagesToXaml);
			if (exportContext.ResourceMap.ShouldAddCheckBoxTemplates)
			{
				WriteCheckBoxTemplates(writer);
			}
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static void WriteBorderStyles(XamlWriter writer, IEnumerable<XamlBorderStyle> borderStyles, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ae: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (XamlBorderStyle borderStyle in borderStyles)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Style);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.x, XamlAttribute.Key, borderStyle.Name);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.TargetType, XamlNames.TargetTypeBorder);
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.BorderThickness, GetBorderWidth((BorderSide)1, borderStyle), GetBorderWidth((BorderSide)2, borderStyle), GetBorderWidth((BorderSide)4, borderStyle), GetBorderWidth((BorderSide)8, borderStyle));
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.BorderBrush, borderStyle.BorderBrush);
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.Background, borderStyle.BackColor);
				PaddingInfo padding = borderStyle.Padding;
				PaddingInfo padding2 = borderStyle.Padding;
				PaddingInfo val = ((PaddingInfo)(ref padding)).Scale(96f / ((PaddingInfo)(ref padding2)).Dpi);
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.Padding, ((PaddingInfo)(ref val)).Left, ((PaddingInfo)(ref val)).Top, ((PaddingInfo)(ref val)).Right, ((PaddingInfo)(ref val)).Bottom);
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void WriteBorderDashStyles(XamlWriter writer, IEnumerable<XamlLineStyle> lineStyles)
		{
			foreach (XamlLineStyle lineStyle in lineStyles)
			{
				WriteLineStart(writer, lineStyle);
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.StrokeStartLineCap, "Square");
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.StrokeEndLineCap, "Square");
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void WriteLineStart(XamlWriter writer, XamlLineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Style);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.x, XamlAttribute.Key, lineStyle.Name);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.TargetType, XamlNames.TargetTypeLine);
			writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.Stroke, lineStyle.Stroke);
			writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.StrokeThickness, lineStyle.StrokeThickness);
		}

		private static void WriteTextBlockStyles(XamlWriter writer, IEnumerable<XamlTextBlockStyle> textBlockStyles, XamlCompatibility compatibility, TextMeasurementSystem textMeasurementSystem)
		{
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (XamlTextBlockStyle textBlockStyle in textBlockStyles)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Style);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.x, XamlAttribute.Key, textBlockStyle.Name);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.TargetType, XamlNames.TargetTypeTextBlock);
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.FontFamily, ResolveFontFamilyName(textBlockStyle.Font));
				WriteFontSetters(writer, textBlockStyle);
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.Foreground, textBlockStyle.Foreground);
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.TextAlignment, GetTextHorizontalAlignment(textBlockStyle.TextAlignment, compatibility));
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.VerticalAlignment, GetVerticalAlignment(textBlockStyle.TextAlignment));
				if (textMeasurementSystem == TextMeasurementSystem.NativeXpf)
				{
					writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.TextWrapping, textBlockStyle.WrapText ? XamlNames.TextWrappingWrap : XamlNames.TextWrappingNoWrap);
				}
				if (textBlockStyle.StringTrimming != DXStringTrimming.None)
				{
					string textTrimming = GetTextTrimming(textBlockStyle.StringTrimming);
					if (textTrimming != XamlNames.TextTrimmingNone)
					{
						writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.TextTrimming, textTrimming);
					}
				}
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static string ResolveFontFamilyName(DXFont font)
		{
			return FontResolver.ResolveEnglishFamilyName(font);
		}

		internal static Stream GetCheckBoxTemplatesResourceStream()
		{
			return ResourceStreamHelper.GetStream("Native.CheckBoxTemplates.xaml", typeof(ResFinder));
		}

		private static void WriteCheckBoxTemplates(XamlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.ResourceDictionaryMergedDictionaries);
			using (Stream stream = GetCheckBoxTemplatesResourceStream())
			{
				using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
				writer.WriteRaw(streamReader.ReadToEnd());
			}
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static void WriteLineStyles(XamlWriter writer, IEnumerable<XamlLineStyle> lineStyles)
		{
			foreach (XamlLineStyle lineStyle in lineStyles)
			{
				WriteLineStyle(writer, lineStyle);
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void WriteLineStyle(XamlWriter writer, XamlLineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Style);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.x, XamlAttribute.Key, lineStyle.Name);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.TargetType, XamlNames.TargetTypeLine);
			writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.Stroke, lineStyle.Stroke);
			writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.StrokeThickness, lineStyle.StrokeThickness);
		}

		private static void WriteImageResources(XamlWriter writer, IEnumerable<ImageResource> imageResources, bool shouldWriteConverterResource, XamlCompatibility compatibility, bool embedImagesToXaml)
		{
			foreach (ImageResource imageResource in imageResources)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlNsPrefix.system, XamlTag.String, "clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib");
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.x, XamlAttribute.Key, imageResource.Name);
				writer.WriteValue(GetBase64StringForImage(imageResource.Image));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
			if (shouldWriteConverterResource)
			{
				if (embedImagesToXaml)
				{
					writer.WriteStartElement(XamlNsPrefix.dxpn, XamlTag.Base64StringImageConverter, "http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/printingcore/xtraprinting/native/presentation");
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.x, XamlAttribute.Key, "embeddedImageConverter");
					writer.WriteEndElement();
				}
				if (compatibility == XamlCompatibility.WPF)
				{
					writer.WriteStartElement(XamlNsPrefix.dxpn, XamlTag.RepositoryImageConverter, "http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/printingcore/xtraprinting/native/presentation");
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.x, XamlAttribute.Key, "repositoryImageConverter");
					writer.WriteEndElement();
				}
			}
		}

		private static string GetBase64StringForImage(DXImage image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return Convert.ToBase64String(DXImageHelper.GetImageBytes(image, DXImageFormat.Png));
		}

		private static void WriteFontSetters(XamlWriter writer, XamlTextBlockStyle textBlockStyle)
		{
			float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(textBlockStyle.Font.Size, GraphicsUnit.Point, GraphicsUnit.Document);
			writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.FontSize, GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(num));
			if (textBlockStyle.Font.Bold)
			{
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.FontWeight, XamlNames.FontBold);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.FontWeight, XamlNames.FontNormal);
			}
			if (textBlockStyle.Font.Italic)
			{
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.FontStyle, XamlNames.FontItalic);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.FontStyle, XamlNames.FontNormal);
			}
			if (textBlockStyle.Font.Strikeout && textBlockStyle.Font.Underline)
			{
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.TextDecorations, $"{XamlNames.FontStrikethrough},{XamlNames.FontUnderline}");
				return;
			}
			if (textBlockStyle.Font.Strikeout)
			{
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.TextDecorations, XamlNames.FontStrikethrough);
			}
			if (textBlockStyle.Font.Underline)
			{
				writer.WriteSetter(XamlAttribute.TextDecorations, XamlNames.FontUnderline);
			}
		}

		private static string GetTextTrimming(DXStringTrimming stringTrimming)
		{
			return stringTrimming switch
			{
				DXStringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter => XamlNames.TextTrimmingCharacterEllipsis, 
				DXStringTrimming.EllipsisWord => XamlNames.TextTrimmingWordEllipsis, 
				_ => XamlNames.TextTrimmingNone, 
			};
		}

		private static string MapTextAlignmentToHorizontalAlignment(TextAlignment textAlignment)

		protected virtual string GetText(TextBrick brick, PrintingSystemBase ps, Page drawingPage, TextMeasurementSystem textMeasurementSystem)
		{
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string text = ((VisualBrick)brick).Text;

			{
				if (brick is LabelBrick && ((LabelBrick)brick).Angle != 0f)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && !brick.StringFormat.FormatFlags.HasFlag(DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces))
					{
						return text.TrimEnd(' ');
					}
					return text;
				}

				float num = Math.Max(0f, ((PaddingInfo)(ref padding)).DeflateWidth(((BrickBase)brick).Width, 300f));
				GdiPlusMeasurer val = new GdiPlusMeasurer();

				{
					TextFormatter val2 = TextFormatter.CreateInstance(DXGraphicsUnit.Document, (IMeasurer)(object)val);
					string[] value = val2.FormatMultilineText(text, brick.Font, num, float.MaxValue, brick.StringFormat.Value);
					return string.Join(Environment.NewLine, value);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void WriteDashedBorder(XamlWriter writer, XamlExportContext exportContext, VisualBrick visualBrick)

		private static void WriteLine(XamlWriter writer, XamlExportContext exportContext, VisualBrick visualBrick, PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Line);
			if (exportContext.ResourceMap.BorderDashStylesDictionary.ContainsKey(visualBrick))
			{
				string arg = exportContext.ResourceMap.BorderDashStylesDictionary[visualBrick];
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Style, $"{{StaticResource {arg}}}");
			}
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.X1, startPoint.X);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.X2, endPoint.X);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Y1, startPoint.Y);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Y2, endPoint.Y);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.StrokeDashArray, VisualBrick.GetDashPattern(visualBrick.Style.BorderDashStyle));
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.CanvasZIndex, 1f);
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static void WriteAttachedValues(XamlWriter writer, XamlExportContext exportContext, VisualBrick visualBrick)
		{
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.dxpn, XamlAttribute.VisualHelperIsVisualBrickBorder, true.ToString());
			WriteTagAttribute(writer, exportContext, visualBrick);
			if (((Brick)visualBrick).Value != null && !((Brick)visualBrick).Value.Equals(string.Empty))
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.dxpn, XamlAttribute.PreviewClickHelperTag, string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", new object[1] { ((Brick)visualBrick).Value }));
			}
			if (visualBrick.NavigationPair != BrickPagePair.Empty)
			{
				string tagByIndices = DocumentMapTreeViewNodeHelper.GetTagByIndices(visualBrick.NavigationBrickIndices, visualBrick.NavigationPageIndex);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.dxpn, XamlAttribute.PreviewClickHelperNavigationPair, tagByIndices);
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((Brick)visualBrick).GetActualUrl()))
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlNsPrefix.dxpn, XamlAttribute.PreviewClickHelperUrl, ((Brick)visualBrick).GetActualUrl());
			}
		}
	}
	public static class BrickXamlExporterFactory
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<string, Type> exportersHashTable;

		static BrickXamlExporterFactory()
		{
			exportersHashTable = new Dictionary<string, Type>();
			RegisterDefaultExporters();
		}

		public static BrickXamlExporterBase CreateExporter(BrickBase brick)
		{
			return CreateExporter(((object)brick).GetType());
		}

		public static BrickXamlExporterBase CreateExporter(Type brickType)
		{
			if (exportersHashTable.TryGetValue(brickType.FullName, out var value) && Activator.CreateInstance(value) is BrickXamlExporterBase result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (!(DXTypeExtensions.GetBaseType(brickType) == null))
			{
				return CreateExporter(DXTypeExtensions.GetBaseType(brickType));
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static void RegisterExporter(Type brickType, Type exporterType)
		{
			RegisterExporter(brickType.FullName, exporterType);
		}

		public static void RegisterExporter(string brickTypeName, Type exporterType)
		{
			exportersHashTable[brickTypeName] = exporterType;
		}

		private static void RegisterDefaultExporters()
		{
			RegisterExporter<TextBrick, TextBrickXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<BrickContainerBase, BrickContainerBaseXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<BrickContainer, BrickContainerXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<CompositeBrick, CompositeBrickXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<PanelBrick, PanelBrickXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<Page, PageXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<LineBrick, LineBrickXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<CheckBoxBrick, CheckBoxBrickXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<PageInfoTextBrick, PageInfoTextBrickXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<ImageBrick, ImageBrickXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter<VisualBrick, BrickImageXamlExporter>();
			RegisterExporter("DevExpress.XtraPrinting.RichTextBrickBase", typeof(RichTextBrickXamlExporter));
			RegisterExporter<SeparableBrick, PanelBrickXamlExporter>();
		}

		private static void RegisterExporter<T, V>()
		{
			RegisterExporter(typeof(T), typeof(V));
		}
	}

	{
		public XamlWriter Writer { get; private set; }

		public DeclareNamespacesEventArgs(XamlWriter writer)
		{
			Writer = writer;
		}
	}
	public static class FontResolver
	{
		public class FamilyNameResolvedEventArgs : EventArgs
		{
			public string FamilyName { get; set; }

			public FamilyNameResolvedEventArgs(string familyName)
			{
				FamilyName = familyName;
			}
		}

		public static event EventHandler<FamilyNameResolvedEventArgs> FamilyNameResolved;

		internal static string ResolveFamilyName(DXFont font)
		{
			string familyName = font.Name;
			RaiseFamilyNameResolved(ref familyName);
			return familyName;
		}

		internal static string ResolveEnglishFamilyName(DXFont font)
		{
			string familyName = font.Name;
			RaiseFamilyNameResolved(ref familyName);
			return familyName;
		}

		private static void RaiseFamilyNameResolved(ref string familyName)
		{
			if (FontResolver.FamilyNameResolved != null)
			{
				FamilyNameResolvedEventArgs e = new FamilyNameResolvedEventArgs(familyName);
				FontResolver.FamilyNameResolved(null, e);
				familyName = e.FamilyName;
			}
		}
	}

	{

	public class ImageResource : XamlResourceBase
	{
		private DXImage image;

		public DXImage Image => image;

		public ImageResource(DXImage image)
		{
			this.image = image;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ImageResource imageResource))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("obj");
			}
			if (image == null)
			{
				return imageResource.Image == null;
			}
			if (imageResource.Image == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			lock (image)
			{
				lock (imageResource)
				{
					return imageResource.Image.Size == image.Size && imageResource.Image == image;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Image.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class ResourceCache
	{
		private const string watermarkResourceName = "Watermark";

		private Collection<XamlBorderStyle> borderStyles = new Collection<XamlBorderStyle>();

		private Collection<XamlLineStyle> borderDashStyles = new Collection<XamlLineStyle>();

		private Collection<XamlTextBlockStyle> textBlockStyles = new Collection<XamlTextBlockStyle>();

		private Collection<XamlLineStyle> lineStyles = new Collection<XamlLineStyle>();

		private Collection<ImageResource> imageResources = new Collection<ImageResource>();

		public IEnumerable<XamlBorderStyle> BorderStyles => borderStyles;

		public IEnumerable<XamlLineStyle> BorderDashStyles => borderDashStyles;

		public IEnumerable<XamlTextBlockStyle> TextBlockStyles => textBlockStyles;

		public IEnumerable<XamlLineStyle> LineStyles => lineStyles;

		public IEnumerable<ImageResource> ImageResources => imageResources;

		public string RegisterBorderStyle(XamlBorderStyle style)
		{
			return RegisterResourceCore(style, borderStyles, GenerateBorderStyleName);
		}

		public string RegisterBorderDashStyle(XamlLineStyle style)
		{
			return RegisterResourceCore(style, borderDashStyles, GenerateBorderDashStyleName);
		}

		public string RegisterTextBlockStyle(XamlTextBlockStyle style)
		{
			return RegisterResourceCore(style, textBlockStyles, GenerateTextBlockStyleName);
		}

		public string RegisterLineStyle(XamlLineStyle style)
		{
			return RegisterResourceCore(style, lineStyles, GenerateLineStyleName);
		}

		public string RegisterImageResource(ImageResource resource)
		{
			return RegisterResourceCore(resource, imageResources, GenerateImageName);
		}

		private static string RegisterResourceCore<T>(T resource, Collection<T> resourceCollection, Func<string> generateStyleName) where T : XamlResourceBase
		{
			string text;
			if (!resourceCollection.Contains(resource))
			{
				text = generateStyleName();
				resource.SetName(text);
				resourceCollection.Add(resource);
			}
			else
			{
				text = resourceCollection[resourceCollection.IndexOf(resource)].Name;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public string RegisterWatermarkImageResource(ImageResource resource)
		{
			imageResources.Add(resource);
			resource.SetName("Watermark");
			return "Watermark";
		}

		private string GenerateBorderStyleName()
		{
			return $"BorderStyle{borderStyles.Count + 1}";
		}

		private string GenerateBorderDashStyleName()
		{
			return $"BorderDashStyle{borderDashStyles.Count + 1}";
		}

		private string GenerateTextBlockStyleName()
		{
			return $"TextBlockStyle{textBlockStyles.Count + 1}";
		}

		private string GenerateLineStyleName()
		{
			return $"LineStyle{lineStyles.Count + 1}";
		}

		private string GenerateImageName()
		{
			return $"Image{imageResources.Count + 1}";
		}
	}

	internal static class WatermarkXamlExporter
	{
		private const int showOnTopZIndex = 1;

		public static void WriteToXaml(XamlWriter writer, Page page, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			WriteWatermarkToXaml(writer, page, exportContext, page.ActualWatermark);
		}

		private static void WriteWatermarkToXaml(XamlWriter writer, Page page, XamlExportContext exportContext, PageWatermark wm)
		{
			if (wm != null)
			{
				if (ContainsImage(wm))
				{
					WriteImageWatermark(writer, page, exportContext, wm);
				}
				if (ContainsText(wm))
				{
					WriteTextWatermark(writer, page, wm, exportContext);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void WriteImageWatermark(XamlWriter writer, Page page, XamlExportContext exportContext, PageWatermark wm)
		{
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0192: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0198: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_026a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (exportContext.ResourceMap.ImageResourcesDictionary.ContainsKey((BrickBase)(object)page) && (!wm.ImageTiling || !exportContext.IsPartialTrustMode))
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Border);
				if (!wm.ShowBehind)
				{
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.CanvasZIndex, 1f);
				}
				SizeF watermarkAreaSize = GetWatermarkAreaSize(page, exportContext);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Width, watermarkAreaSize.Width);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Height, watermarkAreaSize.Height);
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Image);
				SizeF sizeF = (((int)wm.ImageViewMode == 0 && !wm.ImageTiling) ? wm.ImageSource.GetImageSize(false) : watermarkAreaSize);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Width, sizeF.Width);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Height, sizeF.Height);
				if (exportContext.Compatibility == XamlCompatibility.WPF)
				{
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.RenderOptionsBitmapScalingMode, XamlNames.Fant);
				}
				string value = exportContext.ResourceMap.ImageResourcesDictionary[(BrickBase)(object)page];
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Source, value);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Margin, GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Left), GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Top), GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Right), GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Bottom));
				if (wm.ImageTransparency != 0 && !wm.ImageTiling)
				{
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Opacity, MapTransparencyToOpacity(wm.ImageTransparency));
				}
				if ((int)wm.ImageViewMode != 2)
				{
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.VerticalAlignment, MapContentAlignmentToVerticalAlignment(wm.ImageAlign));
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.HorizontalAlignment, MapContentAlignmentToHorizontalAlignment(wm.ImageAlign));
				}
				if (wm.ImageTiling)
				{
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Stretch, MapImageViewModeToStretch((ImageViewMode)1));
					writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.ImageEffect);
					writer.WriteStartElement(XamlNsPrefix.dxpn, XamlTag.TileEffect, "http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/printingcore/xtraprinting/native/presentation");
					SizeF watermarkImageSize = GetWatermarkImageSize(page, exportContext);
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.TileCount, watermarkAreaSize.Width / watermarkImageSize.Width, watermarkAreaSize.Height / watermarkImageSize.Height);
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Opacity, MapTransparencyToOpacity(wm.ImageTransparency));
					writer.WriteEndElement();
					writer.WriteEndElement();
				}
				else
				{
					writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Stretch, MapImageViewModeToStretch(wm.ImageViewMode));
				}
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void WriteTextWatermark(XamlWriter writer, Page page, PageWatermark wm, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Border);
			SizeF watermarkAreaSize = GetWatermarkAreaSize(page, exportContext);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.MinWidth, watermarkAreaSize.Width);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.MinHeight, watermarkAreaSize.Height);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.MaxWidth, watermarkAreaSize.Width);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.MaxHeight, watermarkAreaSize.Height);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Margin, GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Left), GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Top), GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Right), GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Bottom));
			if (!wm.ShowBehind)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.CanvasZIndex, 1f);
			}
			writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.TextBlock);
			if (wm.TextTransparency != 0)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Opacity, MapTransparencyToOpacity(wm.TextTransparency));
			}
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Text, wm.Text);
			WriteFontAttributes(writer, wm);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.FontFamily, FontResolver.ResolveFamilyName(wm.Font));
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Foreground, wm.ForeColor);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.VerticalAlignment, MapContentAlignmentToVerticalAlignment(ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter));
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.HorizontalAlignment, MapContentAlignmentToHorizontalAlignment(ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter));
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.RenderTransformOrigin, 0.5f, 0.5f);
			WriteRotateTransform(writer, wm);
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static void WriteRotateTransform(XamlWriter writer, PageWatermark wm)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)wm.TextDirection != 0)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.TextBlockRenderTransform);
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.TransformGroup);
				writer.WriteStartElement(XamlTag.RotateTransform);
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Angle, GetRotationAngle(wm.TextDirection));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static int GetRotationAngle(DirectionMode directionMode)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)directionMode switch
			{
				2 => 50, 
				1 => 310, 
				0 => 0, 
				4 => 270, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("directionMode"), 
			};
		}

		private static bool ContainsImage(PageWatermark wm)
		{
			return !ImageSource.IsNullOrEmpty(wm.ImageSource);
		}

		private static bool ContainsText(PageWatermark wm)
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(wm.Text);
		}

		private static SizeF GetWatermarkAreaSize(Page page, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			SizeF result = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(page.PageSize);
			result.Width -= GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Left) + GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Right);
			result.Height -= GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Top) + GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(((MarginsFBase)page.PageData.MinMarginsF).Bottom);
			return result;
		}

		private static string MapImageViewModeToStretch(ImageViewMode imageWatermarkMode)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)imageWatermarkMode switch
			{
				0 => XamlNames.StretchFill, 
				2 => XamlNames.StretchUniform, 
				1 => XamlNames.StretchFill, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("imageWatermarkMode"), 
			};
		}

		private static string MapContentAlignmentToVerticalAlignment(ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case ContentAlignment.TopLeft:
			case ContentAlignment.TopCenter:
			case ContentAlignment.TopRight:
				return XamlNames.AlignmentTop;
			case ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft:
			case ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter:
			case ContentAlignment.MiddleRight:
				return XamlNames.AlignmentCenter;
			case ContentAlignment.BottomLeft:
			case ContentAlignment.BottomCenter:
			case ContentAlignment.BottomRight:
				return XamlNames.AlignmentBottom;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("alignment");
			}
		}

		private static string MapContentAlignmentToHorizontalAlignment(ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case ContentAlignment.TopLeft:
			case ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft:
			case ContentAlignment.BottomLeft:
				return XamlNames.AlignmentLeft;
			case ContentAlignment.TopCenter:
			case ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter:
			case ContentAlignment.BottomCenter:
				return XamlNames.AlignmentCenter;
			case ContentAlignment.TopRight:
			case ContentAlignment.MiddleRight:
			case ContentAlignment.BottomRight:
				return XamlNames.AlignmentRight;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("alignment");
			}
		}

		private static SizeF GetWatermarkImageSize(Page page, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			PageWatermark actualWatermark = page.ActualWatermark;
			ImageViewMode imageViewMode = actualWatermark.ImageViewMode;
			return (int)imageViewMode switch
			{
				0 => actualWatermark.ImageSource.GetImageSize(false), 
				1 => GetWatermarkAreaSize(page, exportContext), 
				2 => CalculateWatermarkImageSizeInZoomMode(page, exportContext), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("page"), 
			};
		}

		private static SizeF CalculateWatermarkImageSizeInZoomMode(Page page, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			SizeF watermarkAreaSize = GetWatermarkAreaSize(page, exportContext);
			SizeF imageSize = page.ActualWatermark.ImageSource.GetImageSize(false);
			float num = watermarkAreaSize.Width / imageSize.Width;
			float num2 = watermarkAreaSize.Height / imageSize.Height;
			if (num > num2)
			{
				return new SizeF(imageSize.Width * num2, watermarkAreaSize.Height);
			}
			return new SizeF(watermarkAreaSize.Width, imageSize.Height * num);
		}

		private static void WriteFontAttributes(XamlWriter writer, PageWatermark wm)
		{
			float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(wm.Font.Size, GraphicsUnit.Point, GraphicsUnit.Document);
			writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.FontSize, GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(num));
			if (wm.Font.Bold)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.FontWeight, XamlNames.FontBold);
			}
			if (wm.Font.Italic)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.FontStyle, XamlNames.FontItalic);
			}
			if (wm.Font.Strikeout && wm.Font.Underline)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.TextDecorations, XamlNames.FontStrikethrough + "," + XamlNames.FontUnderline);
				return;
			}
			if (wm.Font.Strikeout)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.TextDecorations, XamlNames.FontStrikethrough);
			}
			if (wm.Font.Underline)
			{
				writer.WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.TextDecorations, XamlNames.FontUnderline);
			}
		}

		private static float MapTransparencyToOpacity(int transparency)
		{
			return 1f - (float)transparency / 255f;
		}
	}

	public class XamlBorderStyle : XamlResourceBase
	{
		private float borderWidth;

		private System.Drawing.Color borderBrush;

		private BorderSide sides;

		private System.Drawing.Color backColor;

		private PaddingInfo padding;

		public float BorderWidth => borderWidth;

		public System.Drawing.Color BorderBrush => borderBrush;

		public BorderSide Sides => sides;

		public System.Drawing.Color BackColor => backColor;

		public PaddingInfo Padding => padding;

		public XamlBorderStyle(float borderWidth, System.Drawing.Color borderBrush, BorderSide sides, System.Drawing.Color backColor, PaddingInfo padding)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.borderWidth = borderWidth;
			this.borderBrush = borderBrush;
			this.sides = sides;
			this.backColor = backColor;
			this.padding = padding;
		}

	public class XamlExporter
	{

		private PrintingSystemBase currentPrintingSystem;

		public event EventHandler<ImageResolveEventArgs> ImageResolve;

		public event EventHandler<DeclareNamespacesEventArgs> DeclareNamespaces;

		public event EventHandler<WriteCustomPropertiesEventArgs> WriteCustomProperties;

		public XamlExporter()
		{
			EmbedImagesToXaml = true;
		}

		public void Export(Stream stream, Page page, int pageNumber, int pageCount, XamlCompatibility compatibility, TextMeasurementSystem textMeasurementSystem)
		{
			using (XamlWriter xamlWriter = new XamlWriter(stream))
			{
				XamlExportContext exportContext = new XamlExportContext(page, pageNumber, pageCount, new ResourceCache(), new ResourceMap(), compatibility, textMeasurementSystem, IsPartialTrustMode, EmbedImagesToXaml);
				if (page.Document != null)
				{
					currentPrintingSystem = page.Document.PrintingSystem;
				}
				CollectStyles((BrickBase)(object)page, exportContext);
				RectangleF clipRect = new RectangleF(0f, 0f, ((BrickBase)page).Rect.X + ((BrickBase)page).Rect.Width, page.PageData.PageSize.Height);
				WriteBricks(xamlWriter, (BrickBase)(object)page, exportContext, ((BrickBase)page).Location, clipRect, RectangleF.Empty);
				xamlWriter.Flush();
			}
			if (EmbedImagesToXaml && currentPrintingSystem != null)
			{
				((ObjectContainer<object, DXImage>)(object)currentPrintingSystem.GarbageImages).Clear();
			}
			currentPrintingSystem = null;
		}

		private string ResolveImage(DXImage image)
		{
			if (this.ImageResolve != null && image != null)
			{
				ImageResolveEventArgs e = new ImageResolveEventArgs(image);
				this.ImageResolve(this, e);
				return e.Uri;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void RaiseDeclareNamespaces(XamlWriter writer)
		{
			if (this.DeclareNamespaces != null)
			{
				this.DeclareNamespaces(this, new DeclareNamespacesEventArgs(writer));
			}
		}

		private void RaiseWriteCustomProperties(XamlWriter writer, object obj)
		{
			if (this.WriteCustomProperties != null)
			{
				this.WriteCustomProperties(this, new WriteCustomPropertiesEventArgs(writer, obj));
			}
		}

		private void CollectStyles(BrickBase brick, XamlExportContext exportContext)
		{
			RegisterBorderStyle(brick, exportContext);
			RegisterTextBlockStyle(brick, exportContext);
			RegisterLineStyle(brick, exportContext);
			RegisterImage(brick, exportContext);
			exportContext.ResourceMap.ShouldAddCheckBoxTemplates = exportContext.ResourceMap.ShouldAddCheckBoxTemplates || brick is CheckBoxBrick;
			foreach (Brick innerBrick in GetInnerBricks(brick))
			{
				CollectStyles((BrickBase)(object)innerBrick, exportContext);
			}
		}

		private void WriteBricks(XamlWriter writer, BrickBase brickBase, XamlExportContext exportContext, PointF offset, RectangleF clipRect, RectangleF exportBrickClipRect)
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			}
			brickXamlExporterBase?.WriteEndTags(writer);
		}

	{
		private const string defaultFormatString = "{0}";

		private const string argbColorFormatString = "#{0:X8}";

		private XmlWriter writer;

		private bool disposed;

		public XamlWriter(Stream output)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)output, "output");
			XmlWriterSettings settings = new XmlWriterSettings
			{
				OmitXmlDeclaration = true,
				Indent = true
			};
			writer = XmlWriter.Create(output, settings);
		}

		public void WriteStartElement(string tag)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
		}

		public void WriteStartElement(string tag, string ns)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement(tag, ns);
		}

		public void WriteStartElement(string prefix, string tag, string ns)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement(prefix, tag, ns);
		}

		public void WriteEndElement()
		{
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public void WriteValue(string value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			writer.WriteValue(value);
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string prefix, string attribute, RectangleF value)
		{
			WriteAttribute(prefix, attribute, value.X, value.Y, value.Width, value.Height);
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string prefix, string attribute, params float[] values)
		{
			string value = JoinItemsToString(values);
			WriteAttribute(prefix, attribute, value);
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string prefix, string attribute, System.Drawing.Color value)
		{
			string value2 = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "#{0:X8}", new object[1] { value.ToArgb() });
			WriteAttribute(prefix, attribute, value2);
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string prefix, string attribute, string value)
		{
			writer.WriteAttributeString(prefix, attribute, null, value);
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string attribute, RectangleF value)
		{
			WriteAttribute(attribute, value.X, value.Y, value.Width, value.Height);
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string attribute, params float[] values)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)values, "values");
			string value = JoinItemsToString(values);
			WriteAttribute(attribute, value);
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string attribute, string value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			WriteAttributeCore(attribute, "{0}", value);
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string attribute, float value)
		{
			WriteAttributeCore(attribute, "{0}", value);
		}

		public void WriteAttribute(string attribute, System.Drawing.Color value)
		{
			WriteAttributeCore(attribute, "#{0:X8}", value.ToArgb());
		}

		private void WriteAttributeCore(string attribute, string format, object value)
		{
			string text = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, format, new object[1] { value });
			if (attribute == XamlAttribute.Text && text.Length > 0 && text[0] == '{')
			{
				text = "{}" + text;
			}
			string value2 = RemoveInvalidXmlCharacters(text);
			writer.WriteAttributeString(attribute, value2);
		}

		public void WriteNamespace(string prefix, string value)
		{
			writer.WriteAttributeString("xmlns", prefix, null, value);
		}

		public void WriteSetter(string attribute, string value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			WriteSetterCore(attribute, "{0}", value);
		}

		public void WriteSetter(string attribute, float value)
		{
			WriteSetterCore(attribute, "{0}", value);
		}

		public void WriteSetter(string attribute, System.Drawing.Color value)
		{
			WriteSetterCore(attribute, "#{0:X8}", value.ToArgb());
		}

		public void WriteSetter(string attribute, params float[] values)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)values, "values");
			string value = JoinItemsToString(values);
			WriteSetterCore(attribute, "{0}", value);
		}

		public void WriteRaw(string data)
		{
			writer.WriteRaw(data);
		}

		private void WriteSetterCore(string attribute, string format, object value)
		{
			WriteStartElement(XamlTag.Setter);
			WriteAttribute(XamlAttribute.Property, attribute);
			WriteAttributeCore(XamlAttribute.Value, format, value);
			WriteEndElement();
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			writer.Flush();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposed)
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					writer.Close();
					writer = null;
				}
				disposed = true;
			}
		}

		private static string JoinItemsToString<T>(IEnumerable<T> items) where T : IConvertible
		{
			IEnumerable<string> values = items.Select((T value) => value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			return string.Join(",", values);
		}

		private static string RemoveInvalidXmlCharacters(string text)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Concat(text.Where((char ch) => XmlConvert.IsXmlChar(ch)));
		}
	}
}

	internal static class BrickResolver
	{
		static BrickResolver()
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BrickFactory.BrickResolve += new BrickResolveEventHandler(BrickFactory_BrickResolve);
		}

		public static void EnsureStaticConstructor()
		{
		}

		private static void BrickFactory_BrickResolve(object sender, BrickResolveEventArgs args)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (args.Brick != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string name = ((ResolveEventArgs)(object)args).Name;
			if (!(name == "RichText"))
			{
				if (name == "FormattedRichText")
				{
					args.Brick = (Brick)new FormattedRichTextBrick();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				args.Brick = (Brick)new RichTextBrick();
			}
		}
	}

	public static class ImageRepository
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, ImageSource>> items;

		static ImageRepository()
		{
			items = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, ImageSource>>();
		}

		public static void RegisterImageSource(string psId, string imageId, ImageSource imageSource)
		{
			if (!items.ContainsKey(psId))
			{
				items.Add(psId, new Dictionary<string, ImageSource>());
			}
			if (items[psId].ContainsKey(imageId))
			{
				items[psId].Remove(imageId);
			}
			items[psId].Add(imageId, imageSource);
		}

		public static ImageSource GetImageSource(string psId, string imageId)
		{
			if (!items.ContainsKey(psId) || !items[psId].ContainsKey(imageId))
			{
				throw new KeyNotFoundException("ImageSource with such ID doesn't registered in ImageRepository");
			}
			return items[psId][imageId];
		}

		public static void Clear(string psId)
		{
			if (items.ContainsKey(psId) && items[psId].Count != 0)
			{
				items[psId].Clear();
				items.Remove(psId);
			}
		}
	}

	{

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TagProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Tag", typeof(string), typeof(PreviewClickHelper), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UrlProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Url", typeof(string), typeof(PreviewClickHelper), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnUrlChanged));

		public static string GetNavigationPair(DependencyObject obj)

		}

		public static void SetNavigationPair(DependencyObject obj, string value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(NavigationPairProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnNavigationPairChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			string value = (string)e.NewValue;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				frameworkElement.Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Hand;
			}
		}

		public static string GetTag(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (string)obj.GetValue(TagProperty);
		}

		public static void SetTag(DependencyObject obj, string value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(TagProperty, value);
		}

		public static string GetUrl(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (string)obj.GetValue(UrlProperty);
		}

		public static void SetUrl(DependencyObject obj, string value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(UrlProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnUrlChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			string url = (string)e.NewValue;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(url) && string.Compare(url, "empty", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) != 0)
			{
				frameworkElement.Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Hand;
				frameworkElement.MouseLeftButtonUp += delegate
				{
					NavigateToUrl(url);
				};
			}
		}

		private static void NavigateToUrl(string url)
		{
			ProcessLaunchHelper.Start(url);
		}
	}

	public class Base64StringImageConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!targetType.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(BitmapSource)))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Not supported target type: " + targetType);
			}
			if (value == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value as string))
			{
				return null;
			}
			byte[] buffer = System.Convert.FromBase64String((string)value);
			BitmapImage bitmapImage = new BitmapImage();
			using MemoryStream streamSource = new MemoryStream(buffer);
			bitmapImage.BeginInit();
			bitmapImage.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
			bitmapImage.StreamSource = streamSource;
			bitmapImage.EndInit();
			bitmapImage.Freeze();
			return bitmapImage;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}

	public class RepositoryImageConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(parameter is string text))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("parameter");
			}
			string[] array = text.Split('_');
			string psId = array[0];
			string imageId = array[1];
			return ImageRepository.GetImageSource(psId, imageId);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		{
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			gridControl.BeginInit();
			((Collection<GridColumn>)(object)gridControl.Columns).Add(new GridColumn
			{
				FieldName = "Item"
			});

			{

				.RegisterReadOnly<PrintOptions>("PrintOptions", ref PrintOptionsPropertyKey, ref PrintOptionsProperty, (PrintOptions)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("PrintOptionsTemplate", ref PrintOptionsTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowPreview", ref ShowPreviewProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowPrintSettings", ref ShowPrintSettingsProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("CustomSettings", ref CustomSettingsProperty, (object)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("CustomSettingsTemplate", ref CustomSettingsTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("EnableContinuousScrolling", ref EnableContinuousScrollingProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("StatusBarTemplate", ref StatusBarTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("ZoomFactor", ref ZoomFactorProperty, 1.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ZoomMode>("ZoomMode", ref ZoomModeProperty, ZoomMode.PageLevel, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.UseIndependentThemeStyleKey<BackstagePrintPreview>();
		}

		public BackstagePrintPreview()
		{
			SetActualPreview(this, this);
			PrintCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(Print, CanPrint);
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			preview = GetTemplateChild("PART_Preview") as DocumentPreviewControl;
			AttachPreview(preview);
		}

		internal void AttachPreview(DocumentPreviewControl preview)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)preview, "preview");
			UnsubscribePreview();
			SubscribePreview();
			PrintOptions = CreatePrintOptionsInternal();
			PrintOptions.CurrentPageNumber = preview.CurrentPageNumber;
			if (preview.Document.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.IsLoaded, () => false))
			{
				PrintOptions.SetDocumentModel(preview.Document);
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribePreview()
		{
			preview.Do(delegate(DocumentPreviewControl x)
			{
				x.DocumentChanged -= OnDocumentChanged;
				x.DocumentLoaded -= OnDocumentLoaded;
				x.CurrentPageNumberChanged -= OnPreviewCurrentPageNumberChanged;
			});
		}

		private void SubscribePreview()
		{
			preview.Do(delegate(DocumentPreviewControl x)
			{
				x.DocumentChanged += OnDocumentChanged;
				x.DocumentLoaded += OnDocumentLoaded;
				x.CurrentPageNumberChanged += OnPreviewCurrentPageNumberChanged;
			});
		}

		private PrintOptions CreatePrintOptionsInternal()
		{
			return ViewModelSource.Create(GetPrintOptionsConstructorExpression());
		}

		protected virtual Expression<Func<PrintOptions>> GetPrintOptionsConstructorExpression()
		{
			return () => new PrintOptions();
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UnsubscribePreview();
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SubscribePreview();
		}

		private void OnDocumentLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			PrintOptions.Do(delegate(PrintOptions options)
			{
				options.SetDocumentModel(preview.Document);
			});
		}

		private void OnDocumentChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			PrintOptions.Do(delegate(PrintOptions options)
			{
				options.SetDocumentModel(preview.Document);
			});
		}

		private void OnPreviewCurrentPageNumberChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			PrintOptions.Do(delegate(PrintOptions x)
			{
				x.CurrentPageNumber = preview.CurrentPageNumber;
			});
		}

		private void Print()
		{
			PrintOptions.SavePrinterSettings();
			new DocumentPublishEngine(preview.Document.PrintingSystem).Print((PrintDocument)(object)PrintOptions.PrintDocument);
		}

		private bool CanPrint()
		{
			return PrintOptions.Return((PrintOptions x) => x.IsValid, () => false);
		}
	}
	public class PrintOptions : BindableBase, IPrintForm, IDataErrorInfo
	{
		private PrintDocument printDocument;

		private readonly PrinterSettings printerSettings;

		{
			get
			{
				if (!AvailablePrinters.Any())
				{
					return AvailablePrinters.Contains(SelectedPrinter);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldUpdatePageSettings
		{
			get
			{
				System.Drawing.Size size = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(new System.Drawing.Size(SelectedPaperSize.Width, SelectedPaperSize.Height), 100f, 300f);
				if (!(DocumentModel.PageSettings.PageSize != size) && DocumentModel.PageSettings.Landscape == Landscape)
				{
					if (!(SelectedPageMargins != null))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return DocumentModel.PageSettings.Margins != SelectedPageMargins.Margins;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

				this.RaisePropertyChanged((PrintOptions x) => x.AllowCustomPageRange);

		public bool AllowCollate => Copies > 1;
