		string IDataErrorInfo.Error
		{
			get
			{
				if (PrintRange != PrintRange.SomePages)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return PrintOptionsHelper.ValidatePageRange(CustomPageRange, PrinterSettings.MaximumPage);
			}
		}

		public bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (PrinterIsValid && PrintDocument != null && AllowEditOptions)
				{
					return string.IsNullOrEmpty(((IDataErrorInfo)this).Error);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		string IDataErrorInfo.this[string columnName]
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnName == ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName(() => CustomPageRange) && PrintRange == PrintRange.SomePages)
				{
					return PrintOptionsHelper.ValidatePageRange(CustomPageRange, PrinterSettings.MaximumPage);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public PrintOptions()
			: this(PrintOptionsHelper.CreatePrinterSettings())
		{
		}

		public PrintOptions(PrinterSettings printerSettings)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.printerSettings = printerSettings;
			printDocument = new PrintDocument
			{
				PrinterSettings = printerSettings
			};
			controller = new PrintEditorController(this);
			controller.LoadForm(printerItemContainer);
			preferencesCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(ShowPreferences, CanShowPreferences);
			paperSizeCollection = PrinterSettings.PaperSizes.ToDXPaperSizeCollection();
		}

		internal void SetDocumentModel(DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel documentModel)
		{
			UnhookDocument();
			DocumentModel = documentModel;
			Initialize();
			HookDocument();
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			if (AllowEditOptions)
			{
				printDocument = (PrintDocument)(object)PrintOptionsHelper.CreatePrintDocument(DocumentModel.PrintingSystem, printerSettings);
				UpdatePageSettings();
				controller = new PrintEditorController(this);
				controller.LoadForm(printerItemContainer);
			}
			RaisePropertiesChanged();
		}

		private void HookDocument()
		{
			DocumentModel.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.StartDocumentCreation += OnStartDocumentCreation;
				x.DocumentCreated += OnDocumentCreated;
			});
		}

		private void UnhookDocument()
		{
			printDocument = null;
			DocumentModel.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.StartDocumentCreation -= OnStartDocumentCreation;
				x.DocumentCreated -= OnDocumentCreated;
			});
		}

		private void OnDocumentCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			PageScope pageScope = new PageScope(1, DocumentModel.PrintingSystem.PageCount);
			printerSettings.MaximumPage = DocumentModel.PrintingSystem.PageCount;
			printerSettings.FromPage = pageScope.FromPage;
			printerSettings.ToPage = pageScope.ToPage;
			CustomPageRange = pageScope.PageRange;
			printDocument = (PrintDocument)(object)PrintOptionsHelper.CreatePrintDocument(DocumentModel.PrintingSystem, PrinterSettings);
			controller.LoadForm(printerItemContainer);
			UpdatePageSettings();
			RaisePropertiesChanged();
		}

		private void OnStartDocumentCreation(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RaisePropertiesChanged();
		}

		private bool GetActualCanEditPaperSource()
		{
			int num = AvailablePaperSources.Return((IEnumerable<string> x) => x.Count(), () => 0);
			if (PaperSource == null)
			{
				return num > 0;
			}
			return num > 1;
		}

		protected void OnSelectedPrinterChanged()
		{
			paperSizeCollection = PrinterSettings.PaperSizes.ToDXPaperSizeCollection();
			if (PrinterIsValid)
			{
				PrinterSettings.PrinterName = SelectedPrinter.FullName;
			}
			UpdatePaperSources();
			UpdateDuplex();
			if (DocumentModel != null)
			{
				UpdatePageSettings();
			}
			short copies;
			if (Copies <= MaxCopies)
			{
				copies = Copies;
			}
			else
			{
				short num = (Copies = Convert.ToInt16(MaxCopies));
				copies = num;
			}
			Copies = copies;
			RaisePropertiesChanged();
		}

		private void UpdateDuplex()
		{
			if (PrinterSettings.CanDuplex)
			{
				CanDuplex = true;
				PrintHelper.GetDuplexAsync(PrinterSettings).ContinueWith((Task<Duplex> t) => Duplex = t.Result, TaskScheduler.FromCurrentSynchronizationContext());
			}
			else
			{
				CanDuplex = false;
				Duplex = Duplex.Simplex;
			}
		}

		internal void SavePrinterSettings()
		{
			controller.AssignPrinterSettings();
		}

		private void UpdatePaperSources()
		{
			paperSourceLocker.Lock();
			AvailablePaperSources = Enumerable.Empty<string>();
			PaperSource = null;
			if (!PrinterIsValid)
			{
				paperSourceLocker.Unlock();
				return;
			}
			PrintOptionsHelper.UpdatePaperSources(printerSettings, delegate(IEnumerable<string> sources)
			{
				AvailablePaperSources = sources;
				this.RaisePropertyChanged((PrintOptions x) => x.AvailablePaperSources);
			}, delegate(string source)
			{
				PaperSource = source;
				paperSourceLocker.Unlock();
				this.RaisePropertyChanged((PrintOptions x) => x.AllowEditPaperSource);
			});
		}

		private void SetSelectedPrinter(string printerName)
		{
			SelectedPrinter = AvailablePrinters.Single((PrinterItem x) => x.FullName == printerName);
		}

		void IPrintForm.AddPrinterItem(PrinterItem item)
		{
			if (!availablePrinters.Contains(item))
			{
				availablePrinters.Add(item);
			}
		}

		void IPrintForm.SetSelectedPrinter(string printerName)
		{
			SetSelectedPrinter(printerName);
		}

		private void ShowPreferences()
		{
			try
			{
				IntPtr hwnd = (from x in PresentationSource.CurrentSources.OfType<HwndSource>()
					select x.Handle).LastOrDefault();
				controller.ShowPrinterPreferences(hwnd);
				UpdatePaperSources();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private bool CanShowPreferences()
		{
			if (printDocument != null)
			{
				return DocumentModel.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.IsCreated, () => false);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void OnLandscapeChanged()
		{
			((PrintDocument)(object)PrintDocument).DefaultPageSettings.Landscape = Landscape;
			AssignPageDataIfNeeded();
		}

		protected void OnSelectedPaperSizeChanged()
		{
			if (SelectedPaperSize != null)
			{
				((PrintDocument)(object)PrintDocument).DefaultPageSettings.PaperSize = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePaperSize(SelectedPaperSize);
				AssignPageDataIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		private void AssignPageDataIfNeeded()
		{
			if (ShouldUpdatePageSettings && !pageSettingsLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				PageData val = DocumentModel.PageSettings.Data;
				PageData val2 = CreatePageData(pageSize: new System.Drawing.Size(SelectedPaperSize.Width, SelectedPaperSize.Height), margins: SelectedPageMargins.Margins, minMargins: ((ReadonlyPageData)val).MinMargins, paperKind: SelectedPaperSize.Kind, landscape: Landscape);
				DocumentModel.PageSettings.Assign(val2);
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectedPageMarginsChanged()
		{
			((PrintDocument)(object)PrintDocument).DefaultPageSettings.Margins = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateMargins(SelectedPageMargins.Margins);
			AssignPageDataIfNeeded();
		}

		private void UpdatePageSettings()
		{
			pageSettingsLocker.Lock();
			DXPaperSize appropriatePaperSize = PrintOptionsHelper.GetAppropriatePaperSize(DocumentModel.PrintingSystem, paperSizeCollection);
			ICollection<DXPaperSize> collection = paperSizeCollection;
			if (!collection.Contains(appropriatePaperSize))
			{
				AvailablePaperSizes = collection.Concat(appropriatePaperSize.Yield()).ToArray();
			}
			else
			{
				AvailablePaperSizes = collection.ToArray();
			}
			PageMarginInfo margins = new PageMarginInfo(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.CustomPageMargins), DocumentModel.PrintingSystem.PageMargins);
			PageMarginInfo pageMarginInfo = data.SingleOrDefault((PageMarginInfo x) => x == margins);
			IEnumerable<PageMarginInfo> availablePageMargins;
			if (!(pageMarginInfo != null))
			{
				IEnumerable<PageMarginInfo> enumerable = data.Concat(margins.Yield()).ToArray();
				availablePageMargins = enumerable;
			}
			else
			{
				availablePageMargins = data;
			}
			AvailablePageMargins = availablePageMargins;
			SelectedPaperSize = appropriatePaperSize;
			Landscape = DocumentModel.PrintingSystem.Landscape;
			SelectedPageMargins = AvailablePageMargins.SingleOrDefault((PageMarginInfo x) => x.Margins == DocumentModel.PrintingSystem.PageMargins);
			pageSettingsLocker.Unlock();
		}

		private static PageData CreatePageData(DXMargins margins, DXMargins minMargins, DXPaperKind paperKind, System.Drawing.Size pageSize, bool landscape)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new PageData(margins, minMargins, paperKind, (SizeF)pageSize, landscape);
		}

		public void ShowPageSetup()
		{
			new PageSettingsConfiguratorService().Configure(DocumentModel.Pages[0].Page);
		}

		protected bool CanShowPageSetup()
		{
			return DocumentModel.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.IsCreated && x.CanChangePageSettings, () => false);
		}

		protected void OnPrintRangeChanged()
		{
			if (printDocument != null)
			{
				PopulatePageNumbers();
				AllowCustomPageRange = PrintRange == PrintRange.SomePages;
				this.RaisePropertyChanged((PrintOptions x) => x.CustomPageRange);
			}
		}

		protected void OnCustomPageRangeChanged()
		{
			PopulatePageNumbers();
		}

		private void PopulatePageNumbers()
		{
			if (PrintDocument != null)
			{
				switch (PrintRange)
				{
				case PrintRange.AllPages:
					((IPrintForm)this).PageRangeText = new PageScope(1, DocumentModel.PrintingSystem.Pages.Count).PageRange;
					break;
				case PrintRange.CurrentPage:
					((IPrintForm)this).PageRangeText = $"{CurrentPageNumber}";
					break;
				case PrintRange.SomePages:
					((IPrintForm)this).PageRangeText = CustomPageRange;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		void IPrintForm.SetPrintRange(PrintRange printRange)
		{
			PrintRange = printRange;
		}

		private void SetCopies(short value)
		{
			if (AllowCopies)
			{
				short copies = ((value > 0 && value <= MaxCopies) ? value : Copies);
				PrinterSettings.Copies = copies;
			}
			this.RaisePropertyChanged((PrintOptions x) => x.Copies);
		}

		protected void OnCopiesChanged()
		{
			PrinterSettings.Copies = (short)((Copies <= 0) ? 1 : Copies);
		}
	}
	internal class PrintOptionsHelper
	{
		public static PrinterSettings CreatePrinterSettings()
		{
			PageSettings pageSettings = (PageSettings)PageSettingsHelper.DefaultPageSettings.Clone();
			if (pageSettings.PrinterSettings != null)
			{
				pageSettings.PrinterSettings = (PrinterSettings)pageSettings.PrinterSettings.Clone();
				PageSettings pageSettings2 = (PageSettings)PageSettingsHelper.DefaultPageSettings.Clone();
				pageSettings2.PrinterSettings = pageSettings.PrinterSettings;
				PageSettingsHelper.SetDefaultPageSettings(pageSettings.PrinterSettings, pageSettings2);
			}
			PrinterSettings printerSettings = pageSettings.PrinterSettings;
			printerSettings.MinimumPage = 1;
			printerSettings.MaximumPage = 0;
			printerSettings.FromPage = 0;
			printerSettings.ToPage = 0;
			return printerSettings;
		}

		public static DXPaperSize GetAppropriatePaperSize(PrintingSystemBase printingSystem, ICollection<DXPaperSize> paperSizes)
		{
			PageData data = printingSystem.PageSettings.Data;
			DXPaperSize dXPaperSize = new DXPaperSize(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.CustomPaperSize), ((ReadonlyPageData)data).Size.Width, ((ReadonlyPageData)data).Size.Height);
			return DXPageSizeInfo.GetAppropriatePaperSize(paperSizes, dXPaperSize) ?? dXPaperSize;
		}

		public static string ValidatePageRange(string pageRange, int maxPages)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageRange))
			{
				return PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)129);
			}
			int[] indices = PageRangeParser.GetIndices(pageRange, maxPages);
			if (indices.Length == 0 || (indices.Length == 1 && indices[0] == -1))
			{
				return PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)129);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static PSPrintDocument CreatePrintDocument(PrintingSystemBase printingSystem, PrinterSettings printerSettings)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string pageRange = new PageScope(0, printingSystem.PageCount).PageRange;
			PrintController printController = (printingSystem.ShowPrintStatusDialog ? ((PrintController)new PrintProgressController()) : ((PrintController)new StandardPrintController()));
			return new PSPrintDocument(printingSystem, printController, printerSettings, (Func<bool>)(() => true))
			{
				PageRange = pageRange
			};
		}

		public static void UpdatePaperSources(PrinterSettings printerSettings, Action<IEnumerable<string>> onGetPaperSources, Action<string> onGetActualPaperSource)
		{
			PaperSource source = null;
			IEnumerable<string> sources = Enumerable.Empty<string>();
			TaskScheduler scheduler = TaskScheduler.FromCurrentSynchronizationContext();
			Task<PrinterSettings.PaperSourceCollection> paperSourcesAsync = PrintHelper.GetPaperSourcesAsync(printerSettings);
			paperSourcesAsync.ContinueWith(delegate(Task<PrinterSettings.PaperSourceCollection> t)
			{
				sources = (from PaperSource x in t.Result
					select x.SourceName into x
					orderby x
					where x != string.Empty
					select x).ToList();
				onGetPaperSources(sources);
			}, scheduler);
			Task task = Task.Factory.StartNew(delegate
			{
				source = null;
				try
				{
					source = printerSettings.DefaultPageSettings.PaperSource;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Tracer.TraceError("DXperience.Reporting", (object)ex);
					Exception printerException = PrintHelper.GetPrinterException(ex);
				}
			});
			Task task2 = new TaskFactory(scheduler).ContinueWhenAll(new Task[2] { task, paperSourcesAsync }, delegate
			{
				string obj = null;
				if (source != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.SourceName))
				{
					obj = (sources.Contains(source.SourceName) ? source.SourceName : null);
				}
				onGetActualPaperSource(obj);
			});
		}
	}
	public static class BarItemBehavior
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SendZoomToModelOnClickProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("SendZoomToModelOnClick", typeof(PreviewModelBase), typeof(BarItemBehavior), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnSendZoomToModelOnClickChanged));

		public static PreviewModelBase GetSendZoomToModelOnClick(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (PreviewModelBase)obj.GetValue(SendZoomToModelOnClickProperty);
		}

		public static void SetSendZoomToModelOnClick(DependencyObject obj, PreviewModelBase value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(SendZoomToModelOnClickProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnSendZoomToModelOnClickChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BarButtonItem val = (BarButtonItem)(object)((d is BarButtonItem) ? d : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			if (e.OldValue is PreviewModelBase)
			{
				((BarItem)val).ItemClick -= new ItemClickEventHandler(barButtonItem_ItemClick);
			}
			if (e.NewValue is PreviewModelBase)
			{
				((BarItem)val).ItemClick += new ItemClickEventHandler(barButtonItem_ItemClick);
			}
		}

		private static void barButtonItem_ItemClick(object sender, ItemClickEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BarButtonItem val = (BarButtonItem)e.Item;
			PreviewModelBase sendZoomToModelOnClick = GetSendZoomToModelOnClick((DependencyObject)(object)val);
			if (sendZoomToModelOnClick == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidProgramException();
			}
			sendZoomToModelOnClick.ZoomMode = (ZoomItemBase)((BarItem)val).CommandParameter;
		}
	}
	public static class BarManagerCustomization
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Template", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(BarManagerCustomization), new PropertyMetadata(null, TemplateChangedCallback));

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty TemplatesCollectorProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("TemplatesCollector", typeof(List<DataTemplate>), typeof(BarManagerCustomization), new PropertyMetadata(new List<DataTemplate>()));

		public static DataTemplate GetTemplate(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (DataTemplate)obj.GetValue(TemplateProperty);
		}

		public static void SetTemplate(DependencyObject obj, DataTemplate value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(TemplateProperty, value);
		}

		private static List<DataTemplate> GetTemplatesCollector(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (List<DataTemplate>)obj.GetValue(TemplatesCollectorProperty);
		}

		private static void TemplateChangedCallback(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d != null && e.NewValue != null)
			{
				if (!(d is DocumentPreview documentPreview))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Dependency Property can by applied only to the DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.DocumentPreview");
				}
				if (documentPreview.BarManager == null)
				{
					List<DataTemplate> templatesCollector = GetTemplatesCollector(d);
					templatesCollector.Add((DataTemplate)e.NewValue);
				}
				ApplyTemplate(documentPreview);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal static void ApplyTemplate(DocumentPreview preview)
		{
			if (preview == null || preview.BarManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<DataTemplate> templatesCollector = GetTemplatesCollector(preview);
			foreach (DataTemplate item in templatesCollector)
			{
				AddAndExecute(preview.BarManager, item);
			}
			DataTemplate template = GetTemplate(preview);
			if (!templatesCollector.Contains(template))
			{
				AddAndExecute(preview.BarManager, template);
			}
			templatesCollector.Clear();
		}

		private static void AddAndExecute(BarManager manager, DataTemplate template)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!manager.Controllers.OfType<TemplatedBarManagerController>().Any((TemplatedBarManagerController x) => x.Template == template))
			{
				TemplatedBarManagerController val = new TemplatedBarManagerController
				{
					Template = template
				};
				manager.Controllers.Add((IControllerAction)(object)val);
				((BarManagerControllerBase)val).Execute((DependencyObject)null);
			}
		}
	}

	public class PageNumberBehavior : Behavior<BarEditItem>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FocusTargetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FocusTarget", typeof(UIElement), typeof(PageNumberBehavior), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public UIElement FocusTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(FocusTargetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(FocusTargetProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			((ObservableCollection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((BarItem)base.AssociatedObject).Links).CollectionChanged += Links_CollectionChanged;
			foreach (BarEditItemLink item in (Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((BarItem)base.AssociatedObject).Links)
			{
				BarEditItemLink val = item;
				((BarItemLinkBase)val).LinkControlLoaded += new BarItemLinkControlLoadedEventHandler(link_LinkControlLoaded);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			((ObservableCollection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((BarItem)base.AssociatedObject).Links).CollectionChanged -= Links_CollectionChanged;
			foreach (BarEditItemLink item in (Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((BarItem)base.AssociatedObject).Links)
			{
				BarEditItemLink val = item;
				((BarItemLinkBase)val).LinkControlLoaded -= new BarItemLinkControlLoadedEventHandler(link_LinkControlLoaded);
				val.Editor.Do(delegate(BaseEdit x)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)x).GotKeyboardFocus -= OnEditorGotFocus;
					((UIElement)(object)x).KeyUp -= OnKeyUp;
					((UIElement)(object)x).LostKeyboardFocus -= OnEditorLostFocus;
				});
			}
		}

		private void Links_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				foreach (BarEditItemLink newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					BarEditItemLink val = newItem;
					((BarItemLinkBase)val).LinkControlLoaded -= new BarItemLinkControlLoadedEventHandler(link_LinkControlLoaded);
					((BarItemLinkBase)val).LinkControlLoaded += new BarItemLinkControlLoadedEventHandler(link_LinkControlLoaded);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BarEditItemLink oldItem in e.OldItems)
			{
				BarEditItemLink val2 = oldItem;
				((BarItemLinkBase)val2).LinkControlLoaded -= new BarItemLinkControlLoadedEventHandler(link_LinkControlLoaded);
			}
		}

		private void link_LinkControlLoaded(object sender, BarItemLinkControlLoadedEventArgs e)
		{
			BarEditItemLink val = (BarEditItemLink)((sender is BarEditItemLink) ? sender : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)val.Editor).GotKeyboardFocus += OnEditorGotFocus;
				((UIElement)(object)val.Editor).KeyUp += OnKeyUp;
				((UIElement)(object)val.Editor).LostKeyboardFocus += OnEditorLostFocus;
			}
		}

		private void OnEditorGotFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BaseEdit val = (BaseEdit)((sender is BaseEdit) ? sender : null);
			val.SelectAll();
		}

		private void OnEditorLostFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RevertEditValue(base.AssociatedObject);
		}

		private void OnKeyUp(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				FocusEditor();
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Return)
			{
				GetTextBindingExpression().UpdateSource();
				FocusEditor();
			}
		}

		private void RevertEditValue(BarEditItem item)
		{
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)item).GetBindingExpression(BarEditItem.EditValueProperty).UpdateTarget();
		}

		private void FocusEditor()
		{
			if (FocusTarget != null)
			{
				FocusTarget.Focus();
			}
		}

		private BindingExpression GetTextBindingExpression()
		{
			return BindingOperations.GetBindingExpression((DependencyObject)(object)base.AssociatedObject, BarEditItem.EditValueProperty);
		}
	}
	public static class RibbonCustomization
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Template", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(RibbonCustomization), new PropertyMetadata(null, TemplateChangedCallback));

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty TemplatesCollectorProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("TemplatesCollector", typeof(List<DataTemplate>), typeof(RibbonCustomization), new PropertyMetadata(new List<DataTemplate>()));

		public static DataTemplate GetTemplate(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (DataTemplate)obj.GetValue(TemplateProperty);
		}

		public static void SetTemplate(DependencyObject obj, DataTemplate value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(TemplateProperty, value);
		}

		private static List<DataTemplate> GetTemplatesCollector(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (List<DataTemplate>)obj.GetValue(TemplatesCollectorProperty);
		}

		private static void TemplateChangedCallback(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d != null && e.NewValue != null)
			{
				if (!(d is RibbonDocumentPreview ribbonDocumentPreview))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Dependency Property can by applied only to the DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.RibbonDocumentPreview");
				}
				if (ribbonDocumentPreview.Ribbon == null)
				{
					List<DataTemplate> templatesCollector = GetTemplatesCollector(d);
					templatesCollector.Add((DataTemplate)e.NewValue);
				}
				ApplyTemplate(ribbonDocumentPreview);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal static void ApplyTemplate(RibbonDocumentPreview preview)
		{
			if (preview == null || preview.Ribbon == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<DataTemplate> templatesCollector = GetTemplatesCollector(preview);
			foreach (DataTemplate item in templatesCollector)
			{
				AddAndExecute(preview.Ribbon, item);
			}
			DataTemplate template = GetTemplate(preview);
			if (!templatesCollector.Contains(template))
			{
				AddAndExecute(preview.Ribbon, template);
			}
			templatesCollector.Clear();
		}

		private static void AddAndExecute(RibbonControl ribbon, DataTemplate template)
		{
			if (!ribbon.Controllers.OfType<TemplatedRibbonController>().Any((TemplatedRibbonController x) => x.Template == template))
			{
				TemplatedRibbonController templatedRibbonController = new TemplatedRibbonController
				{
					Template = template
				};
				ribbon.Controllers.Add((IControllerAction)(object)templatedRibbonController);
				((BarManagerControllerBase)templatedRibbonController).Execute((DependencyObject)null);
			}
		}
	}

		{
			cursorFilePath = GetUriString(cursorFilePath, rootNamespace);
			UriKind uriKind = UriKind.Relative;

		}

		{
			return string.Format("/{0}{1};component/{2}", rootNamespace, ".v23.2", cursorFilePath);
		}

		public IEnumerable<InplaceEditorInfoBase> EditorInfoCollection => infoCollection;

		public bool RegisterEditorInfo(string editorName, string category, string editorDisplayName = null)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(editorName, "editorName");
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(category, "category");
			InplaceEditorInfo editorInfo = new InplaceEditorInfo(editorName, category, editorDisplayName);
			return RegisterEditorInfo(editorInfo);
		}

		public bool RegisterTextEditorInfo(string editorName, string category, string editorDisplayName = null)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(editorName, "editorName");
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(category, "category");
			InplaceEditorInfo editorInfo = new InplaceEditorInfo(editorName, category, editorDisplayName);
			return RegisterEditorInfo(editorInfo);
		}

		public bool RegisterEditorInfo(InplaceEditorInfoBase editorInfo)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)editorInfo, "editorInfo");
			if (EditorInfoCollection.Any((InplaceEditorInfoBase x) => x.EditorName == editorInfo.EditorName) || !EditingFieldEditorNameExtensions.Instance.RegisterEditorName(editorInfo.EditorName, editorInfo.DisplayName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			infoCollection.Add(editorInfo);
			return true;
		}

		public bool RegisterImageEditorInfo(string editorName, ImageEditorOptions options, string displayName = null)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(editorName, "editorName");
			return RegisterEditorInfo(new ImageInplaceEditorInfo(editorName, options, displayName));
		}

		public bool RegisterImageCollectionEditorInfo(string editorName, IDictionary<string, System.Drawing.Image> images, bool searchEnabled = true, bool sizeOptionsEnabled = false, string displayName = null)
		{
			ImageCollectionEditorInfo editorInfo = new ImageCollectionEditorInfo(editorName, images, searchEnabled, sizeOptionsEnabled, displayName);
			return RegisterEditorInfo(editorInfo);
		}

		public bool RegisterImageCollectionEditorInfo(string editorName, IEnumerable<System.Drawing.Image> images, bool sizeOptionsEnabled = false, string displayName = null)
		{
			ImageCollectionEditorInfo editorInfo = new ImageCollectionEditorInfo(editorName, images, sizeOptionsEnabled, displayName);
			return RegisterEditorInfo(editorInfo);
		}

		public bool UnregisterEditorInfo(string editorName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(editorName, "editorName");
			InplaceEditorInfoBase editorInfo = EditorInfoCollection.SingleOrDefault((InplaceEditorInfoBase x) => x.EditorName == editorName);
			return UnregisterEditorInfo(editorInfo);
		}

		public bool UnregisterEditorInfo(InplaceEditorInfoBase editorInfo)
		{
			if (editorInfo == null || !EditorInfoCollection.Contains(editorInfo) || !EditingFieldEditorNameExtensions.Instance.UnregisterEditorName(editorInfo.EditorName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			infoCollection.Remove(editorInfo);
			return true;
		}

		public IEnumerable<InplaceEditorInfoBase> GetTextInplaceEditors()
		{
			return infoCollection.Where((InplaceEditorInfoBase x) => x.EditingFieldType == EditingFieldType.Text).ToArray();
		}

		public IEnumerable<InplaceEditorInfoBase> GetImageInplaceEditors()
		{
			return infoCollection.Where((InplaceEditorInfoBase x) => x.EditingFieldType == EditingFieldType.Image).ToArray();
		}
	}

	public abstract class InplaceEditorInfoBase
	{
		public string EditorName { get; private set; }

		public string DisplayName { get; private set; }

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal abstract EditingFieldType EditingFieldType { get; }

		protected InplaceEditorInfoBase(string editorName, string editorDisplayName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(editorName, "editorName");
			EditorName = editorName;
			DisplayName = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(editorDisplayName) ? editorName : editorDisplayName);
		}
	}

	public class ImageCollectionEditorInfo : ImageInplaceEditorInfo
	{
		public IEnumerable<ImageGalleryItem> ImageCollection { get; }

		public bool SearchEnabled { get; }

		public bool SizeOptionsEnabled { get; }

		public bool ShowCaption { get; }

		internal override EditingFieldType EditingFieldType => EditingFieldType.Image;

		public ImageCollectionEditorInfo(string editorName, IEnumerable<System.Drawing.Image> images, bool sizeOptionsEnabled, string editorDisplayName = null)
			: base(editorName, CreateEditorOptions(images, sizeOptionsEnabled), editorDisplayName)
		{
			ImageCollection = images.Select((System.Drawing.Image x) => new ImageGalleryItem(x)).ToArray();
			SizeOptionsEnabled = sizeOptionsEnabled;
		}

		public ImageCollectionEditorInfo(string editorName, IDictionary<string, System.Drawing.Image> images, bool searchEnabled, bool sizeOptionsEnabled, string editorDisplayName = null)
			: base(editorName, CreateEditorOptions(images, sizeOptionsEnabled, searchEnabled), editorDisplayName)
		{
			ImageCollection = images.Select((KeyValuePair<string, System.Drawing.Image> x) => new ImageGalleryItem(x.Value, x.Key)).ToArray();
			SearchEnabled = searchEnabled;
			SizeOptionsEnabled = sizeOptionsEnabled;
			ShowCaption = true;
		}

		private static ImageEditorOptions CreateEditorOptions(IEnumerable<System.Drawing.Image> images, bool sizeOptionsEnabled)
		{
			ImageEditorOptions options = new ImageEditorOptions
			{
				AllowLoadImage = false,
				AllowDraw = false,
				AllowSearchPredefinedImages = false,
				AllowChangeSizeOptions = sizeOptionsEnabled
			};
			IEnumerableExtensions.ForEach<System.Drawing.Image>(images, (Action<System.Drawing.Image>)delegate(System.Drawing.Image image)
			{
				options.PredefinedImages.Add(new ImageGalleryItem(image));
			});
			return options;
		}

		private static ImageEditorOptions CreateEditorOptions(IDictionary<string, System.Drawing.Image> images, bool sizeOptionsEnabled, bool searchEnabled)
		{
			ImageEditorOptions options = new ImageEditorOptions
			{
				AllowLoadImage = false,
				AllowDraw = false,
				AllowChangeSizeOptions = sizeOptionsEnabled,
				AllowSearchPredefinedImages = searchEnabled
			};
			IEnumerableExtensions.ForEach<KeyValuePair<string, System.Drawing.Image>>((IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, System.Drawing.Image>>)images, (Action<KeyValuePair<string, System.Drawing.Image>>)delegate(KeyValuePair<string, System.Drawing.Image> imageAndDisplayName)
			{
				options.PredefinedImages.Add(new ImageGalleryItem(imageAndDisplayName.Value, imageAndDisplayName.Key));
			});
			return options;
		}

	public class CompositeLink : TemplatedLink
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<TemplatedLink> links;

		private readonly PageBreakInfoCollection pageBreaks = new PageBreakInfoCollection();

		private bool disposed;

		private readonly VisualTreeWalker walker = new VisualTreeWalker();

		public IEnumerable<TemplatedLink> Links => links;

		public PageBreakInfoCollection PageBreaks => pageBreaks;

		public CompositeLink(IEnumerable<TemplatedLink> links)
			: this(links, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public CompositeLink(IEnumerable<TemplatedLink> links, string documentName)
			: base(documentName)
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.links = links;
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageInsertComplete += new PageInsertCompleteEventHandler(OnPageInsertComplete);
		}

		private void OnPageInsertComplete(object sender, PageInsertCompleteEventArgs e)
		{
			links.OfType<PrintableControlLink>().ForEach(delegate(PrintableControlLink x)
			{
				//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0033: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (base.BrickCollector != null)
				{
					BrickEnumerator val = new BrickEnumerator((BrickBase)(object)((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Pages[e.PageIndex]);
					x.PrintableControl.PagePrintedCallback((IEnumerator)val, base.BrickCollector.BrickUpdaters);
				}
			});
		}

		public void CreatePageForEachLink()
		{
			OnCreateDocumentStarted();
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).ClearContent();
			SinglePrintingDocumentFactory documentFactory = new SinglePrintingDocumentFactory();
			foreach (TemplatedLink link in links)
			{
				IDocumentFactory documentFactory2 = link.PrintingSystem.DocumentFactory;
				link.PrintingSystem.DocumentFactory = documentFactory;
				link.CreateDocument(buildForInstantPreview: false);
				link.PrintingSystem.DocumentFactory = documentFactory2;
				if (((PrintingSystemBase)link.PrintingSystem).PageCount > 0)
				{
					((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Pages.Add(((PrintingSystemBase)link.PrintingSystem).Pages[0]);
				}
			}
			OnCreateDocumentFinished();
		}

		protected override void Build(bool buildPagesInBackground)
		{
			Links.ForEach(delegate(TemplatedLink x)
			{
				SyncPageSettings(x);
			});
			base.Build(buildPagesInBackground);
		}

		internal override void End(bool buildPagesInBackground)
		{
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).End(buildPagesInBackground);
			foreach (TemplatedLink link in Links)
			{
				(link.RootNode as IDisposable).Do(delegate(IDisposable x)
				{
					x.Dispose();
				});
			}
		}

		protected override IRootDataNode CreateRootNode()
		{
			foreach (TemplatedLink link in Links)
			{
				link.PreventDisposing = true;
			}
			return (IRootDataNode)(object)new CompositeRootNode(this);
		}

		internal sealed override VisualDataNodeBandManager CreateVisualDataNodeBandManager()
		{
			return new CompositeLinkBandManager(base.RootNode, base.BandInitializer, delegate(IDataNode node)
			{
				IVisualTreeWalker visualTreeWalker = (IVisualTreeWalker)(((object)(base.RootNode as CompositeRootNode).TryGetWalker(node)) ?? ((object)walker));
				base.BrickCollector.VisualTreeWalker = visualTreeWalker;
			});
		}

		protected override bool IsDocumentLayoutRightToLeft()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void SyncPageSettings(TemplatedLink link)
		{
			link.PaperKind = ((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings.PaperKind;
			link.CustomPaperSize = ((ReadonlyPageData)((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings.Data).Size;
			link.Landscape = ((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings.Landscape;
			link.MinMargins = ((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings.MinMargins;
			link.Margins = ((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings.Margins;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!disposed)
			{
				if (disposing && base.PrintingSystem != null)
				{
					((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageInsertComplete -= new PageInsertCompleteEventHandler(OnPageInsertComplete);
				}
				disposed = true;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}
	}
	internal class CompositeLinkBandManager : VisualDataNodeBandManager
	{
		private readonly Action<IDataNode> assignActualTreeWalker;

		public CompositeLinkBandManager(IRootDataNode rootNode, DocumentBandInitializer bandInitializer, Action<IDataNode> assignActualTreeWalker)
			: base(rootNode, bandInitializer)
		{
			this.assignActualTreeWalker = assignActualTreeWalker;
		}

		protected override DocumentBand CreateDetailBand(IDataNode node)
		{
			assignActualTreeWalker(node);
			return base.CreateDetailBand(node);
		}
	}
	internal class CompositeRootNode : IRootDataNode, IDataNode, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<IRootDataNode, IVisualTreeWalker> rootNodeTreeWalkerDictionary = new Dictionary<IRootDataNode, IVisualTreeWalker>();

		private readonly int detailCount;

		public CompositeLink Link { get; private set; }

		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public bool IsDetailContainer => false;

		public bool PageBreakAfter => false;

		public bool PageBreakBefore => false;

		public IDataNode Parent => null;

		public CompositeRootNode(CompositeLink link)
		{
			Link = link;
			detailCount = link.Links.Count();
		}

		public int GetTotalDetailCount()
		{
			return detailCount;
		}

		public bool CanGetChild(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				return index < detailCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public IDataNode GetChild(int index)
		{
			TemplatedLink link = Link.Links.ElementAt(index);
			link.CreateDocument(buildForInstantPreview: false);
			PageBreakInfo pageBreaksInfo = Link.PageBreaks.FirstOrDefault((PageBreakInfo x) => x.Link == link);
			IDataNode result = (IDataNode)(object)new CompositeLinkGroupContainer(this, (IDataNode)(object)link.RootNode, index, link.GetReportHeaderRowViewInfo(allowContentReuse: true), link.GetReportFooterRowViewInfo(allowContentReuse: true), pageBreaksInfo);
			(link as PrintableControlLink).Do(delegate(PrintableControlLink x)
			{
				rootNodeTreeWalkerDictionary[link.RootNode] = x.PrintableControl.GetCustomVisualTreeWalker();
			});
			return result;
		}

		internal IVisualTreeWalker TryGetWalker(IDataNode node)
		{
			IRootDataNode key = node.Yield<IDataNode>().Flatten((IDataNode x) => (!(x is IRootDataNode) && x.Parent != null) ? x.Parent.Yield<IDataNode>() : Enumerable.Empty<IDataNode>()).OfType<IRootDataNode>()
				.SingleOrDefault();
			IVisualTreeWalker value = null;
			rootNodeTreeWalkerDictionary.TryGetValue(key, out value);
			return value;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			rootNodeTreeWalkerDictionary.Clear();
		}
	}
	internal class CompositeLinkGroupContainer : IVisualGroupNode, IGroupNode, IDataNode
	{
		private readonly IDataNode wrapperNode;

		private readonly int index;

		private readonly RowViewInfo header;

		private readonly RowViewInfo footer;

		private readonly PageBreakInfo pageBreaksInfo;

		public bool RepeatHeaderEveryPage => false;

		public GroupUnion Union => (GroupUnion)0;

		public int Index => index;

		public bool IsDetailContainer => wrapperNode.IsDetailContainer;

		public bool PageBreakAfter => pageBreaksInfo.Return((PageBreakInfo x) => x.PageBreakAfter, () => false);

		public bool PageBreakBefore => pageBreaksInfo.Return((PageBreakInfo x) => x.PageBreakBefore, () => false);

		public IDataNode Parent { get; private set; }

		public CompositeLinkGroupContainer(CompositeRootNode parent, IDataNode wrapperNode, int index, RowViewInfo headerViewInfo, RowViewInfo footerViewInfo, PageBreakInfo pageBreaksInfo = null)
		{
			Parent = (IDataNode)(object)parent;
			this.wrapperNode = wrapperNode;
			this.index = index;
			header = headerViewInfo;
			footer = footerViewInfo;
			this.pageBreaksInfo = pageBreaksInfo;
		}

		public RowViewInfo GetFooter(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			return footer;
		}

		public RowViewInfo GetHeader(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			return header;
		}

		public bool CanGetChild(int index)
		{
			return wrapperNode.CanGetChild(index);
		}

		public IDataNode GetChild(int index)
		{
			return wrapperNode.GetChild(index);
		}
	}

	public abstract class LinkBase : DependencyObject, IDisposable, ILink2, ILink, IDocumentSource
	{
		private enum PrintMode
		{
			Dialog,
			Direct
		}

		private class PrintingContext
		{
			private readonly DocumentPrinter documentPrinter;

			private readonly PrintMode printMode;

			private readonly PrintQueue printQueue;

			public DocumentPrinter DocumentPrinter => documentPrinter;

			public PrintMode PrintMode => printMode;

			public PrintQueue PrintQueue => printQueue;

			public PrintingContext(DocumentPrinter documentPrinter, PrintMode printMode, PrintQueue printQueue)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentPrinter, "documentPrinter");
				this.documentPrinter = documentPrinter;
				this.printMode = printMode;
				this.printQueue = printQueue;
			}

			public void Print(DocumentPaginator paginator, ReadonlyPageData[] pageData, string documentName, bool asyncMode)
			{
				if (PrintMode == PrintMode.Dialog)
				{
					DocumentPrinter.PrintDialog(paginator, pageData, documentName, asyncMode);
				}
				else if (PrintQueue == null)
				{
					DocumentPrinter.PrintDirect(paginator, pageData, documentName, asyncMode);
				}
				else
				{
					DocumentPrinter.PrintDirect(paginator, pageData, documentName, PrintQueue, asyncMode);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsDocumentEmpty => ((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Document.PageCount == 0;

		private PrintingContext ActualPrintingContext { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets the Printing System used to create and print a document for this link.")]
		public PrintingSystem PrintingSystem { get; private set; }

		IPrintingSystem ILink.PrintingSystem => (IPrintingSystem)(object)PrintingSystem;

		PrintingSystemBase IDocumentSource.PrintingSystemBase => (PrintingSystemBase)(object)PrintingSystem;

		[Description("Gets or sets a value indicating whether it is necessary to suppress rebuilding the document every time a link’s page settings are changed.")]
		public bool SuppressAutoRebuildOnPageSettingsChange { get; set; }

		[Description("Specifies whether content bricks, which are outside the right page margin, should be split across pages, or moved in their entirety to the next page.")]
		public VerticalContentSplitting VerticalContentSplitting { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets a value indicating whether the page orientation is landscape.")]
		public bool Landscape { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets the type of paper for the document.")]
		public DXPaperKind PaperKind { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets a size of custom paper (measured in hundredths of an inch).")]
		public System.Drawing.Size CustomPaperSize { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets the margins of a report page (measured in hundredths of an inch).")]
		public DXMargins Margins { get; set; }

		[Description("Specifies the minimum printer margin values.")]
		public DXMargins MinMargins { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets the name of the document.")]
		public string DocumentName { get; set; }

		internal bool IsPrintingSystemOwner { get; private set; }

		internal bool BuildPagesInBackground { get; private set; }

		[Obsolete("This event is now obsolete. Asynchronous printing is no longer supported.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public event AsyncCompletedEventHandler PrintCompleted;

		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> CreateDocumentStarted;

		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> CreateDocumentFinished;

		public Window ShowPrintPreview(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			return ShowPrintPreview(owner, null);
		}

		public Window ShowRibbonPrintPreview(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			return ShowRibbonPrintPreview(owner, null);

		public bool? Print()
		{
			return Print(null);
		}

		internal bool? Print(string themeName)
		{
			PrepareToPrint();
			return PrintHelperInternal.Print((PrintingSystemBase)(object)PrintingSystem, ActiveWindowFinderBase<ActiveWindowFinder>.Instance.GetActiveWindow(), themeName);
		}

		{
			PrintDirect((string)null);
		}

			PrintHelperInternal.PrintDirect((PrintingSystemBase)(object)PrintingSystem, printerName);
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is now obsolete. Use the DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.LinkBase.PrintDirect(string printerName) method instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void PrintDirect(PrintQueue queue)
		{
			PrepareToPrint();
			new DocumentPrinter().PrintDirect(CreatePaginator(), PrintHelper.CollectPageData(((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Pages.ToArray()), ((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Document.Name, queue, asyncMode: false);
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is now obsolete. Asynchronous printing is no longer supported.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void PrintAsync()
		{
			PrintAsyncCore(PrintMode.Dialog, null);
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is now obsolete. Asynchronous printing is no longer supported.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void PrintDirectAsync()

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void PrintDirectAsync(PrintQueue queue)
		{
			PrintAsyncCore(PrintMode.Direct, queue);
		}

		[Obsolete("This method is now obsolete. Asynchronous printing is no longer supported.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void CancelPrintAsync()
		{
			if (ActualPrintingContext != null)
			{
				ActualPrintingContext.DocumentPrinter.CancelPrint();
			}
		}

		private void PrintAsyncCore(PrintMode printMode, PrintQueue printQueue)
		{
			ActualPrintingContext = new PrintingContext(new DocumentPrinter(), printMode, printQueue);
			if (IsDocumentEmpty)
			{
				CreateDocumentFinished += LinkBase_CreateDocumentFinished;
				CreateDocument(buildForInstantPreview: true);
			}
			else
			{
				StartPrintAsync();
			}
		}

		private void StartPrintAsync()
		{
			ActualPrintingContext.DocumentPrinter.PrintCompleted += printer_PrintCompleted;
			ActualPrintingContext.Print(CreatePaginator(), PrintHelper.CollectPageData(((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Pages.ToArray()), ((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Document.Name, asyncMode: true);
		}

		private void LinkBase_CreateDocumentFinished(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CreateDocumentFinished -= LinkBase_CreateDocumentFinished;
			StartPrintAsync();
		}

		private void printer_PrintCompleted(object sender, AsyncCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			ActualPrintingContext.DocumentPrinter.PrintCompleted -= printer_PrintCompleted;
			ActualPrintingContext = null;
			if (this.PrintCompleted != null)
			{
				this.PrintCompleted(this, new AsyncCompletedEventArgs(e.Error, e.Cancelled, e.UserState));
			}
		}

		private void PrepareToPrint()
		{
			CreateIfEmpty(buildPagesInBackground: false);
		}

		internal DocumentPaginator CreatePaginator()
		{
			return new DelegatePaginator(VisualizePage, () => ((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Document.Pages.Count);
		}

		protected LinkBase(PrintingSystem ps, string documentName)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (ps != null)
			{
				PrintingSystem = ps;
			}
			else
			{
				PrintingSystem = new PrintingSystem();
				IsPrintingSystemOwner = true;
			}
			((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).PageSettingsChanged += ps_PageSettingsChanged;
			((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).AfterMarginsChange += new MarginsChangeEventHandler(ps_PageSettingsChanged);
			((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).AfterBuildPages += PrintingSystem_AfterBuildPages;
			ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<XpsExportServiceBase>((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)PrintingSystem, (XpsExportServiceBase)(object)new XpsExportService(CreatePaginator()), false);
			DocumentName = documentName;
			PaperKind = DXPaperKind.Letter;
			Margins = XtraPageSettingsBase.DefaultMargins;
			MinMargins = XtraPageSettingsBase.DefaultMinMargins;
		}

		protected LinkBase(PrintingSystem ps)
			: this(ps, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		protected LinkBase(string documentName)
			: this(null, documentName)
		{
		}

		protected LinkBase()
			: this(null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public void CreateDocument()
		{
			CreateDocument(buildForInstantPreview: false);
		}

		public void CreateDocument(bool buildForInstantPreview)
		{
			BuildPagesInBackground = buildForInstantPreview;
			CreateDocument(buildForInstantPreview, applyPageSettings: true);
		}

		public void StopPageBuilding()
		{
			if (PrintingSystem != null)
			{
				((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Document.StopPageBuilding();
			}
		}

		internal void CreateIfEmpty(bool buildPagesInBackground)
		{
			if (((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Document.PageCount == 0)
			{
				CreateDocument(buildPagesInBackground);
			}
		}

		private void CreateDocument(bool buildPagesInBackground, bool applyPageSettings)
		{
			OnCreateDocumentStarted();
			CreateDocumentCore(buildPagesInBackground, applyPageSettings);
		}

		protected abstract void CreateDocumentCore(bool buildPagesInBackground, bool applyPageSettings);

		protected virtual void AfterBuildPages()
		{
			OnCreateDocumentFinished();
		}

		protected internal FrameworkElement VisualizePage(int pageIndex)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PageVisualizer pageVisualizer = CreatePageVisualizer();
			try
			{
				return pageVisualizer.Visualize((PSPage)((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Pages[pageIndex], pageIndex, ((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Pages.Count);
			}
			catch (System.Windows.Markup.XamlParseException)
			{
				return new PageWithRedCross();
			}
		}

		protected virtual PageVisualizer CreatePageVisualizer()
		{
			return new BrickPageVisualizer(TextMeasurementSystem.NativeXpf);
		}

		private void ps_PageSettingsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!SuppressAutoRebuildOnPageSettingsChange)
			{
				CreateDocument(BuildPagesInBackground, applyPageSettings: false);
			}
		}

		private void PrintingSystem_AfterBuildPages(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			AfterBuildPages();
		}

		protected void OnCreateDocumentStarted()
		{
			if (this.CreateDocumentStarted != null)
			{
				this.CreateDocumentStarted(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected void OnCreateDocumentFinished()
		{
			if (this.CreateDocumentFinished != null)
			{
				this.CreateDocumentFinished(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		void ILink2.AddSubreport(PrintingSystemBase ps, DocumentBand band, PointF offset)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (disposing && PrintingSystem != null)
			{
				if (((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Document.IsCreating)
				{
					((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).Document.StopPageBuilding();
				}
				((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).PageSettingsChanged -= ps_PageSettingsChanged;
				((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).AfterMarginsChange -= new MarginsChangeEventHandler(ps_PageSettingsChanged);
				((PrintingSystemBase)PrintingSystem).AfterBuildPages -= PrintingSystem_AfterBuildPages;
				ImageRepository.Clear(RepositoryImageHelper.GetDocumentId((PrintingSystemBase)(object)PrintingSystem));
				if (IsPrintingSystemOwner)
				{
					((Component)(object)PrintingSystem).Dispose();
					PrintingSystem = null;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class PageMarginInfo : ImmutableObject
	{
		public string DisplayName { get; private set; }

		public DXMargins Margins { get; private set; }

		public PageMarginInfo(string displayName, DXMargins margins)
		{
			DisplayName = displayName;
			Margins = margins;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Margins.GetHashCode() ^ typeof(PageMarginInfo).GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			PageMarginInfo input = obj as PageMarginInfo;
			return input.Return((PageMarginInfo x) => x.Margins == Margins, () => false);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(PageMarginInfo m1, PageMarginInfo m2)
		{
			return ((object)m1)?.Equals((object)m2) ?? ((object)m2 == null);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(PageMarginInfo m1, PageMarginInfo m2)
		{
			return !(m1 == m2);
		}
	}

		private ICommand CreateExportCommand(ExportFormat format, ICommand exportCommand, bool isSendOperation)

		protected virtual IEnumerable<ExportFormat> GetExportFormats()
		{

		internal void UpdateCommands()
		{
			if (!DocumentViewer.DocumentPresenter.Return((DocumentPresenterControl x) => x.IsContentLoaded, () => true))
			{
				return;
			}
			((CommandCheckItem)ToggleDocumentMapCommand).Do(delegate(CommandCheckItem c)
			{
				bool canShow = DocumentViewer.Document.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.HasBookmarks, () => false);
				c.UpdateCheckState(() => canShow && DocumentViewer.PropertyProvider.ShowDocumentMap);
			});
			((CommandCheckItem)ToggleParametersPanelCommand).Do(delegate(CommandCheckItem c)
			{
				bool canShow = ((ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>)(object)DocumentViewer.ParameterPanelViewModel).HasVisibleParameters;
				c.UpdateCheckState(() => canShow && DocumentViewer.PropertyProvider.ShowParametersPanel);
			});
			((CommandCheckItem)ToggleThumbnailsCommand).Do(delegate(CommandCheckItem c)
			{
				bool canShow = DocumentViewer.Document != null && !DocumentViewer.Document.IsRemoteReportDocumentSource();
				c.UpdateCheckState(() => canShow && DocumentViewer.ShowThumbnails);
			});
			((CommandCheckItem)ToggleNavigationPaneCommand).Do(delegate(CommandCheckItem c)
			{
				bool canShow = DocumentViewer.CanToggleNavigationPane();
				c.UpdateCheckState(() => canShow && DocumentViewer.ShowNavigationPane);
			});
			((CommandCheckItem)ToggleEditingFieldsCommand).Do(delegate(CommandCheckItem c)
			{
				bool canShow = DocumentViewer.Document.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.EditingFields.Any(), () => false);
				c.UpdateCheckState(() => canShow && DocumentViewer.HighlightEditingFields);
			});
			CursorModeType actualCursorMode = DocumentViewer.Return((DocumentPreviewControl x) => x.CursorMode, () => CursorModeType.HandTool);
			((CommandCheckItem)HandToolCommand).UpdateCheckState(() => actualCursorMode == CursorModeType.HandTool);
			((CommandCheckItem)SelectToolCommand).UpdateCheckState(() => actualCursorMode == CursorModeType.SelectTool);
			CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
		}

		internal void UpdateExportCommands()
		{
			((CommandSplitItem)ExportSplitCommand).Do(delegate(CommandSplitItem c)
			{
				c.Commands = new ObservableCollection<ICommand>(from x in GetExportFormats()
					select CreateExportCommand(x, c.Command, isSendOperation: false));
			});
			((CommandSplitItem)SendSplitCommand).Do(delegate(CommandSplitItem c)
			{
				c.Commands = new ObservableCollection<ICommand>(from x in GetSendFormats()
					select CreateExportCommand(x, c.Command, isSendOperation: true));
			});
		}

		internal void UpdatePageLayoutCommands()
		{
			PageLayoutSettings currentPageLayout = DocumentViewer.Return((DocumentPreviewControl x) => new PageLayoutSettings(x.PageDisplayMode, x.ColumnsCount), () => new PageLayoutSettings());
			CommandCheckItems commandCheckItems = (CommandCheckItems)SetPageLayoutSplitCommand;
			commandCheckItems.UpdateCheckState(delegate(CommandToggleButton button)
			{
				PageLayoutCommandButton pageLayoutCommandButton = (PageLayoutCommandButton)button;
				switch (currentPageLayout.PageDisplayMode)
				{
				case PageDisplayMode.Single:
					return pageLayoutCommandButton.PageLayoutSettings.PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Single;
				case PageDisplayMode.Columns:
					if (pageLayoutCommandButton.PageLayoutSettings.PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Columns)
					{
						return pageLayoutCommandButton.PageLayoutSettings.ColumnCount == 2;
					}
					return false;
				case PageDisplayMode.Wrap:
					return pageLayoutCommandButton.PageLayoutSettings.PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Wrap;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			});
			CommandToggleButton input = commandCheckItems.Items.Where((CommandToggleButton x) => x is PageLayoutCommandButton).SingleOrDefault((CommandToggleButton x) => x.IsChecked);
			commandCheckItems.LargeGlyph = input.Return((CommandToggleButton x) => x.LargeGlyph, () => UriHelper.GetUri(dllName, "Images/BarItems/SinglePage.svg"));
			commandCheckItems.SmallGlyph = input.Return((CommandToggleButton x) => x.SmallGlyph, () => UriHelper.GetUri(dllName, "Images/BarItems/SinglePage.svg"));
			((CommandCheckItem)ToggleShowCoverPageCommand).UpdateCheckState(() => DocumentViewer.Return((DocumentPreviewControl x) => x.ShowCoverPage, () => false));
			((CommandCheckItem)ToggleEnableContinuousScrollingCommand).UpdateCheckState(() => DocumentViewer.Return((DocumentPreviewControl x) => x.EnableContinuousScrolling, () => true));
			CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
		}
	}

	internal static class ExportFormatHelper
	{
		private const string export = "Export";

		private const string send = "Send";

		public unsafe static PrintingStringId GetExportCaption(ExportFormat format, bool isSendOperation)
		{
			string value = (isSendOperation ? "Send" : "Export") + ((object)(*(ExportFormat*)(&format))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString();
			if (Enum.TryParse<PrintingStringId>(value, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (!isSendOperation)
			{
				return PrintingStringId.ExportFile;
			}
			return PrintingStringId.SendFile;
		}

		public unsafe static PreviewStringId? GetExportDescription(ExportFormat format, bool isSendOperation)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string text = (((int)format == 9) ? "Graphic" : ((object)(*(ExportFormat*)(&format))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
			text = (isSendOperation ? "Send" : "Export") + text.ToString();
			text = $"RibbonPreview_{text}_Description";
			if (Enum.TryParse<PreviewStringId>(text, out PreviewStringId result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		public DocumentPresenterControl()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			RenderMask = new DrawingBrush
			{
				Drawing = new GeometryDrawing()
			};
			InteractionProvider = CreateDefaultInteractionProvider();
			EditingStrategy = CreateDefaultEditingStrategy();
			SelectionRectangle = new SelectionRectangle(default(System.Windows.Point), System.Windows.Size.Empty);
			base.IsVisibleChanged += OnIsVisibleChanged;

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Renderer.Do(delegate(DocumentPreviewRenderer x)
			{
				x.UpdateInnerRenderer();
			});
		}

		private void OnIsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsVisible)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
			{
				base.ItemsPanel.Do(delegate(DocumentViewerPanel x)
				{
					x.UpdateLayout();
				});
				Update();
			});
		}

		private EditingStrategy CreateDefaultEditingStrategy()
		{
			return new EditingStrategy(this);
		}

		protected override void OnBehaviorProviderChanged(BehaviorProvider oldValue, BehaviorProvider newValue)
		{
			base.OnBehaviorProviderChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.ZoomChanged -= OnZoomChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.ZoomChanged += OnZoomChanged;
			}
			if (SelectionService == null)
			{
				SelectionService = new SelectionService(this)
				{
					Zoom = (float)newValue.ZoomFactor
				};
				SelectionService.InvalidatePage += InvalidatePage;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateBehaviorProviderProperties()
		{
			PreviewBehaviorProvider.Do(delegate(PreviewBehaviorProvider x)
			{
				x.PageDisplayMode = base.PageDisplayMode;
			});
			PreviewBehaviorProvider.Do(delegate(PreviewBehaviorProvider x)
			{
				x.RealPageSize = GetMaxPageSize(delegate(PageWrapper p)
				{
					if (!p.Pages.Any())
					{
						return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
					}
					double num = 0.0;
					System.Windows.Size result = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
					foreach (IPage page in p.Pages)
					{
						double num2 = page.PageSize.Width * page.PageSize.Height;
						if (num2 > num)
						{
							result = page.PageSize;
							num = num2;
						}
					}
					return result;
				});
			});
			base.UpdateBehaviorProviderProperties();
		}

		protected override void OnDocumentChanged(DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.IDocument oldValue, DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.IDocument newValue)
		{
			base.OnDocumentChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (base.BehaviorProvider != null)
			{
				NavigationStrategy.Do(delegate(DocumentNavigationStrategy x)
				{
					x.ScrollToStartUp();
				});
			}
			(oldValue as DocumentViewModel).Do(delegate(DocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.Pages.CollectionChanged -= OnPagesCollectionChanged;
				x.DocumentChanged -= OnInnerDocumentChanged;
				x.Disposing -= OnDocumentDisposing;
			});
			Renderer.Do(delegate(DocumentPreviewRenderer x)
			{
				x.Reset();
			});
			SelectionService.Do(delegate(SelectionService x)
			{
				x.ResetAll();
			});
			(newValue as DocumentViewModel).Do(delegate(DocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.Pages.CollectionChanged += OnPagesCollectionChanged;
				x.DocumentChanged += OnInnerDocumentChanged;
				x.Disposing += OnDocumentDisposing;
			});
			SearchParameter = new TextSearchParameter
			{
				CurrentPage = base.BehaviorProvider.Return((BehaviorProvider x) => x.PageIndex + 1, () => 1)
			};
		}

		private void OnDocumentDisposing(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DocumentViewModel documentViewModel = sender as DocumentViewModel;
			documentViewModel.Pages.CollectionChanged -= OnPagesCollectionChanged;
			documentViewModel.DocumentChanged -= OnInnerDocumentChanged;
			documentViewModel.Disposing -= OnDocumentDisposing;
		}

		private void OnPagesCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Dispatcher.Invoke(delegate
			{
				if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
				{
					foreach (PageViewModel page in e.NewItems.OfType<PageViewModel>())
					{
						PageWrapper pageWrapper = base.Pages.Single((PageWrapper x) => x.Pages.Any((IPage p) => p.PageIndex == page.PageIndex));
						int index = base.Pages.IndexOf(pageWrapper);
						IPage oldPage = pageWrapper.Pages.Single((IPage x) => x.PageIndex == page.PageIndex);
						int index2 = pageWrapper.Pages.IndexOf((IPage x) => x == oldPage);
						List<IPage> pages = new List<IPage>(pageWrapper.Pages) { [index2] = page };
						PageWrapper pageWrapper2 = CreatePageWrapper(pages);
						pageWrapper2.HorizontalPageSpacing = base.HorizontalPageSpacing;
						pageWrapper2.VerticalPageSpacing = base.VerticalPageSpacing;
						base.Pages[index] = pageWrapper2;
						int[] array = (from x in GetPages()
							select x.First.Index).ToArray();
					}
					base.ItemsPanel.Do(delegate(DocumentViewerPanel x)
					{
						x.UpdateLayout();
					});
				}
				else if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
				{
					base.Pages.Do(delegate(ObservableCollection<PageWrapper> x)
					{
						x.Clear();
					});
					NavigationStrategy.GenerateStartUpState();
				}
				else if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
				{
					OnAddPages(e);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Pages = ((Document.IsLoaded && Document.Pages.Any()) ? Document.With((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => GeneratePageWrappers(Document.Pages)) : null);
					base.ItemsControl.ItemsSource = base.Pages;
				}
				base.BehaviorProvider.Do(delegate(BehaviorProvider x)
				{
					x.PageSize = GetMaxPageSize();
				});
				base.BehaviorProvider.Do(delegate(BehaviorProvider x)
				{
					x.PageVisibleSize = GetMaxPageVisibleSize();
				});
				if (!Document.IsRemoteReportDocumentSource())
				{
					ActualDocumentViewer.Do(delegate(DocumentPreviewControl x)
					{
						x.ThumbnailsSettings.RaiseInvalidate();
					});
				}
			});
		}

		private void OnAddPages(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Pages == null || base.PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Wrap)
			{
				base.Pages = ((Document.IsLoaded && Document.Pages.Any()) ? Document.With((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => GeneratePageWrappers(Document.Pages)) : null);
				base.ItemsControl.ItemsSource = base.Pages;
			}
			else if (base.PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Columns)
			{
				PageWrapper pageWrapper = base.Pages.LastOrDefault();
				if (pageWrapper == null)
				{
					base.Pages = ((Document.IsLoaded && Document.Pages.Any()) ? Document.With((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => GeneratePageWrappers(Document.Pages)) : null);
					base.ItemsControl.ItemsSource = base.Pages;
				}
				else
				{
					IEnumerable<IPage> enumerable = Enumerable.Empty<IPage>();
					bool flag = false;
					if (pageWrapper.Pages.Count() < base.ColumnsCount)
					{
						flag = true;
						int pageIndex = pageWrapper.Pages.First().PageIndex;
						enumerable = Document.Pages.Skip(pageIndex);
					}
					else
					{
						int pageIndex2 = pageWrapper.Pages.Last().PageIndex;
						enumerable = (enumerable = Document.Pages.Skip(pageIndex2 + 1));
					}
					ObservableCollection<PageWrapper> observableCollection = GeneratePageWrappers(enumerable);
					if (flag)
					{
						base.Pages[base.Pages.Count - 1] = observableCollection[0];
					}
					IEnumerable<PageWrapper> enumerable3;
					if (!flag)
					{
						IEnumerable<PageWrapper> enumerable2 = observableCollection;
						enumerable3 = enumerable2;
					}
					else
					{
						enumerable3 = observableCollection.Skip(1);
					}
					IEnumerable<PageWrapper> enumerable4 = enumerable3;
					foreach (PageWrapper item in enumerable4)
					{
						base.Pages.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (IPage item2 in e.NewItems.Cast<IPage>())
				{
					base.Pages.Add(CreatePageWrapper(item2));
				}
			}
			UpdateBehaviorProviderProperties();
			NavigationStrategy.GenerateStartUpState();
		}

		private void OnInnerDocumentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.Dispatcher.Invoke(delegate
			{
				if (!Document.IsRemoteReportDocumentSource())
				{
					ActualDocumentViewer.Do(delegate(DocumentPreviewControl x)
					{
						x.ThumbnailsSettings.RaiseInvalidate();
					});
				}
				Update();
			});
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetMaxPageSize()
		{
			return GetMaxPageSize((PageWrapper x) => x.PageSize);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetMaxPageVisibleSize()
		{
			return GetMaxPageSize((PageWrapper x) => x.VisibleSize);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetMaxPageSize(Func<PageWrapper, System.Windows.Size> sizeSelector)
		{
			if (base.Pages == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			System.Windows.Size result = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			foreach (PageWrapper page in base.Pages)
			{
				double num2 = sizeSelector(page).Width * sizeSelector(page).Height;
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					result = sizeSelector(page);
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void InvalidatePage(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RenderContent();
		}

		protected override void Initialize()
		{
			//IL_013b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0145: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (base.ItemsControl == null || !base.IsInitialized || base.BehaviorProvider == null || ScrollViewer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Pages = (Document.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.IsLoaded, () => false) ? GeneratePageWrappers(Document.Pages) : null);
			base.ItemsControl.PageDisplayMode = base.PageDisplayMode;
			base.ItemsControl.ItemsSource = base.Pages;
			base.ItemsPanel.ShowSingleItem = base.ShowSingleItem;
			NavigationStrategy.GenerateStartUpState();
			UpdateBehaviorProviderProperties();
			base.NativeImage.Invalidate();
			DocumentViewModel documentModel = Document as DocumentViewModel;
			if (documentModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (documentModel.NavigationState != null)
			{
				base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
					{
						documentModel.NavigationState.Do(NavigationStrategy.ChangePosition);
						documentModel.NavigationState = null;
					});
				});
			}
			else if (base.Pages != null)
			{
				base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((IAction)new DelegateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					NavigationStrategy.ScrollToStartUp();
				}));
			}
			base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)Update);
		}

		protected override void OnScrollViewerScrollChanged(object sender, ScrollChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnScrollViewerScrollChanged(sender, e);
			InteractionProvider.OnScrollChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void UpdatePages()
		{
			base.UpdatePages();
			base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)Update);
		}

		internal void AttachEditorToTree(DocumentInplaceEditorOwner editorOwner, int pageIndex, Func<Rect> rectHandler, double angle)
		{
			PreviewPageControl previewPageControl = (PreviewPageControl)LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)base.ItemsPanel, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement fr) => (fr as PageControl).If((PageControl x) => ((PageWrapper)x.DataContext).Pages.Any((IPage page) => page.PageIndex == pageIndex)).ReturnSuccess()));
			if (previewPageControl != null)
			{
				ActiveEditorOwner = editorOwner;
				editorOwner.Page = previewPageControl;
				previewPageControl.AddEditor(editorOwner.VisualHost, rectHandler, angle);
			}
		}

		internal void DetachEditorFromTree()
		{
			if (ActiveEditorOwner != null)
			{
				PreviewPageControl page = ActiveEditorOwner.Page;
				page.RemoveEditor();
				ActiveEditorOwner = null;
			}
		}

		internal DrawingBrush GenerateRenderMask(IEnumerable<RenderItem> drawingContent)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			foreach (RenderItem item in drawingContent)
			{
				Rect rectangle = item.Rectangle;
				rectangle = CalcPageRect(item, rectangle);
				Geometry value = new RectangleGeometry(rectangle);
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(value);
			}
			GeometryDrawing drawing = new GeometryDrawing
			{
				Geometry = geometryGroup,
				Brush = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Green,
				Pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen()
			};
			return new DrawingBrush(drawing)
			{
				AlignmentX = AlignmentX.Left,
				AlignmentY = AlignmentY.Top,
				Stretch = Stretch.None,
				ViewboxUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute
			};
		}

		private Rect CalcPageRect(RenderItem pair, Rect rect)
		{
			PageWrapper pageWrapper = base.Pages.FirstOrDefault((PageWrapper x) => x.Pages.Any((IPage p) => p.PageIndex == pair.Page.PageIndex));
			if (pageWrapper != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Control control = (System.Windows.Controls.Control)base.ItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(pageWrapper);
				double num = (control.Padding.Left + control.Padding.Right) / 2.0;
				double num2 = (control.Padding.Top + control.Padding.Bottom) / 2.0;
				rect.Inflate(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num2);
			}
			return rect;
		}

		protected internal IEnumerable<RenderItem> GetDrawingContent()
		{
			return GetDrawingContent(base.ItemsPanel);
		}

		private IEnumerable<RenderItem> GetDrawingContent(DocumentViewerPanel panel)
		{
			List<RenderItem> list = new List<RenderItem>();
			if (panel == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			list.AddRange(GetVisiblePagesCore().Select(delegate(Pair<IPage, Rect> x)
			{
				IDocumentPage documentPage = (IDocumentPage)x.First;
				return new RenderItem
				{
					Rectangle = x.Second,
					Page = documentPage,
					NeedInvalidate = documentPage.NeedInvalidate,
					ForceInvalidate = documentPage.ForceInvalidate,
					TextureType = TextureType.Content
				};
			}));
			return list;
		}

		private bool IsVisibleChild(Rect rect)
		{
			return rect.IntersectsWith(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ItemsControl.ActualWidth, base.ItemsControl.ActualHeight));
		}

		protected internal void UpdatePanel()
		{
			if (base.ItemsPanel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.ItemsPanel.InternalChildren)
			{
				internalChild.InvalidateVisual();
			}
			base.ItemsPanel.InvalidatePanel();
		}

		protected override PageWrapper CreatePageWrapper(IEnumerable<IPage> pages)
		{
			return new PreviewPageWrapper(pages)
			{
				ZoomFactor = base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor,
				HorizontalPageSpacing = base.HorizontalPageSpacing,
				VerticalPageSpacing = base.VerticalPageSpacing
			};
		}

		protected override PageWrapper CreatePageWrapper(IPage page)
		{
			return new PreviewPageWrapper(page)
			{
				ZoomFactor = base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor
			};
		}

		protected override ObservableCollection<PageWrapper> GeneratePageWrappers(IEnumerable<IPage> pages)
		{
			if (pages.Any())
			{
				return base.GeneratePageWrappers(pages);
			}
			return new ObservableCollection<PageWrapper>();
		}

		public IEnumerable<Pair<Page, RectangleF>> GetPages()
		{
			return (from x in GetVisiblePagesCore()
				select new Pair<Page, RectangleF>(((IDocumentPage)x.First).Page, (RectangleF)WinFormsCompatibilityExtensions.ToWinFormsRectangle(x.Second))).ToList();
		}

		private IEnumerable<Pair<IPage, Rect>> GetVisiblePagesCore()
		{
			List<Pair<IPage, Rect>> list = new List<Pair<IPage, Rect>>();
			if (base.ItemsPanel != null)
			{
				foreach (FrameworkElement internalChild in base.ItemsPanel.InternalChildren)
				{
					if (internalChild.ActualWidth == 0.0 || internalChild.ActualHeight == 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					PageWrapper pageWrapper = (PageWrapper)base.ItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(internalChild);
					Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)internalChild, (UIElement)base.ItemsControl);
					foreach (PageViewModel item in from x in pageWrapper.Pages.OfType<PageViewModel>()
						where x.IsValid
						select x)
					{
						Rect pageRect = pageWrapper.GetPageRect(item);
						pageRect.Offset(relativeElementRect.Left, relativeElementRect.Top);
						if (IsVisibleChild(pageRect))
						{
							list.Add(new Pair<IPage, Rect>((IPage)item, pageRect));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		void ISupportInvalidateRenderingOnIdle.InvalidateRenderingOnIdle()
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle, (Action)delegate
			{
				if (FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree((FrameworkElement)this))
				{
					IEnumerable<RenderItem> drawingContent = GetDrawingContent();
					RenderItem renderItem = drawingContent.FirstOrDefault((RenderItem x) => x.NeedInvalidate);
					if (renderItem != null)
					{
						renderItem.Page.ForceInvalidate = true;
						RenderContent();
					}
				}
			});
		}
	}
