		public DocumentPreviewControl()
		{
			Cache = new TextureCache();
			HiddenExportFormats = new ObservableCollection<ExportFormat>();
			CreateParameterPanelViewModel();
			ThumbnailsSettings = new ThumbnailsViewerSettings();
			ThumbnailsSettings.Initialize(this);
			ActualNavigationPaneSettings = CreateDefaultNavigationPaneSettings();
			DXDisplayNameAttribute.UseResourceManager = true;
		}

		private void OnUseAsyncDocumentCreationChanged()
		{
			Document.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.UseAsyncDocumentCreation = ActualUseAsyncDocumentCreation;
			});
		}

		private void OnNavigationPaneSettingsChanged()
		{
			ActualNavigationPaneSettings = NavigationPaneSettings ?? CreateDefaultNavigationPaneSettings();
		}

		private void OnDocumentMapSettingsChanged()
		{
			base.ActualDocumentMapSettings = DocumentMapSettings ?? CreateDefaultDocumentMapSettings();
		}

		internal override void OnDocumentChangedInternal(DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.IDocument oldValue, DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.IDocument newValue)
		{
			(oldValue as DocumentViewModel)?.Dispose();
			base.OnDocumentChangedInternal(oldValue, newValue);
			ThumbnailsSettings.RaiseInvalidateTextureCache();
		}

		protected override DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.DocumentMapSettings CreateDefaultDocumentMapSettings()
		{
			return new DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.Native.DocumentMapSettings();
		}

		protected virtual NavigationPaneSettings CreateDefaultNavigationPaneSettings()
		{
			return new NavigationPaneSettings();
		}

		protected override void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			DocumentViewModel documentViewModel = Document as DocumentViewModel;
			Unsubscribe(documentViewModel);
			CloseActiveEditingFieldEditor();
			if (Document is DocumentViewModel documentViewModel2)
			{
				documentViewModel2.NavigationState = DocumentPresenter?.NavigationStrategy.GenerateNavigationState();
				documentViewModel2.ClearPages();
				documentViewModel2.RaiseDocumentChanged();
			}
			base.OnUnloaded(sender, e);
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLoaded(sender, e);
			DocumentViewModel documentViewModel = Document as DocumentViewModel;
			Subscribe(documentViewModel);
		}

		private void OnWindowChanged(Window oldValue, Window newValue)
		{
			UnsubscribeWindowEvents(oldValue);
			SubscribeWindowEvents(newValue);
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotFocus(e);
			DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.Focus();
			});
		}

			ToggleDocumentMapCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(ToggleDocumentMap, CanToggleDocumentMap);
			ToggleThumbnailsCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(ToggleThumbnails, CanToggleThumbnails);
			ToggleNavigationPaneCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(ToggleNavigationPane, CanToggleNavigationPane);
			ToggleEditingFieldsCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(ToggleEditingFields, CanToggleEditingFields);
			SaveCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(Save, CanSave);

			PageSetupCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(PageSetup, CanPageSetup);
			ScaleCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(Scale, CanScale);
			FirstPageCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(GoToFirstPage, CanGoToFirstPage);

		protected override string GetOpenFileFilter()
		{
			return string.Format("{0} (*{1})|*{1}", PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)274), ".prnx");
		}

		public override void OpenDocument(string filePath = null)
		{
			string value;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath) && File.Exists(filePath))
			{
				value = filePath;
			}
			else
			{
				CloseActiveEditingFieldEditor();
				IOpenFileDialogService openFileDialogService = base.OpenFileDialogTemplate.Return((Func<DataTemplate, IOpenFileDialogService>)TemplateHelper.LoadFromTemplate<IOpenFileDialogService>, (Func<IOpenFileDialogService>)CreateDefaultOpenFileDialogService);
				IFileInfo fileInfo = null;
				AssignableServiceHelper2<DocumentViewerControl, IOpenFileDialogService>.DoServiceAction((DependencyObject)this, openFileDialogService, (Action<IOpenFileDialogService>)delegate(IOpenFileDialogService service)
				{
					fileInfo = (service.ShowDialog() ? service.Files.FirstOrDefault() : null);
				});
				if (fileInfo == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				value = Path.Combine(fileInfo.DirectoryName, fileInfo.Name);
			}
			SetCurrentValue(DocumentViewerControl.DocumentSourceProperty, value);
		}

		public virtual void Save()
		{
			if (CanSave())
			{
				CloseActiveEditingFieldEditor();
				if (ShowSaveDialog(out var filePath) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
				{
					Document.Save(filePath);
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShowSaveDialog(out string filePath)
		{
			string path = string.Empty;
			bool result = false;
			AssignableServiceHelper2<DocumentPresenterControl, ISaveFileDialogService>.DoServiceAction((DependencyObject)this, SaveFileDialogTemplate.Return((Func<DataTemplate, ISaveFileDialogService>)TemplateHelper.LoadFromTemplate<ISaveFileDialogService>, (Func<ISaveFileDialogService>)CreateDefaultSaveFileDialogService), (Action<ISaveFileDialogService>)delegate(ISaveFileDialogService service)
			{
				service.InitialDirectory = Document.InitialDirectory;
				service.DefaultFileName = Document.DefaultFileName;
				result = service.ShowDialog();
				if (result)
				{
					path = Path.Combine(service.File.DirectoryName, service.File.Name);
				}
			});
			filePath = path;
			return result;
		}

		public virtual bool CanSave()
		{
			return Document.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.IsCreated && !IsInProgress, () => false);
		}

		public virtual void Print()
		{
			if (CanPrint() && !IsInProgress)
			{
				PrintOptionsViewModel printOptionsViewModel = PrintOptionsViewModel.Create(Document.PrintingSystem);
				printOptionsViewModel.PagePreviewIndex = base.CurrentPageNumber - 1;
				CloseActiveEditingFieldEditor();
				ShowPrintDialog(printOptionsViewModel);
			}
		}

		protected void ShowPrintDialog(PrintOptionsViewModel printModel)
		{
			DelegateCommand executeCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
			{
				printModel.SavePrinterSettings();
				Print(printModel);
			}, () => printModel.IsValid);
			AssignableServiceHelper2<DocumentPreviewControl, DialogService>.DoServiceAction((DependencyObject)this, DialogServiceTemplate.Return((Func<DataTemplate, DialogService>)TemplateHelper.LoadFromTemplate<DialogService>, (Func<DialogService>)CreateDefaultDialogService), (Action<DialogService>)delegate(DialogService service)
			{
				((ViewServiceBase)service).ViewTemplate = (DataTemplate)FindResource(new NewDocumentViewerThemeKeyExtension
				{
					ResourceKey = NewDocumentViewerThemeKeys.PrintDialogTemplate
				});
				service.ShowDialog(executeCommand, null, PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Print), printModel);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void Print(PrintOptionsViewModel printModel)
		{
			Document.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.Print(printModel);
			});
		}

		public virtual bool CanPrint()
		{
			return Document.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.IsCreated && !((IProgressSettings)x).InProgress, () => false);
		}

		public virtual void PrintDirect(string printerName = null)
		{
			CloseActiveEditingFieldEditor();
			Document.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.PrintDirect(printerName);
			});
		}

		public virtual bool CanPrintDirect()
		{
			return Document.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.IsCreated && !IsInProgress, () => false);
		}

		protected virtual void PageSetup()
		{
			if (Document != null)
			{
				PageViewModel selectedPage = Document.Pages.Where((PageViewModel page) => page.IsSelected).FirstOrDefault();
				DXGraphicsUnit unit = (Document.PrintingSystem.IsMetric ? DXGraphicsUnit.Millimeter : DXGraphicsUnit.Inch);
				PageSetupViewModel model = ViewModelSource.Create(() => new PageSetupViewModel(selectedPage.Page.PageData, unit));
				CloseActiveEditingFieldEditor();
				if (ShowPageSetupDialog(model))
				{
					PageSettingsViewModelHelper.AssignPageDataFromModel(model, selectedPage.Page, Document.PrintingSystem);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShowPageSetupDialog(PageSetupViewModel model)
		{
			return ShowDialog(model, NewDocumentViewerThemeKeys.PageSetupDialogTemplate, PrintingStringId.PageSetup);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanPageSetup()
		{
			if (base.DocumentSource is ILink)
			{
				DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel document = Document;
				if (document != null && document.CanChangePageSettings)
				{
					PageViewModel pageViewModel = Document.Pages[base.CurrentPageNumber - 1];
					if (pageViewModel.IsValid)
					{
						return !pageViewModel.Page.IsReadOnlyPageSettins;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void SetWatermark()
		{
			if (Document == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WatermarkEditorViewModel model = ViewModelSource.Create(() => new WatermarkEditorViewModel(Document.Watermarks.Clone(), WatermarkPageHelper.CopyPage(Document.Pages[CurrentPageNumber - 1].Page)));
			CloseActiveEditingFieldEditor();
			if (ShowWatermarkDialog(model))
			{
				Document.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x)
				{
					x.SetWatermarks(model.Watermarks);
				});
				DocumentPresenter.Update();
			}
		}

		private bool ShowDialog(ViewModelBase viewModelBase, NewDocumentViewerThemeKeys dialogTemplate, PrintingStringId caption, NewDocumentViewerThemeKeys dialogStyle = NewDocumentViewerThemeKeys.CommonDialogStyle)
		{
			bool result = false;
			DialogService dialogService = CreateDefaultDialogService();
			if (dialogStyle != NewDocumentViewerThemeKeys.CommonDialogStyle)
			{

		protected override void ExecuteNavigate(object parameter)
		{
			base.ShowFindTextCommand.Execute(false);
			BookmarkNode bookmarkNode = (BookmarkNode)(((parameter is BookmarkNode) ? parameter : null) ?? (parameter as BookmarkNodeItem)?.BookmarkNode);
			if (bookmarkNode is RootBookmarkNode)
			{
				DocumentPresenter?.ScrollViewer.ScrollToTop();
			}
			BookmarkNode obj = bookmarkNode;
			object obj2;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj2 = null;
			}
			else
			{
				BrickPagePair pair = obj.Pair;
				obj2 = ((pair != null) ? pair.GetPage((IPageRepository)(object)Document.PrintingSystem.Pages) : null);
			}
			if (obj2 != null)
			{
				DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl presenter)
				{
					presenter.SelectionService.ResetAll();
					DocumentPresenter.NavigationStrategy.ShowBrick(bookmarkNode.Pair);
				});
			}
			object obj3 = ((parameter is BrickPagePair) ? parameter : null);
			if (obj3 == null)
			{
				object obj4 = ((parameter is SearchData) ? parameter : null);
				obj3 = ((obj4 != null) ? ((SearchData)obj4).BrickPagePair : null);
			}
			BrickPagePair val = (BrickPagePair)obj3;
			if (val != null)
			{
				SelectBrick(val, ScrollIntoViewMode.Center);
			}
		}

		private void SelectBrick(BrickPagePair result, ScrollIntoViewMode? scrollIntoView = null)
		{
			DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.SelectionService.SelectBrick(result.GetPage((IPageRepository)(object)Document.PrintingSystem.Pages), BrickPagePairHelper.GetBrick(result, (IPageRepository)(object)Document.PrintingSystem.Pages));
				x.NavigationStrategy.ShowBrick(result, scrollIntoView);
				x.Update();
			});
		}

		protected override void FindNextText(TextSearchParameter parameter)
		{
			DocumentPresenter.SelectionService.ResetSelectedBricks();
			BrickPagePair val = Document.PerformSearch(parameter);
			if (val != null)
			{
				SelectBrick(val);
				return;
			}
			AssignableServiceHelper2<DocumentPreviewControl, DXMessageBoxService>.DoServiceAction((DependencyObject)this, MessageBoxServiceTemplate.Return((Func<DataTemplate, DXMessageBoxService>)TemplateHelper.LoadFromTemplate<DXMessageBoxService>, (Func<DXMessageBoxService>)CreateDefaultMessageBoxService), (Action<DXMessageBoxService>)delegate(DXMessageBoxService service)
			{
				((IMessageBoxService)service).ShowMessage(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.SearchFinished_NoMatchesFound), PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)166), MessageButton.OK, MessageIcon.Information);
			});
		}

		protected override void ShowFindText(bool? show)

			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetPageLayout(PageLayoutSettings settings)
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				CloseActiveEditingFieldEditor();
				if (settings.PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Columns)
				{
					ColumnsCount = ((settings.ColumnCount != 0) ? settings.ColumnCount : ColumnsCount);
					PageDisplayMode = settings.PageDisplayMode;
					SetZoomMode(ZoomMode.FitToWidth);
				}
				else
				{
					double zoomFactor = base.ActualBehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor;
					PageDisplayMode = settings.PageDisplayMode;
					SetZoomFactor(zoomFactor);
				}
				ActualCommandProvider.UpdateCommands();
			}
		}

		protected override DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.IDocument CreateDocument(object source)
		{
			DocumentViewModel documentViewModel = ((source is IReport) ? new ReportDocumentViewModel(this) : new DocumentViewModel());
			((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel)documentViewModel).UseAsyncDocumentCreation = ActualUseAsyncDocumentCreation;
			Subscribe(documentViewModel);
			return documentViewModel;
		}

		protected sealed override void LoadDocument(object source)
		{
			base.LoadDocument(source);
			if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				((DocumentViewModel)Document).Load(source);
				PrintingSystemBase printingSystem = Document.PrintingSystem;
				if (printingSystem != null)
				{
					ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<MessageBoxAccessor>((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)printingSystem, new MessageBoxAccessor(DoWithMessageBoxService), false);
				}
				RaiseDocumentLoaded();
				base.ActualDocumentMapSettings.UpdateProperties();
				ActualCommandProvider.Do(delegate(DocumentCommandProvider x)
				{
					x.UpdateCommands();
				});
				if (UseOfficeInspiredNavigationPane && AutoShowDocumentMap && Document.Return((DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x) => x.HasBookmarks, () => false))
				{
					ActualNavigationPaneSettings.ActiveTab = NavigationPaneTabType.DocumentMap;
					ShowNavigationPane = true;
				}
				CreateDocumentIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void CreateDocumentIfNeeded()
		{
			if (!Document.IsLoaded || !Document.PrintingSystem.Document.IsEmpty || Document.IsCreated || DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) || !RequestDocumentCreation)
			{
				return;
			}
			object documentSource = base.DocumentSource;
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (documentSource == base.DocumentSource)
				{
					CreateDocumentCore();
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		private void CreateDocumentCore()
		{
			if (Document != null && Document.PrintingSystem != null && !Document.PrintingSystem.IsDisposed && !Document.IsCreating)
			{
				Document.CreateDocument();
			}
		}

			ActualCommandProvider.Do(delegate(DocumentCommandProvider x)

				x.UpdateCommands();
			});
			ThumbnailsSettings.RaiseInvalidate();
			Cache.Reset();
			(Document as DocumentViewModel).Do(delegate(DocumentViewModel document)
			{
				document.NavigationState = null;
			});
		}

		private void Subscribe(DocumentViewModel documentViewModel)
		{
			Unsubscribe(documentViewModel);
			documentViewModel.Do(delegate(DocumentViewModel x)
			{
				//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004e: Expected O, but got Unknown
				x.Pages.CollectionChanged += OnPagesCollectionChanged;
				x.StartDocumentCreation += OnStartDocumentCreation;
				x.DocumentCreated += OnDocumentCreated;
				x.DocumentException += new ExceptionEventHandler(OnDocumentException);
				x.Subscribe();
			});
		}

		private void SubscribeWindowEvents(Window window)
		{
			if (window != null)
			{
				window.Closed += OnWindowClosed;
			}
		}

		private void Unsubscribe(DocumentViewModel documentViewModel)
		{
			documentViewModel.Do(delegate(DocumentViewModel x)
			{
				//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0074: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (x.PrintingSystem != null && !x.PrintingSystem.IsDisposed)
				{
					ServiceContainerExtensions.RemoveService<MessageBoxAccessor>((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)x.PrintingSystem);
				}
				x.Unsubscribe();
				x.Pages.CollectionChanged -= OnPagesCollectionChanged;
				x.StartDocumentCreation -= OnStartDocumentCreation;
				x.DocumentCreated -= OnDocumentCreated;
				x.DocumentException -= new ExceptionEventHandler(OnDocumentException);
			});
		}

		private void OnPagesCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.PageCount = Document.Pages.Count();
			if (base.CurrentPageNumber == 0 && base.PageCount > 0)
			{
				SetCurrentPageNumber(1);
			}
			if (HighlightCurrentPage)
			{
				Document.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x)
				{
					x.SetCurrentPage(base.CurrentPageNumber - 1);
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnStartDocumentCreation(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.ActualDocumentMapSettings.UpdateProperties();
			DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.NavigationStrategy.ScrollToStartUp();
				x.EditingStrategy.EndEditing();
			});
			Cache.Reset();
			ThumbnailsSettings.RaiseInvalidateTextureCache();
		}

		private void OnDocumentCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.ActualDocumentMapSettings.UpdateProperties();
			((DelegateCommand)ToggleEditingFieldsCommand).RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			ActualCommandProvider.Do(delegate(DocumentCommandProvider x)
			{
				x.UpdateCommands();
			});
			if (UseOfficeInspiredNavigationPane && PropertyProvider.ShowDocumentMap && AutoShowDocumentMap && Document.HasBookmarks)
			{
				ActualNavigationPaneSettings.SetCurrentValue(NavigationPaneSettings.ActiveTabProperty, NavigationPaneTabType.DocumentMap);
				SetCurrentValue(ShowNavigationPaneProperty, true);
			}
			DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.ItemsPanel.Do(delegate(DocumentViewerPanel panel)
				{
					panel.UpdateLayout();
				});
				x.Update();
			});
			Document.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PreviewControl.IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.SetCurrentPage(base.CurrentPageNumber - 1);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnDocumentException(object sender, ExceptionEventArgs e)
		{
			DoWithMessageBoxService(delegate(IMessageBoxService service)
			{
				service.ShowMessage(GetExceptionMessage(e.Exception), PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Error), MessageButton.OK, MessageIcon.Error);
			});
		}

		private void DoWithMessageBoxService(Action<IMessageBoxService> action)
		{
			AssignableServiceHelper2<DocumentPreviewControl, IMessageBoxService>.DoServiceAction((DependencyObject)this, MessageBoxServiceTemplate.Return((Func<DataTemplate, IMessageBoxService>)TemplateHelper.LoadFromTemplate<IMessageBoxService>, (Func<IMessageBoxService>)CreateDefaultMessageBoxService), (Action<IMessageBoxService>)delegate(IMessageBoxService service)
			{
				service.Do(delegate(IMessageBoxService s)
				{
					action(s);
				});
			});
		}

		private static string GetExceptionMessage(Exception e)
		{
			if (e is TargetInvocationException && e.InnerException != null)
			{
				e = e.InnerException;
			}
			else if (e is AggregateException)
			{
				e = e.GetBaseException();
			}
			return e.Message;
		}

		{

				DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
				{
					x.SelectionService.ResetSelectedBricks();

		}

		private ObservableCollection<ExportFormat> CoerceHiddenFormats(ObservableCollection<ExportFormat> hiddenFormats)
		{
			if (hiddenFormats == null)
			{
				return new ObservableCollection<ExportFormat>();
			}
			return new ObservableCollection<ExportFormat>(hiddenFormats.Distinct());
		}

		private void OnHiddenFormatsChanged(ObservableCollection<ExportFormat> oldValue, ObservableCollection<ExportFormat> newValue)
		{
			oldValue.Do(delegate(ObservableCollection<ExportFormat> x)

				x.CollectionChanged -= OnHiddenFormatsCollectionChanged;
			});
			newValue.Do(delegate(ObservableCollection<ExportFormat> x)
			{
				x.CollectionChanged += OnHiddenFormatsCollectionChanged;
			});
			ActualCommandProvider.Do(delegate(DocumentCommandProvider x)
			{
				x.UpdateExportCommands();
			});
		}

			});
		}

		private void OnHighlightCurrentPageChanged()
		{
			Document.SetCurrentPage(HighlightCurrentPage ? (base.CurrentPageNumber - 1) : (-1));
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageLayoutChanged()
		{
			ZoomMode zoomMode = base.ActualBehaviorProvider.ZoomMode;
			double zoomFactor = base.ActualBehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor;
			AssignDocumentPresenterProperties();
			if (PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Columns)
			{
				SetZoomMode(EnableContinuousScrolling ? ZoomMode.FitToWidth : ZoomMode.PageLevel);
			}
			else if (zoomMode != ZoomMode.Custom)
			{
				SetZoomMode(zoomMode);
			}
			else
			{
				SetZoomFactor(zoomFactor);
			}
		}

		protected override void AssignDocumentPresenterProperties()
		{
			base.AssignDocumentPresenterProperties();
			AssignPageLayoutSettings();
		}

		private void AssignPageLayoutSettings()
		{
			ActualCommandProvider.Do(delegate(DocumentCommandProvider x)
			{
				x.UpdatePageLayoutCommands();
			});
			DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.PageDisplayMode = PageDisplayMode;
				x.ColumnsCount = ((PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Columns) ? ColumnsCount : x.ColumnsCount);
				x.ShowCoverPage = PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Columns && x.ColumnsCount == 2 && ShowCoverPage;
				x.ShowSingleItem = (PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Single || PageDisplayMode == PageDisplayMode.Columns) && !EnableContinuousScrolling;
				x.HighlightSelectionColor = HighlightSelectionColor;
			});
		}

		private void OnAllowCachePagesChanges()
		{
			DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.Renderer.UpdateInnerRenderer();
			});
		}

		private void OnAllowDocumentEditingChanged()
		{
			if (!AllowDocumentEditing)
			{
				DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
				{
					x.EditingStrategy.EndEditing();
				});
			}
		}

	public class EditingFieldTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		private const string ImageEdit = "BrickImageEdit";

		private readonly FrameworkElement frameworkElement = new FrameworkElement();

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			EditingField val = Guard.ArgumentMatchType<EditingField>(item, "item");
			if (val is TextEditingField)
			{
				return (DataTemplate)frameworkElement.TryFindResource(new EditingFieldThemeKeyExtension
				{
					ResourceKey = ((TextEditingField)val).EditorName
				});
			}
			if (val is ImageEditingField)
			{
				return (DataTemplate)frameworkElement.TryFindResource(new EditingFieldThemeKeyExtension
				{
					ResourceKey = "BrickImageEdit"
				});
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class DockPanelVisibilityConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values.Length < 2 || values.Any((object x) => x == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue))
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			bool? flag = values[0] as bool?;
			bool flag2 = (values[1] as bool?).Return((bool? x) => x.Value, () => false);
			bool flag3 = values.Length != 3 || (values[2] as bool?).Return((bool? x) => x.Value, () => true);
			bool num;
			if (!flag.HasValue)
			{
				num = flag3 && flag2;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					goto IL_010c;
				}
				num = flag.Value;
			}
			if (!num)
			{
				goto IL_010c;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			goto IL_0110;
			IL_0110:
			return (Visibility)num2;
			IL_010c:
			num2 = 2;
			goto IL_0110;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Visibility visibility = (Visibility)value;
			bool flag = visibility == Visibility.Visible;
			return new object[1] { flag };
		}

	public class PreviewPageControl : PageControl, IVisualOwner, IInputElement, ILogicalOwner
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PagesProperty;

		private FrameworkElement activeEditor;

		public IEnumerable<PageViewModel> Pages
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable<PageViewModel>)GetValue(PagesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PagesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount => base.VisualChildrenCount + VisualContainer.VisualChildrenCount;

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => (IEnumerator)new MergedEnumerator(new IEnumerator[3]
		{
			VisualContainer.GetEnumerator(),
			base.LogicalChildren,
			LogicalContainer.GetEnumerator()
		});

		private VisualChildrenContainer VisualContainer { get; set; }

		private LogicalChildrenContainer LogicalContainer { get; set; }

		static PreviewPageControl()
		{
			PagesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Pages", typeof(IEnumerable<PageViewModel>), typeof(PreviewPageControl), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		public PreviewPageControl()
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			VisualContainer = new VisualChildrenContainer((IVisualOwner)(object)this, (ILogicalOwner)(object)this);
			LogicalContainer = new LogicalChildrenContainer((ILogicalOwner)(object)this);
			base.Focusable = false;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			if (activeEditor != null)
			{
				Func<Rect> func = (Func<Rect>)activeEditor.Tag;
				Rect finalRect = func();
				activeEditor.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (activeEditor != null)
			{
				Func<Rect> func = (Func<Rect>)activeEditor.Tag;
				System.Windows.Size size = func().Size;
				activeEditor.Measure(size);
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index >= base.VisualChildrenCount)
			{
				return VisualContainer.GetVisualChild(index - base.VisualChildrenCount);
			}
			return base.GetVisualChild(index);
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new PreviewPageControlItem();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is PreviewPageControlItem;
		}

		public void AddEditor(FrameworkElement editor, Func<Rect> rectHandler, double angle)
		{
			activeEditor = editor;
			VisualContainer.AddChild((Visual)editor);
			LogicalContainer.AddLogicalChild((object)editor);
			editor.Tag = rectHandler;
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		public void RemoveEditor()
		{
			if (activeEditor != null)
			{
				LogicalContainer.RemoveLogicalChild((object)activeEditor);
				VisualContainer.RemoveChild((Visual)activeEditor);
			}
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.AddChild(object child)
		{
			AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void IVisualOwner.AddChild(Visual child)
		{
			AddVisualChild(child);
		}

		void IVisualOwner.RemoveChild(Visual child)
		{
			RemoveVisualChild(child);
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool ILogicalOwner.get_IsLoaded()
		{
			return base.IsLoaded;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.add_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded += value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.remove_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded -= value;
		}

		{
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualHeight()
		{
			return base.ActualHeight;
		}

		{

		}

		protected override void OnDataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateMargin((e.NewValue as IPage)?.Margin ?? new Thickness(0.0));
		}

		private new void UpdateMargin(Thickness margin)
		{
			base.Margin = margin;
		}
	}
	public class NavigationPaneSearchModel
	{
		private CancellationTokenSource tokenSource;

		private readonly INavigationPaneUI navigationPaneUI;

		private readonly ObservableRangeCollection<SearchData> searchResults = new ObservableRangeCollection<SearchData>();

		private readonly ObservableRangeCollection<int> resultPageIndices = new ObservableRangeCollection<int>();

		private readonly ImmediateSingleActionManager singleActionManager;

		public virtual ObservableRangeCollection<object> BookmarkNodes { get; protected set; }

		public IEnumerable<int> ResultPageIndices => (IEnumerable<int>)resultPageIndices;

		public IEnumerable<SearchData> SearchResults => (IEnumerable<SearchData>)searchResults;

		public virtual SearchData SelectedSearchResult { get; set; }

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public int SelectedSearchResultIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((Collection<SearchData>)(object)searchResults).Contains(SelectedSearchResult))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return ((Collection<SearchData>)(object)searchResults).IndexOf(SelectedSearchResult);
			}
		}

		public virtual SearchState SearchState { get; protected set; }

		public virtual string SearchText { get; set; }

		public virtual bool UseCaseSensitiveSearch { get; set; }

		public virtual bool SearchWholeWords { get; set; }

		protected NavigationPaneSearchModel(INavigationPaneUI navigationPaneUI)
		{
			this.navigationPaneUI = navigationPaneUI;
			singleActionManager = new ImmediateSingleActionManager(delegate
			{
				Search();
			}, 800.0);
			BookmarkNodes = navigationPaneUI.BookmarkNodes;
		}

		protected void OnSelectedSearchResultChanged()
		{
			this.RaisePropertyChanged((NavigationPaneSearchModel m) => m.SelectedSearchResultIndex);
		}

		protected void OnSearchTextChanged()
		{
			InvalidateSearch();
			singleActionManager.RaiseAction();
		}

		protected void OnUseCaseSensitiveSearchChanged()
		{
			navigationPaneUI.SyncSearchParametersWithSettings();
			InvalidateSearch();
			singleActionManager.RaiseAction();
		}

		protected void OnSearchWholeWordsChanged()
		{
			navigationPaneUI.SyncSearchParametersWithSettings();
			InvalidateSearch();
			singleActionManager.RaiseAction();
		}

		public void Search()
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			InvalidateSearch();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchText))
			{
				return;
			}
			TextBrickSelector val = new TextBrickSelector(SearchText, SearchWholeWords, UseCaseSensitiveSearch, (IPrintingSystemContext)(object)navigationPaneUI.PrintingSystem);
			BrickPagePairComparer val2 = new BrickPagePairComparer((IPageRepository)(object)navigationPaneUI.PrintingSystem.Pages);
			Func<List<SearchData>, Task> func = delegate(List<SearchData> x)
			{
				navigationPaneUI.Dispatcher.Invoke(delegate
				{
					if (SearchState == SearchState.InProgress)
					{
						List<SearchData> list = x;
						searchResults.AddRange((IEnumerable<SearchData>)list);
						ProcessBookmarks(list.Where((SearchData y) => y.BookmarkNode != null));
						ProcessThumbnails(list.Select((SearchData y) => y.PageIndex));
					}
				}, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle);
				return TaskHelper.CompletedTask;
			};
			tokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			SearchState = SearchState.InProgress;
			Task task = SearchDataHelper.RunSearchAsync(navigationPaneUI.PrintingSystem, func, val, tokenSource.Token, ((IEnumerable<object>)BookmarkNodes).Select((object x) => ((BookmarkNodeItem)x).BookmarkNode));
			task.ContinueWith((Task x) => SearchState = SearchState.Finished);
		}

		public static NavigationPaneSearchModel Create(INavigationPaneUI navigationPaneUI)
		{
			return ViewModelSource.Create(() => new NavigationPaneSearchModel(navigationPaneUI));
		}

		public void StopSearch()
		{
			tokenSource.Cancel();
		}

		protected internal bool CanStopSearch()
		{
			return SearchState == SearchState.InProgress;
		}

		internal void InvalidateSearch()
		{
			if (SearchState == SearchState.InProgress && tokenSource != null)
			{
				tokenSource.Cancel();
			}
			SearchState = SearchState.None;
			((Collection<SearchData>)(object)searchResults).Clear();
			SelectedSearchResult = null;
			foreach (BookmarkNodeItem item in (Collection<object>)(object)BookmarkNodes)
			{
				item.IsHighlighted = false;
			}
			((Collection<int>)(object)resultPageIndices).Clear();
		}

		private void ProcessThumbnails(IEnumerable<int> indices)
		{
			if (indices.Any())
			{
				resultPageIndices.AddRange(indices);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessBookmarks(IEnumerable<SearchData> items)
		{
			if (!items.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IGrouping<BookmarkNode, SearchData> item in from x in items
				group x by x.BookmarkNode)
			{
				foreach (BookmarkNodeItem item2 in (Collection<object>)(object)BookmarkNodes)
				{
					if (item.Key == item2.BookmarkNode)
					{
						item2.IsHighlighted = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool SetSelectedItem(BookmarkNodeItem bookmarkNodeItem)
		{
			foreach (SearchData searchResult in SearchResults)
			{
				BookmarkNode bookmarkNode = bookmarkNodeItem.BookmarkNode;
				if (bookmarkNode == searchResult.BookmarkNode)
				{
					SelectedSearchResult = searchResult;
					SelectBrick(SelectedSearchResult.With((SearchData x) => x.BrickPagePair));
					navigationPaneUI.SelectedBookmarkNode = bookmarkNodeItem;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void NavigateToNextResult(TextSearchDirection searchDirection)
		{
			if (navigationPaneUI.ActiveTab == NavigationPaneTabType.DocumentMap && ((IEnumerable<object>)BookmarkNodes).Any())
			{
				BookmarkNodeItem selectedBookmarkItem = (BookmarkNodeItem)navigationPaneUI.SelectedBookmarkNode;
				IEnumerable<SearchData> source = SearchResults.Where((SearchData x) => x.BookmarkNode == selectedBookmarkItem.BookmarkNode);
				if (SelectedSearchResult != null && SelectedSearchResult.BookmarkNode == selectedBookmarkItem.BookmarkNode && source.Skip(1).Any() && ((searchDirection == TextSearchDirection.Forward && source.Last() != SelectedSearchResult) || (searchDirection == TextSearchDirection.Backward && source.First() != SelectedSearchResult)))
				{
					NavigateToBrick(searchDirection);
					return;
				}
				if (searchDirection == TextSearchDirection.Forward)
				{
					for (int num = ((Collection<object>)(object)BookmarkNodes).IndexOf((object)selectedBookmarkItem) + 1; num < ((IEnumerable<object>)BookmarkNodes).Count(); num++)
					{
						if (SetSelectedItem((BookmarkNodeItem)BookmarkNodes[num]))
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					SelectedSearchResult = SearchResults.First((SearchData x) => x.BookmarkNode != null);
					SelectDocumentMapNode();
					return;
				}
				for (int num2 = ((Collection<object>)(object)BookmarkNodes).IndexOf((object)selectedBookmarkItem) - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					if (SetSelectedItem((BookmarkNodeItem)BookmarkNodes[num2]))
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				SelectedSearchResult = SearchResults.Last((SearchData x) => x.BookmarkNode != null);
				SelectDocumentMapNode();
			}
			else if (navigationPaneUI.ActiveTab == NavigationPaneTabType.Pages)
			{
				if (SelectedSearchResult != null && SelectedSearchResult.PageIndex + 1 == navigationPaneUI.CurrentPageNumber)
				{
					SelectedSearchResult = GetNextSelection(searchDirection);
					SelectBrick(SelectedSearchResult.With((SearchData x) => x.BrickPagePair));
					return;
				}
				SearchData selectedSearchResult = SearchResults.Where((SearchData x) => ((BrickPageInfo)x.BrickPagePair).PageIndex + 1 == navigationPaneUI.CurrentPageNumber).FirstOrDefault() ?? SearchResults.FirstOrDefault();
				SelectedSearchResult = selectedSearchResult;
				SelectBrick(SelectedSearchResult.With((SearchData x) => x.BrickPagePair));
			}
			else
			{
				if (SelectedSearchResult == null)
				{
					SelectedSearchResult = ((searchDirection == TextSearchDirection.Forward) ? SearchResults.FirstOrDefault() : SearchResults.LastOrDefault());
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedSearchResult = GetNextSelection(searchDirection);
				}
				SelectBrick(SelectedSearchResult.With((SearchData x) => x.BrickPagePair));
			}
		}

		protected bool CanNavigateToNextResult(TextSearchDirection direction)
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<SearchData>)searchResults).Any();
		}

		private void SelectDocumentMapNode()
		{
			SelectBrick(SelectedSearchResult.With((SearchData x) => x.BrickPagePair));
			object selectedBookmarkNode = ((IEnumerable<object>)BookmarkNodes).First((object y) => ((BookmarkNodeItem)y).BookmarkNode == SelectedSearchResult.BookmarkNode);
			navigationPaneUI.SelectedBookmarkNode = selectedBookmarkNode;
		}

		private void NavigateToBrick(TextSearchDirection searchDirection)
		{
			int num = ((Collection<SearchData>)(object)searchResults).IndexOf(SelectedSearchResult);
			SelectedSearchResult = searchResults[(searchDirection == TextSearchDirection.Forward) ? (num + 1) : (num - 1)];
			SelectBrick(SelectedSearchResult.With((SearchData x) => x.BrickPagePair));
		}

		private SearchData GetNextSelection(TextSearchDirection searchDirection)
		{
			if (searchDirection == TextSearchDirection.Forward)
			{
				if (SelectedSearchResult != SearchResults.Last())
				{
					return searchResults[((Collection<SearchData>)(object)searchResults).IndexOf(SelectedSearchResult) + 1];
				}
				return SearchResults.First();
			}
			if (SelectedSearchResult != SearchResults.First())
			{
				return searchResults[((Collection<SearchData>)(object)searchResults).IndexOf(SelectedSearchResult) - 1];
			}
			return SearchResults.Last();
		}

		private void SelectBrick(BrickPagePair result)
		{
			if (result != null)
			{
				navigationPaneUI.DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
				{
					x.SelectionService.SelectBrick(result.GetPage((IPageRepository)(object)navigationPaneUI.PrintingSystem.Pages), BrickPagePairHelper.GetBrick(result, (IPageRepository)(object)navigationPaneUI.PrintingSystem.Pages));
					x.NavigationStrategy.ShowBrick(result);
					x.Update();
				});
			}
		}
	}
	public enum SearchState
	{
		None,
		InProgress,
		Finished
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_DocumentMapControl", Type = typeof(DocumentMap))]

		object INavigationPaneUI.SelectedBookmarkNode

			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<NavigationPaneControl>.New().RegisterReadOnly<NavigationPaneSearchModel>("NavigationPaneSearchModel", ref NavigationPaneSearchModelPropertyKey, ref NavigationPaneSearchModelProperty, (NavigationPaneSearchModel)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<NavigationPaneSettings>("NavigationPaneSettings", ref NavigationPaneSettingsProperty, (NavigationPaneSettings)null, (Action<NavigationPaneControl, NavigationPaneSettings, NavigationPaneSettings>)delegate(NavigationPaneControl d, NavigationPaneSettings o, NavigationPaneSettings n)
			{

				.Register<DocumentViewModel>("ActualDocument", ref ActualDocumentProperty, (DocumentViewModel)null, (Action<NavigationPaneControl, DocumentViewModel, DocumentViewModel>)delegate(NavigationPaneControl d, DocumentViewModel o, DocumentViewModel n)
				{

				.OverrideMetadata<DocumentPreviewControl>(DocumentViewerControl.ActualViewerProperty, (DocumentPreviewControl)null, (Action<NavigationPaneControl, DocumentPreviewControl, DocumentPreviewControl>)delegate(NavigationPaneControl d, DocumentPreviewControl o, DocumentPreviewControl n)
				{
					d.viewer = n;
				}, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<NavigationPaneControl>();

		public NavigationPaneControl()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SearchCommand = new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				NavigationPaneSearchModel.Search();
			});
			SetCurrentValue(NavigationPaneSettingsProperty, new NavigationPaneSettings());
			SetBinding(ActualDocumentProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{

				FallbackValue = null

		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			searchBox = (ButtonEdit)GetTemplateChild("PART_SearchBox");

		private void OnSettingsChanged(NavigationPaneSettings o, NavigationPaneSettings n)
		{
			o.Do(delegate(NavigationPaneSettings x)
			{
				x.AssignNavigationPaneUI(null);
			});
			n.Do(delegate(NavigationPaneSettings x)
			{
				x.AssignNavigationPaneUI(this);
			});
		}

		public void FocusSearchBox()
		{
			((UIElement)(object)searchBox).Focus();
			Keyboard.Focus((IInputElement)searchBox);
			DispatcherHelper.DoEvents(2);
		}

		private void OnDocumentChanged(DocumentViewModel oldValue, DocumentViewModel newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.StartDocumentCreation -= OnStartDocumentCreation;
				oldValue.DocumentCreated -= OnDocumentCreated;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				NavigationPaneSearchModel = NavigationPaneSearchModel.Create(this);
				((INavigationPaneUI)this).SyncSearchParametersWithModel();
				newValue.StartDocumentCreation += OnStartDocumentCreation;
				newValue.DocumentCreated += OnDocumentCreated;
			}
			else
			{
				NavigationPaneSearchModel = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnDocumentCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NavigationPaneSearchModel.Search();
		}

		private void OnStartDocumentCreation(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (NavigationPaneSearchModel.CanStopSearch())
			{
				NavigationPaneSearchModel.StopSearch();
			}
		}

		void INavigationPaneUI.SyncSearchParametersWithModel()
		{
			settingsLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (NavigationPaneSearchModel != null && NavigationPaneSettings != null)
				{
					NavigationPaneSearchModel.UseCaseSensitiveSearch = NavigationPaneSettings.UseCaseSensitiveSearch;
					NavigationPaneSearchModel.SearchWholeWords = NavigationPaneSettings.SearchWholeWords;
				}
			});
		}

		void INavigationPaneUI.SyncSearchParametersWithSettings()
		{
			settingsLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (NavigationPaneSearchModel != null && NavigationPaneSettings != null)
				{
					NavigationPaneSettings.UseCaseSensitiveSearch = NavigationPaneSearchModel.UseCaseSensitiveSearch;
					NavigationPaneSettings.SearchWholeWords = NavigationPaneSearchModel.SearchWholeWords;
				}
			});
		}

	public class NavigationPaneSettings : FrameworkElement
	{

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowDocumentMapTabProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowPagesTabProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UseCaseSensitiveSearchProperty;

			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowPagesTabProperty);
			}
			set

			}

		{
			get

			}

		static NavigationPaneSettings()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<NavigationPaneSettings>.New().Register<NavigationPaneTabType>("ActiveTab", ref ActiveTabProperty, NavigationPaneTabType.SearchResults, (Func<NavigationPaneSettings, NavigationPaneTabType, NavigationPaneTabType>)((NavigationPaneSettings d, NavigationPaneTabType n) => d.CoerceActiveTab(n)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<bool>("ShowDocumentMapTab", ref ShowDocumentMapTabProperty, true, (Action<NavigationPaneSettings>)delegate(NavigationPaneSettings d)
			{
				d.OnShowDocumentMapChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowPagesTab", ref ShowPagesTabProperty, true, (Action<NavigationPaneSettings>)delegate(NavigationPaneSettings d)
				{
					d.OnShowPagesTabChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("UseCaseSensitiveSearch", ref UseCaseSensitiveSearchProperty, false, (Action<NavigationPaneSettings>)delegate(NavigationPaneSettings d)
				{
					d.OnSearchSettingsChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("SearchWholeWords", ref SearchWholeWordsProperty, false, (Action<NavigationPaneSettings>)delegate(NavigationPaneSettings d)
				{
					d.OnShowPagesTabChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		private NavigationPaneTabType CoerceActiveTab(NavigationPaneTabType newValue)
		{
			if ((newValue == NavigationPaneTabType.DocumentMap && !ShowDocumentMapTab) || (newValue == NavigationPaneTabType.Pages && !ShowPagesTab))
			{
				return NavigationPaneTabType.SearchResults;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private void OnShowDocumentMapChanged()
		{
			if (!ShowDocumentMapTab && ActiveTab == NavigationPaneTabType.DocumentMap)
			{
				ActiveTab = NavigationPaneTabType.SearchResults;
			}
		}

		private void OnShowPagesTabChanged()
		{
			if (!ShowPagesTab && ActiveTab == NavigationPaneTabType.Pages)
			{
				ActiveTab = NavigationPaneTabType.SearchResults;
			}
		}

		private void OnSearchSettingsChanged()
		{
			navigationPane.Do(delegate(INavigationPaneUI x)
			{
				x.SyncSearchParametersWithModel();
			});
		}

		internal void AssignNavigationPaneUI(INavigationPaneUI navigationPane)
		{
			this.navigationPane = navigationPane;
			navigationPane.Do(delegate(INavigationPaneUI x)
			{
				x.SyncSearchParametersWithModel();
			});
		}

		public void ForceFocusSearchBox()
		{
			DocumentPreviewControl input = DocumentViewerControl.GetActualViewer((FrameworkElement)navigationPane) as DocumentPreviewControl;
			input.Do(delegate(DocumentPreviewControl x)
			{
				x.ShowNavigationPane = true;
			});
			DispatcherHelper.DoEvents(3);
			ActiveTab = NavigationPaneTabType.SearchResults;
			navigationPane.FocusSearchBox();
		}
	}

	public class PageLayoutSettings : MarkupExtension
	{
		public PageDisplayMode PageDisplayMode { get; set; }

		public int ColumnCount { get; set; }

		public PageLayoutSettings()
			: this(PageDisplayMode.Single)
		{
		}

		public PageLayoutSettings(PageDisplayMode mode)
			: this(mode, (mode != PageDisplayMode.Columns) ? 1 : 2)
		{
		}

		public PageLayoutSettings(PageDisplayMode mode, int columnCount)
		{
			PageDisplayMode = mode;
			ColumnCount = columnCount;
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is PageLayoutSettings pageLayoutSettings && PageDisplayMode == pageLayoutSettings.PageDisplayMode)
			{
				return ColumnCount == pageLayoutSettings.ColumnCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return PageDisplayMode.GetHashCode() ^ ColumnCount.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		public static bool? Print(IPrintableControl source)
		{
			using PrintableControlLink printableControlLink = new PrintableControlLink(source);
			return printableControlLink.Print();
		}

		public static bool? Print(IReport source)
		{
			if (((IDocumentSource)source).PrintingSystemBase.Document.PageCount == 0)
			{
				((ILink)source).CreateDocument(false);
			}
			return PrintHelperInternal.Print(((IDocumentSource)source).PrintingSystemBase, ActiveWindowFinderBase<ActiveWindowFinder>.Instance.GetActiveWindow());
		}

		public static bool? Print(IBasePrintable source)
		{
			return Print(source, null);
		}

		internal static bool? Print(IBasePrintable source, string themeName)
		{
			using LegacyPrintableComponentLink legacyPrintableComponentLink = new LegacyPrintableComponentLink(source);
			legacyPrintableComponentLink.CreateDocument(buildForInstantPreview: false);
			return PrintHelperInternal.Print((PrintingSystemBase)(object)legacyPrintableComponentLink.PrintingSystem, ActiveWindowFinderBase<ActiveWindowFinder>.Instance.GetActiveWindow(), themeName);
		}

		internal static ReadonlyPageData[] CollectPageData(Page[] pages)
		{
			ReadonlyPageData[] array = (ReadonlyPageData[])(object)new ReadonlyPageData[pages.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < pages.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = pages[i].PageData;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static void link_PrintCompleted(object sender, AsyncCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			LinkBase linkBase = (LinkBase)sender;
			linkBase.PrintCompleted -= link_PrintCompleted;
			linkBase.Dispose();
			if (PrintHelper.PrintCompleted != null)
			{
				PrintHelper.PrintCompleted(null, new AsyncCompletedEventArgs(e.Error, e.Cancelled, e.UserState));
			}
		}

	public class ReportParameterValidationBehavior : Behavior<DocumentPreviewControl>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValidateParameterCommandProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValidateParameterCommand", typeof(ICommand<ValidateParameterEventArgs>), typeof(ReportParameterValidationBehavior), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public ICommand<ValidateParameterEventArgs> ValidateParameterCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return (ICommand<ValidateParameterEventArgs>)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ValidateParameterCommandProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ValidateParameterCommandProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			((ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>)(object)base.AssociatedObject.ParameterPanelViewModel).Validate += OnValidate;
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>)(object)base.AssociatedObject.ParameterPanelViewModel).Validate -= OnValidate;
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		private void OnValidate(object sender, ValidateParameterEventArgs e)
		{
			ValidateParameterCommand?.Execute(e);
		}
	}

		{
			this.parameters = (IParameterContainer)(object)parameters;
			CreateDocumentInternal(null);
		}

		protected void CreateDocumentInternal(object customArgs)
		{
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0094: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a0: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ValidateInstanceIdentity();
			Clear();
			client = CreateClient();
			client.GetPagesCompleted += client_GetPagesCompleted;
			WatermarkCollection val = (isWatermarkChanged ? xpfWatermarks : null);
			if (parameters is ClientParameterContainer)
			{
				IEnumerableExtensions.ForEach<ParameterItemViewModel>((IEnumerable<ParameterItemViewModel>)((ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>)(object)ParametersModel).Parameters, (Action<ParameterItemViewModel>)delegate(ParameterItemViewModel x)
				{
					x.UpdateParameter((UpdateAction)0);
				});
				ReportParameterContainer val2 = new ReportParameterContainer
				{
					Parameters = ((ParameterPanelViewModel)(object)ParametersModel).GetReportParameterStubs()
				};
				parameters = (IParameterContainer)new ClientParameterContainer(val2);
			}
			ReportBuildArgs buildArgs = Helper.CreateReportBuildArgs(parameters, DocumentPageSettings, val, customArgs);
			CreateDocumentCore(ConstructCreateDocumentOperation(buildArgs));
		}

		protected virtual CreateDocumentOperation ConstructCreateDocumentOperation(ReportBuildArgs buildArgs)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new CreateDocumentOperation(client, InstanceIdentity, buildArgs, !isReportInformationRequested, statusUpdateInterval);
		}

		protected virtual void ValidateInstanceIdentity()
		{
			if (InstanceIdentity == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't create a document because InstanceIdentity or ReportName is not set.");
			}
			InstanceIdentity obj = InstanceIdentity;
			ReportNameIdentity val = (ReportNameIdentity)(object)((obj is ReportNameIdentity) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.Value))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't create a document because ReportName is not set.");
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			Clear(enableRefresh: false);
		}

		private void Clear(bool enableRefresh)
		{
			if (exportWriter != null)
			{
				exportWriter.Dispose();
				exportWriter = null;
			}
			if (serviceOperation != null)
			{
				serviceOperation.Abort();
				serviceOperation = null;
			}
			ClearDocumentOnServer();
			if (client != null)
			{
				client.GetPagesCompleted -= client_GetPagesCompleted;
				client.GetDocumentDataCompleted -= client_GetDocumentDataCompleted;
				((IServiceClientBase)client).CloseAsync();
				client = null;
			}
			documentMapRootNode = null;
			IsDocumentMapVisible = false;
			canRefresh = enableRefresh;
			DocumentExportOptions = null;
			exportModes = null;
			base.IsLoading = false;
			SetProgressVisibility(value: false);
			IsCreating = false;
			printData = null;
			ClearParameters();
			SetCurrentPageIndex(-1);
			SetPageCount(0);
			RaisePropertyChanged(() => IsEmptyDocument);
			RaiseAllCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private void CreateDocumentCore(CreateDocumentOperation operation)
		{
			operation.GetReportParameters += createDocumentOperation_GetReportParameters;
			operation.Started += createDocumentOperation_Started;
			operation.Progress += createDocumentOperation_Progress;
			operation.Completed += createDocumentOperation_Completed;
			((ReportServiceOperation)operation).CanStopChanged += createDocumentOperation_CanStopChanged;

			serviceOperation.Start();
			IsCreating = true;
			base.IsLoading = true;
			RaiseAllCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private void createDocumentOperation_Started(object sender, CreateDocumentStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			documentId = e.DocumentId;
			StartShowingProgress();
		}

		private void createDocumentOperation_Progress(object sender, CreateDocumentProgressEventArgs e)
		{
			if (pageCount == 0 && e.PageCount > 0)
			{
				SetPageCount(e.PageCount);
				if (!IsValidPageIndex(base.CurrentPageIndex))
				{
					base.CurrentPageIndex = 0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetPageCount(e.PageCount);
			}
			SetProgressValue(e.ProgressPosition);
			RaiseNavigationCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private void createDocumentOperation_Completed(object sender, CreateDocumentCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((AsyncCompletedEventArgs)(object)e).Error != null)
			{
				Clear(enableRefresh: true);
				RaiseOperationError(((AsyncCompletedEventArgs)(object)e).Error, this.CreateDocumentError);
				return;
			}
			IsCreating = false;
			base.IsLoading = false;
			if (documentId != null)
			{
				RefreshPageOnReportBuildCompleted();
				client.GetDocumentDataCompleted += client_GetDocumentDataCompleted;
				client.GetDocumentDataAsync(documentId, (object)null);
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => IsEmptyDocument);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RefreshPageOnReportBuildCompleted()
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (PageCount > 0)
			{
				client.GetPagesAsync(documentId, new int[1] { base.CurrentPageIndex }, PageCompatibility, (object)base.CurrentPageIndex);
			}
		}

		private void client_GetDocumentDataCompleted(object sender, ScalarOperationCompletedEventArgs<DocumentData> e)
		{
			//IL_011f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0124: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IReportServiceClient val = (IReportServiceClient)((sender is IReportServiceClient) ? sender : null);

			if (((AsyncCompletedEventArgs)(object)e).Error != null)
			{
				RaiseOperationError(((AsyncCompletedEventArgs)(object)e).Error, this.CreateDocumentError);
				return;
			}
			serviceOperation = null;

				DocumentData result = e.Result;

				SubscribePageSettingsChangedEvent();

				Helper.DeserializeExportOptions(DocumentExportOptions, result.ExportOptions);
				DocumentExportOptions.HiddenOptions.Clear();
				base.DefaultExportFormat = ExportFormatConverter.ToExportFormat(DocumentExportOptions.PrintPreview.DefaultExportFormat);
				RestoreWatermark(result.SerializedWatermarks);

		private void CopyParameters(DefaultValueParameterContainer source, ClientParameterContainer dest)
		{

			}
		}

		private void printDocumentOperation_Completed(object sender, PrintDocumentCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PrintDocumentOperation val = (PrintDocumentOperation)sender;
			val.Completed -= printDocumentOperation_Completed;
			SetProgressVisibility(value: false);
			if (((AsyncCompletedEventArgs)(object)e).Error != null)
			{
				RaiseOperationError(((AsyncCompletedEventArgs)(object)e).Error, this.PrintError);
			}
			else
			{
				printData = e.Pages;
				ContinuePrint(val.IsDirectPrinting);
			}
			serviceOperation = null;
			RaiseStopPrintExportCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private void client_GetPagesCompleted(object sender, ScalarOperationCompletedEventArgs<byte[]> e)
		{
			if ((int)((AsyncCompletedEventArgs)(object)e).UserState != base.CurrentPageIndex)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.IsLoading = false;
			if (((AsyncCompletedEventArgs)(object)e).Error != null)
			{
				base.IsIncorrectPageContent = true;
				if (this.GetPageError != null)
				{
					this.GetPageError(this, new SimpleFaultEventArgs(((AsyncCompletedEventArgs)(object)e).Error));
				}
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				string[] source = Helper.DeserializePages(e.Result);
				SetPageContent(XamlReaderHelper.Load(source.First()));
				base.IsIncorrectPageContent = false;
			}
			catch (System.Windows.Markup.XamlParseException)
			{
				base.IsIncorrectPageContent = true;
			}
		}

		private void RestoreWatermark(byte[] watermark)
		{
			if (xpfWatermarks == null || watermark == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(watermark);
			try
			{
				xpfWatermarks.Clear(false);
				xpfWatermarks.RestoreFromStream((Stream)memoryStream);
				isWatermarkChanged = false;
			}
			catch
			{
				base.IsIncorrectPageContent = true;
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidPageIndex(int pageIndex)
		{
			if (pageIndex >= 0)
			{
				return pageIndex < PageCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ContinuePrint(bool isDirectPrinting)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DocumentPrinter documentPrinter = new DocumentPrinter();
			ReadonlyPageData[] pageData = (ReadonlyPageData[])(object)new ReadonlyPageData[1]
			{
				new ReadonlyPageData((ReadonlyPageData)(object)DocumentPageSettings.Data)
			};
			if (isDirectPrinting)
			{
				documentPrinter.PrintDirect(new XamlDocumentPaginator(printData), pageData, documentName, asyncMode: true);
			}
			else
			{
				documentPrinter.PrintDialog(new XamlDocumentPaginator(printData), pageData, documentName, asyncMode: true);
			}
		}

		private bool StartExportShowSaveFileDialog(ExportFormat format)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Stream stream = ShowSaveExportedFileDialog(format);
			bool flag = stream != null;
			if (flag)
			{
				exportWriter = new BinaryWriter(stream);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void ExportCompletedSaveData(ExportId exportId, byte[] data, Exception error)
		{
			try
			{
				if (error == null)
				{
					exportWriter.Write(data);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				exportWriter.Dispose();
				exportWriter = null;
			}
		}

		private void ExportConfiguredCompleted(ExportDocumentOperation exportDocumentOperation)

				exportDocumentOperation.Progress += exportDocumentOperation_Progress;
				exportDocumentOperation.Completed += exportDocumentOperation_Completed;
				serviceOperation = (ReportServiceOperation)(object)exportDocumentOperation;
				serviceOperation.Start();
				RaiseStopPrintExportCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
			}
		}

		}

		public void ShowInformation(string text, string caption)
		{
			CompatibilityMessageBox.Show(text, caption, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Asterisk);
		}

		public Stream ShowSaveFileDialog(string caption, string filter, int filterIndex, string initialDirectory, string fileName)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SaveFileDialogService val = new SaveFileDialogService();
			((FileDialogServiceBase)val).Filter = filter;
			((FileDialogServiceBase)val).FilterIndex = filterIndex;
			((FileDialogServiceBase)val).DefaultFileName = fileName;
			((FileDialogServiceBase)val).Title = caption;
			((FileDialogServiceBase)val).InitialDirectory = initialDirectory;
			if (!((ISaveFileDialogService)val).ShowDialog())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((ISaveFileDialogService)val).OpenFile();
		}

		public Window GetParentWindow()
		{

		}

		}

		public Stream ShowOpenFileDialog(string caption, string filter, out string fileName)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IOpenFileDialogService openFileDialogService = (IOpenFileDialogService)new OpenFileDialogService
			{
				Filter = filter,
				Title = caption
			};
			if (!openFileDialogService.ShowDialog())
			{
				fileName = null;

		public DocumentMapTreeViewNode DocumentMapSelectedNode
		{
			get
			{
				return documentMapSelectedNode;
			}
			set
			{
				documentMapSelectedNode = value;
				if (HighlightingService != null)
				{
					HighlightingService.HideHighlighting();
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					requiredScrollingToHighlightedElement = true;
					highLightingPriority = HighlightingPriority.DocumentMap;
					CurrentPageIndex = ((DocumentMapSelectedNode.PageIndex >= 0) ? DocumentMapSelectedNode.PageIndex : 0);
					RaisePropertyChanged(() => DocumentMapSelectedNode);
					RaisePropertyChanged(() => PageContent);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public BrickInfo FoundBrickInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return foundBrickInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				foundBrickInfo = value;
				if (foundBrickInfo == null)
				{
					highLightingPriority = HighlightingPriority.None;
					return;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(foundBrickInfo.BrickTag))
				{
					requiredScrollingToHighlightedElement = true;
					highLightingPriority = HighlightingPriority.Search;
					CurrentPageIndex = ((foundBrickInfo.PageIndex >= 0) ? foundBrickInfo.PageIndex : 0);
				}
				else
				{
					highLightingPriority = HighlightingPriority.None;
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => PageContent);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<PreviewClickEventArgs> PreviewClick;

		public event EventHandler<PreviewClickEventArgs> PreviewMouseMove;

		public event EventHandler<PreviewClickEventArgs> PreviewDoubleClick;

		private static void BringIntoView(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IScrollInfo>((DependencyObject)element)?.MakeVisible(element, Rect.Empty);
		}

		public DocumentPreviewModelBase()
		{
			CreateCommands();
			inputController = new DocumentPreviewInputController
			{
				Model = this
			};
		}

		protected override void ProcessPageContent(FrameworkElement pageContent)
		{
			switch (highLightingPriority)
			{
			case HighlightingPriority.None:
				if (HighlightingService != null)
				{
					HighlightingService.HideHighlighting();
				}
				break;
			case HighlightingPriority.DocumentMap:
				if (DocumentMapSelectedNode != null && CurrentPageIndex == DocumentMapSelectedNode.PageIndex)
				{
					HighlightElement(pageContent, DocumentMapSelectedNode.AssociatedElementTag);
				}
				break;
			case HighlightingPriority.Search:
				if (FoundBrickInfo != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(FoundBrickInfo.BrickTag))
				{
					HighlightElement(pageContent, FoundBrickInfo.BrickTag);
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException("HighLightingPriority");
			}
		}

		protected internal void SetCurrentPageIndex(int value)
		{
			if (currentPageIndex != value)
			{
				currentPageIndex = value;
				OnCurrentPageIndexChanged();
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => CurrentPageIndex);
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => CurrentPageNumber);
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => PageContent);
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => PageViewWidth);
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => PageViewHeight);
				RaiseNavigationCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void HandlePreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e, FrameworkElement source)
		{
			FrameworkElement hitTestResult = GetHitTestResult(e, source);
			if (hitTestResult != null)
			{
				string navigationPair = PreviewClickHelper.GetNavigationPair(hitTestResult);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(navigationPair))
				{
					int num = Convert.ToInt32(DocumentMapTreeViewNodeHelper.GetPageIndexByTag(navigationPair));
					if (num >= 0 && num < PageCount)
					{
						FoundBrickInfo = new BrickInfo(navigationPair, num);
					}
				}
			}
			if (this.PreviewClick != null)
			{
				string elementTag = ((hitTestResult != null) ? PreviewClickHelper.GetTag(hitTestResult) : null);
				this.PreviewClick(this, new PreviewClickEventArgs(elementTag, hitTestResult));
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void HandlePreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e, FrameworkElement source)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void HandlePreviewMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, FrameworkElement source)
		{
			if (this.PreviewMouseMove != null)
			{
				FrameworkElement hitTestResult = GetHitTestResult(e, source);
				string elementTag = ((hitTestResult != null) ? PreviewClickHelper.GetTag(hitTestResult) : null);
				this.PreviewMouseMove(this, new PreviewClickEventArgs(elementTag, hitTestResult));
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void HandlePreviewDoubleClick(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, FrameworkElement source)
		{
			if (this.PreviewDoubleClick != null)
			{
				FrameworkElement hitTestResult = GetHitTestResult(e, source);
				string elementTag = ((hitTestResult != null) ? PreviewClickHelper.GetTag(hitTestResult) : null);
				this.PreviewDoubleClick(this, new PreviewClickEventArgs(elementTag, hitTestResult));
			}
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetHitTestResult(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, FrameworkElement source)
		{
			UIElement topLevelVisual = LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)source);
			if (topLevelVisual == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FrameworkElement result = null;
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(topLevelVisual, delegate(DependencyObject d)
			{
				if (d is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && IsHitTestResult(frameworkElement) && DependencyObjectExtensions.FindIsInParents((DependencyObject)frameworkElement, (DependencyObject)source))
				{
					result = frameworkElement;
				}
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
			}, (HitTestResult res) => HitTestResultBehavior.Continue, new PointHitTestParameters(e.GetPosition(topLevelVisual)));
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsHitTestResult(FrameworkElement control)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract void Print(object parameter);

		protected virtual void Export(object parameter)
		{
			Export(parameter, BeginExport, Export, EndExport);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanExport(object parameter)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			ExportFormat exportFormatByExportParameter = GetExportFormatByExportParameter(parameter);
			bool flag = PageCount > 0 && DocumentExportOptions != null;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			AvailableExportModes documentExportModes = DocumentExportModes;
			switch ((int)exportFormatByExportParameter)
			{
			case 7:
				return flag;
			case 1:
				if (flag && documentExportModes != null)
				{
					return documentExportModes.Html.Any();
				}
				return false;
			case 9:
				if (flag && documentExportModes != null)
				{
					return documentExportModes.Image.Any();
				}
				return false;
			case 2:
				if (flag && documentExportModes != null)
				{
					return !documentExportModes.Html.Any();
				}
				return false;
			case 0:
				return flag;
			case 3:
				if (flag && documentExportModes != null)
				{
					return documentExportModes.Rtf.Any();
				}
				return false;
			case 8:
				return flag;
			case 5:
				if (flag && documentExportModes != null)
				{
					return documentExportModes.Xls.Any();
				}
				return false;
			case 6:
				if (flag && documentExportModes != null)
				{
					return documentExportModes.Xlsx.Any();
				}
				return false;
			case 10:
				return flag;
			case 11:
				return flag;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("format");
			}
		}

		private void Export(object parameter, Action<ExportFormat> beginExport, Action<ExportFormat> doExport, Action endExport)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ExportFormat val = (DefaultExportFormat = GetExportFormatByExportParameter(parameter));
			ExportOptionsConfiguratorService.Completed += ExportOptionsConfiguratorService_Completed;
			ExportOptionsConfiguratorService.Context = new ExportOptionContext(val, beginExport, doExport, endExport);
			ExportOptionsConfiguratorService.Configure(Helper.GetByFormat(DocumentExportOptions, val), DocumentExportOptions.PrintPreview, DocumentExportModes, DocumentHiddenOptions);
		}

		private void HighlightElement(FrameworkElement pageContent, string brickTag)
		{
			if (HighlightingService == null || pageContent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HighlightingService.HideHighlighting();
			new OnLoadedScheduler().Schedule(delegate
			{
				FrameworkElement target = LayoutHelper.FindElement(pageContent, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement x) => (string)x.Tag == brickTag));
				if (target != null)
				{
					if (requiredScrollingToHighlightedElement)
					{
						requiredScrollingToHighlightedElement = false;
						new OnLoadedScheduler().Schedule(delegate
						{
							BringIntoView(target);
						}, target);
					}
					HighlightingService.ShowHighlighting(pageContent, target);
				}
			}, pageContent);
		}

		protected virtual void GoToFirstPage(object parameter)
		{
			CurrentPageIndex = 0;
		}

		private bool CanGoToFirstPage(object parameter)
		{
			return CurrentPageIndex > 0;
		}

		private void GoToPreviousPage(object parameter)
		{
			CurrentPageIndex--;
		}

		private bool CanGoToPreviousPage(object parameter)
		{
			return CurrentPageIndex > 0;
		}

		private void GoToNextPage(object parameter)
		{
			CurrentPageIndex++;
		}

		private bool CanGoToNextPage(object parameter)
		{
			return CurrentPageIndex + 1 < PageCount;
		}

		private void GoToLastPage(object parameter)
		{
			CurrentPageIndex = PageCount - 1;
		}

		private bool CanGoToLastPage(object parameter)
		{
			return CurrentPageIndex < PageCount - 1;
		}

		private void ToggleIsDocumentMapVisible(object parameter)
		{
			IsDocumentMapVisible = !IsDocumentMapVisible;
			if (!IsDocumentMapVisible && HighlightingService != null)
			{
				if (highLightingPriority == HighlightingPriority.DocumentMap)
				{
					HighlightingService.HideHighlighting();
					highLightingPriority = HighlightingPriority.None;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => PageContent);
			}
		}

		private void ToggleIsParametersPanelVisible(object parameter)
		{
			IsParametersPanelVisible = !IsParametersPanelVisible;
		}

		private void ToggleSearchPanelVisibility(object parameter)
		{
			IsSearchPanelVisible = !IsSearchPanelVisible;
			if (!IsSearchPanelVisible && HighlightingService != null && highLightingPriority == HighlightingPriority.Search)
			{
				HighlightingService.HideHighlighting();
				highLightingPriority = HighlightingPriority.None;
			}
		}

		private void ExportOptionsConfiguratorService_Completed(object sender, AsyncCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ExportOptionsConfiguratorService.Completed -= ExportOptionsConfiguratorService_Completed;
			if (!e.Cancelled && e.Error == null)
			{
				ExportOptionContext context = ExportOptionsConfiguratorService.Context;
				ExportFormat format = context.Format;
				if (context.BeginExportAction != null)
				{
					context.BeginExportAction(format);
				}
				if (context.ExportAction != null)
				{
					context.ExportAction(format);
				}
				if (context.EndExportAction != null)
				{
					context.EndExportAction();
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void Export(ExportFormat format);

		protected Stream ShowSaveExportedFileDialog(ExportFormat format)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ExportOptionsBase byFormat = Helper.GetByFormat(DocumentExportOptions, format);
			ExportOptionsControllerBase controllerByOptions = ExportOptionsControllerBase.GetControllerByOptions(byFormat);
			int filterIndex = Array.IndexOf(controllerByOptions.FileExtensions, controllerByOptions.GetFileExtension(byFormat)) + 1;
			return DialogService.ShowSaveFileDialog(PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)264), controllerByOptions.Filter, filterIndex, null, DocumentExportOptions.PrintPreview.DefaultFileName);
		}

		protected virtual void BeginExport(ExportFormat format)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void EndExport()
		{
		}

		protected virtual DataContext GetDataContext()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected ExportFormat GetExportFormatByExportParameter(object parameter)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				return (ExportFormat)Enum.Parse(typeof(ExportFormat), (string)parameter, ignoreCase: false);
			}
			return DefaultExportFormat;
		}
	}

	internal enum HighlightingPriority

		None,
