	public class HighlightingService : IHighlightingService
	{
		private Border highlightRect;

		private Border HighlightRect
		{
			get
			{
				if (highlightRect == null)
				{
					highlightRect = new Border();
					highlightRect.BorderThickness = new Thickness(5.0);
					highlightRect.BorderBrush = CreateHatchBrush();
				}
				return highlightRect;
			}
		}

		public void ShowHighlighting(FrameworkElement parent, FrameworkElement target)
		{
			if (!(parent is Canvas))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("parent");
			}
			new OnLoadedScheduler().Schedule(delegate
			{
				ShowHighlightingCore((Canvas)parent, target);
			}, target);
		}

		public void HideHighlighting()
		{
			FrameworkElementExtensions.RemoveFromVisualTree((FrameworkElement)HighlightRect);
		}

		private void ShowHighlightingCore(Canvas parentCanvas, FrameworkElement target)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("target");
			}
			if (parentCanvas == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parentCanvas");
			}
			if (FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree(target) && FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree((FrameworkElement)parentCanvas))
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = RectHelper.Location(LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)target, (UIElement)parentCanvas));
				point.X -= 6.0;
				point.Y -= 6.0;
				Canvas.SetLeft(HighlightRect, point.X);
				Canvas.SetTop(HighlightRect, point.Y);
				System.Windows.Controls.Panel.SetZIndex(HighlightRect, 255);
				HighlightRect.Width = target.Width + 12.0;
				HighlightRect.Height = target.Height + 12.0;
				HighlightRect.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), new System.Windows.Size((parentCanvas.Width > point.X) ? (parentCanvas.Width - point.X) : 0.0, (parentCanvas.Height > point.Y) ? (parentCanvas.Height - point.Y) : 0.0))
				};
				HideHighlighting();
				parentCanvas.Children.Add(HighlightRect);
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateHatchBrush()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush();
			linearGradientBrush.MappingMode = BrushMappingMode.Absolute;
			linearGradientBrush.SpreadMethod = GradientSpreadMethod.Repeat;
			linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(3.0, 3.0);
			GradientStop gradientStop = new GradientStop();
			gradientStop.Color = Colors.Gray;
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(gradientStop);
			gradientStop = new GradientStop();
			gradientStop.Color = Colors.Gray;
			gradientStop.Offset = 0.5;
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(gradientStop);
			gradientStop = new GradientStop();
			gradientStop.Color = Colors.Transparent;
			gradientStop.Offset = 0.5;
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(gradientStop);
			gradientStop = new GradientStop();
			gradientStop.Color = Colors.Transparent;
			gradientStop.Offset = 1.0;
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(gradientStop);
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}
	}

	public abstract class InputController
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<InputShortcut, ICommand> shortcuts;

		private readonly List<ModifierKeys> pressedModifiers;

		private Key pressedKey;

		private MouseInputAction currentMouseAction;

		private MouseWheelScrollingDirection scrollingDirection;

		private IPreviewModel model;

		public IPreviewModel Model
		{
			get
			{
				return model;
			}
			set
			{
				if (model != value)
				{
					model = value;
					if (model != null)
					{
						shortcuts.Clear();
						CreateShortcuts();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool AreModifiersPressed => !ModifierKeysHelper.NoModifiers(Keyboard.Modifiers);

		public InputController()
		{
			pressedKey = Key.None;
			pressedModifiers = new List<ModifierKeys>();
			currentMouseAction = MouseInputAction.None;
			scrollingDirection = MouseWheelScrollingDirection.None;
			shortcuts = new Dictionary<InputShortcut, ICommand>();
		}

		public void HandleKeyDown(Key key)
		{
			if (key != Key.None && !IsModifierKey(key))
			{
				key = Convert(key);
				pressedKey = key;
				FillPressedModifiers();
				ExecuteShortcut(new KeyShortcut(pressedModifiers.ToArray(), pressedKey));
			}
		}

		public void HandleMouseDown(MouseButton mouseButton)
		{
			switch (mouseButton)
			{
			case MouseButton.Left:
				currentMouseAction = MouseInputAction.LeftClick;
				break;
			case MouseButton.Middle:
				currentMouseAction = MouseInputAction.MiddleClick;
				break;
			case MouseButton.Right:
				currentMouseAction = MouseInputAction.RightClick;
				break;
			}
			FillPressedModifiers();
			ExecuteShortcut(new MouseShortcut(pressedModifiers.ToArray(), currentMouseAction, MouseWheelScrollingDirection.None));
		}

		public void HandleMouseWheel(int delta)
		{
			scrollingDirection = MouseWheelScrollingDirection.None;
			if (delta > 0)
			{
				scrollingDirection = MouseWheelScrollingDirection.Up;
			}
			if (delta < 0)
			{
				scrollingDirection = MouseWheelScrollingDirection.Down;
			}
			FillPressedModifiers();
			ExecuteShortcut(new MouseShortcut(pressedModifiers.ToArray(), MouseInputAction.WheelClick, scrollingDirection));
		}

		private static Key Convert(Key key)
		{
			return key switch
			{
				Key.Prior => Key.Prior, 
				Key.Next => Key.Next, 
				_ => key, 
			};
		}

		private static bool IsModifierKey(Key key)
		{
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.LWin:
			case Key.RWin:
			case Key.LeftShift:
			case Key.RightShift:
			case Key.LeftCtrl:
			case Key.RightCtrl:
			case Key.LeftAlt:
			case Key.RightAlt:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void CreateShortcuts();

		protected internal void TryAddShortcutForPSCommand(InputShortcut shortcut, PrintingSystemCommand psCommand)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Model is PreviewModelBase previewModelBase && previewModelBase.Commands.TryGetValue(psCommand, out var value))
			{
				AddShortcut(shortcut, value);
			}
		}

		protected void AddShortcut(InputShortcut shortcut, ICommand command)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)shortcut, "shortcut");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)command, "command");
			if (shortcuts.ContainsKey(shortcut))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("This shortcut has already been added");
			}
			shortcuts.Add(shortcut, command);
		}

		private void FillPressedModifiers()
		{
			pressedModifiers.Clear();
			ModifierKeys modifiers = Keyboard.Modifiers;
			if (AreModifiersPressed)
			{
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsAltPressed(modifiers))
				{
					pressedModifiers.Add(ModifierKeys.Alt);
				}
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(modifiers))
				{
					pressedModifiers.Add(ModifierKeys.Control);
				}
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(modifiers))
				{
					pressedModifiers.Add(ModifierKeys.Shift);
				}
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsWinPressed(modifiers))
				{
					pressedModifiers.Add(ModifierKeys.Windows);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ExecuteShortcut(InputShortcut shortcut)
		{
			if (shortcuts.TryGetValue(shortcut, out var value) && value.CanExecute(null))
			{
				value.Execute(null);
			}
		}
	}

	[Obsolete("The DocumentPreview and corresponding xxxPreviewModel classes and interfaces are now obsolete. Use the DocumentPreviewControl class to display a print preview. More information: https://www.devexpress.com/Support/WhatsNew/DXperience/files/16.1.2.bc.xml#BC3444")]
	public class LinkPreviewModel : PrintingSystemPreviewModel
	{
		private static readonly TimeSpan blockingExportDelay = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100.0);

		private LinkBase link;

		public LinkBase Link
		{
			get
			{
				return link;
			}
			set
			{
				if (link != value)
				{
					OnSourceChanging();
					link = value;
					OnSourceChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override PrintingSystemBase PrintingSystem
		{
			get

	public class PrintableControlLink : TemplatedLink
	{
		private readonly IPrintableControl printableControl;

		private bool disposed;

		internal IPrintableControl PrintableControl => printableControl;

		public PrintableControlLink(IPrintableControl printableControl, string documentName)
			: base(documentName)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)printableControl, "printableControl");
			this.printableControl = printableControl;
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageInsertComplete += new PageInsertCompleteEventHandler(PrintingSystem_PageInsertComplete);
		}

		public PrintableControlLink(IPrintableControl printableControl)
			: this(printableControl, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		protected override void Build(bool buildPagesInBackground)
		{
			if (printableControl == null || !buildPagesInBackground || !printableControl.CanCreateRootNodeAsync)
			{
				base.Build(buildPagesInBackground);
				return;
			}
			printableControl.CreateRootNodeCompleted += printableControl_CreateRootNodeCompleted;
			CreateRootNodeAsync();
		}

		protected override void BuildCore()
		{
			if (printableControl != null)
			{
				IVisualTreeWalker customVisualTreeWalker = printableControl.GetCustomVisualTreeWalker();
				if (customVisualTreeWalker != null)
				{
					base.BrickCollector.VisualTreeWalker = customVisualTreeWalker;
				}
			}
			base.BuildCore();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!disposed)
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					if (printableControl != null && printableControl.CanCreateRootNodeAsync)
					{
						printableControl.CreateRootNodeCompleted -= printableControl_CreateRootNodeCompleted;
					}
					if (base.PrintingSystem != null)
					{
						((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageInsertComplete -= new PageInsertCompleteEventHandler(PrintingSystem_PageInsertComplete);
					}
				}
				disposed = true;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override IRootDataNode CreateRootNode()
		{
			if (printableControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DocumentBand root = (DocumentBand)(object)((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PrintingDocument.Root;
			return printableControl.CreateRootNode(DrawingConverter.ToSize(((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings.UsablePageSizeInPixels), GetBoundsSize(root.GetBand((DocumentBandKind)256)), GetBoundsSize(root.GetBand((DocumentBandKind)512)), GetBoundsSize(root.GetBand((DocumentBandKind)18)), GetBoundsSize(root.GetBand((DocumentBandKind)20)));
		}

		protected override bool IsDocumentLayoutRightToLeft()
		{
			IPrintableControl obj = printableControl;
			IRightToLeftSupport val = (IRightToLeftSupport)(object)((obj is IRightToLeftSupport) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return val.RightToLeftLayout;
		}

		private void CreateRootNodeAsync()
		{
			DocumentBand root = (DocumentBand)(object)((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PrintingDocument.Root;
			printableControl.CreateRootNodeAsync(DrawingConverter.ToSize(((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings.UsablePageSizeInPixels), GetBoundsSize(root.GetBand((DocumentBandKind)256)), GetBoundsSize(root.GetBand((DocumentBandKind)512)), GetBoundsSize(root.GetBand((DocumentBandKind)18)), GetBoundsSize(root.GetBand((DocumentBandKind)20)));
		}

		private void printableControl_CreateRootNodeCompleted(object sender, ScalarOperationCompletedEventArgs<IRootDataNode> e)
		{
			printableControl.CreateRootNodeCompleted -= printableControl_CreateRootNodeCompleted;
			if (!disposed)
			{
				base.RootNode = e.Result;
				BuildCore();
				RaiseDocumentBuildingCompleted();
			}
		}

		private void PrintingSystem_PageInsertComplete(object sender, PageInsertCompleteEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (printableControl != null)
			{
				BrickEnumerator val = new BrickEnumerator((BrickBase)(object)((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Pages[e.PageIndex]);
				printableControl.PagePrintedCallback((IEnumerator)val, base.BrickCollector.BrickUpdaters);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetBoundsSize(DocumentBand band)
		{
			SizeF value = new SizeF(band.BrickBounds.Size.Width, band.SelfHeight);
			return DrawingConverter.ToSize(GraphicsUnitConverter2.DocToPixel(value));
		}
	}
	public class SimpleLink : TemplatedLink
	{
		private class PlainDataDetailNode : IVisualDetailNode, IDataNode
		{
			private readonly PlainDataRootNode root;

			public int Index { get; private set; }

			public bool IsDetailContainer => false;

			public IDataNode Parent => (IDataNode)(object)root;

			public bool PageBreakBefore => false;

			public bool PageBreakAfter => false;

			public PlainDataDetailNode(PlainDataRootNode root, int index)
			{
				this.root = root;
				Index = index;
			}

			public RowViewInfo GetDetail(bool allowContentReuse)
			{
				return root.GetDetail(Index);
			}

			public bool CanGetChild(int index)
			{
				return false;
			}

			public IDataNode GetChild(int index)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		private class PlainDataRootNode : IRootDataNode, IDataNode
		{
			private readonly int detailCount;

			private readonly Dictionary<int, Pair<DataTemplate, object>> details;

			public SimpleLink Link { get; private set; }

			public int Index
			{
				get
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
			}

			public bool IsDetailContainer => true;

			public IDataNode Parent => null;

			public bool PageBreakBefore => false;

			public bool PageBreakAfter => false;

			public RowViewInfo GetDetail(int index)
			{
				//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (Link.DetailTemplate == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new RowViewInfo(Link.DetailTemplate, details[index].Second);
			}

			public PlainDataRootNode(SimpleLink link, int detailCount)
			{
				Link = link;
				this.detailCount = detailCount;
				details = new Dictionary<int, Pair<DataTemplate, object>>(detailCount);
			}

			public bool CanGetChild(int index)
			{
				CreateAreaEventArgs e = new CreateAreaEventArgs(index);
				if (index >= detailCount)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Link.RaiseCreateDetail(e);
				details[index] = new Pair<DataTemplate, object>(Link.DetailTemplate, e.Data);
				return true;
			}

			public IDataNode GetChild(int index)
			{
				return (IDataNode)(object)new PlainDataDetailNode(this, index);
			}

			public int GetTotalDetailCount()
			{
				return detailCount;
			}
		}

		private DataTemplate detailTemplate;

		private int detailCount;

		public bool RightToLeftLayout { get; set; }

		[Description("Specifies the template for the document’s detail area.")]
		public DataTemplate DetailTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return detailTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				detailTemplate = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the number of times the SimpleLink.CreateDetail event is raised to create the detail area.")]
		public int DetailCount
		{
			get
			{
				return detailCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value");
				}
				detailCount = value;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<CreateAreaEventArgs> CreateDetail;

		public SimpleLink(DataTemplate detailTemplate, int detailCount, string documentName)
			: base(documentName)
		{
			DetailTemplate = detailTemplate;
			DetailCount = detailCount;
		}

		public SimpleLink(DataTemplate detail, int detailCount)
			: this(detail, detailCount, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public SimpleLink(string documentName)
			: base(documentName)
		{
		}

		public SimpleLink()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsDocumentLayoutRightToLeft()
		{
			return RightToLeftLayout;
		}

		protected override IRootDataNode CreateRootNode()
		{
			return (IRootDataNode)(object)new PlainDataRootNode(this, DetailCount);
		}

		private void RaiseCreateDetail(CreateAreaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.CreateDetail != null)
			{
				this.CreateDetail(this, e);
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void CreateDocumentCore(bool buildPagesInBackground, bool applyPageSettings)
		{
			//IL_00cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Unlock();
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Graph.PageUnit = DXGraphicsUnit.Document;
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).ClearContent();
			ClearBandInitializer();
			ImageRepository.Clear(RepositoryImageHelper.GetDocumentId((PrintingSystemBase)(object)base.PrintingSystem));
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Begin();
			if (applyPageSettings)
			{
				XtraPageSettingsBase.ApplyPageSettings(((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings, base.PaperKind, base.CustomPaperSize, base.Margins, base.MinMargins, base.Landscape);
			}
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).ProgressReflector.SetProgressRanges(new float[2] { 75f, 25f });
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.DocumentName))
			{
				((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Document.Name = base.DocumentName;
			}
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PrintingDocument.VerticalContentSplitting = base.VerticalContentSplitting;
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Document.RightToLeftLayout = IsDocumentLayoutRightToLeft();
			CreateBandInitializer(DrawingConverter.ToSize(((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings.UsablePageSizeInPixels), IsDocumentLayoutRightToLeft());
			BuildHeaderFooterBands();
			if (buildPagesInBackground)
			{
				DocumentBuildingCompleted += TemplatedLink_DocumentBuildingCompleted;
				Build(buildPagesInBackground);
			}
			else
			{
				Build(buildPagesInBackground);
				End(buildPagesInBackground);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void End(bool buildPagesInBackground)
		{
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).End(buildPagesInBackground);
		}

		private void TemplatedLink_DocumentBuildingCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DocumentBuildingCompleted -= TemplatedLink_DocumentBuildingCompleted;
			End(base.BuildPagesInBackground);
		}

		private void BuildHeaderFooterBands()
		{
			BrickCollector.VisualTreeWalker = (IVisualTreeWalker)(object)new VisualTreeWalker();
			DocumentBand root = (DocumentBand)(object)((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PrintingDocument.Root;
			root.Bands.Add(CreateDocumentBand((DocumentBandKind)64, GetTopMarginRowViewInfo));
			root.Bands.Add(CreateDocumentBand((DocumentBandKind)256, GetReportHeaderRowViewInfo));
			root.Bands.Add(CreateDocumentBand((DocumentBandKind)18, GetPageHeaderRowViewInfo));
			root.Bands.Add(CreateDocumentBand((DocumentBandKind)20, GetPageFooterRowViewInfo));
			DocumentBand val = CreateDocumentBand((DocumentBandKind)512, GetReportFooterRowViewInfo);
			val.PrintAtBottom = PrintReportFooterAtBottom;
			root.Bands.Add(val);
			root.Bands.Add(CreateDocumentBand((DocumentBandKind)128, GetBottomMarginRowViewInfo));
		}

		protected virtual void Build(bool buildPagesInBackground)
		{
			RootNode = CreateRootNode();
			BuildCore();
			if (buildPagesInBackground)
			{
				RaiseDocumentBuildingCompleted();
			}
		}

		protected abstract IRootDataNode CreateRootNode();

		protected abstract bool IsDocumentLayoutRightToLeft();

		protected virtual void BuildCore()
		{
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a5: Expected O, but got Unknown
			VisualDataNodeBandManager visualDataNodeBandManager = CreateVisualDataNodeBandManager();
			((DataNodeBandManager)visualDataNodeBandManager).Initialize(((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PrintingDocument.Root);
			if (visualDataNodeBandManager.totalDetailCount == -1)
			{
				((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).ProgressReflector.SetProgressRanges(new float[2]
				{
					float.NaN,
					float.NaN
				});
			}
			if (ColumnWidth > 0f)
			{
				float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(ColumnWidth, 96f, 300f);
				if (num > 0f)
				{
					int columnCount = GetColumnCount(num);
					if (columnCount > 0)
					{
						((DocumentBand)((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PrintingDocument.Root).MultiColumn = new MultiColumn(columnCount, num, ColumnLayout);
					}
				}
			}
			((DocumentBand)((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PrintingDocument.Root).BandManager = (IBandManager)(object)visualDataNodeBandManager;
		}

		internal virtual VisualDataNodeBandManager CreateVisualDataNodeBandManager()
		{
			return new VisualDataNodeBandManager(RootNode, BandInitializer);
		}

		protected override void AfterBuildPages()
		{
			((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Lock();
			BrickCollector.Clear();
			new DocumentMapBuilder().Build(((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).Document);
			BandInitializer.Clear();
			if (!PreventDisposing)
			{
				(RootNode as IDisposable).Do(delegate(IDisposable x)
				{
					x.Dispose();
				});
			}
			base.AfterBuildPages();
		}

		protected void RaiseDocumentBuildingCompleted()
		{
			if (this.DocumentBuildingCompleted != null)
			{
				this.DocumentBuildingCompleted(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private DocumentBand CreateDocumentBand(DocumentBandKind bandKind, Func<bool, RowViewInfo> getRowViewInfo)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DocumentBand val = new DocumentBand(bandKind);
			BandInitializer.Initialize(val, getRowViewInfo);
			return val;
		}

		private int GetColumnCount(float columnWidth)
		{
			float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(((PrintingSystemBase)base.PrintingSystem).PageSettings.UsablePageSize.Width, 100f, 300f);
			int num2 = (int)(num / columnWidth);
			if (num2 <= 0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return num2;
		}
	}

	public abstract class BindingExtensionBase : MarkupExtension
	{
		protected object defaultFallbackValue;

		public BindingMode Mode { get; set; }

		public string Path { get; set; }

		public string Converter { get; set; }

		public object ConverterParameter { get; set; }

		public string StringFormat { get; set; }

		public UpdateSourceTrigger UpdateSourceTrigger { get; set; }

		public object FallbackValue { get; set; }

		public string FallbackValueResourceKey { get; set; }

		protected abstract PropertyPath BindingPath { get; }

		protected abstract RelativeSource RelativeSource { get; }

		public BindingExtensionBase()
		{
			Mode = BindingMode.Default;
			defaultFallbackValue = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			FallbackValue = defaultFallbackValue;
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			if (FallbackValue != defaultFallbackValue && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(FallbackValueResourceKey))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("It is incorrect to\u00a0use FallbackValue and FallbackValueResourceKey together");
			}
			ResourceDictionary resources = GetResources(serviceProvider);
			return CreateBinding(resources);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Data.Binding CreateBinding(ResourceDictionary resources)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				Mode = Mode,
				Path = BindingPath,
				RelativeSource = RelativeSource,
				Converter = GetConverter(resources),
				ConverterParameter = ConverterParameter,
				StringFormat = StringFormat,
				UpdateSourceTrigger = UpdateSourceTrigger,
				FallbackValue = GetFallbackValue(resources)
			};
		}

		private static ResourceDictionary GetResources(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			IRootObjectProvider rootObjectProvider = (IRootObjectProvider)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IRootObjectProvider));
			if (rootObjectProvider.RootObject is ResourceDictionary)
			{
				return (ResourceDictionary)rootObjectProvider.RootObject;
			}
			if (rootObjectProvider.RootObject is FrameworkElement)
			{
				return ((FrameworkElement)rootObjectProvider.RootObject).Resources;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private object GetFallbackValue(ResourceDictionary resources)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(FallbackValueResourceKey))
			{
				return FallbackValue;
			}
			return resources[FallbackValueResourceKey];
		}

		private IValueConverter GetConverter(ResourceDictionary resources)
		{
			if (Converter == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (IValueConverter)resources[Converter];
		}
	}

			AncestorType = AncestorType
		};
	}

	public class CursorService : ICursorService
	{
		private readonly CursorContainer cursorContainer;

		private bool isServiceBlocked;

		private bool isCursorChangingSuppressed;

		private string blockId;

		public CursorService(CursorContainer cursorContainer)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)cursorContainer, "cursorContainer");
			this.cursorContainer = cursorContainer;
		}

		public bool SetCursor(FrameworkElement control, System.Windows.Input.Cursor cursor)
		{
			return SetCursor(control, cursor, string.Empty);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool SetCursor(FrameworkElement control, System.Windows.Input.Cursor cursor, string id)
		{
			if ((isServiceBlocked && blockId != id) || isCursorChangingSuppressed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)cursor, "cursor");
			cursorContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			cursorContainer.CustomCursor = null;
			control.Cursor = cursor;
			return true;
		}

		public bool SetCursor(FrameworkElement control, CustomCursor customCursor)
		{
			return SetCursor(control, customCursor, string.Empty);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool SetCursor(FrameworkElement control, CustomCursor customCursor, string id)
		{
			if ((isServiceBlocked && blockId != id) || isCursorChangingSuppressed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			control.Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.None;
			cursorContainer.CustomCursor = customCursor;
			cursorContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			return true;
		}

		public bool SetCursorPosition(System.Windows.Point relativePosition, FrameworkElement relativeTo)
		{
			return SetCursorPosition(relativePosition, relativeTo, string.Empty);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool SetCursorPosition(System.Windows.Point relativePosition, FrameworkElement relativeTo, string id)
		{
			if ((isServiceBlocked && blockId != id) || isCursorChangingSuppressed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (cursorContainer.CustomCursor == null || cursorContainer.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			new OnLoadedScheduler().Schedule(delegate
			{
				System.Windows.Point cursorPosition = relativeTo.TranslatePoint(relativePosition, cursorContainer);
				cursorContainer.CursorPosition = cursorPosition;
			}, relativeTo);
			return true;
		}

		public bool HideCustomCursor()
		{
			return HideCustomCursor(string.Empty);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool HideCustomCursor(string id)
		{
			if ((isServiceBlocked && blockId != id) || isCursorChangingSuppressed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			cursorContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool SetSuppressCursorChanging(bool value)
		{
			if (isServiceBlocked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			isCursorChangingSuppressed = value;
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool BlockService(string id)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(id, "id");
			if (isServiceBlocked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			blockId = id;
			isServiceBlocked = true;
			isCursorChangingSuppressed = false;
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool UnblockService(string id)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(id, "id");
			if (!isServiceBlocked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (blockId != id)
			{
				return false;
			}
			blockId = string.Empty;
			isServiceBlocked = false;
			return true;
		}
	}

	public abstract class InputShortcut
	{
		private readonly List<ModifierKeys> modifiers;

		public ModifierKeys[] Modifiers => modifiers.ToArray();

		public virtual string DisplayString
		{
			get
			{
				if (Modifiers.Length == 0)
				{
					return Enum.GetName(typeof(ModifierKeys), ModifierKeys.None);
				}
				return string.Join("+", Modifiers);
			}
		}

		public InputShortcut()
			: this(new ModifierKeys[0])
		{
		}

		public InputShortcut(ModifierKeys[] modifiers)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)modifiers, "modifiers");
			modifiers = modifiers.Distinct().ToArray();
			this.modifiers = new List<ModifierKeys>(modifiers);
			if (this.modifiers.Contains(ModifierKeys.None))
			{
				this.modifiers.Remove(ModifierKeys.None);
			}
		}

		protected bool AreModifierArraysEqual(ModifierKeys[] first, ModifierKeys[] second)
		{
			if (first == null || second == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (first.Length != second.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ModifierKeys value in first)
			{
				if (!second.Contains(value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalcHashCode(ArrayHelper.ConvertAll<char, int>(DisplayString.ToCharArray(), (Converter<char, int>)((char chr) => chr)));
		}
	}
	public class KeyShortcut : InputShortcut
	{
		public Key Key { get; set; }

		public override string DisplayString
		{
			get
			{
				string displayString = base.DisplayString;
				return $"{displayString}+{Key}";
			}
		}

		public KeyShortcut(Key key)
			: this(new ModifierKeys[0], key)
		{
		}

		public KeyShortcut(ModifierKeys modifier, Key key)
			: this(new ModifierKeys[1] { modifier }, key)
		{
		}

		public KeyShortcut(ModifierKeys[] modifiers, Key key)
			: base(modifiers)
		{
			Key = key;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is KeyShortcut keyShortcut && AreModifierArraysEqual(base.Modifiers, keyShortcut.Modifiers))
			{
				return Key == keyShortcut.Key;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class MouseShortcut : InputShortcut
	{
		public MouseInputAction MouseAction { get; set; }

		public MouseWheelScrollingDirection ScrollingDirection { get; set; }

		public override string DisplayString
		{
			get
			{
				string displayString = base.DisplayString;
				return $"{displayString}+{MouseAction}+Scroll {ScrollingDirection}";
			}
		}

		public MouseShortcut(MouseInputAction mouseAction)
			: this(new ModifierKeys[0], mouseAction, MouseWheelScrollingDirection.None)
		{
		}

		public MouseShortcut(ModifierKeys modifier, MouseInputAction mouseAction)
			: this(new ModifierKeys[1] { modifier }, mouseAction, MouseWheelScrollingDirection.None)
		{
		}

		public MouseShortcut(ModifierKeys[] modifiers, MouseInputAction mouseAction)
			: this(modifiers, mouseAction, MouseWheelScrollingDirection.None)
		{
		}

		public MouseShortcut(MouseInputAction mouseAction, MouseWheelScrollingDirection scrollingDirection)
			: this(new ModifierKeys[0], mouseAction, scrollingDirection)
		{
		}

		public MouseShortcut(ModifierKeys modifier, MouseInputAction mouseAction, MouseWheelScrollingDirection scrollingDirection)
			: this(new ModifierKeys[1] { modifier }, mouseAction, scrollingDirection)
		{
		}

		public MouseShortcut(ModifierKeys[] modifiers, MouseInputAction mouseAction, MouseWheelScrollingDirection scrollingDirection)
			: base(modifiers)
		{
			MouseAction = mouseAction;
			ScrollingDirection = scrollingDirection;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is MouseShortcut mouseShortcut && AreModifierArraysEqual(base.Modifiers, mouseShortcut.Modifiers) && MouseAction == mouseShortcut.MouseAction)
			{
				return ScrollingDirection == mouseShortcut.ScrollingDirection;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		private ReadOnlyCollection<ZoomItemBase> zoomModes;

		private ZoomItemBase zoomMode;

		private IDialogService dialogService;

		private ICursorService cursorService;

		internal Dictionary<PrintingSystemCommand, DelegateCommand<object>> Commands => commands;

		protected virtual ReadOnlyCollection<double> ZoomValues => zoomValues ?? (zoomValues = new ReadOnlyCollection<double>(new double[9] { 10.0, 25.0, 50.0, 75.0, 100.0, 150.0, 200.0, 400.0, 800.0 }));

		public FrameworkElement PageContent
		{
			get
			{
				FrameworkElement pageContent = GetPageContent();
				ProcessPageContent(pageContent);
				return pageContent;
			}
		}

		public double PageViewWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (PageContent == null)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return PageContent.Width * Zoom / 100.0;
			}
		}

		public double PageViewHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (PageContent == null)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return PageContent.Height * Zoom / 100.0;
			}
		}

		public double Zoom
		{
			get
			{
				return zoom;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0.0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Zoom");
				}
				if (zoom != value)
				{
					SetZoom(value);
					ZoomMode = new ZoomValueItem(value);
					RaisePropertyChanged(() => ZoomMode);
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract int PageCount { get; }

		public string ZoomDisplayFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return zoomDisplayFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("ZoomDisplayFormat");
				}
				if (!(zoomDisplayFormat == value))
				{
					zoomDisplayFormat = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged(() => ZoomDisplayFormat);
					RaisePropertyChanged(() => ZoomDisplayText);
				}
			}
		}

		public string ZoomDisplayText => string.Format(ZoomDisplayFormat, Zoom);

		public IEnumerable<ZoomItemBase> ZoomModes => zoomModes ?? (zoomModes = CreateZoomModes());

		public ZoomItemBase ZoomMode
		{
			get
			{
				return zoomMode;
			}
			set
			{
				zoomMode = value;
				if (value is ZoomValueItem)
				{
					SetZoom(((ZoomValueItem)value).ZoomValue);
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => ZoomMode);
			}
		}

		public abstract bool IsCreating { get; protected set; }

		public bool IsLoading
		{
			get
			{
				return isLoading;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (isLoading != value)
				{
					isLoading = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged(() => IsLoading);
					OnIsLoadingChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsIncorrectPageContent
		{
			get
			{
				return isIncorrectPageContent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isIncorrectPageContent != value)
				{
					isIncorrectPageContent = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged(() => IsIncorrectPageContent);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual IDialogService DialogService
		{
			get

				return dialogService;
			}
			set

					throw new ArgumentNullException("DialogService");

				dialogService = value;

		public virtual bool UseSimpleScrolling { get; set; }

		public virtual InputController InputController => inputController;

		public ICommand ZoomOutCommand => commands[(PrintingSystemCommand)12];

		public ICommand ZoomInCommand => commands[(PrintingSystemCommand)11];

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public PreviewModelBase()
		{
			dialogService = new NonInteractiveDialogService();
			CreateCommands();
			inputController = new PreviewInputController
			{
				Model = this
			};
			ZoomMode = GetInitialZoomMode(ZoomModes);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetZoom(double value)
		{
			if (zoom != value && !(value <= 0.0))
			{
				zoom = value;
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => Zoom);
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => ZoomDisplayText);
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => PageViewWidth);
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => PageViewHeight);
				RaiseZoomCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public abstract void HandlePreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e, FrameworkElement source);

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public abstract void HandlePreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e, FrameworkElement source);

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public abstract void HandlePreviewMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, FrameworkElement source);

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public abstract void HandlePreviewDoubleClick(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, FrameworkElement source);

		protected virtual void ProcessPageContent(FrameworkElement pageContent)
		{
		}

		protected abstract FrameworkElement GetPageContent();

		protected ReadOnlyCollection<ZoomItemBase> CreateZoomModes()
		{
			List<ZoomItemBase> list = new List<ZoomItemBase>();
			foreach (double zoomValue in ZoomValues)
			{
				list.Add(new ZoomValueItem(zoomValue));
			}
			list.Add(new ZoomSeparatorItem());
			foreach (object value in EnumExtensions.GetValues(typeof(ZoomFitMode)))
			{
				list.Add(new ZoomFitModeItem((ZoomFitMode)value));
			}
			return new ReadOnlyCollection<ZoomItemBase>(list);
		}

		private ZoomItemBase GetInitialZoomMode(IEnumerable<ZoomItemBase> zoomModes)
		{
			return zoomModes.First((ZoomItemBase mode) => mode is ZoomValueItem && ((ZoomValueItem)mode).ZoomValue == 100.0);
		}

		private void ZoomOut(object parameter)
		{
			if (!CanZoomOut(parameter))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			for (int num = ZoomValues.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (Zoom > ZoomValues[num])
				{
					Zoom = ZoomValues[num];
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanZoomOut(object parameter)
		{
			return Zoom > ZoomValues[0];
		}

		private void ZoomIn(object parameter)
		{
			if (!CanZoomIn(parameter))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ZoomValues.Count; i++)
			{
				if (Zoom < ZoomValues[i])
				{
					Zoom = ZoomValues[i];
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanZoomIn(object parameter)
		{
			return Zoom < ZoomValues[ZoomValues.Count - 1];
		}

		private void CreateCommands()
		{
			commands.Add((PrintingSystemCommand)12, DelegateCommandFactory.Create<object>(ZoomOut, CanZoomOut, useCommandManager: false));
			commands.Add((PrintingSystemCommand)11, DelegateCommandFactory.Create<object>(ZoomIn, CanZoomIn, useCommandManager: false));
		}

		protected void SafeCommandHandler(Action handler)
		{
			try
			{
				handler();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				dialogService.ShowError(ex.Message, PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Error));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsLoadingChanged()
		{
		}

		protected void RaiseZoomCommandsCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			commands[(PrintingSystemCommand)12].RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			commands[(PrintingSystemCommand)11].RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		protected void RaiseAllCommandsCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			foreach (DelegateCommand<object> value in commands.Values)
			{
				value.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseOperationError(Exception error, EventHandler<FaultEventArgs> errorEvent)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (errorEvent != null)
			{
				FaultEventArgs e = new FaultEventArgs(error);
				errorEvent(this, e);
				flag = !e.Handled;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ShowError(error.Message);
			}
		}

		protected void ShowError(string message)
		{
			DialogService.ShowError(message, PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Error));
		}

		protected void RaiseAllPropertiesChanged()
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(null));
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged<T>(Expression<Func<T>> property)
		{
			PropertyExtensions.RaisePropertyChanged<T>((INotifyPropertyChanged)this, this.PropertyChanged, property);
		}
	}
	public class PrintingResourceImageExtension : ResourceImageExtensionBase
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> redirects = new Dictionary<string, string>
		{
			{ "images/baritems/exporttocsv.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportCsv.svg" },
			{ "images/baritems/exporttodocx.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportDocx.svg" },
			{ "images/baritems/exporttohtml.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportHtm.svg" },
			{ "images/baritems/exporttoimage.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportImage.svg" },
			{ "images/baritems/exporttomht.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportMht.svg" },
			{ "images/baritems/exporttopdf.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportPdf.svg" },
			{ "images/baritems/exporttortf.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportRtf.svg" },
			{ "images/baritems/exporttotext.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportTxt.svg" },
			{ "images/baritems/exporttoxls.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportXls.svg" },
			{ "images/baritems/exporttoxlsx.svg", "Images/BarItems/ExportXlsx.svg" }
		};

		public string ResourceName { get; set; }

		protected sealed override string ResourceNameCore => CoerceResourceName(ResourceName);

		private static string CoerceResourceName(string resourceName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(resourceName))
			{
				return resourceName;
			}
			if (redirects.TryGetValue(resourceName.ToLower(), out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return resourceName;
		}
	}

		public IPreviewModelWrapper GetPreview()
		{
			FrameworkElement associatedObject = ((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject;
			PrintableControlLink printableControlLink = new PrintableControlLink((IPrintableControl)(object)((associatedObject is IPrintableControl) ? associatedObject : null));
			printableControlLink.Landscape = Landscape;
			printableControlLink.PageHeaderTemplate = PageHeaderTemplate;
			printableControlLink.PageHeaderData = PageHeaderData;
			printableControlLink.PageFooterTemplate = PageFooterTemplate;
			printableControlLink.PageFooterData = PageFooterData;
			printableControlLink.PaperKind = PaperKind;
			LinkPreviewModel linkPreviewModel = new LinkPreviewModel(printableControlLink);
			ConfigurePreviewModel(linkPreviewModel);
			PreviewModelWrapper result = new PreviewModelWrapper(linkPreviewModel);
			printableControlLink.CreateDocument(buildForInstantPreview: true);
			return result;

	public interface IScaleService
	{
		void Scale(PrintingSystemPreviewModel previewModel, Window ownerWindow);
	}
	public enum ScaleMode
	{
		AdjustToPercent,
		FitToPageWidth
	}
	internal class ScaleService : IScaleService
	{
		private PrintingSystemPreviewModel model;

		private ScaleWindow scaleWindow;

		public void Scale(PrintingSystemPreviewModel model, Window ownerWindow)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)model, "model");
			this.model = model;
			scaleWindow = new ScaleWindow(model.PrintingSystem.Document.ScaleFactor, model.PrintingSystem.Document.AutoFitToPagesWidth);
			((Window)(object)scaleWindow).Owner = ownerWindow;
			if (ownerWindow != null)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)scaleWindow).FlowDirection = ownerWindow.FlowDirection;
			}
			scaleWindow.ViewModel.ScaleApplied += ViewModel_ScaleApplied;
			((Window)(object)scaleWindow).ShowDialog();
		}

		private void ViewModel_ScaleApplied(object sender, ScaleWindowViewModelEventArgs e)
		{
			scaleWindow.ViewModel.ScaleApplied -= ViewModel_ScaleApplied;
			if (e.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.AdjustToPercent)
			{
				model.PrintingSystem.Document.ScaleFactor = e.ScaleFactor;
				return;
			}
			if (e.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.FitToPageWidth)
			{
				model.PrintingSystem.Document.AutoFitToPagesWidth = e.PagesToFit;
				return;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("ScaleMode");
		}
	}
	public class PrintingStringIdConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("parameter");
			}
			PrintingStringId id = (PrintingStringId)Enum.Parse(typeof(PrintingStringId), parameter.ToString(), ignoreCase: false);
			return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		public static XtraLocalizer<PrintingStringId> CreateDefaultLocalizer()
		{
			return (XtraLocalizer<PrintingStringId>)(object)new PrintingResXLocalizer();
		}

		public static string GetString(PrintingStringId id)
		{
			return XtraLocalizer<PrintingStringId>.Active.GetLocalizedString(id);
		}

		public override XtraLocalizer<PrintingStringId> CreateResXLocalizer()
		{
			return (XtraLocalizer<PrintingStringId>)(object)new PrintingResXLocalizer();
		}
	}
	public class PrintingResXLocalizer : DXResXLocalizer<PrintingStringId>
	{
		public PrintingResXLocalizer()
			: base((XtraLocalizer<PrintingStringId>)(object)new PrintingLocalizer())
		{
		}

		protected override ResourceManager CreateResourceManagerCore()
		{
			return XtraLocalizer.CreateResourceManager<PrintingStringId>((XtraResXLocalizer<PrintingStringId>)(object)this, "DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.LocalizationRes", typeof(PrintingResXLocalizer));
		}

	[Obsolete("The DocumentPreview and corresponding xxxPreviewModel classes and interfaces are now obsolete. Use the DocumentPreviewControl class to display a print preview. More information: https://www.devexpress.com/Support/WhatsNew/DXperience/files/16.1.2.bc.xml#BC3444")]
	public class XtraReportPreviewModel : LegacyLinkPreviewModel
	{
		private IReport report;

		private bool autoShowParametersPanel = true;

		private readonly ParametersModel parametersModel;

		private readonly CancellationTokenSource cts = new CancellationTokenSource();

		[Description("Specifies the report assigned to the model.")]
		public IReport Report
		{
			get
			{
				return report;
			}
			set
			{
				if (report != value)
				{
					OnSourceChanging();
					report = value;
					PrepareParametersModel();
					OnSourceChanged();
					UpdateCurrentPageContent();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies whether the Parameters panel is visible in the Print Preview.")]
		public bool AutoShowParametersPanel
		{
			get
			{
				return autoShowParametersPanel;
			}
			set
			{
				autoShowParametersPanel = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsEmptyDocument
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsCreating && PageCount == 0)
				{
					return !((ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>)(object)parametersModel).IsSubmitted;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override PrintingSystemBase PrintingSystem
		{
			get
			{
				if (report != null)
				{
					return ((IDocumentSource)report).PrintingSystemBase;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal IWatermarkService WatermarkService { get; set; }

		public override bool IsSetWatermarkVisible => true;

		public override ParametersModel ParametersModel => parametersModel;

		public XtraReportPreviewModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public XtraReportPreviewModel(IReport report)
			: base((ILink)(object)report)
		{
			this.report = report;
			parametersModel = ParametersModel.CreateParametersModel();
			((ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>)(object)parametersModel).Submit += OnSubmit;
			PrepareParametersModel();
			WatermarkService = new WatermarkService();
			OnSourceChanged();
		}

		internal XtraReportPreviewModel(IReport report, IPageSettingsConfiguratorService pageSettingsConfiguratorService, IPrintService printService, IExportSendService exportSendService, IHighlightingService highlightService, IScaleService scaleService, IWatermarkService watermarkService)
			: base((ILink)(object)report, pageSettingsConfiguratorService, printService, exportSendService, highlightService, scaleService)
		{
			this.report = report;
			WatermarkService = watermarkService;
			OnSourceChanged();
		}

		private void PrepareParametersModel()
		{
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00ae: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b5: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<ParameterModel> list = new List<ParameterModel>();
			if (Report == null)
			{
				parametersModel.AssignParameters(list);
				return;
			}
			List<Parameter> list2 = CollectReportParameters(Report);
			if (list2.Count == 0)
			{
				parametersModel.AssignParameters(list);
				return;
			}
			string message = default(string);
			if (!CascadingParametersService.ValidateFilterStrings((IEnumerable<Parameter>)list2, ref message))
			{
				parametersModel.AssignParameters(list);
				ShowError(message);
				return;
			}
			Report.RaiseParametersRequestBeforeShow(new ParametersRequestEventArgs((IList<ParameterInfo>)list2.ConvertAll((Parameter x) => ParameterInfoFactory.CreateWithoutEditor(x))));
			DataContext service = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<DataContext>((IServiceProvider)Report);
			List<ParameterModel> collection = ModelsCreator.CreateParameterModels(list2);
			list.AddRange(collection);
			LookUpValuesProvider val = new LookUpValuesProvider((IEnumerable<Parameter>)list2, service, (IParameterAllValuesService)null);
			((ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>)(object)parametersModel).ReplaceService<ILookUpValuesProvider>((ILookUpValuesProvider)(object)val);
			Task task = ((ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>)(object)parametersModel).AssignParametersAsync((IEnumerable<ItemViewModel>)list, cts.Token);
			if (AutoShowParametersPanel && ((ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>)(object)parametersModel).HasVisibleParameters)
			{
				IsParametersPanelVisible = true;
				RaisePropertyChanged(() => IsParametersPanelVisible);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing && cts != null)
			{
				cts.Cancel();
				cts.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void OnSubmit(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SubmitParameters(CollectReportParameters(Report));
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement VisualizePage(int pageIndex)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BrickPageVisualizer brickPageVisualizer = new BrickPageVisualizer(TextMeasurementSystem.GdiPlus);
			PSPage val = (PSPage)PrintingSystem.Pages[pageIndex];
			((Page)val).PerformLayout((IPrintingSystemContext)new PrintingSystemContextWrapper((IPrintingSystemContext)(object)PrintingSystem, (Page)(object)val));
			return brickPageVisualizer.Visualize(val, pageIndex, PrintingSystem.Pages.Count);
		}

		protected override void HookPrintingSystem()
		{
			base.HookPrintingSystem();
			Report.PrintTool = (IReportPrintTool)(object)new ReportPrintToolWpf(Report);
		}

		protected override void UnhookPrintingSystem()
		{
			base.UnhookPrintingSystem();
			PrintingSystem.RemoveService(typeof(XpsExportServiceBase));
		}

		protected override void CreateDocument(bool buildPagesInBackground)
		{
			((ILink)Report).CreateDocument(buildPagesInBackground);
		}

		protected override bool CanShowParametersPanel(object parameter)
		{
			if (Report == null || CollectReportParameters(Report).Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (Parameter item in CollectReportParameters(Report))
			{
				if (item.Visible)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override DataContext GetDataContext()
		{
			object service = ((IServiceProvider)Report).GetService(typeof(DataContext));
			return (DataContext)((service is DataContext) ? service : null);
		}

		private static List<Parameter> CollectReportParameters(IReport report)
		{
			return report.CollectParameters().ToList();
		}

		private void SubmitParameters(List<Parameter> parameters)
		{
			try
			{
				ParameterPanelViewModelBase<ParameterItemViewModel>.RaiseParameterRequestSubmit(Report, (IEnumerable<ParameterInfo>)parameters.ConvertAll((Converter<Parameter, ParameterInfo>)((Parameter parameter) => new ParameterInfo(parameter, (Function<System.Windows.Forms.Control, Parameter>)((Parameter type) => (System.Windows.Forms.Control)null)))), true);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Report != null && !((IDocumentSource)Report).PrintingSystemBase.HandleCreateDocumentException(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanSetWatermark(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.BuildPagesComplete && !base.IsExporting)
			{
				return !base.IsSaving;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void SetWatermark(object parameter)
		{
			WatermarkService.EditCompleted += watermarkService_EditCompleted;
			WatermarkService.Edit(DialogService.GetParentWindow(), PrintingSystem.Pages[base.CurrentPageIndex], PrintingSystem.PageCount, PrintingSystem.Watermarks);
		}

		private void watermarkService_EditCompleted(object sender, WatermarkServiceEventArgs e)
		{
			WatermarkService.EditCompleted -= watermarkService_EditCompleted;
			if (e.IsWatermarkAssigned == true)
			{
				PrintingSystem.Watermarks.CopyFrom(e.Watermarks);
				report.Watermarks.CopyFrom(e.Watermarks);
				ClearCache();
				UpdateCurrentPageContent();
			}
		}
	}
	public class ZoomComboBoxTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate ZoomModeItemTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate SeparatorItemTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (item is ZoomSeparatorItem)
			{
				((UIElement)(ComboBoxEditItem)((ContentPresenter)container).TemplatedParent).IsEnabled = false;
				return SeparatorItemTemplate;
			}
			if (item is ZoomValueItem || item is ZoomFitModeItem)
			{
				return ZoomModeItemTemplate;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

			}
		}

		public ExportOptionsContainer ExportOptions => (ExportOptionsContainer)(object)((PrintingSystemBase)this).ExportOptions;

			: base((IContainer)null, (ExportOptions)(object)new ExportOptionsContainer())

		}

		{
			return (CommandVisibility)3;
		}

		protected override PrintingDocument CreateDocument()
		{
			return DocumentFactory.Create((PrintingSystemBase)(object)this);
		}

		public void ExportToXps(string filePath)
		{
			((PrintingSystemBase)this).ExportToXps(filePath, ExportOptions.Xps);
		}

	public abstract class PrintingSystemPreviewModel : DocumentPreviewModelBase, IDisposable
	{
		internal const int DefaultPageCacheSize = 20;

		private IPageSettingsConfiguratorService pageSettingsConfiguratorService;

		private IPrintService printService;

		private IExportSendService exportSendService;

		private IHighlightingService highlightingService;

		private PagesCache pagesCache;

		private bool isCreating;

		private bool isExporting;

		private bool disposed;

		private bool firstPageDisplayed;

		private bool isReflectorPositionChanged;

		private bool isSaving;

		internal EventHandler Saving;

		public int PageCacheSize
		{
			get
			{
				return pagesCache.CacheSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != pagesCache.CacheSize)
				{
					pagesCache = new PagesCache(value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract PrintingSystemBase PrintingSystem { get; }

		protected internal bool IsSaving
		{
			get
			{
				return isSaving;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isSaving != value)
				{
					isSaving = value;
					RaiseAllCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool IsExporting
		{
			get
			{
				return isExporting;

		private void ProgressReflector_PositionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			ProgressReflector val = (ProgressReflector)sender;
			IsReflectorPositionChanged = true;
			if (val.PositionCore == val.MaximumCore && IsSaving)
			{
				IsSaving = false;
			}
			if ((int)PrintingSystem.Document.State == 3)
			{
				TimeSpan timeout = new TimeSpan(100000L);
				Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.Invoke((ThreadStart)delegate
				{
				}, timeout, DispatcherPriority.Background);
			}
		}

		private void PrintingSystemBase_BeforeBuildPages(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ClearCache();
			IsCreating = true;
		}

		private void PrintingSystem_DocumentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (PageCount > 0 && !firstPageDisplayed)
			{
				firstPageDisplayed = true;
				base.CurrentPageIndex = 0;
				UpdateCurrentPageContent();
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged(() => PageCount);
			RaiseNavigationCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private void PrintingSystem_AfterBuildPages(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			IsCreating = false;
			if (PageCount != 0)
			{
				pagesCache.Clear();
				UpdateCurrentPageContent();
			}
		}

		protected void OnSourceChanging()
		{
			if (PrintingSystem != null)
			{
				UnhookPrintingSystem();
			}
			ClearCache();
		}

		protected void OnSourceChanged()
		{
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (PrintingSystem != null)
			{
				HookPrintingSystem();
				if (PageCount > 0)
				{
					base.CurrentPageIndex = 0;
				}
				if (!PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options.ContainsKey(typeof(XpsExportOptions)))
				{
					PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options.Add(typeof(XpsExportOptions), (ExportOptionsBase)new XpsExportOptions());
				}
				RaiseAllPropertiesChanged();
				RaiseAllCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void HookPrintingSystem()
		{
			PrintingSystem.DocumentChanged += PrintingSystem_DocumentChanged;
			PrintingSystem.BeforeBuildPages += PrintingSystemBase_BeforeBuildPages;
			PrintingSystem.AfterBuildPages += PrintingSystem_AfterBuildPages;
			PrintingSystem.ProgressReflector.PositionChanged += ProgressReflector_PositionChanged;
			ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<XpsExportServiceBase>((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)PrintingSystem, (XpsExportServiceBase)(object)new XpsExportService(CreatePaginator()), false);
			BackgroundServiceHelper.ReplaceBackgroundService(PrintingSystem);
			ICancellationService service = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<ICancellationService>((IServiceProvider)PrintingSystem);
			if (service != null)
			{
				service.StateChanged += cancellationService_StateChanged;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnhookPrintingSystem()
		{
			PrintingSystem.DocumentChanged -= PrintingSystem_DocumentChanged;
			PrintingSystem.BeforeBuildPages -= PrintingSystemBase_BeforeBuildPages;
			PrintingSystem.AfterBuildPages -= PrintingSystem_AfterBuildPages;
			PrintingSystem.ProgressReflector.PositionChanged -= ProgressReflector_PositionChanged;
			PrintingSystem.RemoveService(typeof(IBackgroundService));
			ICancellationService service = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<ICancellationService>((IServiceProvider)PrintingSystem);
			if (service != null)
			{
				service.StateChanged -= cancellationService_StateChanged;
			}
		}

		private void cancellationService_StateChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ICancellationService val = (ICancellationService)sender;
			IsCreating = CancellationServiceExtensions.CanBeCanceled(val) || PrintingSystem.Document.IsCreating;
		}

		protected DocumentPaginator CreatePaginator()

		public void Dispose()
		{

			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposed)

				disposed = true;
			}
		}

		private ExportOptionsBase GetExportOptions(ExportFormat format)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (ExportOptionsBase)((int)format switch
			{
				0 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(PdfExportOptions)], 
				1 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(HtmlExportOptions)], 
				2 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(MhtExportOptions)], 
				3 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(RtfExportOptions)], 
				5 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(XlsExportOptions)], 
				6 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(XlsxExportOptions)], 
				7 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(CsvExportOptions)], 
				8 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(TextExportOptions)], 
				9 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(ImageExportOptions)], 
				10 => PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.Options[typeof(XpsExportOptions)], 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("format"), 
			});
		}

		private bool IsProgressReflectorComplited()
		{
			return PrintingSystem.ProgressReflector.PositionCore == PrintingSystem.ProgressReflector.MaximumCore;
		}

		private bool IsProgressMarquee()
		{
			if (PrintingSystem.ProgressReflector.Ranges.Count != 0)
			{
				return float.IsNaN(PrintingSystem.ProgressReflector.Ranges[0]);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement GetPageContent()
		{
			if (PageCount == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			FrameworkElement page = pagesCache.GetPage(base.CurrentPageIndex);
			if (page == null)
			{
				try
				{
					frameworkElement = VisualizePage(base.CurrentPageIndex);
					pagesCache.AddPage(frameworkElement, base.CurrentPageIndex);
					base.IsIncorrectPageContent = false;
				}
				catch (System.Windows.Markup.XamlParseException)
				{
					base.IsIncorrectPageContent = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				frameworkElement = page;
			}
			return frameworkElement;
		}

		protected override void Open(object parameter)
		{
			string caption = PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)648);
			string filter = string.Format(PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)647), ".prnx");
			using Stream stream = DialogService.ShowOpenFileDialog(caption, filter);
			if (stream == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				PrintingSystem.LoadDocument(stream);
			}
			catch
			{
				DialogService.ShowError(PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)186), PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Error));
			}
			finally
			{
				IsCreating = false;
				ClearCache();
				commands[(PrintingSystemCommand)1].RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
				if (!CanShowDocumentMap(null))
				{
					IsDocumentMapVisible = false;
				}
				commands[(PrintingSystemCommand)2].RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
				if (!CanShowParametersPanel(null))
				{
					IsParametersPanelVisible = false;
				}
				if (base.CurrentPageIndex == 0)
				{
					UpdateCurrentPageContent();
				}
				else
				{
					base.CurrentPageIndex = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanOpen(object parameter)
		{
			if (PrintingSystem != null && !IsCreating && !IsExporting)
			{
				return !IsSaving;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void Save(object parameter)
		{
			string caption = PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)264);
			string filter = string.Format("{0} (*{1})|*{1}", PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)274), ".prnx");
			string defaultDirectory = PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.PrintPreview.DefaultDirectory;
			string defaultFileName = PrintingSystem.ExportOptions.PrintPreview.DefaultFileName;
			using Stream stream = DialogService.ShowSaveFileDialog(caption, filter, 0, defaultDirectory, defaultFileName);
			if (stream != null)
			{
				IsSaving = true;
				Saving?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				PrintingSystem.SaveDocument(stream);
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanSave(object parameter)
		{
			if (BuildPagesComplete && !IsExporting)
			{
				return !IsSaving;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CanShowDocumentMap(object parameter)
		{

			{
				return ((ICollection)PrintingSystem.Document.BookmarkNodes).Count != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{

			firstPageDisplayed = false;
		}

		protected override bool IsHitTestResult(FrameworkElement element)
		{

		}

	public interface IPageSettingsConfiguratorService
	{
		bool? Configure(XtraPageSettingsBase pageSettings, Window ownerWindow);
	}
	public class PageSettingsConfiguratorService : IPageSettingsConfiguratorService
	{
		internal bool Configure(Page page, DialogService dialogService = null)
		{
			DXGraphicsUnit unit = (RegionInfo.CurrentRegion.IsMetric ? DXGraphicsUnit.Millimeter : DXGraphicsUnit.Inch);
			ReadonlyPageData pageData = page.PageData;
			PageSetupViewModel model = ViewModelSource.Create(() => new PageSetupViewModel(pageData, unit));
			if (ShowPageSetupDialog(model, dialogService))
			{
				PageSettingsViewModelHelper.AssignPageDataFromModel(model, page, page.Document.PrintingSystem);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShowPageSetupDialog(PageSetupViewModel model, DialogService dialogService)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Window activeWindow = ActiveWindowFinderBase<ActiveWindowFinder>.Instance.GetActiveWindow();
			if (dialogService == null)
			{
				dialogService = new DialogService
				{
					DialogStyle = (Style)activeWindow.FindResource(new NewDocumentViewerThemeKeyExtension
					{
						ResourceKey = NewDocumentViewerThemeKeys.CommonDialogStyle
					}),
					ViewTemplate = (DataTemplate)activeWindow.FindResource(new NewDocumentViewerThemeKeyExtension
					{
						ResourceKey = NewDocumentViewerThemeKeys.PageSetupDialogTemplate
					})
				};
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (!((AttachableObjectBase)dialogService).IsAttached)
			{
				((AttachableObjectBase)dialogService).Attach((DependencyObject)activeWindow);
				flag = true;
			}
			bool result = ((DevExpress.Mvvm.IDialogService)dialogService).ShowDialog(MessageButton.OKCancel, PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.PageSetup), model) == MessageResult.OK;
			if (flag)
			{
				((AttachableObjectBase)dialogService).Detach();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool? Configure(XtraPageSettingsBase pageSettings, Window ownerWindow)
		{
			try
			{
				PageSetupWindow pageSetupWindow = new PageSetupWindow
				{
					Owner = ownerWindow,
					WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner
				};
				if (ownerWindow != null)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)pageSetupWindow).FlowDirection = ownerWindow.FlowDirection;
				}
				LegacyPageSetupViewModel model = pageSetupWindow.Model;
				AssignPageSettingsToModel(pageSettings, model);
				if (((Window)(object)pageSetupWindow).ShowDialog() == true)
				{
					AssignPageSettingsFromModel(pageSettings, model);
				}
				return ((Window)(object)pageSetupWindow).DialogResult;
			}
			catch (PrintServerException)
			{
				MessageBoxHelper.Show(MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand, (PreviewStringId)123);
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static void AssignPageSettingsFromModel(XtraPageSettingsBase pageSettings, LegacyPageSetupViewModel model)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			MarginsF margins = model.GetMargins(300f);
			SizeF sizeF = model.GetSizeF(300f);
			PageData val = new PageData(margins, model.PaperKind, model.Landscape);
			if (model.PaperKind == DXPaperKind.Custom)
			{
				((ReadonlyPageData)val).PageSize = sizeF;
			}
			pageSettings.Assign(val);
		}

		private static void AssignPageSettingsToModel(XtraPageSettingsBase pageSettings, LegacyPageSetupViewModel model)
		{
			PageData data = pageSettings.Data;
			model.Landscape = pageSettings.Landscape;
			model.PaperKind = pageSettings.PaperKind;
			model.SetPageSize(((ReadonlyPageData)data).PageSize, 300f);
			model.SetMargins(((MarginsFBase)((ReadonlyPageData)data).MarginsF).Left, ((MarginsFBase)((ReadonlyPageData)data).MarginsF).Top, ((MarginsFBase)((ReadonlyPageData)data).MarginsF).Right, ((MarginsFBase)((ReadonlyPageData)data).MarginsF).Bottom, 300f);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ZoomItemBase
	{
		[Description("Gets the text representation of a ZoomValueItem in Print Preview.")]
		public abstract string DisplayedText { get; }

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return DisplayedText;
		}
	}
	internal class ZoomSeparatorItem : ZoomItemBase
	{
		public override string DisplayedText => string.Empty;
	}
	public class ZoomSubItemTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate ZoomModeItemTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate SeparatorItemTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (item is ZoomSeparatorItem)
			{
				return SeparatorItemTemplate;
			}
			if (item is ZoomValueItem || item is ZoomFitModeItem)
			{
				return ZoomModeItemTemplate;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ZoomValueItem : ZoomItemBase
	{
		[Description("Specifies the zoom factor value to which the ZoomValueItem corresponds.")]
		public double ZoomValue { get; private set; }

		[Description("Specifies the caption for the zoom value item as it appears in Print Preview.")]
		public override string DisplayedText => string.Format(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.ZoomValueItemFormat), ZoomValue);

		public ZoomValueItem(double zoomValue)
		{
			ZoomValue = zoomValue;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ZoomValueItem)
			{
				return ((ZoomValueItem)obj).ZoomValue == ZoomValue;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
