	public class DocumentNavigationStrategy : NavigationStrategy
	{
		private readonly Locker pageIndexSyncLocker;

		private readonly Locker backPageIndexSyncLocker;

		protected new DocumentPresenterControl Presenter => base.Presenter as DocumentPresenterControl;

		internal new PositionCalculator PositionCalculator => base.PositionCalculator;

		public DocumentNavigationStrategy(DocumentPresenterControl presenter)
			: base(presenter)
		{
			ref Locker reference = ref pageIndexSyncLocker;
			object value = typeof(NavigationStrategy).GetField("pageIndexSyncLocker", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic).GetValue(this);
			reference = (Locker)((value is Locker) ? value : null);
			ref Locker reference2 = ref backPageIndexSyncLocker;
			object value2 = typeof(NavigationStrategy).GetField("backPageIndexSyncLocker", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic).GetValue(this);
			reference2 = (Locker)((value2 is Locker) ? value2 : null);
		}

		public override void ProcessZoomChanged(ZoomChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.ProcessZoomChanged(e);
			Presenter.Do(delegate(DocumentPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.InvalidateRenderCaches();
			});
		}

		internal NavigationState GenerateNavigationState()
		{
			if (base.ScrollViewer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GenerateCurrentState(0.0, base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor, base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomMode);
		}

		public PageViewModel GetPageViewModel(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (Presenter.Pages == null || Presenter.ItemsPanel == null || Presenter.ScrollViewer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PageViewModel result = null;
			if (Presenter.ShowSingleItem)
			{
				int num = base.ItemsPanel.IndexCalculator.VerticalOffsetToIndex(base.ItemsPanel.GetVirtualVerticalOffset());
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				PageWrapper pageWrapper = Presenter.Pages.ElementAt(num);
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)Presenter.ItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(pageWrapper);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = uIElement.TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), Presenter);
				foreach (IPage page in pageWrapper.Pages)
				{
					Rect pageRect = pageWrapper.GetPageRect(page);
					pageRect.Offset(point2.X, point2.Y);
					if (RectExtension.IsInside(pageRect, point))
					{
						return page as PageViewModel;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int pageIndex = PositionCalculator.GetPageIndex(point.Y + base.ScrollViewer.VerticalOffset, point.X, base.ItemsPanel.CalcPageHorizontalOffset);
				if (pageIndex == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				PageWrapper pageWrapper2 = GetPageWrapper(pageIndex);
				result = pageWrapper2.With((PageWrapper p) => p.Pages.SingleOrDefault((IPage x) => x.PageIndex == pageIndex) as PageViewModel);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void ProcessPageIndexChanged(int pageIndex)
		{
			if (base.ItemsPanel == null)
			{
				base.ProcessPageIndexChanged(pageIndex);
			}
			else if (Presenter.ActualDocumentViewer.CanSelectPageByClick)
			{
				pageIndexSyncLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					backPageIndexSyncLocker.LockOnce();
					int pageWrapperIndex = PositionCalculator.GetPageWrapperIndex(pageIndex);
					Rect pageWrapperRect = GetPageWrapperRect(pageWrapperIndex);
					int num = base.ItemsPanel.IndexCalculator.VerticalOffsetToIndex(base.ItemsPanel.GetVirtualVerticalOffset());
					bool flag = num != -1 && base.ItemsPanel.IsRectangleVisible(pageWrapperRect);
					ScrollIntoView(pageWrapperIndex, Rect.Empty, (!flag) ? ScrollIntoViewMode.TopLeft : ScrollIntoViewMode.Edge);
				});
			}
		}

		private Rect GetPageWrapperRect(int pageWrapperIndex)
		{
			System.Windows.Size realItemSize = base.ItemsPanel.IndexCalculator.GetRealItemSize(pageWrapperIndex);
			return new Rect(0.0, base.ItemsPanel.IndexCalculator.IndexToVerticalOffset(pageWrapperIndex, showSingleItem: false), realItemSize.IsEmpty ? 0.0 : realItemSize.Width, realItemSize.IsEmpty ? 0.0 : realItemSize.Height);
		}

		public PageWrapper GetPageWrapper(int pageIndex)
		{
			int pageWrapperIndex = PositionCalculator.GetPageWrapperIndex(pageIndex);
			return Presenter.Pages.ElementAt(pageWrapperIndex);
		}

		public Brick GetBrick(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return GetPageModelBrickPair(point).With((Pair<PageViewModel, Brick> x) => x.Second);
		}

		public Pair<PageViewModel, Brick> GetPageModelBrickPair(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			PageViewModel pageViewModel = GetPageViewModel(point);
			if (pageViewModel == null || !pageViewModel.IsValid)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PageWrapper pageWrapper = GetPageWrapper(pageViewModel.PageIndex);
			Rect pageRect = pageWrapper.GetPageRect(pageViewModel);
			double num = (Presenter.ShowSingleItem ? CalcPageVerticalOffset(pageWrapper) : PositionCalculator.GetPageVerticalOffset(pageViewModel.PageIndex, 0.0)) + pageRect.Top;
			double num2 = Presenter.ItemsPanel.CalcPageHorizontalOffset(pageWrapper.RenderSize.Width) + pageRect.Left;
			double scaleX = Presenter.GetScaleX();
			double num3 = (Presenter.ShowSingleItem ? 0.0 : base.ScrollViewer.VerticalOffset);
			System.Windows.Point relativePoint = new System.Windows.Point((point.X - num2) * scaleX, (point.Y + num3 - num) * scaleX);
			Brick brick = pageViewModel.GetBrick(relativePoint, base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor);
			return new Pair<PageViewModel, Brick>(pageViewModel, brick);
		}

		private double CalcPageVerticalOffset(PageWrapper wrapper)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Presenter.ItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(wrapper) as FrameworkElement;
			return frameworkElement.TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), Presenter).Y;
		}

		public void ShowBrick(BrickPagePair brickPagePair, ScrollIntoViewMode? scrollIntoView = null)
		{
			if (BrickPagePairHelper.GetBrick(brickPagePair, (IPageRepository)(object)Presenter.Document.PrintingSystem.Pages) != null)
			{
				ShowBrickCore(brickPagePair, scrollIntoView);
				return;
			}
			(Presenter.Document as DocumentViewModel).Do(delegate(DocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.EnsureBrickOnPage(brickPagePair, delegate(BrickPagePair pair)
				{
					ShowBrickCore(pair, scrollIntoView);
				});
			});
		}

		private void ShowBrickCore(BrickPagePair brickPagePair, ScrollIntoViewMode? scrollIntoView = null)
		{
			RectangleF brickBounds = brickPagePair.GetBrickBounds((IPageRepository)(object)Presenter.Document.PrintingSystem.Pages);
			int pageIndex = ((BrickPageInfo)brickPagePair).PageIndex;
			int pageWrapperIndex = PositionCalculator.GetPageWrapperIndex(pageIndex);
			RectangleF rectangleF = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(brickBounds, 300f, 96f);
			Rect rect = new Rect((double)rectangleF.X * base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor, (double)rectangleF.Y * base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor, (double)rectangleF.Width * base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor, (double)rectangleF.Height * base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor);
			ScrollIntoViewMode mode = (scrollIntoView.HasValue ? scrollIntoView.Value : ((!Presenter.IsSearchControlVisible) ? ScrollIntoViewMode.TopLeft : ScrollIntoViewMode.Center));
			ScrollIntoView(pageWrapperIndex, rect, mode);
		}

		public Rect GetPageRect(int pageIndex)
		{
			PageViewModel page = Presenter.Document.Pages.Single((PageViewModel x) => x.PageIndex == pageIndex);
			PageWrapper pageWrapper = GetPageWrapper(pageIndex);
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)Presenter.ItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(pageWrapper);
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect(uIElement, (UIElement)Presenter.ItemsControl);
			Rect pageRect = pageWrapper.GetPageRect(page);
			pageRect.Offset(relativeElementRect.Left, relativeElementRect.Top);
			return pageRect;
		}
	}

		public static void SetCurrentPage(this IDocumentViewModel document, int pageIndex)
		{
			document.Do(delegate(IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.Pages.ForEach(delegate(PageViewModel p)
				{
					p.IsSelected = p.PageIndex == pageIndex;
				});
			});
		}

		{

		}

	public class PageToMarginSizeConverter : PageToMarginSizeConverterBase
	{
		protected override object GetResult(PageViewModel page, double actualZoom)
		{

			return new GridLength((double)GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip((float)marginSize) * actualZoom);
		}

	public class PageToMaxMarginSizeConverter : PageToMarginSizeConverterBase
	{
		protected override object GetResult(PageViewModel page, double actualZoom)
		{
			double marginSize = GetMarginSize(page, reverse: true);
			float num = (base.IsVertical ? page.Page.PageSize.Height : page.Page.PageSize.Width);
			double num2 = (double)num - marginSize - 25.0;
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return (double)GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip((float)num2) * actualZoom;
		}
	}

	public class PageMarginModel
	{
		public MarginSide Side { get; private set; }

		public virtual double SizeF { get; protected set; }

		public virtual double MaxSizeF { get; protected set; }

		public virtual double Size { get; protected set; }

		public virtual double MaxSize { get; protected set; }

		public virtual double Zoom { get; set; }

		public static PageMarginModel Create(MarginSide side)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ViewModelSource.Create(() => new PageMarginModel(side));
		}

		protected PageMarginModel(MarginSide side)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Side = side;
			Zoom = 1.0;
		}

		protected void OnZoomChanged()
		{
			double num = (double)GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip((float)SizeF) * Zoom - 1.0;
			Size = ((num < 0.0) ? 0.0 : num);
			MaxSize = (double)GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip((float)MaxSizeF) * Zoom;
		}

		protected void OnSizeFChanged()
		{
			double num = (double)GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip((float)SizeF) * Zoom - 1.0;
			Size = ((num < 0.0) ? 0.0 : num);
		}

		protected void OnMaxSizeFChanged()
		{
			MaxSize = (double)GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip((float)MaxSizeF) * Zoom;
		}

		public void SetDefinitions(double sizeF, double maxSizeF)
		{
			SizeF = sizeF;
			MaxSizeF = maxSizeF;
		}
	}

		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<PageMarginsEditor>.New().Register<PageViewModel>("Page", ref PageProperty, (PageViewModel)null, (Action<PageMarginsEditor, PageViewModel, PageViewModel>)delegate(PageMarginsEditor d, PageViewModel o, PageViewModel n)
			{
				d.OnPageChanged(o, n);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<double>("Zoom", ref ZoomProperty, 1.0, (Action<PageMarginsEditor>)delegate(PageMarginsEditor d)
			{
				d.OnZoomChanged();

				.RegisterReadOnly<PageMarginModel>("RightMargin", ref RightMarginPropertyKey, ref RightMarginProperty, (PageMarginModel)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)

		public PageMarginsEditor()
		{
			LeftMargin = PageMarginModel.Create((MarginSide)1);
			TopMargin = PageMarginModel.Create((MarginSide)2);
			RightMargin = PageMarginModel.Create((MarginSide)4);
			BottomMargin = PageMarginModel.Create((MarginSide)8);
		}

		private void OnZoomChanged()
		{
			LeftMargin.Zoom = Zoom;
			TopMargin.Zoom = Zoom;
			RightMargin.Zoom = Zoom;
			BottomMargin.Zoom = Zoom;
		}

		private void OnPageChanged(PageViewModel oldValue, PageViewModel newValue)
		{
			oldValue.Do(delegate(PageViewModel x)
			{
				x.PageChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(x.PageChanged, new EventHandler(OnPagePropertyChanged));
			});
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				ClearDefinitions();
				return;
			}
			SetDefinitions();
			oldValue.Do(delegate(PageViewModel x)
			{
				x.PageChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(x.PageChanged, new EventHandler(OnPagePropertyChanged));
			});
		}

		private void ClearDefinitions()
		{
			LeftMargin.SetDefinitions(0.0, 0.0);
			TopMargin.SetDefinitions(0.0, 0.0);
			RightMargin.SetDefinitions(0.0, 0.0);
			BottomMargin.SetDefinitions(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		private void SetDefinitions()
		{
			LeftMargin.SetDefinitions(Page.PageMargins.Left, (double)Page.Page.PageSize.Width + Page.PageMargins.Left - 50.0);
			TopMargin.SetDefinitions(Page.PageMargins.Top, (double)Page.Page.PageSize.Height + Page.PageMargins.Top - 50.0);
			RightMargin.SetDefinitions(Page.PageMargins.Right, (double)Page.Page.PageSize.Width + Page.PageMargins.Right - 50.0);
			BottomMargin.SetDefinitions(Page.PageMargins.Bottom, (double)Page.Page.PageSize.Height + Page.PageMargins.Bottom - 50.0);
		}

		private void OnPagePropertyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetDefinitions();
		}
	}

		public MarginThumb()

			base.DragStarted += OnDragStarted;
			base.DragCompleted += OnDragCompleted;
			base.DragDelta += OnDragDelta;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			AddHandler(UIElement.PreviewMouseRightButtonDownEvent, (RoutedEventHandler)delegate

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			toolTip.Do(delegate(System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip x)
			{
				PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState(toolTip, false);
				x.Opened -= OnToolTipOpened;
			});
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();

			{
				x.Opened += OnToolTipOpened;
			});
		}

		private void OnToolTipOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ToolTipLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState(toolTip, false);
			}
		}

		private void OnDragStarted(object sender, DragStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolTipLocker.LockOnce();
			if (PageMargin == null || SetPageMarginCommand == null)
			{
				CancelDrag();
				return;
			}
			startMousePosition = GetPositionsByPreview();
			ActualSize = PageMargin.SizeF;
			toolTip.Do(delegate
			{
				CommonThemeHelper.SetThemeName((DependencyObject)toolTip, CommonThemeHelper.ActualApplicationThemeName);
				toolTip.UpdateLayout();
				PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState(toolTip, true);
			});
		}

		private void OnDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ToolTipLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			ActualSize = GetActualSize(e.HorizontalChange, e.VerticalChange);
			toolTip.Do(delegate(System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip x)
			{
				PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState(toolTip, true);
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					x.VerticalOffset = GetToolTipOffset();
				}
				else
				{
					x.HorizontalOffset = GetToolTipOffset();
				}
			});
		}

		private void OnDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState(toolTip, false);
			ToolTipLocker.Unlock();
			if (!e.Canceled && SetPageMarginCommand != null && ActualSize != PageMargin.SizeF)
			{
				SetPageMarginCommand.Execute(new PageMarginSettings(PageMargin.Side, ActualSize));
			}
		}

		private double GetToolTipOffset()
		{
			System.Windows.Point positionsByPreview = GetPositionsByPreview();
			double num = (IsVertical ? (positionsByPreview.Y - startMousePosition.Y) : (positionsByPreview.X - startMousePosition.X));
			if (!Reverse)
			{
				if (num < 0.0 - PageMargin.Size)
				{
					return 0.0 - PageMargin.Size;
				}
				if (num > PageMargin.MaxSize - PageMargin.Size)
				{
					return PageMargin.MaxSize - PageMargin.Size;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (num < 0.0 - (PageMargin.MaxSize - PageMargin.Size))
				{
					return 0.0 - (PageMargin.MaxSize - PageMargin.Size);
				}
				if (num > PageMargin.Size)
				{
					return PageMargin.Size;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetPositionsByPreview()
		{
			DocumentPresenterControl relativeTo = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DocumentPresenterControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			return Mouse.GetPosition(relativeTo);
		}

		private double GetActualSize(double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			horizontalChange /= PageMargin.Zoom;
			verticalChange /= PageMargin.Zoom;
			float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip((float)ActualSize);
			double num2 = (IsVertical ? verticalChange : horizontalChange);
			num2 = (Reverse ? (0.0 - num2) : num2);
			double num3 = (double)num + num2;
			num3 = ((num3 < 0.0) ? 0f : ((float)num3));
			double num4 = GraphicsUnitConverter.DipToDoc((float)num3);
			return (num4 > PageMargin.MaxSizeF) ? PageMargin.MaxSizeF : num4;
		}
	}
	public class NavigationPaneTabTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate DocumentMapTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate PagesTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate SearchResultTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			NavigationPaneTabType? navigationPaneTabType = item as NavigationPaneTabType?;
			if (!navigationPaneTabType.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return navigationPaneTabType.Value switch
			{
				NavigationPaneTabType.DocumentMap => DocumentMapTemplate, 
				NavigationPaneTabType.Pages => PagesTemplate, 
				NavigationPaneTabType.SearchResults => SearchResultTemplate, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}
	}

	public class PreviewBehaviorProvider : BehaviorProvider
	{
		private class PreviewZoomHelper : ZoomHelper
		{
			public System.Windows.Size RealPageSize { get; set; }

			public PageDisplayMode PageDisplayMode { get; set; }

			protected override double CalcViewPageWidth()
			{
				if (PageDisplayMode != PageDisplayMode.Wrap)
				{
					return base.CalcViewPageWidth();
				}
				if (base.Viewport.IsEmpty || RealPageSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				return base.Viewport.Width / RealPageSize.Width;
			}

			protected override double CalcViewWholePage()
			{
				if (PageDisplayMode != PageDisplayMode.Wrap)
				{
					return base.CalcViewWholePage();
				}
				if (base.Viewport.IsEmpty || RealPageSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				double val = base.Viewport.Width / RealPageSize.Width;
				double val2 = base.Viewport.Height / RealPageSize.Height;
				return Math.Min(val, val2);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size realPageSize;

		private PageDisplayMode pageDisplayMode;

		private PreviewZoomHelper ZoomHelper { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Size RealPageSize
		{
			get
			{
				return realPageSize;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(ref realPageSize, value, () => RealPageSize, OnRealPageSizeChanged);
			}
		}

		public PageDisplayMode PageDisplayMode
		{
			get
			{
				return pageDisplayMode;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(ref pageDisplayMode, value, () => PageDisplayMode, OnPageDisplayModeChanged);
			}
		}

		internal override ZoomHelper CreateZoomHelper()
		{
			return ZoomHelper = new PreviewZoomHelper();
		}

		private void OnRealPageSizeChanged()
		{
			ZoomHelper.RealPageSize = RealPageSize;
			UpdateZoomFactor();
		}

		private void OnPageDisplayModeChanged()
		{
			ZoomHelper.PageDisplayMode = PageDisplayMode;
			UpdateZoomFactor();
		}
	}

		private class ProgressWindow : ThemedWindow, ISplashScreen
		{
			public static DependencyProperty ProgressViewModelProperty;

			public PrintProgressViewModel ProgressViewModel
			{
				get

					return (PrintProgressViewModel)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(ProgressViewModelProperty);

			static ProgressWindow()

				DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ProgressWindow>.New().Register<PrintProgressViewModel>("ProgressViewModel", ref ProgressViewModelProperty, (PrintProgressViewModel)null, (Action<ProgressWindow>)delegate(ProgressWindow d)
				{
					((ContentControl)(object)d).Content = d.ProgressViewModel;

				((FrameworkElement)this).MinWidth = 300.0;
				((FrameworkElement)this).MinHeight = 50.0;
				((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.Invoke(delegate
				{
					((ContentControl)this).ContentTemplate = new FrameworkElement().TryFindResource(new NewDocumentViewerThemeKeyExtension

				((Window)this).WindowStyle = WindowStyle.ToolWindow;
				((Window)this).SizeToContent = SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight;

			}

			}

			{

				((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.Invoke(delegate
				{

						frameworkElement.Name = "close_hiddenButton";
						frameworkElement.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

		private int pageNumber = 1;

		private readonly StandardPrintController standardController;

		private CancellationTokenSource cancelationTokenSource;

		private Window owner;

		private System.Windows.Point center;

		private Dispatcher Dispatcher => owner?.Dispatcher;

		public PrintProgressController()
		{
			standardController = new StandardPrintController();
		}

		public override void OnStartPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			cancelationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			base.OnStartPrint(document, e);
			if (!document.PrinterSettings.IsValid)
			{
				throw new InvalidPrinterException(document.PrinterSettings);
			}
			DoWithTryCatch(delegate
			{
				standardController.OnStartPrint(document, e);
				if (SystemInformation.UserInteractive)
				{
					InitializeOwner();
					SetOwnerEnabled(enabled: false);
					DXSplashScreen.Show<ProgressWindow>(WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen, (SplashScreenOwner)null, (SplashScreenClosingMode)2);
					DXSplashScreen.CallSplashScreenMethod<ProgressWindow>((Action<ProgressWindow>)delegate(ProgressWindow x)
					{
						if (owner != null)
						{
							CenterSplashScreen(x);
						}
						x.ProgressViewModel = ViewModelSource.Create(() => new PrintProgressViewModel(document, () => cancelationTokenSource.Cancel()));
					});
				}
			}, delegate
			{
				if (cancelationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
				}
			});
		}

		private void InitializeOwner()
		{
			HwndSource input = PresentationSource.CurrentSources.OfType<HwndSource>().LastOrDefault();
			owner = input.With((HwndSource x) => x.RootVisual as Window);
			if (owner != null)
			{
				center = GetOwnerCenter();
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetOwnerCenter()
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = default(System.Windows.Point);
			Dispatcher?.Invoke(delegate
			{
				point = ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint((FrameworkElement)owner, new System.Windows.Point(owner.Width / 2.0, owner.Height / 2.0));
			});
			return point;
		}

		private void SetOwnerEnabled(bool enabled)
		{
			Dispatcher?.Invoke(() => owner.IsEnabled = enabled);
		}

		private void CenterSplashScreen(ProgressWindow window)
		{
			if (owner == null)
			{
				((Window)(object)window).WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen;
				return;
			}
			((Window)(object)window).WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual;
			double left = Math.Max(center.X - ((FrameworkElement)(object)window).Width / 2.0, 0.0);
			double top = Math.Max(center.Y - ((FrameworkElement)(object)window).Height / 2.0, 0.0);
			((Window)(object)window).Left = left;
			((Window)(object)window).Top = top;
			Trace.WriteLine($"status position: {((Window)(object)window).Left}, {((Window)(object)window).Top}");
			((DispatcherObject)(object)window).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				((Window)(object)window).Left = left;
				((Window)(object)window).Top = top;
			}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
		}

		public override Graphics OnStartPage(PrintDocument document, PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnStartPage(document, e);
			DispatcherHelper.DoEvents(DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle, 1);
			if (!cancelationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested && DXSplashScreen.IsActive)
			{
				DXSplashScreen.CallSplashScreenMethod<ProgressWindow>((Action<ProgressWindow>)delegate(ProgressWindow x)
				{
					x.ProgressViewModel.Progress = pageNumber;
				});
			}
			Graphics graphics = null;
			DoWithTryCatch(delegate
			{
				graphics = standardController.OnStartPage(document, e);
			}, delegate
			{
				if (cancelationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
				}
			});
			return graphics;
		}

		public override void OnEndPage(PrintDocument document, PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			DoWithTryCatch(delegate
			{
				standardController.OnEndPage(document, e);
			}, delegate
			{
				pageNumber++;
				if (cancelationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
				}
				base.OnEndPage(document, e);
			});
		}

		public override void OnEndPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			DoWithTryCatch(delegate
			{
				standardController.OnEndPrint(document, e);
			}, delegate
			{
				if (cancelationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
				}
				else
				{
					cancelationTokenSource.Cancel();
				}
				SetOwnerEnabled(enabled: true);
				owner = null;
				if (DXSplashScreen.IsActive)
				{
					DXSplashScreen.Close();
				}
				base.OnEndPrint(document, e);
			});
		}

		private void DoWithTryCatch(Action tryAction, Action finalyAction = null)
		{
			try
			{
				tryAction();
			}
			catch
			{
				cancelationTokenSource.Cancel();
				if (DXSplashScreen.IsActive)
				{
					DXSplashScreen.Close();
				}
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				finalyAction.Do(delegate(Action x)
				{
					x();
				});
			}
		}
	}

	public class SearchHelper
	{
		private readonly SearchHelperBase searchHelper = new SearchHelperBase();

		private string actualText;

		private bool actualCaseSensitive;

		private bool actualWholeWord;

		private SearchDirection actualDirection;

		private string ActualText
		{
			get
			{
				return actualText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(actualText == value))
				{
					actualText = value;
					searchHelper.ResetSearchResults();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ActualCaseSensitive
		{
			get
			{
				return actualCaseSensitive;
			}
			set
			{
				if (actualCaseSensitive != value)
				{
					actualCaseSensitive = value;
					searchHelper.ResetSearchResults();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ActualWholeWord
		{
			get
			{
				return actualWholeWord;
			}
			set
			{
				if (actualWholeWord != value)
				{
					actualWholeWord = value;
					searchHelper.ResetSearchResults();
				}
			}
		}

		private SearchDirection ActualDirection
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return actualDirection;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (actualDirection != value)
				{
					actualDirection = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public BrickPagePair FindNext(PrintingSystemBase ps, TextSearchParameter searchParameter)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AssignParameters(searchParameter);
			return searchHelper.CircleFindNext(ps, ActualText, ActualDirection, ActualWholeWord, ActualCaseSensitive);
		}

		private void AssignParameters(TextSearchParameter searchParameter)
		{
			ActualText = searchParameter.Text;
			ActualCaseSensitive = searchParameter.IsCaseSensitive;
			ActualWholeWord = searchParameter.WholeWord;
			ActualDirection = (SearchDirection)(searchParameter.SearchDirection == TextSearchDirection.Forward);
		}
	}

	public class SelectionRectangle : BindableBase
	{
		public double Width => Math.Abs(StartPoint.X - AnchorPoint.X);

		public double Height => Math.Abs(StartPoint.Y - AnchorPoint.Y);

		public double X => Math.Min(StartPoint.X, AnchorPoint.X);

		public double Y => Math.Min(StartPoint.Y, AnchorPoint.Y);

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (DoubleExtensions.AreClose(Width, 0.0))
				{
					return DoubleExtensions.AreClose(Height, 0.0);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public Rect Rectangle => new Rect(X + HorizontalOffset, Y + VerticalOffset, Width, Height);

		private System.Windows.Size ViewportSize { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Point StartPoint { get; private set; }

		public System.Windows.Point AnchorPoint { get; private set; }

		private double HorizontalOffset { get; set; }

		private double VerticalOffset { get; set; }

		public SelectionRectangle(System.Windows.Point startPoint, System.Windows.Size viewportSize)
		{
			ViewportSize = viewportSize;
			SetStartPoint(startPoint);
		}

		public void AddStartXOffset(double dx)

		}

		public void AddStartYOffset(double dy)

		}

		public void AddAnchorXOffset(double dx)

			SetAnchorPoint(new System.Windows.Point(AnchorPoint.X + dx, AnchorPoint.Y));
		}

		public void AddAnchorYOffset(double dy)
		{
			SetAnchorPoint(new System.Windows.Point(AnchorPoint.X, AnchorPoint.Y + dy));
		}

		public void SetPointPosition(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			SetAnchorPoint(point);
		}

		private System.Windows.Point CoerceAnchorPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(Math.Max(0.0 - HorizontalOffset, Math.Min(point.X, ViewportSize.Width - HorizontalOffset)), Math.Max(0.0 - VerticalOffset, Math.Min(point.Y, ViewportSize.Height - VerticalOffset)));
		}

		private void SetAnchorPoint(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			AnchorPoint = CoerceAnchorPoint(p);

		}

		public void SetViewport(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			ViewportSize = size;
			SetAnchorPoint(AnchorPoint);
		}

		public void SetStartPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			StartPoint = point;
			Reset();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			SetAnchorPoint(StartPoint);
		}

		public void SetVerticalOffset(double offset, bool coerceStart)
		{
			double num = offset - VerticalOffset;
			VerticalOffset = offset;
			if (coerceStart)
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(StartPoint.X, StartPoint.Y - num);
			}
		}

		public void SetHorizontalOffset(double offset, bool coerceStart)
		{
			double num = offset - HorizontalOffset;
			HorizontalOffset = offset;
			if (coerceStart)
			{

			}
		}

	public class SelectionService
	{
		private const int LengthsSideInsensitiveZone = 10;

		private System.Drawing.Point selectionRectangleStartPosition = System.Drawing.Point.Empty;

		private System.Drawing.Point selectionRectangleCurrentPosition = System.Drawing.Point.Empty;

		private System.Drawing.Color selectionColorForBricks = System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(180, System.Drawing.SystemColors.Highlight);

		private bool leftButtonDown;

		private bool canSelect;

		private bool multiSelect;

		private readonly List<Pair<Page, RectangleF>> selectedPages = new List<Pair<Page, RectangleF>>();

		private List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>> selectedBricks = new List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>>();

		private readonly List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>> previousSelectedBricks = new List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>>();

		private readonly IPagesPresenter presenter;

		[DefaultValue(1f)]
		public float Zoom { get; set; }

		public System.Drawing.Color SelectionColor
		{
			get
			{
				return selectionColorForBricks;
			}
			set
			{
				selectionColorForBricks = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanSelect
		{
			get
			{
				if (!canSelect && leftButtonDown && (Math.Abs(selectionRectangleCurrentPosition.X - selectionRectangleStartPosition.X) > 10 || Math.Abs(selectionRectangleCurrentPosition.Y - selectionRectangleStartPosition.Y) > 10))
				{
					canSelect = true;
				}
				return canSelect;
			}
			set
			{
				canSelect = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasSelection => selectedBricks.Count > 0;

		private Rectangle SelectionScreenRectangle => Rectangle.Round(RectFBase.FromPoints((PointF)selectionRectangleStartPosition, (PointF)selectionRectangleCurrentPosition));

		public event EventHandler InvalidatePage;

		public SelectionService(IPagesPresenter presenter)
		{
			this.presenter = presenter;
		}

		internal void CorrectStartPoint(double delta)
		{
			foreach (Pair<Page, RectangleF> selectedPage in selectedPages)
			{
				selectedPage.Second = new RectangleF(new PointF(selectedPage.Second.X, selectedPage.Second.Y + (float)delta), selectedPage.Second.Size);
			}
		}

		internal void SetStartPoint(System.Drawing.Point point)
		{
			selectionRectangleStartPosition = point;
		}

		public void ResetAll()
		{
			ResetSelectedBricks();
			ResetService();
			RaiseInvalidate();
		}

		public bool OnMouseDown(System.Drawing.Point cursorLocation, MouseButtons mouseButtons, Keys keys)
		{
			if (!keys.HasFlag(Keys.Shift) && !keys.HasFlag(Keys.Control))
			{
				ResetSelectedBricks();
				multiSelect = false;
			}
			else
			{
				multiSelect = true;
			}
			leftButtonDown = true;
			double scaleX = (presenter as Visual).GetScaleX();
			selectionRectangleStartPosition = (selectionRectangleCurrentPosition = new System.Drawing.Point((int)((double)cursorLocation.X * scaleX), (int)((float)cursorLocation.Y * (float)scaleX)));
			return false;
		}

		public bool OnMouseUp(System.Drawing.Point cursorLocation, MouseButtons mouseButtons, Keys keys)
		{
			previousSelectedBricks.Clear();
			previousSelectedBricks.AddRange(selectedBricks);
			ResetService();
			return false;
		}

		public bool OnMouseMove(System.Drawing.Point cursorLocation, MouseButtons mouseButtons, Keys keys)
		{
			double scaleX = (presenter as Visual).GetScaleX();
			selectionRectangleCurrentPosition = new System.Drawing.Point((int)((double)cursorLocation.X * scaleX), (int)((float)cursorLocation.Y * (float)scaleX));
			if (leftButtonDown && CanSelect)
			{
				UpdateSelectedBricks();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedBricks()
		{
			IEnumerable<Pair<Page, RectangleF>> enumerable = FindPages(SelectionScreenRectangle);
			if (!enumerable.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerableExtensions.ForEach<Pair<Page, RectangleF>>(enumerable, (Action<Pair<Page, RectangleF>>)delegate(Pair<Page, RectangleF> x)
			{
				Pair<Page, RectangleF> val = selectedPages.FirstOrDefault((Pair<Page, RectangleF> page) => page.First.Index == x.First.Index);
				if (val != null)
				{
					selectedPages.Remove(val);
				}
				selectedPages.Add(x);
			});
			List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>> source = selectedBricks;
			List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>> newSelectedBricks = FindBricks(selectedPages);
			if (multiSelect)
			{
				List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>> collection = previousSelectedBricks.Where((Tuple<Brick, RectangleF> c) => !newSelectedBricks.Any((Tuple<Brick, RectangleF> any) => any.Item1 == c.Item1)).ToList();
				List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>> list = newSelectedBricks.Where((Tuple<Brick, RectangleF> c) => previousSelectedBricks.Any((Tuple<Brick, RectangleF> any) => any.Item1 == c.Item1)).ToList();
				list.AddRange(source.Where((Tuple<Brick, RectangleF> c) => !newSelectedBricks.Any((Tuple<Brick, RectangleF> any) => any.Item1 == c.Item1) && !previousSelectedBricks.Any((Tuple<Brick, RectangleF> any) => any.Item1 == c.Item1)));
				foreach (Tuple<Brick, RectangleF> item in list)
				{
					newSelectedBricks.Remove(item);
				}
				newSelectedBricks.AddRange(collection);
			}
			selectedBricks = newSelectedBricks;
			RaiseInvalidate();
		}

		private void RaiseInvalidate()
		{
			this.InvalidatePage?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public IEnumerable<Pair<Page, RectangleF>> FindPages(Rectangle rect)
		{
			List<Pair<Page, RectangleF>> list = new List<Pair<Page, RectangleF>>();
			foreach (Pair<Page, RectangleF> page in presenter.GetPages())
			{
				if (page.Second.IntersectsWith(rect))
				{
					RectangleF rectangleF = CorrectWithDPI(page.Second);
					list.Add(new Pair<Page, RectangleF>(page.First, rectangleF));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private RectangleF CorrectWithDPI(RectangleF rect)
		{
			double scaleX = (presenter as Visual).GetScaleX();
			return new RectangleF((float)((double)rect.X * scaleX), (float)((double)rect.Y * scaleX), (float)((double)rect.Width * scaleX), (float)((double)rect.Height * scaleX));
		}

		private List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>> FindBricks(IEnumerable<Pair<Page, RectangleF>> pages)
		{
			List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>> list = new List<Tuple<Brick, RectangleF>>();
			if (!pages.Any())
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (Pair<Page, RectangleF> page in pages)
			{
				RectangleF rectangleF = PSUnitConverter.PixelToDoc(page.Second, Zoom);
				if (!rectangleF.IsEmpty)
				{
					Rectangle selectionScreenRectangle = SelectionScreenRectangle;
					RectangleF rectangleF2 = PSUnitConverter.PixelToDoc((RectangleF)selectionScreenRectangle, Zoom);
					list.AddRange(SelectedBrickIterator.GetSelectedBricks(page.First, rectangleF, rectangleF2));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void ResetSelectedBricks()
		{
			selectedPages.Clear();
			bool flag = selectedBricks.Any();
			selectedBricks.Clear();
			previousSelectedBricks.Clear();
			if (flag)
			{
				RaiseInvalidate();
			}
		}

		private void ResetService()
		{
			selectionRectangleStartPosition = System.Drawing.Point.Empty;
			multiSelect = false;
			CanSelect = false;
			leftButtonDown = false;
		}

		internal void OnDrawPage(Page page, Graphics gr, PointF position)
		{
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				return;
			}
			SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(selectionColorForBricks);
			try
			{
				List<Brick> bricks = selectedBricks.Select((Tuple<Brick, RectangleF> item) => item.Item1).ToList();
				BrickNavigator val = new BrickNavigator((BrickBase)(object)page, false, true)
				{
					BrickPosition = position,
					ClipRect = PageExtension.DeflateMinMargins(page, PageExtension.GetRect(page, position))
				};

				{
					if (bricks.Remove(brick))
					{
						gr.FillRectangle(brush, RectangleF.Intersect(brickRect, brickClipRect));
					}

				});

				}
			}
		}

				SafeClipboardWin.Instance.Clear();

			}
		}

		private void OnFilteredPagesChanged(ObservableCollection<int> oldPages, ObservableCollection<int> newPages)
		{
			oldPages.Do(delegate(ObservableCollection<int> x)
			{
				x.CollectionChanged -= OnFilteredPagesCollectionChanged;
			});
			ThumbnailsPresenter.Do(delegate(ThumbnailsPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.UpdatePagesInternal();
			});
			newPages.Do(delegate(ObservableCollection<int> x)
			{
				x.CollectionChanged += OnFilteredPagesCollectionChanged;
			});
		}

		private void OnFilteredPagesCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ThumbnailsPresenter.Do(delegate(ThumbnailsPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.UpdatePagesInternal();
			});
		}

		public ThumbnailsViewerControl()
		{
			DocumentViewerControl.SetActualViewer(this, this);
			UndoRedoManager = new UndoRedoManager(base.Dispatcher);
			ActualCommandProvider = new DocumentCommandProvider();
			ActualBehaviorProvider = new BehaviorProvider
			{
				ZoomMode = ZoomMode.ActualSize
			};
			ZoomFactor = ActualBehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor;
			ActualBehaviorProvider.ZoomChanged += ActualBehaviorProvider_ZoomChanged;
			HorizontalPageSpacing = 5.0;
			VerticalPageSpacing = 26.0;
		}

		private void ActualBehaviorProvider_ZoomChanged(object sender, ZoomChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ZoomFactor = e.ZoomFactor;
		}

		private void OnSelectedPageNumberChanged()
		{
			Document.Do(delegate(IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.SetCurrentPage(SelectedPageNumber - 1);
			});
			if (SelectedPageNumber >= 1)
			{
				DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.DocumentPresenterControl x)
				{
					int pageWrapperIndex = x.NavigationStrategy.PositionCalculator.GetPageWrapperIndex(SelectedPageNumber - 1);
					x.NavigationStrategy.ScrollIntoView(pageWrapperIndex, Rect.Empty, ScrollIntoViewMode.Edge);
				});
			}
		}

		void IDocumentViewerControl.AttachDocumentPresenterControl(DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.DocumentPresenterControl presenter)
		{
			if (DocumentPresenter != null)
			{
				DetachDocumentPresenterControl();
			}
			DocumentPresenter = presenter;
			AssignDocumentPresenterProperties();
		}

		protected virtual void AssignDocumentPresenterProperties()
		{
			DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.DocumentPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.Document = (DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.IDocument)Document;
				x.BehaviorProvider = ActualBehaviorProvider;
				x.HorizontalPageSpacing = HorizontalPageSpacing;
				x.VerticalPageSpacing = VerticalPageSpacing;
			});
		}

		protected virtual void DetachDocumentPresenterControl()
		{
			DocumentPresenter.Do(delegate(DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.DocumentPresenterControl x)
			{
				x.BehaviorProvider = null;
				x.Document = null;
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnSettingsChanged(ThumbnailsViewerSettings oldValue, ThumbnailsViewerSettings newValue)
		{
			oldValue.Do(delegate(ThumbnailsViewerSettings x)
			{
				x.InvalidateTextureCache -= OnInvalidateTextureCache;
			});
			newValue.Do(delegate(ThumbnailsViewerSettings x)
			{
				x.InvalidateTextureCache += OnInvalidateTextureCache;
			});
			oldValue.Do(delegate(ThumbnailsViewerSettings x)
			{
				x.Invalidate -= OnInvalidateThumbnails;
			});
			newValue.Do(delegate(ThumbnailsViewerSettings x)
			{
				x.Invalidate += OnInvalidateThumbnails;
			});
			Document = Settings?.Document;
			TextureCache = new TextureCache();
		}

		protected virtual ThumbnailsViewerSettings CreateDefaultThumbnailsViewerSettings()
		{
			return new ThumbnailsViewerSettings();
		}

		private void OnInvalidateThumbnails(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Settings == null)
			{
				Document = null;
				return;
			}
			Document = Settings?.Document;
			AssignDocumentPresenterProperties();
			ThumbnailsPresenter?.UpdateContent();
		}

		private void OnInvalidateTextureCache(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			TextureCache.Reset();
		}
	}
	public class ThumbnailsPresenterControl : DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.DocumentPresenterControl, ISupportInvalidateRenderingOnIdle
	{
		protected class ThumbnailsInputController : KeyboardAndMouseController
		{
			private ThumbnailsViewerControl Viewer => presenter.ActualDocumentViewer as ThumbnailsViewerControl;

			public ThumbnailsInputController(ThumbnailsPresenterControl documentPresenter)
				: base(documentPresenter)
			{
			}

			public override void ProcessMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
			{
			}

			public override void ProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
			{
				if (Viewer != null)
				{
					switch (e.Key)
					{
					case Key.Up:
						NavigateToPreviousPageWrapper();
						e.Handled = true;
						break;
					case Key.Down:
						NavigateToNextPageWrapper();
						e.Handled = true;
						break;
					case Key.Left:
						NavigateToPreviousPage();
						e.Handled = true;
						break;
					case Key.Right:
						NavigateToNextPage();
						e.Handled = true;
						break;
					case Key.Prior:
						presenter.NavigationStrategy.ProcessScroll(ScrollCommand.PageUp);
						e.Handled = true;
						break;
					case Key.Next:
						presenter.NavigationStrategy.ProcessScroll(ScrollCommand.PageDown);
						e.Handled = true;
						break;
					case Key.Home:
						presenter.NavigationStrategy.ProcessScroll(ScrollCommand.Home);
						e.Handled = true;
						break;
					case Key.End:
						presenter.NavigationStrategy.ProcessScroll(ScrollCommand.End);
						e.Handled = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			private void NavigateToNextPageWrapper()
			{
				int pageWrapperIndex = GetPageWrapperIndex();
				if (pageWrapperIndex != -1)
				{
					if (presenter.Pages.Count > pageWrapperIndex + 1)
					{
						PageWrapper pageWrapper = presenter.Pages[pageWrapperIndex];
						int num = pageWrapper.Pages.Count();
						Viewer.SelectedPageNumber += num;
					}
					else
					{
						NavigateToNextPage();
					}
				}
			}

			private void NavigateToPreviousPageWrapper()
			{
				int pageWrapperIndex = GetPageWrapperIndex();
				if (pageWrapperIndex != -1)
				{
					if (pageWrapperIndex > 0)
					{
						PageWrapper pageWrapper = presenter.Pages[pageWrapperIndex];
						int num = pageWrapper.Pages.Count();
						Viewer.SelectedPageNumber -= num;
					}
					else
					{
						NavigateToPreviousPage();
					}
				}
			}

			private void NavigateToNextPage()
			{
				if (Viewer.Document.Pages.Count() > Viewer.SelectedPageNumber)
				{
					Viewer.SelectedPageNumber++;
				}
			}

			private void NavigateToPreviousPage()
			{
				if (Viewer.SelectedPageNumber > 1)
				{
					Viewer.SelectedPageNumber--;
				}
			}

			private int GetPageWrapperIndex()
			{
				int num = Viewer.SelectedPageNumber - 1;
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return presenter.NavigationStrategy.PositionCalculator.GetPageWrapperIndex(num);
			}

			public override void ProcessMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				base.ProcessMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
				if (presenter.Pages == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(presenter);
				PositionCalculator positionCalculator = presenter.NavigationStrategy.PositionCalculator;
				double verticalOffset = position.Y + presenter.ScrollViewer.VerticalOffset;
				int pageIndex = positionCalculator.GetPageIndex(verticalOffset);
				int pageWrapperIndex = positionCalculator.GetPageWrapperIndex(pageIndex);
				double leftMargin = presenter.Pages[pageWrapperIndex].Pages.First().Margin.Left;
				int index = positionCalculator.GetPageIndex(verticalOffset, position.X + presenter.ScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset, (double _) => leftMargin);
				if (index != -1)
				{
					(presenter.ActualDocumentViewer as ThumbnailsViewerControl).Do(delegate(ThumbnailsViewerControl x)
					{
						x.SelectedPageNumber = index + 1;
					});
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal ThumbnailsViewerControl ThumbnailsViewer => base.ActualDocumentViewer as ThumbnailsViewerControl;

		public ThumbnailsPresenterControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.SetAndMeasure<ThumbnailsPresenterControl>(this);
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle, (Action)delegate
			{
				RenderContent();
			});
		}

		protected internal IEnumerable<RenderItem> GetDrawingContent()
		{
			return GetDrawingContent(base.ItemsPanel);
		}

		protected override KeyboardAndMouseController CreateKeyboardAndMouseController()
		{
			return new ThumbnailsInputController(this);
		}

		private IEnumerable<RenderItem> GetDrawingContent(DocumentViewerPanel panel)
		{
			List<RenderItem> list = new List<RenderItem>();
			if (panel == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement internalChild in panel.InternalChildren)
			{
				PageWrapper pageWrapper = (PageWrapper)base.ItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(internalChild);
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)internalChild, (UIElement)base.ItemsControl);
				foreach (IPage page in pageWrapper.Pages)
				{
					Rect pageRect = pageWrapper.GetPageRect(page);
					pageRect.Offset(relativeElementRect.Left, relativeElementRect.Top);
					if (IsVisibleChild(pageRect))
					{
						IDocumentPage documentPage = (IDocumentPage)page;
						list.Add(new RenderItem
						{
							Rectangle = pageRect,
							Page = documentPage,
							NeedInvalidate = documentPage.NeedInvalidateThumbnail,
							ForceInvalidate = documentPage.ForceInvalidateThumbnail,
							TextureType = TextureType.Thumbnail
						});
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		void ISupportInvalidateRenderingOnIdle.InvalidateRenderingOnIdle()
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle, (Action)delegate
			{
				if (FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree((FrameworkElement)this))
				{
					IEnumerable<RenderItem> drawingContent = GetDrawingContent();
					RenderItem renderItem = drawingContent.FirstOrDefault((RenderItem x) => x.NeedInvalidate);
					if (renderItem != null)
					{
						renderItem.Page.ForceInvalidateThumbnail = true;
						RenderContent();
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private bool IsVisibleChild(Rect rect)
		{
			return rect.IntersectsWith(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ItemsControl.ActualWidth, base.ItemsControl.ActualHeight));
		}

		internal DrawingBrush GenerateRenderMask(IEnumerable<RenderItem> drawingContent)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			foreach (RenderItem item in drawingContent)
			{
				Rect rectangle = item.Rectangle;
				rectangle = CalcPageRect(item, rectangle);
				Geometry value = new RectangleGeometry(rectangle);
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(value);
			}
			GeometryDrawing drawing = new GeometryDrawing
			{
				Geometry = geometryGroup,
				Brush = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Green,
				Pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen()
			};
			return new DrawingBrush(drawing)
			{
				AlignmentX = AlignmentX.Left,
				AlignmentY = AlignmentY.Top,
				Stretch = Stretch.None,
				ViewboxUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute
			};
		}

		private Rect CalcPageRect(RenderItem pair, Rect rect)
		{
			PageWrapper pageWrapper = base.Pages.FirstOrDefault((PageWrapper x) => x.Pages.Any((IPage p) => p.PageIndex == pair.Page.PageIndex));
			if (pageWrapper != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Control control = (System.Windows.Controls.Control)base.ItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(pageWrapper);
				double num = (control.Padding.Left + control.Padding.Right) / 2.0;
				double num2 = (control.Padding.Top + control.Padding.Bottom) / 2.0;
				rect.Inflate(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num2);
			}
			return rect;
		}

		protected override DocumentViewerRenderer CreateNativeRenderer()
		{
			return new ThumbnailsRenderer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnScrollViewerViewportChanged(object sender, ScrollChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnScrollViewerViewportChanged(sender, e);
			base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)RenderContent);
		}

		internal void UpdateContent()
		{
			RenderContent();
		}

		protected override void OnDocumentChanged(DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.IDocument oldValue, DevExpress.Xpf.DocumentViewer.IDocument newValue)
		{
			base.OnDocumentChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			(oldValue as IDocumentViewModel).Do(delegate(IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.Pages.CollectionChanged -= OnCollectionChanged;
			});
			(newValue as IDocumentViewModel).Do(delegate(IDocumentViewModel x)
			{
				x.Pages.CollectionChanged += OnCollectionChanged;
			});
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdatePages();
				base.ItemsPanel.Do(delegate(DocumentViewerPanel x)
				{
					x.UpdateLayout();
				});
			});
			base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
			{
				RenderContent();
			});
		}

		protected override ObservableCollection<PageWrapper> GeneratePageWrappers(IEnumerable<IPage> pages)
		{
			IEnumerable<IPage> filteredPages = GetFilteredPages();
			return base.GeneratePageWrappers(filteredPages);
		}

		protected override void UpdateBehaviorProviderProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateBehaviorProviderProperties();
			if (base.BehaviorProvider != null && !base.BehaviorProvider.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				base.Pages.ForEach(delegate(PageWrapper x)
				{
					x.Viewport = base.BehaviorProvider.Viewport;
				});
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<IPage> GetFilteredPages()
		{
			if (ThumbnailsViewer == null || ThumbnailsViewer.FilteredPageIndices == null || !ThumbnailsViewer.FilteredPageIndices.Any())
			{
				return base.Document.Pages;
			}
			return base.Document.Pages.Where((IPage x) => ThumbnailsViewer.FilteredPageIndices.Contains(x.PageIndex)).ToList();
		}

		internal void UpdatePagesInternal()
		{
			UpdatePages();
			RenderContent();
			base.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)RenderContent);
		}

		protected override PageWrapper CreatePageWrapper(IEnumerable<IPage> pages)
		{
			return new ThumbnailPageWrapper(pages);
		}

		protected override PageWrapper CreatePageWrapper(IPage page)
		{
			return new ThumbnailPageWrapper(page);
		}
	}

	public class ThumbnailPageControlItem : PageControlItem
	{

		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(ThumbnailPageControlItem);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<ThumbnailPageControlItem>();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			PageViewModel pageViewModel = base.DataContext as PageViewModel;
			if (base.DocumentViewer == null || pageViewModel == null)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			if (!base.IsVertical)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(pageViewModel.ThumbnailPageSize.Height * base.DocumentViewer.ZoomFactor, pageViewModel.ThumbnailPageSize.Width * base.DocumentViewer.ZoomFactor + base.DocumentViewer.VerticalPageSpacing);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(pageViewModel.ThumbnailPageSize.Width * base.DocumentViewer.ZoomFactor, pageViewModel.ThumbnailPageSize.Height * base.DocumentViewer.ZoomFactor + base.DocumentViewer.VerticalPageSpacing);
		}

	public class UserInputController : KeyboardAndMouseController
	{
		private readonly System.Windows.Point emptyPoint;

		private System.Windows.Point leftButtonDown;

		private DocumentPresenterControl DocumentPresenter => presenter as DocumentPresenterControl;

		private InteractionProvider InteractionProvider => DocumentPresenter.InteractionProvider;

		protected new DocumentNavigationStrategy NavigationStrategy => (DocumentNavigationStrategy)base.NavigationStrategy;

		private CursorModeType CursorMode => DocumentPresenter.CursorMode;

		private bool IsDoubleClicked { get; set; }

		public UserInputController(DocumentPresenterControl presenter)
			: base(presenter)
		{
		}

		public override void ProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DocumentPresenter.IsInEditing)
			{
				((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)DocumentPresenter.ActiveEditorOwner).ProcessKeyDown(e);
			}
			else if (!e.Handled)
			{
				ProcessKeyDownInternal(e);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessKeyDownInternal(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Up:
				base.CommandProvider.With((CommandProvider x) => x.ScrollCommand).Do(delegate(ICommand x)
				{
					x.Execute(ScrollCommand.LineUp);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Down:
				base.CommandProvider.With((CommandProvider x) => x.ScrollCommand).Do(delegate(ICommand x)
				{
					x.Execute(ScrollCommand.LineDown);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Left:
				base.CommandProvider.With((CommandProvider x) => x.ScrollCommand).Do(delegate(ICommand x)
				{
					x.Execute(ScrollCommand.LineLeft);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Right:
				base.CommandProvider.With((CommandProvider x) => x.ScrollCommand).Do(delegate(ICommand x)
				{
					x.Execute(ScrollCommand.LineRight);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Prior:
				base.CommandProvider.With((CommandProvider x) => x.ScrollCommand).Do(delegate(ICommand x)
				{
					x.Execute(ScrollCommand.PageUp);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Next:
				base.CommandProvider.With((CommandProvider x) => x.ScrollCommand).Do(delegate(ICommand x)
				{
					x.Execute(ScrollCommand.PageDown);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Home:
				base.CommandProvider.With((CommandProvider x) => x.ScrollCommand).Do(delegate(ICommand x)
				{
					x.Execute(ScrollCommand.Home);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.End:
				base.CommandProvider.With((CommandProvider x) => x.ScrollCommand).Do(delegate(ICommand x)
				{
					x.Execute(ScrollCommand.End);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Escape:
				DocumentPresenter.Document.ResetMarkedBricks();
				DocumentPresenter.InteractionProvider.ResetSelection(resetAll: true);
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.F:
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers() == ModifierKeys.Control)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
					CommandProvider commandProvider = base.CommandProvider;
					if (commandProvider != null)
					{
						CommandExtensions.TryExecute(commandProvider.ShowFindTextCommand, (object)true);
					}
				}
				break;
			case Key.Add:
			case Key.OemPlus:
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers() == ModifierKeys.Control)
				{
					base.CommandProvider?.ZoomInCommand.Execute(null);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Subtract:
			case Key.OemMinus:
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers() == ModifierKeys.Control)
				{
					base.CommandProvider?.ZoomOutCommand.Execute(null);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.NumPad0:
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers() == ModifierKeys.Control)
				{
					base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomMode = ZoomMode.PageLevel;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.NumPad1:
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers() == ModifierKeys.Control)
				{
					base.BehaviorProvider.ZoomMode = ZoomMode.FitToWidth;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(DocumentPresenter);
			if (HitTestHelper.IsHitTest((UIElement)DocumentPresenter, (UIElement)DocumentPresenter, e.GetPosition(DocumentPresenter)) || InteractionProvider.IsInEditing || DocumentPresenter.Document == null || CursorMode == CursorModeType.HandTool || CheckMarginHitTest(position))
			{
				return;
			}
			DocumentPresenter.Document.ResetMarkedBricks();
			if (e.ClickCount > 1)
			{
				ProcessMouseDoubleClick(e);
				return;
			}
			leftButtonDown = position;
			if (CursorMode == CursorModeType.SelectTool && !InteractionProvider.IsInEditing)
			{
				DocumentPresenter.InteractionProvider.InitializeSelection(position);
				DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.UpdateSelectionState();
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.ProcessMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (IsDoubleClicked)
			{
				IsDoubleClicked = false;
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(DocumentPresenter);
			if (!InteractionProvider.IsInSelecting && position == leftButtonDown)
			{
				ProcessMouseClick(e);
			}
			else if (CursorMode == CursorModeType.SelectTool && !InteractionProvider.IsInEditing)
			{
				DocumentPresenter.InteractionProvider.EndSelection(position);
				DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.UpdateSelectionState();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessMouseDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			IsDoubleClicked = true;
			ProcessMouseClick(e);
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessMouseClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			leftButtonDown = emptyPoint;
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(DocumentPresenter);
			if (CursorMode == CursorModeType.SelectTool && InteractionProvider.CanSelect)
			{
				DocumentPresenter.InteractionProvider.EndSelection(position);
				DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.UpdateSelectionState();
			}
			Pair<PageViewModel, Brick> pair = NavigationStrategy.GetPageModelBrickPair(position);
			if (pair == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Brick brick = pair.Second;
			if (brick == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(brick.Url))
			{
				DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.CurrentPageNumber = pair.First.PageIndex + 1;
			}
			EditingField val = brick.With((Brick x) => DocumentPresenter.Document.EditingFields.FirstOrDefault((EditingField ef) => (object)ef.Brick == x));
			if (DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.AllowDocumentEditing && val != null && !val.ReadOnly)
			{
				InteractionProvider.StartEdit(pair.First, val);
				return;
			}
			InteractionProvider.EndEdit();
			DocumentPreviewMouseEventArgs e2 = new DocumentPreviewMouseEventArgs(pair.First.PageIndex, pair.Second);
			if (IsDoubleClicked)
			{
				DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.RaiseDocumentPreiewMouseDoubleClick(e2);
			}
			else
			{
				DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.RaiseDocumentPreiewMouseClick(e2);
			}
			if (pair.First.IsValid)
			{
				(DocumentPresenter.Document as ReportDocumentViewModel).Do(delegate(ReportDocumentViewModel x)
				{
					x.HandleBrickEvent(IsDoubleClicked ? "BrickDoubleClick" : "BrickClick", pair.First.Page, brick);
				});
				Brick obj = brick;
				VisualBrick val2 = (VisualBrick)(object)((obj is VisualBrick) ? obj : null);
				if (val2 != null && val2.NavigationPair != null && val2.NavigationPair != BrickPagePair.Empty)
				{
					NavigationStrategy.ShowBrick(val2.NavigationPair);
				}
				else if (brick != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(brick.Url) && string.Compare(brick.Url, "empty", ignoreCase: true) != 0)
				{
					ProcessLaunchHelper.Start(brick.Url);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.ProcessMouseMove(e);
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(DocumentPresenter);
			if (!InteractionProvider.IsInSelecting)
			{
				Pair<PageViewModel, Brick> pageModelBrickPair = NavigationStrategy.GetPageModelBrickPair(position);
				if (pageModelBrickPair != null)
				{
					DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.RaiseDocumentPreiewMouseMove(new DocumentPreviewMouseEventArgs(pageModelBrickPair.First.PageIndex, pageModelBrickPair.Second));
				}
			}
			if (CursorMode == CursorModeType.SelectTool && InteractionProvider.CanSelect)
			{
				if (!InteractionProvider.IsInSelecting)
				{
					DocumentPresenter.InteractionProvider.StartSelection(position);
				}
				if (position != leftButtonDown)
				{
					DocumentPresenter.InteractionProvider.ContinueSelection(position);
				}
				DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.UpdateSelectionState();
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!InteractionProvider.IsInSelecting)
			{
				base.ProcessMouseWheel(e);
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessMouseRightButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.ProcessMouseRightButtonDown(e);
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(DocumentPresenter);
			if (!CheckMarginHitTest(position) && InteractionProvider.IsInSelecting)
			{
				InteractionProvider.EndSelection(e.GetPosition(presenter));
				InteractionProvider.ResetSelection();
				DocumentPresenter.ActualDocumentViewer.UpdateSelectionState();
			}
		}

		private bool CheckMarginHitTest(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			bool marginHitTested = false;
			if (presenter.Document is IDocumentViewModel { CanChangePageSettings: false })
			{
				return false;
			}
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(DocumentPresenter, null, delegate(HitTestResult result)
			{
				MarginThumb marginThumb = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<MarginThumb>(result.VisualHit, false, (DependencyObject)DocumentPresenter.ScrollViewer);
				if (marginThumb != null)
				{
					marginHitTested = true;
					return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
				}
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
			}, new PointHitTestParameters(point));
			return marginHitTested;
		}
	}

	public class BrickPagePairToDisplayTextConverter : MarkupExtension, IMultiValueConverter
	{
		private const int CharsCount = 80;

		private const int CharCountBeforeMarchedText = 20;

		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (values.Any((object x) => x == null || x == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue))
			{
				return null;
			}
			PageList val = (PageList)values[0];
			BrickPagePair val2 = (BrickPagePair)values[1];
			bool flag = (bool)values[2];
			string text = (string)values[3];
			Brick brick = BrickPagePairHelper.GetBrick(val2, (IPageRepository)(object)val);
			VisualBrick val3 = (VisualBrick)(object)((brick is VisualBrick) ? brick : null);
			string text2 = null;
			if (val3 != null)
			{
				string text3 = val3.Text;
				int num = val3.Text.IndexOf(text, flag ? StringComparison.Ordinal : StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
				if (num > 20)
				{
					int num2 = num;
					for (int num3 = 0; num3 < 20; num3++)
					{
						if (char.IsWhiteSpace(text3[num - num3]))
						{
							num2 = num - num3;
						}
					}
					num = ((num2 == num) ? (num - 20) : (num2 + 1));
					text2 = "..." + text3.Substring(num, Math.Min(77, text3.Length - num));
				}
				else
				{
					text2 = text3.Substring(0, Math.Min(80, text3.Length));
				}
			}
			if (text2 != null)
			{
				List<Inline> list = new List<Inline>();
				string[] array = Regex.Split(text2, text, RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
				Match match = Regex.Match(text2, text, RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
				for (int num4 = 0; num4 < array.Length; num4++)
				{
					list.Add(new Run(array[num4]));
					if (num4 < array.Length - 1)
					{
						list.Add(new Run(match.Value)
						{
							FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold
						});
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
			return null;
		}

		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

	public interface INativeRendererImpl : IDisposable
	{
		bool RenderToGraphics(Graphics graphics, RenderedContent renderedContent, double zoomFactor, double scaleX, double angle);
	}
	public abstract class RendererImplementationBase : INativeRendererImpl, IDisposable
	{
		private System.Drawing.Pen markPen;

		private System.Drawing.Pen MarkPen
		{
			get
			{
				if (markPen == null)
				{
					markPen = CreateMarkPen();
				}
				return markPen;
			}
		}

		public abstract bool RenderToGraphics(Graphics graphics, RenderedContent renderedContent, double zoomFactor, double scaleX, double angle);

		protected void DrawBookmarks(Page page, Graphics gr, PointF position)
		{
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PrintingSystemBase printingSystem = page.Document.PrintingSystem;
			if (page.PageSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<Brick> markedBricks = new List<Brick>(printingSystem.GetMarkedBricks(page));
			new BrickNavigator((BrickBase)(object)page, false, true)
			{
				BrickPosition = position
			}.IterateBricks((Func<Brick, RectangleF, RectangleF, bool>)delegate(Brick brick, RectangleF brickRect, RectangleF brickClipRect)
			{
				if (markedBricks.Remove(brick))
				{
					DrawBookmark(gr, brickRect);
				}
				return markedBricks.Count == 0;
			});
		}

		private static System.Drawing.Pen CreateMarkPen()
		{
			using Bitmap bitmap = ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateBitmapFromResources("Images.MarkBrush.bmp", typeof(ResFinder));
			bitmap.MakeTransparent(DXColor.Magenta);
			using System.Drawing.Brush brush = new TextureBrush(bitmap);
			return new System.Drawing.Pen(brush, Math.Max(bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height));
		}

		private void DrawBookmark(Graphics gr, RectangleF rect)
		{
			float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.PixelToDoc(3f);
			rect = RectangleF.Inflate(rect, num, num);
			gr.DrawRectangle(MarkPen, Rectangle.Round(rect));
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			MarkPen.Dispose();
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
		}

		public virtual void InvalidateCaches()
		{
		}
	}
	public class DirectRendererImplementation : RendererImplementationBase
	{
		private readonly Lazy<GdiPlusImageRenderHook> gdiPlusImageRenderHookLazy;

		public DirectRendererImplementation()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public DirectRendererImplementation(Func<GdiPlusImageRenderHook> gdiPlusImageRenderHookAccessor)
		{
			if (gdiPlusImageRenderHookAccessor != null)
			{
				gdiPlusImageRenderHookLazy = new Lazy<GdiPlusImageRenderHook>(gdiPlusImageRenderHookAccessor, isThreadSafe: false);
			}
		}

		private Bitmap GetPageBitmap(RenderItem renderItem, SelectionService selection, double zoomFactor, bool drawAdditionalBricks)
		{
			try
			{
				Bitmap bitmap = CreateBitmap(renderItem);
				Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
				graphics.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
				graphics.SmoothingMode = ((zoomFactor < 1.0) ? SmoothingMode.HighQuality : SmoothingMode.Default);
				graphics.ScaleTransform((float)zoomFactor, (float)zoomFactor);
				gdiPlusImageRenderHookLazy.With((Lazy<GdiPlusImageRenderHook> x) => x.Value).Do(delegate(GdiPlusImageRenderHook x)
				{
					x.BeforeRender(graphics);
				});
				renderItem.Page.Page.DrawPage(graphics, new PointF(0f, 0f));
				if (drawAdditionalBricks)
				{
					selection.Do(delegate(SelectionService x)
					{
						x.OnDrawPage(renderItem.Page.Page, graphics, new PointF(0f, 0f));
					});
					DrawBookmarks(renderItem.Page.Page, graphics, new PointF(0f, 0f));
				}
				return bitmap;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static Bitmap CreateBitmap(RenderItem item)
		{
			Page page = item.Page.Page;
			System.Drawing.Size size = new System.Drawing.Size((int)item.Rectangle.Width, (int)item.Rectangle.Height);
			return new Bitmap(size.Width, size.Height);
		}

		public override bool RenderToGraphics(Graphics graphics, RenderedContent renderedContent, double zoomFactor, double scaleX, double angle)
		{
			graphics.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
			foreach (RenderItem renderedPage in renderedContent.RenderedPages)
			{
				IDocumentPage page = renderedPage.Page;
				double num = scaleX / ScreenHelper.ScaleX;
				Rect rectangle = renderedPage.Rectangle;
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(rectangle.Location.X, rectangle.Location.Y);
				PointF pointF = new PointF((float)(point.X / zoomFactor), (float)(point.Y / zoomFactor));
				graphics.ResetTransform();
				graphics.SmoothingMode = ((zoomFactor < 1.0) ? SmoothingMode.HighQuality : SmoothingMode.Default);
				gdiPlusImageRenderHookLazy.With((Lazy<GdiPlusImageRenderHook> x) => x.Value).Do(delegate(GdiPlusImageRenderHook x)
				{
					x.BeforeRender(graphics);
				});
				graphics.ScaleTransform((float)(zoomFactor * num), (float)(zoomFactor * num));
				gdiPlusImageRenderHookLazy.With((Lazy<GdiPlusImageRenderHook> x) => x.Value).Do(delegate(GdiPlusImageRenderHook x)
				{
					x.BeforeRender(graphics);
				});
				if (((PageViewModel)page).IsValid)
				{
					Page psPage = page.Page;
					psPage.DrawPage(graphics, pointF);
					RectangleF rectF = GraphicsUnitConverter.DipToDoc(new RectangleF(pointF, default(SizeF)));
					renderedContent.SelectionService.Do(delegate(SelectionService x)
					{
						x.OnDrawPage(psPage, graphics, rectF.Location);
					});
					DrawBookmarks(psPage, graphics, rectF.Location);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class TextureCacheRenderImplementation : RendererImplementationBase
	{
		private readonly Lazy<GdiPlusImageRenderHook> gdiPlusImageRenderHookLazy;

		private readonly TextureCache textureCache;

		private readonly bool isThumbnailRenderer;

		public TextureCacheRenderImplementation(TextureCache cache, bool isThumbnailRenderer = false, Func<GdiPlusImageRenderHook> gdiPlusImageRenderHookAccessor = null)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)cache, "cache");
			textureCache = cache;
			this.isThumbnailRenderer = isThumbnailRenderer;
			if (gdiPlusImageRenderHookAccessor != null)
			{
				gdiPlusImageRenderHookLazy = new Lazy<GdiPlusImageRenderHook>(gdiPlusImageRenderHookAccessor, isThreadSafe: false);
			}
		}

		private TextureContent GetRenderedPage(RenderItem item, double zoomFactor, double scaleX)
		{
			TextureKey key = new TextureKey(item.TextureType, item.Page.PageIndex);
			TextureContent textureContent = textureCache.Get(key);
			if (item.ForceInvalidate)
			{
				textureContent = CreateRenderedPage(item, zoomFactor, scaleX);
				textureCache.Add(key, textureContent);
				item.ForceInvalidate = false;
			}
			return textureContent ?? new NotRenderedContent(0.0, zoomFactor);
		}

		private TextureContent CreateRenderedPage(RenderItem item, double zoomFactor, double scaleX)
		{
			return new TextureContent(zoomFactor, 0.0, item.Page.Page.IsRestored(), GetPageBitmap(item, zoomFactor, scaleX));
		}

		private Bitmap GetPageBitmap(RenderItem renderItem, double zoomFactor, double scaleX)
		{
			try
			{
				Bitmap bitmap = CreateBitmap(renderItem, scaleX);
				Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
				graphics.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
				graphics.SmoothingMode = ((zoomFactor < 1.0) ? SmoothingMode.HighQuality : SmoothingMode.Default);
				graphics.ScaleTransform((float)zoomFactor, (float)zoomFactor);
				gdiPlusImageRenderHookLazy.With((Lazy<GdiPlusImageRenderHook> x) => x.Value).Do(delegate(GdiPlusImageRenderHook x)
				{
					x.BeforeRender(graphics);
				});
				graphics.FillRectangle(new SolidBrush(System.Drawing.Color.Red), new Rectangle(new System.Drawing.Point(0, 0), bitmap.Size));
				renderItem.Page.Page.DrawPage(graphics, new PointF(0f, 0f));
				return bitmap;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static Bitmap CreateBitmap(RenderItem item, double scaleX)
		{
			Page page = item.Page.Page;
			System.Drawing.Size size = new System.Drawing.Size((int)(item.Rectangle.Width * scaleX), (int)(item.Rectangle.Height * scaleX));
			return new Bitmap(size.Width, size.Height);
		}

		public override bool RenderToGraphics(Graphics graphics, RenderedContent renderedContent, double zoomFactor, double scaleX, double angle)
		{
			bool result = false;
			graphics.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
			foreach (RenderItem renderItem in renderedContent.RenderedPages)
			{
				IDocumentPage page = renderItem.Page;
				double num = zoomFactor * GetScaleMultiplier(page);
				Rect rectangle = renderItem.Rectangle;
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(rectangle.Location.X * scaleX, rectangle.Location.Y * scaleX);
				PointF locationF = new PointF((float)(point.X / num), (float)(point.Y / num));
				graphics.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.Default;
				graphics.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
				if (!((PageViewModel)renderItem.Page).IsValid)
				{
					bool flag = (renderItem.NeedInvalidate = true);
					result = flag;
					continue;
				}
				renderItem.ForceInvalidate = renderItem.ForceInvalidate || !page.Page.IsRestored();
				TextureContent renderedPage = GetRenderedPage(renderItem, num, scaleX);
				if (!page.Page.IsRestored())
				{
					renderItem.NeedInvalidate = true;
				}
				else
				{
					renderItem.NeedInvalidate = !renderedPage.Match(num, angle, page.Page.IsRestored());
				}
				if (renderedPage.Texture != null)
				{
					if (renderItem.NeedInvalidate)
					{
						result = true;
						if (num == renderedPage.ZoomFactor)
						{
							graphics.DrawImageUnscaled(renderedPage.Texture, (int)point.X, (int)point.Y);
						}
						else
						{
							graphics.DrawImage(renderedPage.Texture, (float)point.X, (float)point.Y, (float)(rectangle.Width * scaleX), (float)(rectangle.Height * scaleX));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						graphics.DrawImageUnscaled(renderedPage.Texture, (int)point.X, (int)point.Y);
					}
					if (!renderItem.NeedInvalidate && renderItem.TextureType == TextureType.Content)
					{
						GraphicsUnit pageUnit = graphics.PageUnit;
						graphics.PageUnit = GraphicsUnit.Document;
						graphics.ScaleTransform((float)zoomFactor, (float)zoomFactor);
						renderedContent.SelectionService.Do(delegate(SelectionService x)
						{
							x.OnDrawPage(renderItem.Page.Page, graphics, GraphicsUnitConverter.PixelToDoc(locationF));
						});
						DrawBookmarks(page.Page, graphics, locationF);
						graphics.ResetTransform();
						graphics.PageUnit = pageUnit;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetScaleMultiplier(IDocumentPage page)
		{
			if (!isThumbnailRenderer)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return page.ScaleMultiplier;
		}
	}
	public enum TextureType
	{
		Content,
		Thumbnail
	}
	public sealed class TextureKey
	{
		public TextureType Type { get; private set; }

		public IComparable Descriptor { get; private set; }

		private bool Equals(TextureKey other)
		{
			if (Type == other.Type)
			{
				return Descriptor.Equals(other.Descriptor);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj is TextureKey)
			{
				return Equals((TextureKey)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ((int)Type * 397) ^ Descriptor.GetHashCode();
		}

		public TextureKey(TextureType type, IComparable descriptor)
		{
			Descriptor = descriptor;
			Type = type;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Concat(Type, "@", Descriptor);
		}
	}
	public class TextureContent
	{
		public double Angle { get; private set; }

		public bool Restored { get; private set; }

		public double ZoomFactor { get; private set; }

		public Bitmap Texture { get; private set; }

		public TextureContent(double zoomFactor, double angle, bool restored, Bitmap texture)
		{
			Angle = angle;
			ZoomFactor = zoomFactor;
			Texture = texture;
			Restored = restored;
		}

		public virtual bool Match(double zoomFactor, double angle, bool restored)
		{
			if (DoubleExtensions.AreClose(ZoomFactor, zoomFactor) && DoubleExtensions.AreClose(Angle, angle))
			{
				return Restored == restored;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		}
