	public class TextureCache : IDisposable
	{
		private ConditionalWeakTable<TextureKey, TextureContent> cache = new ConditionalWeakTable<TextureKey, TextureContent>();

		private readonly Dictionary<TextureKey, TextureKey> keysCache = new Dictionary<TextureKey, TextureKey>();

		public void Add(TextureKey key, TextureContent content)
		{
			TextureKey valueOrDefault = keysCache.GetValueOrDefault(key, key);
			keysCache[valueOrDefault] = valueOrDefault;
			cache.Remove(valueOrDefault);
			cache.Add(valueOrDefault, content);
		}

		public void Remove(TextureKey key)
		{
			keysCache.Remove(key);
		}

		public TextureContent Get(TextureKey key)
		{
			TextureKey valueOrDefault = keysCache.GetValueOrDefault(key, null);
			if (valueOrDefault == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (cache.TryGetValue(valueOrDefault, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			keysCache.Remove(key);
			return null;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Reset();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			keysCache.Clear();
		}
	}

		{
			return RenderedContent.Return((Bitmap x) => x.Width * x.Height * 32 / 8, () => 0);
		}

		protected bool Equals(RenderedPage other)
		{
			return PageIndex == other.PageIndex;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj.GetType() != GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((RenderedPage)obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return PageIndex;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			RenderedContent.Do(delegate(Bitmap x)
			{
				x.Dispose();
			});
			RenderedContent = null;
		}

		public DocumentPreviewRenderer(DocumentPresenterControl presenter)

		public void UpdateInnerRenderer()
		{
			INativeRendererImpl nativeRendererImpl2;
			if (Presenter.ActualDocumentViewer.Return((DocumentPreviewControl x) => x.AllowCachePages, () => true))
			{
				INativeRendererImpl nativeRendererImpl = new TextureCacheRenderImplementation(Presenter.ActualDocumentViewer.Return((DocumentPreviewControl x) => x.Cache, () => new TextureCache()), isThumbnailRenderer: false, GetGdiPlusImageRenderHook);
				nativeRendererImpl2 = nativeRendererImpl;
			}
			else
			{
				INativeRendererImpl nativeRendererImpl = new DirectRendererImplementation(GetGdiPlusImageRenderHook);
				nativeRendererImpl2 = nativeRendererImpl;
			}
			nativeRenderer = nativeRendererImpl2;
		}

		public sealed override bool RenderToGraphics(Graphics graphics, INativeImageRenderer renderer, Rect invalidateRect, System.Windows.Size totalSize)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IDocumentViewModel model = Presenter.Document;
			if (locker.IsLocked || Presenter.BehaviorProvider == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (model.Return((IDocumentViewModel x) => !x.Pages.Any(), () => true))
			{
				SetRenderMask(new DrawingBrush(new GeometryDrawing()));
				return true;
			}
			RenderedContent renderedContent = new RenderedContent
			{
				RenderedPages = Presenter.GetDrawingContent(),
				SelectionService = Presenter.SelectionService
			};
			SetRenderMask(Presenter.GenerateRenderMask(renderedContent.RenderedPages));
			ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<IEditBrickServiceBase>((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)model.PrintingSystem, (IEditBrickServiceBase)(object)Presenter.EditingStrategy, false);

				ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<IBrickPaintService>((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)model.PrintingSystem, x, false);
			});

			flag = true;

			if (!renderedContent.RenderedPages.All((RenderItem x) => x.Page.Page.Document.PrintingSystem == actualPS))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool needToRefresh = false;
			locker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				((IDocument)actualPS).BeforeDrawPages((object)this);
				try
				{
					needToRefresh = nativeRenderer.RenderToGraphics(graphics, renderedContent, Presenter.BehaviorProvider.ZoomFactor, scaleX, Presenter.BehaviorProvider.RotateAngle);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDocument)actualPS).AfterDrawPages((object)this, renderedContent.RenderedPages.Select((RenderItem x) => x.Page.PageIndex).ToArray());
				}
				foreach (RenderItem renderedPage in renderedContent.RenderedPages)
				{
					renderedPage.Page.NeedInvalidate = renderedPage.NeedInvalidate;
					renderedPage.Page.ForceInvalidate = renderedPage.ForceInvalidate;
				}
				if (needToRefresh)

				}
				model.GetPaintService().Do<IBrickPaintService>(delegate
				{
					ServiceContainerExtensions.RemoveService<IBrickPaintService>((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)model.PrintingSystem);
				});
				ServiceContainerExtensions.RemoveService<IEditBrickServiceBase>((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)model.PrintingSystem);
			});
			return flag;
		}

		private GdiPlusImageRenderHook GetGdiPlusImageRenderHook()
		{
			return Presenter.With((DocumentPresenterControl x) => x.Document as DocumentViewModel).With((DocumentViewModel x) => ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<GdiPlusImageRenderHook>((IServiceProvider)x.PrintingSystem));
		}

			bool flag = false;
			if (Presenter.BehaviorProvider == null)
			{
				return false;
			}

		protected void UpdateProgressState()
		{
			ProgressType = (IsProgressMarquee() ? ProgressType.Marquee : ProgressType.Default);
			ProgressMaximum = PrintingSystem.Return((PrintingSystemBase x) => x.ProgressReflector.Maximum, () => 100);
			ProgressPosition = PrintingSystem.Return((PrintingSystemBase x) => x.ProgressReflector.PositionCore, () => 0);
			RaiseProgressChanged();
		}

		protected void UpdateProgressState(PrinterSettings printerSettings, int pageIndex)
		{
			ProgressType = ProgressType.Default;
			if (printerSettings == null)
			{
				ProgressMaximum = 0;
				ProgressPosition = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				ProgressMaximum = printerSettings.ToPage - printerSettings.FromPage + 1;
				ProgressPosition = pageIndex - printerSettings.FromPage;
			}
			RaiseProgressChanged();
		}

		private bool IsProgressMarquee()
		{
			if (!IsInteracting)
			{
				return PrintingSystem.Return((PrintingSystemBase x) => x.ProgressReflector.Ranges.Count != 0 && float.IsNaN(x.ProgressReflector.Ranges[0]), () => false);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string GetProgressDisplayText()
		{
			if (IsCreating)
			{
				return PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)115);
			}
			if (IsExporting)
			{
				return PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)117);
			}
			if (IsPrinting)
			{
				return PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)116);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public virtual void Load(object source)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DocumentStatus = DocumentStatus.None;
			this.source = source;
			if (source is ILink)
			{
				link = (ILink)source;
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					link = LoadDocument(source);
				}
				catch (Exception e)
				{
					RaiseDocumentException(e);
					return;
				}
			}
			PrintingSystem = link.Return<ILink, PrintingSystemBase>((ILink x) => (PrintingSystemBase)x.PrintingSystem, () => (PrintingSystemBase)null);
			Initialize();
			RaisePropertiesChanged(() => HasBookmarks, () => CanChangePageSettings);
		}

		protected virtual ILink LoadDocument(object source)
		{
			SimpleLink simpleLink = new SimpleLink();
			if (source is Stream)
			{
				((PrintingSystemBase)simpleLink.PrintingSystem).LoadDocument((Stream)source);
				return (ILink)(object)simpleLink;
			}
			if (source is string)
			{
				((PrintingSystemBase)simpleLink.PrintingSystem).LoadDocument((string)source);
				return (ILink)(object)simpleLink;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.DocumentSourceNotSupported));
		}

		protected void Initialize()
		{
			PrintingSystem.Do<PrintingSystemBase>(delegate

			});
			RaisePropertyChanged("EditingFields");
		}

		protected internal virtual void Subscribe()
		{
			Unsubscribe();
			PrintingSystem.Do(delegate(PrintingSystemBase ps)
			{
				//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004c: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0075: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0087: Expected O, but got Unknown
				ps.BeforeBuildPages += OnBeforeBuildPages;
				ps.DocumentChanged += OnDocumentChanged;
				ps.AfterBuildPages += OnAfterBuildPages;
				ps.CreateDocumentException += new ExceptionEventHandler(OnCreateDocumentException);
				ps.ProgressReflector.PositionChanged += OnProgressChanged;
				ps.StartPrint += new PrintDocumentEventHandler(OnStartPrint);
				ps.PrintProgress += new PrintProgressEventHandler(OnPrintProgress);
				ps.EndPrint += OnEndPrint;
				ResolveNewPages();
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual void Unsubscribe()
		{
			PrintingSystem.Do(delegate(PrintingSystemBase ps)
			{
				//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0062: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0074: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0099: Expected O, but got Unknown
				ps.BeforeBuildPages -= OnBeforeBuildPages;
				ps.DocumentChanged -= OnDocumentChanged;
				ps.AfterBuildPages -= OnAfterBuildPages;
				ps.ProgressReflector.PositionChanged -= OnProgressChanged;
				ps.StartPrint -= new PrintDocumentEventHandler(OnStartPrint);
				ps.PrintProgress -= new PrintProgressEventHandler(OnPrintProgress);
				ps.EndPrint -= OnEndPrint;
				ps.CreateDocumentException -= new ExceptionEventHandler(OnCreateDocumentException);
			});
		}

		}

		private FrameworkElement VisualizePage(int pageIndex)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BrickPageVisualizer brickPageVisualizer = new BrickPageVisualizer(TextMeasurementSystem.GdiPlus);
			PSPage val = (PSPage)PrintingSystem.Pages[pageIndex];
			((Page)val).PerformLayout((IPrintingSystemContext)new PrintingSystemContextWrapper((IPrintingSystemContext)(object)PrintingSystem, (Page)(object)val));
			return brickPageVisualizer.Visualize(val, pageIndex, PrintingSystem.Pages.Count);
		}

		protected void ResolveNewPages()
		{
			if (PrintingSystem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (locker.IsLocked)
			{
				locker.Unlocked += Locker_Unlocked;
				return;
			}
			if (IsCreating)
			{
				DocumentStatus = ((!((IEnumerable<Page>)PrintingSystem.Pages).Any()) ? DocumentStatus.DocumentCreation : DocumentStatus.None);
			}
			else if (IsCreated)
			{
				DocumentStatus = ((!((IEnumerable<Page>)PrintingSystem.Pages).Any()) ? DocumentStatus.NoPages : DocumentStatus.None);
			}
			locker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				Dispatcher.Invoke(ResolvePagesCore);
			});
		}

		private void ResolvePagesCore()
		{
			List<Page> psPages = ((IEnumerable<Page>)PrintingSystem.Pages).Where((Page x) => x.Owner != null).ToList();
			List<PageViewModel> list = Pages.Where((PageViewModel x) => x.PageIndex >= psPages.Count).ToList();
			list.Reverse();
			((ObservableRangeCollection<PageViewModel>)pages).RemoveRange((IEnumerable<PageViewModel>)list);
			bool forceInvalidate = ((Collection<PageViewModel>)(object)pages).Count != Document.PageCount;
			List<PageViewModel> list2 = new List<PageViewModel>();
			List<PageViewModel> list3 = new List<PageViewModel>();
			foreach (Page item in psPages)
			{
				PageViewModel pageViewModel = ((ObservableRangeCollection<PageViewModel>)pages)[item.Index];
				if (pageViewModel == null)
				{
					list2.Add(PageViewModel.Create(item));
					continue;
				}
				if (pageViewModel.PageList != PrintingSystem.Pages)
				{
					pageViewModel.PageList = PrintingSystem.Pages;
					pageViewModel.SyncPageInfo();
					list3.Add(pageViewModel);
					((IDocumentPage)pageViewModel).ForceInvalidateThumbnail = true;
					continue;
				}
				if (pageViewModel.ShouldUpdate)
				{
					pageViewModel.SyncPageInfo();
					list3.Add(pageViewModel);
				}
				((IDocumentPage)pageViewModel).SetForceInvalidate(forceInvalidate);
			}
			((ObservableRangeCollection<PageViewModel>)pages).RaiseUpdateItems((IList)list3);
			((ObservableRangeCollection<PageViewModel>)pages).AddRange((IEnumerable<PageViewModel>)list2);
		}

		private void Locker_Unlocked(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			locker.Unlocked -= Locker_Unlocked;
			ResolveNewPages();
		}

		protected virtual void OnBeforeBuildPages(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DocumentStatus = DocumentStatus.DocumentCreation;
			RaiseDocumentCreatingChanged();
			DoWithDispatcher(Pages.Clear);
			ICancellationService service = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<ICancellationService>((IServiceProvider)PrintingSystem);
			service.Do(delegate(ICancellationService x)
			{
				x.StateChanged += OnCancellationServiceStateChanged;
			});
			RaiseStartDocumentCreation();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDocumentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ResolveNewPages();
			RaiseDocumentCreatingChanged();
			RaiseDocumentChanged();
		}

		protected void DoWithDispatcher(Action action)
		{
			if (UseAsyncDocumentCreation)
			{
				Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(action);
			}
			else
			{
				Dispatcher.Invoke(action);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAfterBuildPages(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CreationRequested = false;
			DocumentStatus = ((!((IEnumerable<Page>)PrintingSystem.Pages).Any()) ? DocumentStatus.NoPages : DocumentStatus.None);
			bookmarks = null;
			UpdateProgressState();
			RaiseDocumentCreatingChanged();
			cancellationService = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<ICancellationService>((IServiceProvider)PrintingSystem);
			cancellationService.Do(delegate(ICancellationService x)
			{
				x.StateChanged -= OnCancellationServiceStateChanged;
			});
			RaisePropertyChanged("EditingFields");
			RaiseDocumentCreated();
			RaisePropertiesChanged(() => HasBookmarks, () => CanChangePageSettings);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCreateDocumentException(object sender, ExceptionEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!args.Handled)
			{
				args.Handled = true;
				RaiseDocumentException(args.Exception);
			}
		}

		protected void OnProgressChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			UpdateProgressState();
			if ((int)PrintingSystem.Document.State == 3)
			{
				TimeSpan timeout = new TimeSpan(100000L);
				Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.Invoke((ThreadStart)delegate
				{
				}, timeout, DispatcherPriority.Background);
			}
		}

		private void OnStartPrint(object sender, PrintDocumentEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateProgressState(e.PrintDocument.PrinterSettings, e.PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.FromPage);
		}

		private void OnPrintProgress(object sender, PrintProgressEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateProgressState(e.PageSettings.PrinterSettings, e.PageIndex);
		}

		private void OnEndPrint(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateProgressState(null, 0);
		}

		public IEnumerable<BookmarkNodeItem> GetBookmarks()
		{
			if (!IsCreated)
			{
				return bookmarks = null;
			}
			if (bookmarks != null)
			{
				return bookmarks;
			}
			List<BookmarkNodeItem> previewNodes = new List<BookmarkNodeItem>();
			int currentId = 0;
			previewNodes.Add(new BookmarkNodeItem(Document.RootBookmark, currentId, -1));
			Document.Do(delegate(Document x)
			{
				CollectBookmarks(x.BookmarkNodes, previewNodes, ref currentId);
			});
			return bookmarks = previewNodes;
		}

		private void CollectBookmarks(IBookmarkNodeCollection nodes, List<BookmarkNodeItem> previewNodes, ref int currentId)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int parentId = currentId;
			foreach (BookmarkNode item in (IEnumerable)nodes)
			{
				BookmarkNode val = item;
				currentId++;
				previewNodes.Add(new BookmarkNodeItem(val, currentId, parentId));
				CollectBookmarks(val.Nodes, previewNodes, ref currentId);
			}
		}

		public void MarkBrick(BookmarkNodeItem bookmark)
		{
			PrintingSystem.ClearMarkedBricks();
			BrickPagePair pair = bookmark.BookmarkNode.Pair;
			PrintingSystem.MarkBrick(BrickPagePairHelper.GetBrick(pair, (IPageRepository)(object)PrintingSystem.Pages), pair.GetPage((IPageRepository)(object)PrintingSystem.Pages));
		}

		public void ResetMarkedBricks()

			{
				x.ClearMarkedBricks();
			});
		}

		public virtual void CreateDocument()
		{
			if (source != null && PrintingSystem != null)
			{
				if (source == link)
				{
					CreationRequested = true;
					link.CreateDocument(true);
				}
				else if (source is Stream)
				{
					PrintingSystem.LoadDocument((Stream)source);
				}
				else if (source is string)
				{
					PrintingSystem.LoadDocument((string)source);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void Print(PrintOptionsViewModel model)
		{
			IsPrinting = true;
			if (this.IsLegacyLinkDocumentSource())
			{
				DoSyncOperation(delegate
				{
					publishEngine.Print(model);
				}, delegate
				{
					IsPrinting = false;
				});
			}
			else
			{
				DoAsyncOperation(() => publishEngine.PrintAsync(model), delegate
				{
					IsPrinting = false;
				});
			}
		}

		public virtual void PrintDirect(string printerName = null)
		{
			IsPrinting = true;
			if (this.IsLegacyLinkDocumentSource())
			{
				DoSyncOperation(delegate
				{
					publishEngine.PrintDirect(printerName);
				}, delegate
				{
					IsPrinting = false;
				});
			}
			else
			{
				DoAsyncOperation(() => publishEngine.PrintDirectAsync(printerName), delegate
				{
					IsPrinting = false;
				});
			}
		}

		public virtual void Send(SendOptionsViewModel options)
		{
			IsExporting = true;
			if (this.IsLegacyLinkDocumentSource())
			{
				DoSyncOperation(delegate
				{
					publishEngine.Send(options);
				}, delegate
				{
					IsExporting = false;
				});
			}
			else
			{
				DoAsyncOperation(() => publishEngine.SendAsync(options), delegate
				{
					IsExporting = false;
				});
			}
		}

		public virtual void Export(ExportOptionsViewModel options)
		{
			IsExporting = true;
			Action afterCompleted = delegate
			{
				IsExporting = false;
				PrintingSystem.ResetCancelPending();
			};
			if (this.IsLegacyLinkDocumentSource())
			{
				DoSyncOperation(delegate
				{
					publishEngine.Export(options);
				}, afterCompleted);
			}
			else
			{
				DoAsyncOperation(() => publishEngine.ExportAsync(options), afterCompleted);
			}
		}

		public void Scale(ScaleOptionsViewModel model)
		{
			if (model.ScaleMode == ScaleMode.AdjustToPercent)
			{
				PrintingSystem.Document.ScaleFactor = model.ScaleFactor;
			}
			else
			{
				PrintingSystem.Document.AutoFitToPagesWidth = model.PagesToFit;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			this.Disposing?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			for (int num = Pages.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				Pages.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			RaiseDocumentChanged();
		}

		private void DoSyncOperation(Action operation, Action afterCompleted)
		{
			try
			{
				operation();
			}
			catch (Exception e)
			{
				RaiseDocumentException(e);
			}
			finally
			{
				afterCompleted();
			}
		}

		private void DoAsyncOperation(Func<Task> operation, Action afterCompleted)
		{
			operation().ContinueWith(delegate(Task t)
			{
				DoWithDispatcher(delegate
				{
					if (t.Exception != null)
					{
						RaiseDocumentException(t.Exception.GetBaseException());
					}
					afterCompleted();
				});
			});
		}
	}

		internal IReport Report => (IReport)base.Link;

		protected sealed override bool IsInteracting
		{
			get
			{
				IInteractionService service = GetService<IInteractionService>();
				if (!(((service != null) ? new bool?(((IInteractionServiceBase)service).IsInteracting) : ((bool?)null)) ?? false))
				{
					IDrillDownServiceBase service2 = GetService<IDrillDownServiceBase>();
					return ((service2 != null) ? new bool?(((IInteractionServiceBase)service2).IsInteracting) : ((bool?)null)) ?? false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override void Load(object source)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.Load(source);
			Report.Tool = null;
			documentCreator = new DocumentCreator(Report, (Func<IEnumerable<Parameter>, bool, CancellationToken, bool>)OnApproveParameters);
			RaiseDocumentCreatingChanged();
			if (!IsRemoteDocumentSource)
			{
				RequestParameters();
			}
		}

		protected override void PreparePrintingSystem(PrintingSystemBase ps)
		{
			base.PreparePrintingSystem(ps);
			if (!(ps is RemotePrintingSystem) && !(ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<BackgroundPageBuildEngineStrategy>((IServiceProvider)ps) is DispatcherPageBuildStrategy))
			{
				ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<BackgroundPageBuildEngineStrategy>((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)ps, (BackgroundPageBuildEngineStrategy)(object)new DispatcherPageBuildStrategy(), false);
			}
			ReplacePageSettingsService((System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer)ps);
		}

		protected internal override void Subscribe()
		{
			base.Subscribe();
			Report.Do(delegate(IReport x)
			{

		private void CreateDocumentCore()
		{
			if (base.IsCreating)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsCachedReportSource || IsRemoteDocumentSource)
			{
				((ILink)Report).CreateDocument(true);
			}
			else if (UseAsyncDocumentCreation)
			{
				base.CreationRequested = true;
				documentCreator.CreateAsync(0f, CancellationToken.None).ContinueWith(delegate(Task task)
				{
					if (task.IsFaulted)
					{
						RaiseDocumentException(task.Exception.GetBaseException());
					}
					base.CreationRequested = false;
				});
			}
			else
			{
				base.CreationRequested = true;
				documentCreator.Create(0f, true);
				if (!(parametersApproved ?? false))
				{
					base.CreationRequested = false;
				}
			}
			RaiseDocumentCreatingChanged();
		}

		private void HandleSorting(string sortData)
		{

			if (service != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sortData))
			{

				{
					service.AppendSorting(sortData);
				}
				else if (Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Control)
				{
					service.RemoveSorting(sortData);
				}
				else
				{
					service.ApplySorting(sortData);
				}
				RefreshDocument(base.PrintingSystem.PageSettings.Data, delegate
				{
					((IInteractionServiceBase)service).IsInteracting = true;
				});
			}
		}

	public class BreadcrumbViewModel : BindableBase
	{
		private readonly DocumentViewModel documentViewModel;

		public ObservableCollection<BreadcrumbNode> NestedReports { get; set; } = new ObservableCollection<BreadcrumbNode>();

		public BreadcrumbNode SelectedNode
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => SelectedNode);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					documentViewModel.Load(value.Report);
					documentViewModel.CreateDocument();
					if (SelectedNode != null && value.ParentID != SelectedNode.ID)
					{
						int num = IListExtensions.FindIndex<BreadcrumbNode>((IList<BreadcrumbNode>)NestedReports, (Predicate<BreadcrumbNode>)((BreadcrumbNode n) => n == value));
						BreadcrumbNode[] array = NestedReports.Skip(num + 1).ToArray();
						BreadcrumbNode[] array2 = array;
						foreach (BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode in array2)
						{
							breadcrumbNode.Report.ReleasePrintingSystem();
							NestedReports.Remove(breadcrumbNode);
						}
						if (NestedReports.Count == 1)
						{
							NestedReports.Clear();
						}
					}
				}
				Visible = NestedReports.Any();
				SetProperty(() => SelectedNode, value);
			}
		}

		public string Path
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => Path);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(() => Path, value);
			}
		}

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => Visible);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(() => Visible, value);
			}
		}

		public BreadcrumbViewModel(DocumentViewModel documentViewModel)
		{
			this.documentViewModel = documentViewModel;
		}

		public BreadcrumbNode AddNode(string name, IReport report)
		{
			BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode = BreadcrumbNode.AddNew(name, report, NestedReports.LastOrDefault()?.ID ?? 0);
			NestedReports.Add(breadcrumbNode);
			return breadcrumbNode;
		}

		public void SetSelectedNode(BreadcrumbNode node)
		{
			SelectedNode = node;
			Path = string.Join("\\", NestedReports.Select((BreadcrumbNode r) => r.Name));
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbNode : BindableBase
	{
		private static int Counter { get; set; }

		public int ID { get; set; }

		public int ParentID { get; set; }

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => Name);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(() => Name, value);
			}
		}

		public IReport Report { get; private set; }

		public static BreadcrumbNode AddNew(string name, IReport report, int parentID)
		{
			BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode = new BreadcrumbNode
			{
				Name = name,
				Report = report,
				ParentID = parentID
			};
			Counter++;
			breadcrumbNode.ID = Counter;
			return breadcrumbNode;
		}
	}

		private Rect GetCaretRect()

			string text = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((CharacterCombTextElement)(ref val)).TextElement)) ? ((CharacterCombTextElement)(ref val)).TextElement : "W");
			SizeF size = Measurement.MeasureString(text, characterComb.CharacterCombInfo.Style.Font, 999999f, DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic(), DXGraphicsUnit.Document);

			rectangleF.Width = Math.Max(1f, rectangleF.Width);
			return DrawingConverter.ToRect(rectangleF);
		}

		public void Update()
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!base.IsLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			CharacterCombTextElement currentElement = CharacterCombTextElement.Empty;
			CharacterCombTextElement currentElement2 = CharacterCombTextElement.Empty;
			CharacterCombTextElement[,] characterCombTextElements = characterComb.CharacterCombTextElements;
			int upperBound = characterCombTextElements.GetUpperBound(0);
			int upperBound2 = characterCombTextElements.GetUpperBound(1);
			for (int i = characterCombTextElements.GetLowerBound(0); i <= upperBound; i++)
			{
				CharacterCombTextElement val;
				for (int j = characterCombTextElements.GetLowerBound(1); j <= upperBound2; j++)
				{
					val = characterCombTextElements[i, j];
					if (((CharacterCombTextElement)(ref val)).TextIndex < 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (((CharacterCombTextElement)(ref val)).TextIndex < characterComb.SelectionStart + characterComb.SelectionLength)
					{
						currentElement = val;
						continue;
					}
					goto IL_0083;
				}
				continue;
				IL_0083:
				currentElement2 = val;
				break;
			}
			if (!((CharacterCombTextElement)(ref currentElement2)).IsEmpty)
			{
				if (((CharacterCombTextElement)(ref currentElement2)).TextIndex > characterComb.SelectionStart + characterComb.SelectionLength)
				{
					CurrentElement = currentElement;
					PlaceAfterLetter = true;
				}

					CurrentElement = currentElement2;
					PlaceAfterLetter = false;
				}
			}
			else if (!((CharacterCombTextElement)(ref currentElement)).IsEmpty && characterComb.SelectionStart + characterComb.SelectionLength >= characterComb.Text.Length)
			{
				CurrentElement = currentElement;
				PlaceAfterLetter = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((CharacterCombTextElement)(ref currentElement)).TextElement);
			}
			else
			{

			}

			void INativeImageRenderer.Render(Graphics graphics, Rect invalidateRect, System.Windows.Size renderSize)

			void IPictureRenderer.AssignEditor(NativeImage editor)
			{

				{

			}

			private void OnMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0084: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0091: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (AllowDraw && currentCurve != null)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)editor).ReleaseMouseCapture();
					currentCurve.Do(delegate(Curve x)
					{
						curves.Add(x);
						currentCurve = null;
						editor.Invalidate();
					});
					DXImage dXImage = imageCreator.CreatePaintedImage((ImageSource)((EditableDataObject)this).Value, curves, new System.Drawing.Size((int)((UIElement)(object)editor).RenderSize.Width, (int)((UIElement)(object)editor).RenderSize.Height), (float)ZoomFactor);

			}

			private void OnMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				if (AllowDraw)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)editor).CaptureMouse();
					System.Drawing.Color color = System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(BrushColor.A, BrushColor.R, BrushColor.G, BrushColor.B);
					currentCurve = new Curve(color, (float)BrushSize);
					System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition((IInputElement)editor);
					PointF item = MathMethods.Scale(new PointF((float)position.X, (float)position.Y), 1.0 / zoomFactor);
					currentCurve.Points.Add(item);
					editor.Invalidate();
				}
			}

			private void OnMouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				if (AllowDraw && currentCurve != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition((IInputElement)editor);
					PointF pointF = MathMethods.Scale(new PointF((float)position.X, (float)position.Y), 1.0 / zoomFactor);
					currentCurve.Do(delegate(Curve x)
					{
						x.Points.Add(pointF);
						editor.Invalidate();
					});
				}
			}

			{

				curves.Clear();
				editor.Do(delegate(NativeImage x)
				{
					x.Invalidate();
				});
			}
		}

			bool IBaseEditWrapper.NeedsKey(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
			{
				Key key = e.Key;
				ModifierKeys keyboardModifiers = ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e);
				bool? flag = NeedsBasicKey(key, () => NeedsEnter());
				if (flag.HasValue)
				{
					return flag.Value;
				}
				switch (key)
				{
				case Key.Tab:
					return NeedsTab();
				case Key.Left:
				case Key.Right:
					return NeedsLeftRight();
				case Key.Up:
				case Key.Down:
					return NeedsUpDown();
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}

	public class PaintedImageCreator
	{
		private readonly System.Drawing.Color background;

		private readonly bool useImageResolution;

		public ImageSizeMode SizeMode { get; set; }

		public ImageAlignment Alignment { get; set; }

		public PaintedImageCreator(ImageSizeMode sizeMode, ImageAlignment alignment, System.Drawing.Color background, bool useImageResolution)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SizeMode = sizeMode;
			Alignment = alignment;
			this.background = background;
			this.useImageResolution = useImageResolution;
		}

		public DXImage CreatePaintedImage(ImageSource source, List<Curve> curves, System.Drawing.Size clientRectSize, float zoomFactor)
		{
			System.Drawing.Size size = MathMethods.Scale((SizeF)clientRectSize, 1f / zoomFactor).ToSize();
			if (ImageSource.IsNullOrEmpty(source) || source.IsSvgImage)
			{
				return CreatePaintedMetafile(size, source, curves);
			}
			if (source.Image is DXMetafile)
			{
				DXMetafile dXMetafile = new DXMetafile(size, DXMetafileFrameUnit.Pixel, DXEmfType.EmfPlusDual);
				using (IDXGraphics graphics = dXMetafile.CreateGraphics())
				{
					SizeF imageSize = MathMethods.Scale((SizeF)source.Image.Size, 96f / source.Image.HorizontalResolution);
					DrawImage(graphics, source, size, imageSize);
					DrawCurves(graphics, 96f, curves);
				}
				return DXImageHelper.PatchMetafileResolution(dXMetafile, (int)source.Image.HorizontalResolution);
			}
			float num = (useImageResolution ? GetEffectiveResolution(source.Image, size) : 96f);
			System.Drawing.Size size2 = System.Drawing.Size.Round(MathMethods.Scale((SizeF)size, num / 96f));
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(size2.Width, size2.Height);
			using (Stream stream = new MemoryStream())
			{
				dXBitmap.Save(stream, DXImageHelper.GetValidNewImageFormat(source.Image.ImageFormat));
				dXBitmap = (DXBitmap)DXImage.FromStream(stream);
			}
			dXBitmap.SetResolution(num, num);
			using IDXGraphics graphics2 = dXBitmap.CreateGraphics();
			if (dXBitmap.PixelFormat.Alpha == DXAlpha.No)
			{
				FillBackground(graphics2, size2, background);
			}
			SizeF imageSize2 = MathMethods.Scale((SizeF)source.Image.Size, num / source.Image.HorizontalResolution);
			DrawImage(graphics2, source, size, imageSize2);
			DrawCurves(graphics2, num, curves);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		private DXImage CreatePaintedMetafile(System.Drawing.Size clientSize, ImageSource actualImageSource, IEnumerable<Curve> curves)
		{
			DXMetafile dXMetafile = new DXMetafile(clientSize, DXMetafileFrameUnit.Pixel, DXEmfType.EmfPlusDual);
			using (IDXGraphics graphics = dXMetafile.CreateGraphics())
			{
				if (!ImageSource.IsNullOrEmpty(actualImageSource))
				{
					SizeF imageSize = actualImageSource.GetImageSize(useImageResolution);
					DrawImage(graphics, actualImageSource, clientSize, imageSize);
				}
				DrawCurves(graphics, 96f, curves);
			}
			return DXImageHelper.PatchMetafileResolution(dXMetafile, 96);
		}

		private DXImage CreatePaintedBitmap(SizeF clientSize, float resolution, ImageSource actualImageSource, IEnumerable<Curve> curves)
		{
			float num = (useImageResolution ? resolution : 96f);
			System.Drawing.Size size = System.Drawing.Size.Round(MathMethods.Scale(clientSize, num / 96f));
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(size.Width, size.Height);
			dXBitmap.SetResolution(num, num);
			using IDXGraphics graphics = dXBitmap.CreateGraphics();
			if (!ImageSource.IsNullOrEmpty(actualImageSource))
			{
				SizeF imageSize = MathMethods.Scale(actualImageSource.GetImageSize(useImageResolution), num / 96f);
				DrawImage(graphics, actualImageSource, clientSize, imageSize);
			}
			DrawCurves(graphics, num, curves);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public void DrawImage(IDXGraphics graphics, ImageSource source, SizeF clientSize, SizeF imageSize)

		private void DrawSvgImage(ImageSource imageSource, SizeF imageSize, RectangleF imageRect, IDXGraphics graphics, SizeF clientSize)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			object state = graphics.Save();

				{
					SvgImage svgImage = imageSource.SvgImage;
					float num = (float)svgImage.Width;
					float num2 = (float)svgImage.Height;
					SvgBitmap svgBitmap = new SvgBitmap(svgImage);
					graphics.TranslateTransform(imageRect.X, imageRect.Y);
					int num3 = (int)Math.Ceiling(imageRect.Width / num);
					int num4 = (int)Math.Ceiling(imageRect.Height / num2);
					for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
					{
						object state2 = graphics.Save();
						for (int j = 0; j < num4; j++)
						{
							svgBitmap.RenderToDXGraphics(graphics, null, 1.0, (DefaultBoolean)2);
							graphics.TranslateTransform(0f, num2);
						}
						graphics.Restore(state2);
						graphics.TranslateTransform(num, 0f);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					graphics.TranslateTransform(imageRect.X, imageRect.Y);
					graphics.ScaleTransform(imageRect.Width / imageSize.Width, imageRect.Height / imageSize.Height);
					SvgBitmap svgBitmap2 = new SvgBitmap(imageSource.SvgImage);
					svgBitmap2.RenderToDXGraphics(graphics, null, 1.0, (DefaultBoolean)2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.Restore(state);
			}
		}

		private static void FillBackground(IDXGraphics graphics, System.Drawing.Size size, System.Drawing.Color backColor)
		{
			System.Drawing.Color color = (DXColor.IsTransparentColor(backColor) ? DXColor.White : backColor);
			using DXSolidBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(color);
			graphics.FillRectangle(brush, new Rectangle(System.Drawing.Point.Empty, size));
		}

		private static DXImage GetTileImage(DXImage baseImage, System.Drawing.Size clientSize)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (baseImage == null)
			{
				return baseImage;
			}
			try
			{
				object obj = (object)new MultiKey(new object[2]
				{
					clientSize,
					DXImageHelper.GetHashCodeFromImageBytes(baseImage)
				});
				return DXImageHelper.CreateTileImage(baseImage, clientSize);
			}
			catch
			{
				return baseImage;
			}
		}

		private void DrawCurves(IDXGraphics graphics, float imageDpi, IEnumerable<Curve> curves)
		{
			graphics.SmoothingMode = DXSmoothingMode.HighQuality;
			graphics.PixelOffsetMode = DXPixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
			float imageDpiScaleFactor = imageDpi / 96f;
			foreach (Curve curf in curves)
			{
				PointF[] points = curf.Points.Select((PointF pt) => MathMethods.Scale(pt, imageDpiScaleFactor)).ToArray();
				float thickness = MathMethods.Scale(curf.Thickness, (double)imageDpiScaleFactor);
				DrawCurve(graphics, points, curf.Color, thickness);
			}
		}

		private float GetEffectiveResolution(DXImage image, SizeF clientSize)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			float num = Math.Min(Math.Max(image.HorizontalResolution, 96f), 300f);
			if ((int)SizeMode == 4 || (int)SizeMode == 5)
			{
				SizeF sizeF = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(image.Size, image.HorizontalResolution, 96f);
				float num2 = Math.Min(clientSize.Width / sizeF.Width, clientSize.Height / sizeF.Height);
				if (num2 < 1f)
				{
					num = Math.Min(600f, num / num2);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void DrawCurve(IDXGraphics graphics, PointF[] points, System.Drawing.Color color, float thickness)
		{
			if (points.Length == 1)
			{
				using (DXSolidBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(color))
				{
					RectangleF rect = new RectangleF(points[0].X - thickness / 2f, points[0].Y - thickness / 2f, thickness, thickness);
					graphics.FillEllipse(brush, rect);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!points.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			using DXPen pen = new DXPen(color, thickness)
			{
				StartCap = DXLineCap.Round,
				EndCap = DXLineCap.Round,
				LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Round
			};
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddLines(points);
			graphics.DrawPath(pen, dXGraphicsPath);
		}
	}

		{
			base.OnCommandChanged(oldCommand, newCommand);
			if (((BarItem)this).Command is PageLayoutCommandButton)
			{
				((BarItem)this).CommandParameter = ((PageLayoutCommandButton)((BarItem)this).Command).PageLayoutSettings;
				string value = TryGetName(((PageLayoutCommandButton)((BarItem)this).Command).PageLayoutSettings);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(DocumentViewerControl.BarItemNameProperty, (object)value);
				}
			}
		}

		private string TryGetName(PageLayoutSettings pageLayoutSettings)
		{
			switch (pageLayoutSettings.PageDisplayMode)
			{
			case PageDisplayMode.Single:
				return "bSinglePage";
			case PageDisplayMode.Columns:
				if (pageLayoutSettings.ColumnCount != 2)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return "bTwoPages";
			case PageDisplayMode.Wrap:
				return "bWrapPages";
			default:
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}
	}

	public static class BooleanValuesHelper
	{

		public static string FalseString => BooleanValues.Single((KeyValuePair<string, bool> x) => !x.Value).Key;

		}
	}

	public abstract class ParameterLayoutGroupBase : DevExpress.Xpf.LayoutControl.LayoutGroup, IWeakEventListener
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemsSourceProperty;

		public object ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return ((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ItemsSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ItemsSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static ParameterLayoutGroupBase()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ParameterLayoutGroupBase>.New().Register<object>("ItemsSource", ref ItemsSourceProperty, (object)null, (Action<ParameterLayoutGroupBase, object, object>)delegate(ParameterLayoutGroupBase d, object o, object n)
			{
				d.OnItemsSourceChanged(o, n);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		private void OnItemsSourceChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			UnsubscribeItemsSource(oldValue);
			InvalidateChildren();
			SubscribeItemsSource(newValue);
		}

		private void UnsubscribeItemsSource(object itemsSource)
		{
			if (itemsSource is INotifyCollectionChanged source)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(source, this);
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeItemsSource(object itemsSource)
		{
			if (itemsSource is INotifyCollectionChanged source)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(source, this);
			}
		}

		private void OnItemsSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				InvalidateChildren();
				return;
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					AddItem(newItem);
				}
			}
			if (e.OldItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
			{
				RemoveItem(oldItem);
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateChildren()
		{
			((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)(object)this).Children.Clear();
			if (!(ItemsSource is IEnumerable enumerable))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in enumerable)
			{
				AddItem(item);
			}
		}

		private void AddItem(object item)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = CreateItem(item);
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				frameworkElement.DataContext = item;
				((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)(object)this).Children.Add(frameworkElement);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveItem(object item)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)(object)this).Children.OfType<FrameworkElement>().FirstOrDefault((FrameworkElement x) => x.DataContext == item);
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)(object)this).Children.Remove(frameworkElement);
				frameworkElement.DataContext = null;
			}
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateItem(object item)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			if (item is GroupItemViewModel)
			{
				frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)(object)new ParameterLayoutGroup();
				SetStyleBinding(frameworkElement, "GroupStyle");
			}
			else if (item is ParameterItemViewModel)
			{
				frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)(object)new LayoutItem
				{
					Content = CreateContent()
				};
				SetStyleBinding(frameworkElement, "ParameterItemStyle");
			}
			else if (item is SeparatorItemViewModel)
			{
				frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)(object)new GroupSeparator
				{
					HorizontalAlignment = ((base.Orientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal) ? System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch : System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left),
					Orientation = ((base.Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal) ? System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical : System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
				};
				SetStyleBinding(frameworkElement, "SeparatorStyle");
			}
			return frameworkElement;
		}

		private void SetStyleBinding(FrameworkElement target, string styleName)
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding(styleName);
			binding.RelativeSource = new RelativeSource
			{
				Mode = RelativeSourceMode.FindAncestor,
				AncestorType = typeof(ParameterLayoutRoot)
			};
			target.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, binding);
		}

		private UIElement CreateContent()
		{
			ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl();
			contentControl.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding());
			contentControl.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath("(0).ParameterTemplateSelector", ParametersPanel.ParametersPanelProperty),
				RelativeSource = new RelativeSource(RelativeSourceMode.Self)
			});
			return contentControl;
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(CollectionChangedEventManager))
			{
				NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e2 = (NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs)e;
				OnItemsSourceCollectionChanged(sender, e2);
			}
			else if (!(managerType == typeof(CurrentChangedEventManager)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class AutoFitColumnGrid : System.Windows.Controls.Grid
	{
		public AutoFitColumnGrid()
		{
			base.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateFirstColumnWidth();
		}

		private void UpdateFirstColumnWidth()
		{
			if (base.ColumnDefinitions.Count > 1)
			{
				double val = CalculateFirstColumnAvailableWidth();
				double firstColumnDesiredWidth = GetFirstColumnDesiredWidth();
				double pixels = Math.Min(val, firstColumnDesiredWidth);
				base.ColumnDefinitions[0].Width = new GridLength(pixels);
			}
		}

		private double CalculateFirstColumnAvailableWidth()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 1; i < base.ColumnDefinitions.Count; i++)
			{
				double maxMinWidth = Math.Max(base.ColumnDefinitions[i].Width.Value, base.ColumnDefinitions[i].MinWidth);
				List<FrameworkElement> columnChildren = GetColumnChildren(i);
				columnChildren.ForEach(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
				{
					maxMinWidth = Math.Max(maxMinWidth, x.MinWidth);
				});
				num += maxMinWidth;
			}
			double num2 = base.ActualWidth - num;
			if (!(num2 < 0.0))
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double GetFirstColumnDesiredWidth()
		{
			double width = 0.0;
			List<FrameworkElement> columnChildren = GetColumnChildren(0);
			columnChildren.ForEach(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, x.ActualHeight));
				width = Math.Max(width, x.DesiredSize.Width);
			});
			return width + 1.0;
		}

		private List<FrameworkElement> GetColumnChildren(int columnIndex)
		{
			return (from x in base.Children.OfType<FrameworkElement>()
				where System.Windows.Controls.Grid.GetColumn(x) == columnIndex
				select x).ToList();
		}
	}

	public class ParameterTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate LookUpEditTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.LookUpEditTemplate;

		public DataTemplate BooleanTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.BooleanTemplate;

		public DataTemplate DateTimeTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.DateTimeTemplate;

		public DataTemplate StringTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.StringTemplate;

		public DataTemplate NumericTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.NumericTemplate;

		public DataTemplate NumericFloatTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.NumericFloatTemplate;

		public DataTemplate GuidTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.GuidTemplate;

		public DataTemplate MultiValueTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.MultiValueTemplate;

		public DataTemplate MultiValueLookUpTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.MultiValueLookUpTemplate;

		public DataTemplate DateRangeTemplate { get; set; } = EditorTemplates.DateRangeTemplate;

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			ParameterItemViewModel val = (ParameterItemViewModel)((item is ParameterItemViewModel) ? item : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (val.IsRangeParameter && val.Parameter.Type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return DateRangeTemplate;
			}
			if (val.MultiValue)
			{
				if (val.LookUpValues == null)
				{
					return MultiValueTemplate;
				}
				return MultiValueLookUpTemplate;
			}
			if (val.LookUpValues != null || val.Parameter.Type.IsEnum)
			{
				return LookUpEditTemplate;
			}
			Type type = val.Parameter.Type;
			if (type == typeof(bool))
			{
				return BooleanTemplate;
			}
			if (type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return DateTimeTemplate;
			}
			if (PSNativeMethods.IsNumericalType(type))
			{
				if (PSNativeMethods.IsFloatType(type))
				{
					return NumericFloatTemplate;
				}
				return NumericTemplate;
			}
			if (type == typeof(Guid))
			{
				return GuidTemplate;
			}
			return StringTemplate;
		}
	}
	public class StringToGuidConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			string input = value as string;
			Guid result = default(Guid);
			if (Guid.TryParse(input, out result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.Parameters.Models.Native
{
	public class ModelsCreator
	{
		public static List<ParameterModel> CreateParameterModels(IEnumerable<IClientParameter> parameters)
		{
			List<ParameterModel> result = new List<ParameterModel>();
			if (parameters == null || !parameters.Any())
			{
				return result;
			}
			IEnumerableExtensions.ForEach<IClientParameter>(parameters, (Action<IClientParameter>)delegate(IClientParameter x)
			{
				result.Add(CreateParameterModel(x));
			});
			return result;
		}

		private static ParameterModel CreateParameterModel(IClientParameter parameter)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ClientParameter val = (ClientParameter)parameter;
			LookUpValueCollection lookUpValues = ((val.OriginalParameter.LookUpSettings is StaticListLookUpSettings) ? ((StaticListLookUpSettings)val.OriginalParameter.LookUpSettings).LookUpValues : null);
			ParameterModel parameterModel = ParameterModel.CreateParameterModel(val.OriginalParameter, lookUpValues);
			((ParameterItemViewModel)parameterModel).Path = val.Path;
			((ParameterItemViewModel)parameterModel).IsFilteredLookUpSettings = val.IsFilteredLookUpSettings;
			return parameterModel;
		}

		public static List<ParameterModel> CreateParameterModels(IEnumerable<Parameter> parameters)
		{
			List<ParameterModel> list = new List<ParameterModel>();
			if (parameters == null || !parameters.Any())
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (Parameter parameter in parameters)
			{
				ParameterModel item = CreateParameterModel(parameter);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static ParameterModel CreateParameterModel(Parameter parameter)
		{
			LookUpSettings lookUpSettings = parameter.LookUpSettings;
			string value = ((lookUpSettings != null) ? lookUpSettings.FilterString : null);
			ParameterModel parameterModel = ParameterModel.CreateParameterModel(parameter);
			((ParameterItemViewModel)parameterModel).IsFilteredLookUpSettings = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value);
			return parameterModel;
		}
	}

	public abstract class ActiveWindowFinderBase<T> where T : ActiveWindowFinderBase<T>, new()
	{
		private static readonly T instance = new T();

		public static T Instance => instance;

		public Window GetActiveWindow(FrameworkElement element = null)
		{
			Window window = element.With(Window.GetWindow);
			if (window != null && window.Dispatcher.CheckAccess() && window.IsLoaded)
			{
				return window;
			}
			if (System.Windows.Application.Current != null && System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
			{
				return System.Windows.Application.Current.With((System.Windows.Application app) => app.Windows.OfType<Window>().SingleOrDefault((Window x) => x.IsActive));
			}
			IEnumerable<Window> enumerable = (from x in PresentationSource.CurrentSources.OfType<HwndSource>()
				select x.RootVisual).OfType<Window>();
			foreach (Window item in enumerable)
			{
				if (item != null && IsSuitableWindow(item))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return enumerable.LastOrDefault();
		}

	internal class BackgroundWorkerWrapper : IBackgroundWorkerWrapper
	{
		private readonly BackgroundWorker worker;

		public bool IsBusy => worker.IsBusy;

		public event EventHandler<DoWorkEventArgs> DoWork;

		public event EventHandler<RunWorkerCompletedEventArgs> RunWorkerCompleted;

		public BackgroundWorkerWrapper()
		{
			worker = new BackgroundWorker();
			worker.DoWork += worker_DoWork;
			worker.RunWorkerCompleted += worker_RunWorkerCompleted;
		}

		private void worker_RunWorkerCompleted(object sender, RunWorkerCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.RunWorkerCompleted != null)
			{
				this.RunWorkerCompleted(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void worker_DoWork(object sender, DoWorkEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.DoWork != null)
			{
				this.DoWork(this, e);
			}
		}

		public void RunWorkerAsync()
		{
			worker.RunWorkerAsync();
		}
	}

	public class PageMarginsInfoToGlyphConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		private readonly DXMargins normal = new DXMargins(100f, 100f, 100f, 100f);

		private readonly DXMargins narrow = new DXMargins(50f, 50f, 50f, 50f);

		private readonly DXMargins moderate = new DXMargins(75f, 100f, 75f, 100f);

		private readonly DXMargins wide = new DXMargins(200f, 200f, 200f, 200f);

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ae: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PageMarginInfo pageMarginInfo = value as PageMarginInfo;
			if (pageMarginInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string format = "pack://application:,,,/{0};component/Images/PageMargins{1}.svg";
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (pageMarginInfo.Margins.Equals(normal))
			{
				empty = "normal";
			}
			else if (pageMarginInfo.Margins.Equals(narrow))
			{
				empty = "narrow";
			}
			else if (pageMarginInfo.Margins.Equals(moderate))
			{
				empty = "moderate";
			}
			else
			{
				if (!pageMarginInfo.Margins.Equals(wide))
				{
					return null;
				}
				empty = "wide";
			}
			return ((MarkupExtension)new SvgImageSourceExtension
			{
				Uri = new Uri(string.Format(format, "DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.v23.2", empty))
			}).ProvideValue((IServiceProvider)null);

			{

		private void SetRange(Range<DateTime> range)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			locker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate

				Range = range;
				StartDate = range.Start;
				EndDate = range.End;
				UpdatePredefinedRangeState();
				RaiseRangeChanged();
			});
		}

		private void OnStartDateChanged()
		{
			locker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				EndDate = new DateTime(Math.Max(StartDate.Ticks, EndDate.Ticks));

				UpdatePredefinedRangeState();
				RaiseRangeChanged();
			});
		}

		private void OnEndDateChanged()
		{
			locker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				StartDate = new DateTime(Math.Min(StartDate.Ticks, EndDate.Ticks));
				Range = new Range<DateTime>(StartDate, EndDate);
				UpdatePredefinedRangeState();
				RaiseRangeChanged();
			});
		}

		private void OnMinValueChanged()
		{
			StartDate = new DateTime(Math.Max(StartDate.Ticks, MinValue.Ticks));
		}

		private void OnMaxValueChanged()
		{
			EndDate = new DateTime(Math.Min(EndDate.Ticks, MaxValue.Ticks));
		}

		private void UpdatePredefinedRangeState()
		{
			SelectedPredefinedRange = (TryGetRangeFromPredefinedRanges(out var name) ? name : null);
		}

		private bool TryGetRangeFromPredefinedRanges(out string name)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Range<DateTime>> predefinedRange in PredefinedRanges)
			{
				if (predefinedRange.Value.Equals(Range))
				{
					name = predefinedRange.Key;
					return true;
				}
			}
			name = null;
			return false;
		}

		}

		}

		private void UpdateDateRangeValues()
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (DateRangeControl != null)

				UpdateRangeControlMinMaxValues();
				if (((BaseEdit)this).EditValue != null)

					DateRangeControl.Range = (Range<DateTime>)((BaseEdit)this).EditValue;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPopupClosed()
		{
			((PopupBaseEdit)this).OnPopupClosed();
			DateRangeControl = null;
		}

		protected override ActualPropertyProvider CreateActualPropertyProvider()

		}

		internal void UpdateOkButtonIsEnabled(bool isEnabled)
		{
			((PopupBaseEdit)this).PropertyProvider.PopupViewModel.OkButtonIsEnabled = isEnabled;
		}

		private void OnMinValueChanged()
		{
			minMaxLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (MaxValue < MinValue)
				{
					MaxValue = MinValue;
				}
			});
			UpdateRangeControlMinMaxValues();
		}

		private void OnMaxValueChanged()
		{
			minMaxLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (MinValue > MaxValue)
				{
					MinValue = MaxValue;
				}
			});
			UpdateRangeControlMinMaxValues();
		}

		private void UpdateRangeControlMinMaxValues()
		{
			if (DateRangeControl != null)
			{
				DateRangeControl.MinValue = MinValue.Date;
				DateRangeControl.MaxValue = MaxValue.Date;
			}
		}

		private DateRangeControl GetRangeControl()
		{
			return (DateRangeControl)(object)LayoutHelper.FindElement(((Popup)(object)((PopupBaseEdit)this).Popup).Child as FrameworkElement, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement element) => element is DateRangeControl && element.Name == "PART_PopupContent"));
		}

	public class DateRangeEditStrategy : PopupBaseEditStrategy
	{

		protected DateRangeEdit Editor => (DateRangeEdit)(object)((TextEditStrategy)this).Editor;

		protected Range<DateTime> EditValue => (Range<DateTime>)(((??)(((EditStrategyBase)this).EditValue as Range<DateTime>?)) ?? new Range<DateTime>(DateTime.Now.Date, DateTime.Now.Date));

		public void SyncWithRangeControl()

				((EditStrategyBase)this).ValueContainer.SetEditValue((object)Editor.DateRangeControl.Range, (UpdateEditorSource)3);
			}
		}

		public override void EditValueChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object obj = newValue;
			Range<DateTime>? val = newValue as Range<DateTime>?;
			if (!val.HasValue)
			{
				obj = new Range<DateTime>(DateTime.Now.Date, DateTime.Now.Date);
			}
			else if (val.Value.Start > val.Value.End)
			{
				obj = new Range<DateTime>(val.Value.End, val.Value.Start);
			}
			else if (val.Value.End.Date == default(DateTime).Date)
			{
				obj = new Range<DateTime>(val.Value.Start, val.Value.End.Date);
			}
			if (obj.Equals(newValue))
			{
				((EditStrategyBase)this).EditValueChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}
			else
			{
				((BaseEdit)Editor).EditValue = obj;
			}
		}

		public void OnPopupOpened()
		{
			IsValueModified = false;
			if (Editor.DateRangeControl != null)
			{
				Editor.DateRangeControl.RangeChanged += OnRangeChanged;
			}
		}

		protected override object ConvertEditValueForFormatDisplayText(object convertedValue)
		{
			object obj = ((EditStrategyBase)this).ConvertEditValueForFormatDisplayText(convertedValue);
			Range<DateTime>? input = obj as Range<DateTime>?;
			return input.Return<Range<DateTime>, string>((Func<Range<DateTime>?, string>)((Range<DateTime>? x) => $"{x.Value.Start:d} - {x.Value.End:d}"), (Func<string>)(() => string.Empty));
		}

		private void OnRangeChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IsValueModified)
			{
				IsValueModified = true;
			}
		}

	internal class DocumentPrinter
	{
		private XpsDocumentWriter writer;

		private PrintTicket documentPrintTicket;

		private ReadonlyPageData[] pageData;

		private int startPageIndex;

		public bool Active => writer != null;

		public event AsyncCompletedEventHandler PrintCompleted;

		public void CancelPrint()
		{
			if (writer != null)
			{
				writer.CancelAsync();
			}
		}

		public void PrintDirect(DocumentPaginator paginator, ReadonlyPageData[] pageData, string jobDescription, bool asyncMode)
		{
			PrintDirect(paginator, pageData, jobDescription, GetDefaultPrintQueue(), asyncMode);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void PrintDirect(DocumentPaginator paginator, ReadonlyPageData[] pageData, string jobDescription, PrintQueue queue, bool asyncMode)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)paginator, "paginator");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)pageData, "pageData");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)queue, "queue");
			if (paginator.PageCount == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("A document must contain at least one page to be printed.");
			}
			if (pageData.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("pageData can not be empty");
			}
			if (Active)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't start printing while another printing job is in progress");
			}
			documentPrintTicket = queue.UserPrintTicket;
			this.pageData = pageData;
			queue.CurrentJobSettings.Description = GetJobDescriptionOrDefault(jobDescription);
			if (PrintHelper.UsePrintTickets)
			{
				ApplyPageDataToTicket(queue.UserPrintTicket, pageData[0]);
			}
			XpsDocumentWriter xpsDocumentWriter = PrintQueue.CreateXpsDocumentWriter(queue);
			Print(paginator, xpsDocumentWriter, asyncMode);
		}

		public bool PrintDialog(DocumentPaginator paginator, ReadonlyPageData[] pageData, string jobDescription, bool asyncMode)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)paginator, "paginator");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)pageData, "pageData");
			if (paginator.PageCount == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("A document must contain at least one page to be printed.");
			}
			if (Active)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't start printing while another printing job is in progress");
			}
			if (pageData.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("pageData can not be empty");
			}
			XpsDocumentWriter xpsDocumentWriter = null;
			PageRange pageRange = default(PageRange);
			PageRangeSelection pageRangeSelection = PageRangeSelection.AllPages;
			this.pageData = pageData;
			xpsDocumentWriter = ShowPrintDialog(pageData[0], jobDescription, ref pageRangeSelection, ref pageRange, (uint)paginator.PageCount);
			if (xpsDocumentWriter == null)
			{
				OnAsyncPrintJobCompleted(null, cancelled: true, false);
				return false;
			}
			DocumentPaginator paginator2 = ((pageRangeSelection == PageRangeSelection.AllPages) ? paginator : new PageRangeCustomPaginator(paginator, GetPageIndexes(pageRange)));
			startPageIndex = ((pageRangeSelection != PageRangeSelection.AllPages) ? (pageRange.PageFrom - 1) : 0);
			Print(paginator2, xpsDocumentWriter, asyncMode);
			return true;
		}

		private static int[] GetPageIndexes(PageRange pageRange)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = pageRange.PageFrom; i <= pageRange.PageTo; i++)
			{
				list.Add(i - 1);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private XpsDocumentWriter ShowPrintDialog(ReadonlyPageData pageData, string jobDescription, ref PageRangeSelection pageRangeSelection, ref PageRange pageRange, uint maxPage)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.PrintDialog printDialog = new System.Windows.Controls.PrintDialog();
			printDialog.UserPageRangeEnabled = true;
			printDialog.MaxPage = maxPage;
			if (PrintHelper.UsePrintTickets)
			{
				ApplyPageDataToTicket(printDialog.PrintTicket, pageData);
			}
			if (printDialog.ShowDialog() == false)
			{
				return null;
			}
			printDialog.PrintQueue.CurrentJobSettings.Description = GetJobDescriptionOrDefault(jobDescription);
			documentPrintTicket = printDialog.PrintTicket;
			pageRangeSelection = printDialog.PageRangeSelection;
			pageRange = printDialog.PageRange;
			return PrintQueue.CreateXpsDocumentWriter(printDialog.PrintQueue);
		}

		private void Print(DocumentPaginator paginator, XpsDocumentWriter writer, bool asyncMode)
		{
			this.writer = writer;
			writer.WritingCompleted += writer_WritingCompleted;
			writer.WritingCancelled += writer_WritingCancelled;
			writer.WritingProgressChanged += writer_WritingProgressChanged;
			if (PrintHelper.UsePrintTickets)
			{
				writer.WritingPrintTicketRequired += writer_WritingPrintTicketRequired;
			}
			if (asyncMode)
			{
				try
				{
					writer.WriteAsync(paginator);
					return;
				}
				catch (PrintSystemException error)
				{
					OnAsyncPrintJobCompleted(error, cancelled: false, null);
					return;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				writer.Write(paginator);
			}
			finally
			{
				OnPrintJobCompleted();
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void writer_WritingPrintTicketRequired(object sender, WritingPrintTicketRequiredEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.CurrentPrintTicketLevel == PrintTicketLevel.FixedDocumentSequencePrintTicket)
			{
				if (documentPrintTicket != null)
				{
					e.CurrentPrintTicket = documentPrintTicket;
				}
			}
			else if (e.CurrentPrintTicketLevel == PrintTicketLevel.FixedPagePrintTicket)
			{
				ReadonlyPageData val = ((pageData.Length > 1) ? pageData[e.Sequence - 1 + startPageIndex] : pageData[0]);
				PrintTicket printTicket = new PrintTicket();
				ApplyPageDataToTicket(printTicket, val);
				e.CurrentPrintTicket = printTicket;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void ApplyPageDataToTicket(PrintTicket ticket, ReadonlyPageData pageData)
		{
			System.Windows.Size pageSize = GetPageSize(pageData);
			ticket.PageMediaSize = new PageMediaSize(DrawingConverter.FromPaperKind(pageData.PaperKind), pageSize.Width, pageSize.Height);
			ticket.PageOrientation = (pageData.Landscape ? PageOrientation.Landscape : PageOrientation.Portrait);
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Size GetPageSize(ReadonlyPageData pageData)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = new System.Windows.Size(GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(pageData.Bounds.Width, 100f, 96f), GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(pageData.Bounds.Height, 100f, 96f));
			if (pageData.Landscape)
			{
				double width = result.Width;
				result.Width = result.Height;
				result.Height = width;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void writer_WritingCancelled(object sender, WritingCancelledEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPrintJobCompleted();
		}

		private void writer_WritingCompleted(object sender, WritingCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnAsyncPrintJobCompleted(e.Error, e.Cancelled, e.UserState);
		}

		private void writer_WritingProgressChanged(object sender, WritingProgressChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TimeSpan timeout = new TimeSpan(100000L);
			Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.Invoke((ThreadStart)delegate
			{
			}, timeout, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle);
		}

		private void OnPrintJobCompleted()
		{
			if (writer != null)
			{
				writer.WritingCompleted -= writer_WritingCompleted;
				writer.WritingCancelled -= writer_WritingCancelled;
				writer.WritingProgressChanged -= writer_WritingProgressChanged;
				writer.WritingPrintTicketRequired -= writer_WritingPrintTicketRequired;
				writer = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnAsyncPrintJobCompleted(Exception error, bool cancelled, object userState)
		{
			OnPrintJobCompleted();
			if (this.PrintCompleted != null)
			{
				this.PrintCompleted(this, new AsyncCompletedEventArgs(error, cancelled, userState));
			}
		}

		internal static string GetJobDescriptionOrDefault(string jobDescription)
		{
			return jobDescription ?? PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.DefaultPrintJobDescription);
		}

		private static PrintQueue GetDefaultPrintQueue()
		{
			using (PrintQueueCollection source = new LocalPrintServer().GetPrintQueues())
			{
				if (source.Count() == 0)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Exception_NoPrinterFound));
				}
			}
			return LocalPrintServer.GetDefaultPrintQueue();
		}
	}
	public class DuplexModeToDisplayTextConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Duplex? duplex = value as Duplex?;
			if (!duplex.HasValue || duplex.Value == Duplex.Default)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (duplex == Duplex.Simplex)
			{
				return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.DuplexMode_Simplex);
			}
			if (duplex == Duplex.Horizontal)
			{
				return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.DuplexMode_Horizontal);
			}
			return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.DuplexMode_Vertical);
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}
	public class DuplexModeToDisplayTextAndDescriptionConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public enum Type
		{
			DisplayText,
			Description
		}

		public Type DisplayTextType { get; set; }

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, System.Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Duplex? duplex = value as Duplex?;
			if (!duplex.HasValue || duplex.Value == Duplex.Default)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (DisplayTextType == Type.DisplayText)
			{
				if (duplex != Duplex.Simplex)
				{
					return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.PrintOnBothSides);
				}
				return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.PrintOneSided);
			}
			if (duplex == Duplex.Simplex)
			{
				return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.PrintOneSidedDescription);
			}
			if (duplex == Duplex.Horizontal)
			{
				return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.DuplexMode_Horizontal);
			}
			return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.DuplexMode_Vertical);
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, System.Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}

		private void LoadCore()
		{
			DoWithOpenFileDialogService(delegate(IOpenFileDialogService service)
			{
				BeforeShowOpenFileDialog();
				service.AssignImageFileFilter(IsImageSource);
				if (service.ShowDialog())
				{
					try
					{
						object imageObjectFromFile = OpenImageSourceHelper.GetImageObjectFromFile(service.GetFullFileName(), DoWithMessageBoxService, IsImageSource);
						editStrategy.SetImage(imageObjectFromFile);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						Exception ex2 = ex;
						Exception e = ex2;
						DoWithMessageBoxService(delegate(IMessageBoxService mService)
						{
							Exception ex3 = e.Yield().Flatten((Exception x) => x.InnerException.Return((Exception singleElement) => singleElement.Yield(), () => Enumerable.Empty<Exception>())).Last();
							mService.ShowMessage(ex3.Message, "Error", MessageButton.OK, MessageIcon.Error, MessageResult.OK);
						});
					}
				}
				AfterShowOpenFileDialog();
			});
		}

		private void SetInitialPopupSize()
		{
			try
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(((PopupBaseEdit)this).ActualPopupWidth) && !double.IsNaN(((PopupBaseEdit)this).ActualPopupHeight))
				{
					return;
				}
				SizeF sizeF;
				if (IsImageSource && !ImageSource.IsNullOrEmpty(ImageSource))
				{
					sizeF = ImageSource.GetImageSize(true);
				}
				else
				{
					if (Image == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					sizeF = new SizeF(Image.Width, Image.Height);
				}
				if (sizeF.Width > 0f && sizeF.Height > 0f)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					double num2 = 0.0;
					double num3 = 0.0;
					num2 = Math.Max(((PopupBaseEdit)this).PopupMinWidth, ((FrameworkElement)this).ActualWidth) / (double)sizeF.Width;
					num3 = ((PopupBaseEdit)this).PopupMinHeight / (double)sizeF.Height;
					num = ((num3 < num2) ? num3 : num2);
					((PopupBaseEdit)this).ActualPopupWidth = Math.Max(((PopupBaseEdit)this).PopupMinWidth, (double)sizeF.Width * num);
					((PopupBaseEdit)this).ActualPopupHeight = Math.Max(((PopupBaseEdit)this).PopupMinHeight, (double)sizeF.Height * num);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(SourceProperty, (object)null);
			}
		}

		internal void Load()
		{
			ImageEditControl.HideMenuPopup();
			LoadCore();
		}

		private void LoadCore()
		{
			((PopupBaseEdit)this).CancelPopup();
			DoWithOpenFileDialogService(delegate(IOpenFileDialogService service)
			{
				BeforeShowOpenFileDialog();
				object obj = OpenImageSourceHelper.Open(service, DoWithMessageBoxService, IsImageSource);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(SourceProperty, obj);
					((EditStrategyBase)EditStrategy).UpdateDisplayText();
				}
				AfterShowOpenFileDialog();
			});
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeShowOpenFileDialog()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void AfterShowOpenFileDialog()
		{
		}
	}
