	public class GridExtensions
	{
		private const string auto = "auto";

		private static readonly GridLengthConverter converter = new GridLengthConverter();

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RowDefinitionsProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("RowDefinitions", typeof(string), typeof(GridExtensions), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnRowDefinitionsChanged((System.Windows.Controls.Grid)d, e);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnDefinitionsProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ColumnDefinitions", typeof(string), typeof(GridExtensions), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnColumnDefinitionsChanged((System.Windows.Controls.Grid)d, e);
		}));

		public static string GetRowDefinitions(System.Windows.Controls.Grid obj)
		{
			return (string)obj.GetValue(RowDefinitionsProperty);
		}

		public static void SetRowDefinitions(System.Windows.Controls.Grid obj, string value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(RowDefinitionsProperty, value);
		}

		public static string GetColumnDefinitions(System.Windows.Controls.Grid obj)
		{
			return (string)obj.GetValue(ColumnDefinitionsProperty);
		}

		public static void SetColumnDefinitions(System.Windows.Controls.Grid obj, string value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ColumnDefinitionsProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnRowDefinitionsChanged(System.Windows.Controls.Grid d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string rowDefinitions = GetRowDefinitions(d);
			Apply(rowDefinitions, d.RowDefinitions, (GridLength length) => new RowDefinition
			{
				Height = length
			});
		}

		private static void OnColumnDefinitionsChanged(System.Windows.Controls.Grid d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string columnDefinitions = GetColumnDefinitions(d);
			Apply(columnDefinitions, d.ColumnDefinitions, (GridLength length) => new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = length
			});
		}

		private static void Apply<T>(string value, IList<T> definitions, Func<GridLength, T> createDefinition) where T : DefinitionBase, new()
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			definitions.Clear();
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = from x in value.Split(',')
				select x.Trim();
			foreach (string item in enumerable)
			{
				GridLength arg = (GridLength)converter.ConvertFromString(item);
				definitions.Add(createDefinition(arg));
			}
		}
	}

	public static class OpenImageSourceHelper
	{
		public static object Open(IOpenFileDialogService service, Action<Action<IMessageBoxService>> doWithMessageBoxService, bool isImageSource)
		{
			service.AssignImageFileFilter(isImageSource);
			object result = null;
			if (service.ShowDialog())
			{
				try
				{
					result = GetImageObjectFromFile(service.GetFullFileName(), doWithMessageBoxService, isImageSource);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception e = ex2;
					doWithMessageBoxService(delegate(IMessageBoxService mService)
					{
						Exception ex3 = e.Yield().Flatten((Exception x) => x.InnerException.Return((Exception singleElement) => singleElement.Yield(), () => Enumerable.Empty<Exception>())).Last();
						mService.ShowMessage(ex3.Message, "Error", MessageButton.OK, MessageIcon.Error, MessageResult.OK);
					});
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static object GetImageObjectFromFile(string fileName, Action<Action<IMessageBoxService>> doWithMessageBoxService, bool isImageSource = true)
		{
			if (isImageSource)
			{
				return GetImageSourceFromFile(fileName, doWithMessageBoxService);
			}
			return System.Drawing.Image.FromFile(fileName);
		}

		private static ImageSource GetImageSourceFromFile(string fileName, Action<Action<IMessageBoxService>> doWithMessageBoxService)
		{
			ImageSource val = ImageSource.FromFile(fileName);
			if (!ImageSource.IsNullOrEmpty(val) && val.IsSvgImage)
			{
				ValidateSvgImage(val.SvgImage, doWithMessageBoxService);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private static void ValidateSvgImage(SvgImage svgImage, Action<Action<IMessageBoxService>> doWithMessageBoxService)
		{
			if (svgImage.UnknownTags.Any())
			{
				doWithMessageBoxService(delegate(IMessageBoxService mService)
				{
					string messageBoxText = string.Format(PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)164), string.Join(", ", svgImage.UnknownTags.Distinct()));
					mService.ShowMessage(messageBoxText, "Information", MessageButton.OK, MessageIcon.Information, MessageResult.OK);
				});
			}
		}
	}
	public class PageDimensionToDisplayValueConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public float SourceDpi { get; set; } = 100f;

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || value == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			float num = System.Convert.ToSingle(value);
			GraphicsUnit graphicsUnit = (RegionInfo.CurrentRegion.IsMetric ? GraphicsUnit.Millimeter : GraphicsUnit.Inch);
			string formatString = GetFormatString(graphicsUnit);
			float num2 = GraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(graphicsUnit);
			float num3 = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(num, SourceDpi, num2);
			return string.Format(formatString, num3);
		}

		private static string GetFormatString(GraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			return unit switch
			{
				GraphicsUnit.Inch => "{0:0.##} ''", 
				GraphicsUnit.Millimeter => "{0:0} " + PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)196), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}

		static PageSettingsPreviewPainter()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<PageSettingsPreviewPainter>.New().Register<PaperKind>("PaperKind", ref PaperKindProperty, PaperKind.A4, (Action<PageSettingsPreviewPainter>)delegate(PageSettingsPreviewPainter d)
			{
				d.UpdatePreview();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<bool>("Landscape", ref LandscapeProperty, false, (Action<PageSettingsPreviewPainter>)delegate(PageSettingsPreviewPainter d)
			{
				d.UpdatePreview();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<float>("PaperWidth", ref PaperWidthProperty, 0f, (Action<PageSettingsPreviewPainter>)delegate(PageSettingsPreviewPainter d)
				{
					d.UpdatePreview();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<float>("PaperHeight", ref PaperHeightProperty, 0f, (Action<PageSettingsPreviewPainter>)delegate(PageSettingsPreviewPainter d)
				{
					d.UpdatePreview();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<float>("LeftMargin", ref LeftMarginProperty, 0f, (Action<PageSettingsPreviewPainter>)delegate(PageSettingsPreviewPainter d)
				{
					d.UpdatePreview();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<float>("RightMargin", ref RightMarginProperty, 0f, (Action<PageSettingsPreviewPainter>)delegate(PageSettingsPreviewPainter d)
				{
					d.UpdatePreview();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<float>("TopMargin", ref TopMarginProperty, 0f, (Action<PageSettingsPreviewPainter>)delegate(PageSettingsPreviewPainter d)
				{
					d.UpdatePreview();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<float>("BottomMargin", ref BottomMarginProperty, 0f, (Action<PageSettingsPreviewPainter>)delegate(PageSettingsPreviewPainter d)
				{
					d.UpdatePreview();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			base.AssociatedObject.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			base.AssociatedObject.Loaded -= OnLoaded;
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdatePreview();
		}

		private void UpdatePreview()
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject.IsLoaded && !WrongValue(PaperWidth) && !WrongValue(PaperHeight))
			{
				System.Windows.Size renderSize = base.AssociatedObject.RenderSize;
				double num = CalculatePreviewScale(renderSize, new System.Windows.Size(PaperWidth, PaperHeight));
				System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size((double)PaperWidth * num, (double)PaperHeight * num);
				Thickness margins = new Thickness((double)LeftMargin * num, (double)TopMargin * num, (double)RightMargin * num, (double)BottomMargin * num);
				if (!WrongMargins(margins))
				{
					Border page = Page;
					Border horizontalMargin = HorizontalMargin;
					double num2 = (VerticalMargin.Width = size.Width);
					double width2 = (horizontalMargin.Width = num2);
					page.Width = width2;
					Border page2 = Page;
					Border horizontalMargin2 = HorizontalMargin;
					num2 = (VerticalMargin.Height = size.Height);
					width2 = (horizontalMargin2.Height = num2);
					page2.Height = width2;
					HorizontalMargin.Padding = new Thickness(margins.Left, 0.0, margins.Right, 0.0);
					VerticalMargin.Padding = new Thickness(0.0, margins.Top, 0.0, margins.Bottom);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool WrongValue(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsInfinity(value) && !double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return value < 0.0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool WrongMargins(Thickness margins)
		{
			if (!WrongValue(margins.Left) && !WrongValue(margins.Right) && !WrongValue(margins.Top))
			{
				return WrongValue(margins.Bottom);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static double CalculatePreviewScale(System.Windows.Size areaSize, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			double val = areaSize.Height / pageSize.Height;
			double val2 = areaSize.Width / pageSize.Width;
			return Math.Min(val, val2);
		}
	}
	public static class PageSettingsViewModelHelper
	{
		public static void AssignPageDataFromModel(PageSetupViewModel model, Page page, PrintingSystemBase printingSystem)
		{
			DXPaperSize paperSize = GetPaperSize(model);
			IPageSettingsService service = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IPageSettingsService>((IServiceProvider)printingSystem);
			if (service != null)
			{
				service.Assign((IPage)(object)page, GetMargins(model), page.PageData.MinMarginsF, paperSize.Kind, (SizeF)PageData.ToSize(paperSize), model.Landscape, paperSize.PaperName);
			}
		}

		public static MarginsF GetMargins(PageSetupViewModel model)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new MarginsF(DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(model.LeftMargin, model.Unit, DXGraphicsUnit.Document), DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(model.RightMargin, model.Unit, DXGraphicsUnit.Document), DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(model.TopMargin, model.Unit, DXGraphicsUnit.Document), DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(model.BottomMargin, model.Unit, DXGraphicsUnit.Document));
		}

		public static DXPaperSize GetPaperSize(PageSetupViewModel model)
		{
			DXPaperSize dXPaperSize = model.PaperSizes.FirstOrDefault((DXPaperSize a) => a.Kind == model.PaperKind);
			if (dXPaperSize.Kind == DXPaperKind.Custom)
			{
				dXPaperSize.Width = (int)GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(model.PaperWidth, DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(model.Unit), 100f);
				dXPaperSize.Height = (int)GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(model.PaperHeight, DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(model.Unit), 100f);
				if (model.Landscape)
				{
					int height = dXPaperSize.Height;
					int width = dXPaperSize.Width;
					dXPaperSize.Width = height;
					dXPaperSize.Height = width;
				}
			}
			return dXPaperSize;
		}
	}

	{
		IEnumerable<DXPaperSize> PaperSizes { get; set; }

		DXPaperKind PaperKind { get; set; }

		float PaperWidth { get; set; }

		float PaperHeight { get; set; }

		DXGraphicsUnit Unit { get; set; }

		bool Landscape { get; set; }

		float LeftMargin { get; set; }

		float RightMargin { get; set; }

		float TopMargin { get; set; }

		float BottomMargin { get; set; }
	}
	[POCOViewModel]
	public class PageSetupViewModel : ViewModelBase, IPageSetupViewModel
	{
		private readonly Locker updatePropertiesLocker = new Locker();

		private float customWidth = 1f;

		private float customHeight = 1f;

		private DXGraphicsUnit currentUnit;

		private static readonly SizeF MinPageSize = PrintingDocument.MinPageSize;

		public virtual IEnumerable<DXPaperSize> PaperSizes { get; set; }

		public virtual bool Landscape { get; set; }

		public virtual IEnumerable<GraphicsUnitInfo> Units => GraphicsUnitInfo.GetStandardUnitsInfo();

		public virtual string DisplayFormat { get; set; }

		public string Mask { get; private set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "OnUnitChanged")]
		public virtual DXGraphicsUnit Unit { get; set; }

		public virtual DXPaperKind PaperKind { get; set; }

		protected virtual float MarginsUnit
		{
			get
			{
				if (Unit == DXGraphicsUnit.Millimeter)
				{
					return 25.4f;
				}
				if (Unit == DXGraphicsUnit.Inch)
				{
					return 1f;
				}
				return GraphicsDpi.Pixel;
			}
		}

		private SizeF PageSizeInUnits => DXPageSizeInfo.GetPageSizeF(PaperKind, MarginsUnit);

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "OnPaperWidthChanged")]
		public virtual float PaperWidth { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "OnPaperHeightChanged")]
		public virtual float PaperHeight { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "OnLeftMarginChanged")]
		public virtual float LeftMargin { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "OnTopMarginChanged")]
		public virtual float TopMargin { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "OnRightMarginChanged")]
		public virtual float RightMargin { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "OnBottomMarginChanged")]
		public virtual float BottomMargin { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty]
		public virtual bool EnableUnitsEditor { get; set; }

		public PageSetupViewModel(XtraPageSettingsBase pageSettings)
			: this(pageSettings, RegionInfo.CurrentRegion.IsMetric ? DXGraphicsUnit.Millimeter : DXGraphicsUnit.Inch)
		{
		}

		public PageSetupViewModel(ReadonlyPageData pageData)
			: this(pageData, RegionInfo.CurrentRegion.IsMetric ? DXGraphicsUnit.Millimeter : DXGraphicsUnit.Inch)
		{
		}

		public PageSetupViewModel(XtraPageSettingsBase pageSettings, DXGraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Unit = unit;
			Landscape = pageSettings.Landscape;
			PaperSizes = SetUpPaperSizes(pageSettings.PaperKind, pageSettings.PageSize);
			SetPageSize(((ReadonlyPageData)pageSettings.Data).PageSize, 300f);
			SetMargins(((MarginsFBase)((ReadonlyPageData)pageSettings.Data).MarginsF).Left, ((MarginsFBase)((ReadonlyPageData)pageSettings.Data).MarginsF).Top, ((MarginsFBase)((ReadonlyPageData)pageSettings.Data).MarginsF).Right, ((MarginsFBase)((ReadonlyPageData)pageSettings.Data).MarginsF).Bottom, 300f);
			currentUnit = unit;
			DisplayFormat = GetFormatString(unit);
			Mask = GetMask(unit);
		}

		private IEnumerable<DXPaperSize> SetUpPaperSizes(DXPaperKind dXPaperKind, SizeF paperSize)
		{
			PaperKind = dXPaperKind;
			ICollection<DXPaperSize> collection = DXPageSizeInfo.CreatePaperSizeCollection(addCustomPaper: true);
			DXPaperSize paperSize2 = DXPageSizeInfo.GetPaperSize(dXPaperKind, new System.Drawing.Size((int)paperSize.Width, (int)paperSize.Height), collection);
			if (dXPaperKind != DXPaperKind.Custom)
			{
				DXPaperSize item = new DXPaperSize(DXPaperKind.Custom.ToString(), paperSize2.Width, paperSize2.Height);
				collection.Add(item);
			}
			else
			{
				collection.Add(paperSize2);
			}
			return collection;
		}

		public PageSetupViewModel(ReadonlyPageData pageData, DXGraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Unit = unit;
			Landscape = pageData.Landscape;
			PaperSizes = SetUpPaperSizes(pageData.PaperKind, pageData.PageSize);
			SetPageSize(pageData.PageSize, 300f);
			SetMargins(((MarginsFBase)pageData.MarginsF).Left, ((MarginsFBase)pageData.MarginsF).Top, ((MarginsFBase)pageData.MarginsF).Right, ((MarginsFBase)pageData.MarginsF).Bottom, 300f);
			currentUnit = unit;
			DisplayFormat = GetFormatString(unit);
			Mask = GetMask(unit);
		}

		protected void OnLeftMarginChanged()
		{
			updatePropertiesLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(MinPageSize.Width, 300f, MarginsUnit);
				float num2 = Math.Min(Math.Max(0f, LeftMargin), (PaperKind == DXPaperKind.Custom) ? (customWidth - RightMargin - num) : (GetPageWidthOnPreview() - RightMargin - num));
				if (num2 != LeftMargin)
				{
					LeftMargin = num2;
				}
			});
		}

		protected void OnTopMarginChanged()
		{
			updatePropertiesLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(MinPageSize.Height, 300f, MarginsUnit);
				float num2 = Math.Min(Math.Max(0f, TopMargin), (PaperKind == DXPaperKind.Custom) ? (customHeight - BottomMargin - num) : (GetPageHeightOnPreview() - BottomMargin - num));
				if (num2 != TopMargin)
				{
					TopMargin = num2;
				}
			});
		}

		protected void OnRightMarginChanged()
		{
			updatePropertiesLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(MinPageSize.Width, 300f, MarginsUnit);
				float num2 = Math.Min(Math.Max(0f, RightMargin), (PaperKind == DXPaperKind.Custom) ? (customWidth - LeftMargin - num) : (GetPageWidthOnPreview() - LeftMargin - num));
				if (num2 != RightMargin)
				{
					RightMargin = num2;
				}
			});
		}

		protected void OnBottomMarginChanged()
		{
			updatePropertiesLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(MinPageSize.Height, 300f, MarginsUnit);
				float num2 = Math.Min(Math.Max(0f, BottomMargin), (PaperKind == DXPaperKind.Custom) ? (customHeight - TopMargin - num) : (GetPageHeightOnPreview() - TopMargin - num));
				if (num2 != BottomMargin)
				{
					BottomMargin = num2;
				}
			});
		}

		protected void OnLandscapeChanged()
		{
			updatePropertiesLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				float paperWidth = PaperWidth;
				PaperWidth = PaperHeight;
				PaperHeight = paperWidth;
				if (PaperKind == DXPaperKind.Custom)
				{
					customWidth = PaperWidth;
					customHeight = PaperHeight;
				}
				if (Landscape)
				{
					float leftMargin = LeftMargin;
					LeftMargin = BottomMargin;
					BottomMargin = RightMargin;
					RightMargin = TopMargin;
					TopMargin = leftMargin;
				}
				else
				{
					float topMargin = TopMargin;
					TopMargin = RightMargin;
					RightMargin = BottomMargin;
					BottomMargin = LeftMargin;
					LeftMargin = topMargin;
				}
			});
		}

		protected void OnPaperWidthChanged()
		{
			if (PaperKind != DXPaperKind.Custom)
			{
				return;
			}
			updatePropertiesLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (PaperWidth > 2.1474836E+09f)
				{
					PaperWidth = 2.1474836E+09f;
				}
				else if (PaperWidth < 0f)
				{
					PaperWidth = 0f;
				}
				ValidateMargins(customWidth, customHeight);
				customWidth = PaperWidth;
			});
		}

		protected void OnPaperHeightChanged()
		{
			if (PaperKind != DXPaperKind.Custom)
			{
				return;
			}
			updatePropertiesLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (PaperHeight > 2.1474836E+09f)
				{
					PaperHeight = 2.1474836E+09f;
				}
				else if (PaperHeight < 0f)
				{
					PaperHeight = 0f;
				}
				ValidateMargins(customWidth, customHeight);
				customHeight = PaperHeight;
			});
		}

		protected void OnPaperKindChanged()
		{
			float prevWidth = PaperWidth;
			float prevHeight = PaperHeight;
			updatePropertiesLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (PaperKind == DXPaperKind.Custom)
				{
					PaperWidth = customWidth;
					PaperHeight = customHeight;
				}
				else
				{
					SizeF pageSizeInUnits = PageSizeInUnits;
					PaperWidth = (Landscape ? pageSizeInUnits.Height : pageSizeInUnits.Width);
					PaperHeight = (Landscape ? pageSizeInUnits.Width : pageSizeInUnits.Height);
				}
				ValidateMargins(prevWidth, prevHeight);
			});
			RaisePropertyChanged("PaperKind");
		}

		protected void OnUnitChanged()
		{
			if (Unit != currentUnit)
			{
				updatePropertiesLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					DisplayFormat = GetFormatString(Unit);
					BottomMargin = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(BottomMargin, currentUnit, Unit);
					LeftMargin = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(LeftMargin, currentUnit, Unit);
					RightMargin = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(RightMargin, currentUnit, Unit);
					TopMargin = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(TopMargin, currentUnit, Unit);
					PaperWidth = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(PaperWidth, currentUnit, Unit);
					PaperHeight = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(PaperHeight, currentUnit, Unit);
					customWidth = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(customWidth, currentUnit, Unit);
					customHeight = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(customHeight, currentUnit, Unit);
					currentUnit = Unit;
				});
			}
		}

		private float GetPageWidthOnPreview()
		{
			if (!Landscape)
			{
				return PageSizeInUnits.Width;
			}
			return PageSizeInUnits.Height;
		}

		private float GetPageHeightOnPreview()
		{
			if (!Landscape)
			{
				return PageSizeInUnits.Height;
			}
			return PageSizeInUnits.Width;
		}

		private string GetFormatString(DXGraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			return unit switch
			{
				DXGraphicsUnit.Inch => "{0:0.##} ''", 
				DXGraphicsUnit.Millimeter => "{0:0} " + PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)196), 
				DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel => "{0:0} " + PreviewLocalizer.GetString((PreviewStringId)197), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		private string GetMask(DXGraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			switch (unit)
			{
			case DXGraphicsUnit.Inch:
				return "f";
			case DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel:
			case DXGraphicsUnit.Millimeter:
				return "d";
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		private void ValidateMargins(float prevWidth, float prevHeight)
		{
			if (!(PaperHeight <= 0f) && !(PaperWidth <= 0f) && (LeftMargin + RightMargin > PaperWidth || TopMargin + BottomMargin > PaperHeight))
			{
				float num = Math.Min(PaperWidth / prevWidth, PaperHeight / prevHeight);
				LeftMargin *= num;
				RightMargin *= num;
				TopMargin *= num;
				BottomMargin *= num;
			}
		}

		internal void SetMargins(float left, float top, float right, float bottom, float dpi)
		{
			LeftMargin = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(left, dpi, MarginsUnit);
			TopMargin = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(top, dpi, MarginsUnit);
			RightMargin = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(right, dpi, MarginsUnit);
			BottomMargin = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(bottom, dpi, MarginsUnit);
		}

		internal void SetPageSize(SizeF pageSize, float dpi)
		{
			PaperWidth = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(pageSize.Width, dpi, MarginsUnit);
			PaperHeight = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(pageSize.Height, dpi, MarginsUnit);
			customWidth = PaperWidth;
			customHeight = PaperHeight;
		}
	}

		private void ValidatePassword(bool usePassword, EncryptionPassword password, Action0 repeatPassword, Action0 postAction)
		{
			if (usePassword)
			{
				EncryptionPassword obj = password;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty((obj != null) ? obj.Password : null))
				{
					onRepeatPasswordComplete = delegate(object o, RepeatPasswordCompleteEventArgs e)
					{
						RepeatPasswordComplete(password, e.RepeatedPassword, postAction);
					};
					view.RepeatPasswordComplete += onRepeatPasswordComplete;
					repeatPassword.Invoke();
					return;
				}
			}
			postAction.Invoke();
		}

		private void RepeatPasswordComplete(EncryptionPassword password, EncryptionPassword repeatedPassword, Action0 postAction)
		{
			view.RepeatPasswordComplete -= onRepeatPasswordComplete;
			ValidationResult validationResult = ((repeatedPassword == null) ? ValidationResult.Cancelled : ((!string.Equals((password != null) ? password.Password : null, (repeatedPassword != null) ? repeatedPassword.Password : null)) ? ValidationResult.Invalid : ValidationResult.Valid));
			if (validationResult == ValidationResult.Invalid)
			{
				view.PasswordDoesNotMatch();
			}
			if (validationResult == ValidationResult.Valid)
			{
				postAction.Invoke();
			}
		}

		private void RefreshView()
		{
			view.EnableControl_OpenPassword(view.RequireOpenPassword);
			view.EnableControlGroup_Permissions(view.RestrictPermissions);
		}

		public void RepeatPassword(string caption, string note, string passwordName)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			RepeatPasswordWindow repeatPasswordWindow = new RepeatPasswordWindow(caption, note, passwordName);
			((Window)(object)repeatPasswordWindow).Owner = Window.GetWindow(this);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)repeatPasswordWindow).FlowDirection = base.FlowDirection;
			((Window)(object)repeatPasswordWindow).WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
			EncryptionPassword val = null;
			if (((Window)(object)repeatPasswordWindow).ShowDialog() == true)
			{
				val = new EncryptionPassword();
				val.Password = repeatPasswordWindow.password.Password;
			}
			if (this.RepeatPasswordComplete != null)
			{
				this.RepeatPasswordComplete(this, new RepeatPasswordCompleteEventArgs(val));
			}
		}

	public class PaperKindToDisplayNameConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public class PaperKindInfo
		{
			public PaperKind PaperKind { get; set; }

			public string DisplayName { get; set; }
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is PaperKind)
			{
				return CreatePaperKindInfo((PaperKind)value);
			}
			if (value is IEnumerable<PaperKind>)
			{
				return from paperKind in (IEnumerable<PaperKind>)value
					select CreatePaperKindInfo(paperKind) into paperKindInfo
					orderby paperKindInfo.DisplayName
					select paperKindInfo;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("value");
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is PaperKindInfo)
			{
				return ((PaperKindInfo)value).PaperKind;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("value");
		}

		private static PaperKindInfo CreatePaperKindInfo(PaperKind paperKind)
		{
			string displayName = GetDisplayName(paperKind);
			return new PaperKindInfo
			{
				PaperKind = paperKind,
				DisplayName = displayName
			};
		}

		private static string GetDisplayName(PaperKind paperKind)
		{
			string name = Enum.GetName(paperKind.GetType(), paperKind);
			string value = $"{paperKind.GetType().Name}_{name}";
			try
			{
				PrintingStringId id = (PrintingStringId)Enum.Parse(typeof(PrintingStringId), value, ignoreCase: true);
				return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(id);
			}
			catch
			{
				return name;
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class PreviewImageHelper
	{
		internal static ImageSource GetPreview(Page page, System.Windows.Size size, double scaleX, Action afterDrawPagesAction = null)
		{
			double num = CalculatePreviewScale(size.Width, size.Height, page);
			System.Windows.Size previewPageSize = GetPreviewPageSize(page);
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap((int)(previewPageSize.Width * num * scaleX), (int)(previewPageSize.Height * num * scaleX));
			Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
			graphics.ScaleTransform((float)num, (float)num);
			graphics.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.HighQuality;
			graphics.InterpolationMode = InterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
			graphics.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.Half;
			page.DrawPage(graphics, PointF.Empty);
			afterDrawPagesAction?.Invoke();
			return ConvertToImageSource(bitmap);
		}

		private static double CalculatePreviewScale(double width, double height, Page page)
		{
			System.Windows.Size previewPageSize = GetPreviewPageSize(page);
			double val = height / previewPageSize.Height;
			double val2 = width / previewPageSize.Width;
			return Math.Min(val, val2);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size GetPreviewPageSize(Page page)
		{
			float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(page.PageSize.Width);
			float num2 = GraphicsUnitConverter.DocToDip(page.PageSize.Height);
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}

		private static ImageSource ConvertToImageSource(Bitmap bitmap)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			bitmap.Save(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Bmp);
			BitmapImage bitmapImage = new BitmapImage();
			bitmapImage.BeginInit();
			memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			bitmapImage.StreamSource = memoryStream;
			bitmapImage.EndInit();
			return bitmapImage;
		}
	}

		public static void PrintDirect(PrintingSystemBase printingSystem, string printerName = null)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)printingSystem, "printingSystem");
			if (printingSystem.PageCount == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("A document must contain at least one page to be printed.");

		}

				Caption = PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.OK),
				IsCancel = false,
				IsDefault = true,

			UICommand uICommand2 = new UICommand
			{
				Id = MessageBoxResult.Cancel,
				Caption = PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Cancel),
				IsCancel = true,
				IsDefault = false
			};
			return new UICommand[2] { uICommand, uICommand2 };
		}

		}

	public abstract class ResourceImageExtensionBase : MarkupExtension
	{
		protected abstract string ResourceNameCore { get; }

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ResourceNameCore))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The value of the ResourceName property is not set.");
			}
			ResourceManager resourceManager = CreateResourceManager();
			using ResourceSet resourceSet = resourceManager.GetResourceSet(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, createIfNotExists: true, tryParents: true);
			try
			{
				using UnmanagedMemoryStream stream = (UnmanagedMemoryStream)resourceSet.GetObject(ResourceNameCore, ignoreCase: true);
				return CreateImage(stream);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private ResourceManager CreateResourceManager()
		{
			string name = GetType().Assembly.GetName().Name;
			string baseName = name + ".g";
			return new ResourceManager(baseName, GetType().Assembly);
		}

		private ImageSource CreateImage(Stream stream)
		{
			try
			{
				if (ResourceNameCore.EndsWith(".svg"))
				{
					SvgImage val = SvgImage.FromStream(stream);
					System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(val.Width, val.Height);
					return WpfSvgRenderer.CreateImageSource(val, size, (WpfSvgPalette)null, (string)null, true, true);
				}
				BitmapDecoder bitmapDecoder = BitmapDecoder.Create(stream, BitmapCreateOptions.None, BitmapCacheOption.Default);
				return bitmapDecoder.Frames.First();
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
		}
	}

				maskProvider.SetMaskManagerValue((object)GetMinValue());

			}
		}

	{
		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			PrintRange? printRange = value as PrintRange?;
			if (!printRange.HasValue || printRange.Value == PrintRange.Selection)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (printRange.Value == PrintRange.AllPages)
			{
				return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.PrintAllPages);
			}
			if (printRange.Value == PrintRange.CurrentPage)
			{
				return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.PrintCurrentPage);
			}
			return PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.PrintCustomPages);
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}

	public class TemplateSelectorBehavior : Behavior<ContentControl>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TrueValueTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FalseValueTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ConditionProperty;

		public DataTemplate TrueValueTemplate
		{

			}
		}

		public DataTemplate FalseValueTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(FalseValueTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(FalseValueTemplateProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public bool Condition
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ConditionProperty);
			}

			}
		}

		static TemplateSelectorBehavior()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TemplateSelectorBehavior>.New().Register<DataTemplate>("TrueValueTemplate", ref TrueValueTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (Action<TemplateSelectorBehavior>)delegate(TemplateSelectorBehavior d)
			{
				d.SetActualTemplate();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<DataTemplate>("FalseValueTemplate", ref FalseValueTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (Action<TemplateSelectorBehavior>)delegate(TemplateSelectorBehavior d)
			{
				d.SetActualTemplate();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("Condition", ref ConditionProperty, true, (Action<TemplateSelectorBehavior>)delegate(TemplateSelectorBehavior d)
				{
					d.SetActualTemplate();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			SetActualTemplate();
		}

		private void SetActualTemplate()
		{

			{
				base.AssociatedObject.ContentTemplate = (Condition ? TrueValueTemplate : FalseValueTemplate);
			}
		}

		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)

		}

	{

		public DataTemplate InFrontValueTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				WatermarkPosition valueOrDefault = val.GetValueOrDefault();

	[POCOViewModel]
	public class WatermarkEditorViewModel : ViewModelBase, IWatermarkViewModel

		private readonly Locker updatePreviewLock = new Locker();

		private readonly Page page;

		private Watermark watermark;

		public ICommand UpdatePreviewCommand { get; private set; }

		public ICommand OpenImageCommand { get; private set; }

		public ICommand ClearAllCommand { get; private set; }

		public ICommand AddWatermark { get; private set; }

		public ICommand MoveUp { get; private set; }

		public ICommand MoveDown { get; private set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]
		public virtual string Text { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]
		public virtual DirectionMode TextDirection { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]
		public virtual ImageViewMode ImageViewMode { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]
		public virtual double ImageTransparency { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]
		public virtual double TextTransparency { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]
		public virtual WatermarkPosition TextPosition { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]
		public virtual WatermarkPosition ImagePosition { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "OnIsPageRangeChanged")]
		public virtual bool IsPageRange { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]
		public virtual string PageRange { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdateList")]
		public virtual string Id { get; set; }

		public virtual ImageSource PreviewImage { get; set; }

		public virtual string PageRangePlaceholder { get; set; }

		public virtual string ImageFileName { get; set; }

		public virtual ImageSource ImageSource { get; set; }

		[BindableProperty(OnPropertyChangedMethodName = "UpdatePreview")]
		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public virtual ObservableCollection<WatermarkItemViewModel> WatermarkItems { get; set; }

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public WatermarkCollection Watermarks
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
				XpfWatermarkCollection val = new XpfWatermarkCollection();
				foreach (WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItem in WatermarkItems)
				{
					((Collection<Watermark>)(object)val).Add(watermarkItem.Watermark);
				}
				return (WatermarkCollection)(object)val;
			}
		}

		public ContentAlignment ImageAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return ContentAlignmentHelper.ContentAlignmentFromAlignments(ImageHorizontalAlignment, ImageVerticalAlignment);
			}
			set
			{
				ImageHorizontalAlignment = ContentAlignmentHelper.HorizontalAlignmentFromContentAlignment(value);
				ImageVerticalAlignment = ContentAlignmentHelper.VerticalAlignmentFromContentAlignment(value);
			}
		}

		public System.Drawing.Color TextColor
		{
			get
			{
				return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(TextForeground.A, TextForeground.R, TextForeground.G, TextForeground.B);
			}
			set
			{
				TextForeground = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(value.A, value.R, value.G, value.B);
			}
		}

		public DXFont TextFont
		{
			get
			{
				DXFontStyle baseFontStyle = DXFontStyle.Regular;
				baseFontStyle = ConvertToFontStyle(TextIsBold, DXFontStyle.Bold, baseFontStyle);
				baseFontStyle = ConvertToFontStyle(TextIsItalic, DXFontStyle.Italic, baseFontStyle);
				return new DXFont(TextFontFamily, TextFontSize, baseFontStyle);
			}
			set
			{
				TextFontFamily = value.With((DXFont x) => x.Name);
				TextFontSize = value.Return((DXFont x) => (int)x.Size, () => 12);
				TextIsBold = value.Return((DXFont x) => x.Bold, () => false);
				TextIsItalic = value.Return((DXFont x) => x.Italic, () => false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual Watermark CreateWatermark()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (Watermark)new XpfWatermark();
		}

		public WatermarkEditorViewModel(WatermarkCollection watermarks, Page page)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			watermark = ((IEnumerable<Watermark>)watermarks).FirstOrDefault();
			SetModelProperties();
			WatermarkItems = new ObservableCollection<WatermarkItemViewModel>();
			foreach (Watermark item in (Collection<Watermark>)(object)watermarks)
			{
				WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItemViewModel = new WatermarkItemViewModel(item);
				watermarkItemViewModel.IsSelected = object.Equals(item, watermark);
				watermarkItemViewModel.OnDelete += Model_OnDelete;
				watermarkItemViewModel.OnSelect += Model_OnSelect;
				WatermarkItems.Add(watermarkItemViewModel);
			}
			this.page = page;
			UpdatePreviewCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(UpdatePreview);
			OpenImageCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(LoadImage);
			ClearAllCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(ResetProperties);
			AddWatermark = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(Add);
			MoveUp = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(Up);
			MoveDown = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(Down);
		}

		private void Model_OnSelect(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItemViewModel = (WatermarkItemViewModel)sender;
			foreach (WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItem in WatermarkItems)
			{
				object.Equals(watermarkItem, watermarkItemViewModel);
			}
			watermark = watermarkItemViewModel.Watermark;
			SetModelProperties();
			UpdatePreview();
		}

		private void Model_OnDelete(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItemViewModel = (WatermarkItemViewModel)sender;
			watermarkItemViewModel.OnDelete -= Model_OnDelete;
			watermarkItemViewModel.OnSelect -= Model_OnSelect;
			WatermarkItems.Remove(watermarkItemViewModel);
			WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItemViewModel2 = WatermarkItems.FirstOrDefault();
			if (watermarkItemViewModel2 != null)
			{
				watermarkItemViewModel2.IsSelected = true;
			}
			else
			{
				ResetProperties();
			}
		}

		private void SetModelProperties()
		{
			if (watermark == null)
			{
				ResetProperties();
				return;
			}
			updatePreviewLock.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Text = ((PageWatermark)watermark).Text;
				TextFont = ((PageWatermark)watermark).Font;
				TextDirection = ((PageWatermark)watermark).TextDirection;
				ImageViewMode = ((PageWatermark)watermark).ImageViewMode;
				ImageIsTiled = ((PageWatermark)watermark).ImageTiling;
				ImageAlignment = ((PageWatermark)watermark).ImageAlign;
				TextTransparency = ((PageWatermark)watermark).TextTransparency;
				ImageTransparency = ((PageWatermark)watermark).ImageTransparency;
				TextPosition = ((PageWatermark)watermark).TextPosition;
				ImagePosition = ((PageWatermark)watermark).ImagePosition;
				PageRange = watermark.PageRange;
				IsPageRange = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PageRange);
				TextColor = ((PageWatermark)watermark).ForeColor;
				ImageSource = ((PageWatermark)watermark).ImageSource;
				Id = watermark.Id;
			});
		}

		protected void UpdatePreview()
		{
			updatePreviewLock.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0033: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_008b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00af: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				IPreviewAreaProvider service = GetService<IPreviewAreaProvider>();
				if (service != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Size previewArea = service.PreviewArea;
					if (!previewArea.IsEmpty && !SizeHelper.IsZero(previewArea) && watermark != null)
					{
						Watermark val = new Watermark();
						((PageWatermark)val).Text = Text;
						((PageWatermark)val).ImageSource = ImageSource;
						((PageWatermark)val).ImageAlign = ImageAlignment;
						((PageWatermark)val).ImageViewMode = ImageViewMode;
						((PageWatermark)val).ImageTiling = ImageIsTiled;
						((PageWatermark)val).ImageTransparency = (int)ImageTransparency;
						((PageWatermark)val).TextTransparency = (int)TextTransparency;
						((PageWatermark)val).TextDirection = TextDirection;
						((PageWatermark)val).ForeColor = TextColor;
						((PageWatermark)val).TextPosition = TextPosition;
						((PageWatermark)val).ImagePosition = ImagePosition;
						val.PageRange = (IsPageRange ? PageRange : string.Empty);
						((PageWatermark)val).Font = TextFont;
						watermark.CopyFrom(val);
						page.AssignWatermark((PageWatermark)(object)watermark);
						PreviewImage = PreviewImageHelper.GetPreview(page, previewArea, service.GetScaleX());
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void Add()
		{
			WatermarkCollection watermarks = Watermarks;
			((Collection<Watermark>)(object)watermarks).Add(CreateWatermark());
			watermark = ((IEnumerable<Watermark>)watermarks).Last();
			WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItemViewModel = new WatermarkItemViewModel(watermark);
			watermarkItemViewModel.IsSelected = true;
			watermarkItemViewModel.OnDelete += Model_OnDelete;
			watermarkItemViewModel.OnSelect += Model_OnSelect;
			WatermarkItems.Add(watermarkItemViewModel);
			SetModelProperties();
			UpdatePreview();
		}

		private void Up()
		{
			for (int i = 1; i < WatermarkItems.Count; i++)
			{
				WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItemViewModel = WatermarkItems[i];
				if (object.Equals(watermarkItemViewModel.Watermark, watermark))
				{
					WatermarkItems.Remove(watermarkItemViewModel);
					WatermarkItems.Insert(i - 1, watermarkItemViewModel);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void Down()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < WatermarkItems.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItemViewModel = WatermarkItems[i];
				if (object.Equals(watermarkItemViewModel.Watermark, watermark))
				{
					WatermarkItems.Remove(watermarkItemViewModel);
					WatermarkItems.Insert(i + 1, watermarkItemViewModel);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void OnIsPageRangeChanged()
		{
			UpdatePreview();
			if (!IsPageRange)
			{
				PageRangePlaceholder = PageRange;
				PageRange = null;
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PageRangePlaceholder))
			{
				PageRange = PageRangePlaceholder;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateList()
		{
			if (WatermarkItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WatermarkItemViewModel watermarkItem in WatermarkItems)
			{
				if (object.Equals(watermarkItem.Watermark, watermark))
				{
					watermarkItem.Id = Id;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResetProperties()
		{
			updatePreviewLock.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				ResetImage();
				ImageHorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
				ImageVerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
				Text = null;
				TextFontFamily = "Verdana";
				TextFontSize = 12;
				TextIsBold = false;
				TextIsItalic = false;
				TextDirection = (DirectionMode)1;
				ImageViewMode = (ImageViewMode)0;
				ImageIsTiled = false;
				TextTransparency = 20.0;
				ImageTransparency = 0.0;
				TextPosition = (WatermarkPosition)1;
				ImagePosition = (WatermarkPosition)1;
				PageRange = string.Empty;
				IsPageRange = false;
				TextForeground = Colors.Red;
				ImageFileName = string.Empty;
				Id = string.Empty;
			});
			UpdatePreview();
		}

		private void LoadImage()
		{
			IOpenFileDialogService service = GetService<IOpenFileDialogService>();
			service.AssignImageFileFilter();
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (!service.ShowDialog(empty))
			{
				return;
			}
			string fullPath = Path.Combine(service.File.DirectoryName, service.File.Name);
			try
			{
				updatePreviewLock.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					ImageFileName = fullPath;
					LoadImageFromFile(fullPath);
				});
			}
			catch (OutOfMemoryException)
			{
				ResetImage();
				ShowErrorMessageBox(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.WatermarkImageLoadError));
			}
			catch (IOException)
			{
				ResetImage();
				ShowErrorMessageBox(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.WatermarkImageLoadError));
			}
			finally
			{
				UpdatePreview();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadImageFromFile(string fullPath)
		{
			object imageObjectFromFile = OpenImageSourceHelper.GetImageObjectFromFile(fullPath, delegate(Action<IMessageBoxService> action)
			{
				action(GetService<IMessageBoxService>());
			});
			ImageSource = (ImageSource)((imageObjectFromFile is ImageSource) ? imageObjectFromFile : null);
		}

		private void ResetImage()
		{
			ImageFileName = null;
			ImageSource = null;
		}

		private void ShowErrorMessageBox(string errorText)
		{
			GetService<IMessageBoxService>().ShowMessage(errorText, PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Error), MessageButton.OK, MessageIcon.Error);
		}

		private static DXFontStyle ConvertToFontStyle(bool fontStyleFlagState, DXFontStyle fontStyleFlag, DXFontStyle baseFontStyle)
		{
			DXFontStyle dXFontStyle = baseFontStyle;
			if (fontStyleFlagState)
			{
				return dXFontStyle | fontStyleFlag;
			}
			return dXFontStyle & ~fontStyleFlag;
		}
	}
	public abstract class WatermarkEnumValueSource<T> : MarkupExtension
	{
		protected virtual IEnumerable<T> ExcludedItems => Enumerable.Empty<T>();

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return (from x in Enum.GetValues(typeof(T)).Cast<T>().Except(ExcludedItems)
				select new EnumMemberInfo(GetDisplayName(x), GetDescription(x), x, null)).ToArray();
		}

		private string GetDescription(T value)
		{

	public class ContentAlignmentHelper
	{
		public static VerticalAlignment VerticalAlignmentFromContentAlignment(ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			if ((alignment & (ContentAlignment)7) != 0)
			{
				return VerticalAlignment.Top;
			}
			if ((alignment & (ContentAlignment)112) != 0)
			{
				return VerticalAlignment.Center;
			}
			if ((alignment & (ContentAlignment)1792) != 0)
			{
				return VerticalAlignment.Bottom;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public static System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignmentFromContentAlignment(ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			if ((alignment & (ContentAlignment)273) != 0)
			{
				return System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			}
			if ((alignment & (ContentAlignment)546) != 0)
			{
				return System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
			}
			if ((alignment & (ContentAlignment)1092) != 0)
			{
				return System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public static ContentAlignment ContentAlignmentFromAlignments(System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment)
		{
			return verticalAlignment switch
			{
				VerticalAlignment.Top => horizontalAlignment switch
				{
					System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left => ContentAlignment.TopLeft, 
					System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center => ContentAlignment.TopCenter, 
					System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right => ContentAlignment.TopRight, 
					_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
				}, 
				VerticalAlignment.Center => horizontalAlignment switch
				{
					System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left => ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft, 
					System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center => ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter, 
					System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right => ContentAlignment.MiddleRight, 
					_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
				}, 
				VerticalAlignment.Bottom => horizontalAlignment switch
				{
					System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left => ContentAlignment.BottomLeft, 
					System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center => ContentAlignment.BottomCenter, 
					System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right => ContentAlignment.BottomRight, 
					_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
				}, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}
	}

	{

		public void Build(Document document)
		{

			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{
				Page val = page;
				NestedBrickIterator val2 = new NestedBrickIterator((BrickBase)(object)val);
				while (val2.MoveNext())

	public enum PageDraggingType
	{
		DragViaScrollViewer,
		DragViaTransform
	}
	public class PageDraggingImplementer
	{
		private const string CS_PAGEDRAGGINGIMPLEMENTER_ID = "CS_PAGEDRAGGINGIMPLEMENTER_ID";

		private bool isDraggingMode;

		private System.Windows.Point? startDragPoint;

		private System.Windows.Point cursorPos;

		public bool IsPageDraggingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isDraggingMode)
				{
					return startDragPoint.HasValue;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public IPreviewModel Model { get; private set; }

		public System.Windows.Point DragOffset { get; private set; }

		public PageDraggingType PageDraggingType { get; private set; }

		private IScrollInfo ScrollableOwner { get; set; }

		private ScrollViewer ScrollViewer => ScrollableOwner.ScrollOwner;

		public PageDraggingImplementer(IPreviewModel model, IScrollInfo scrollableOwner, PageDraggingType pageDraggingType)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)model, "model");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)scrollableOwner, "scrollableOwner");
			Model = model;
			ScrollableOwner = scrollableOwner;
			PageDraggingType = pageDraggingType;
			DragOffset = default(System.Windows.Point);
		}

		private void TrySetCursor(System.Windows.Input.Cursor cursor)
		{
			if (Model != null && Model.CursorService != null)
			{
				Model.CursorService.SetCursor((FrameworkElement)ScrollableOwner, cursor, "CS_PAGEDRAGGINGIMPLEMENTER_ID");
				Model.CursorService.SetCursor(ScrollViewer, cursor, "CS_PAGEDRAGGINGIMPLEMENTER_ID");
			}
		}

		private void TrySetCursor(CustomCursor cursorType)
		{
			if (Model != null && Model.CursorService != null)
			{
				Model.CursorService.SetCursor((FrameworkElement)ScrollableOwner, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.None, "CS_PAGEDRAGGINGIMPLEMENTER_ID");
				Model.CursorService.SetCursor(ScrollViewer, cursorType, "CS_PAGEDRAGGINGIMPLEMENTER_ID");
			}
		}

		private void TrySetCursorPosition(System.Windows.Point position)
		{
			if (Model != null && Model.CursorService != null)
			{
				Model.CursorService.SetCursorPosition(position, (FrameworkElement)ScrollableOwner, "CS_PAGEDRAGGINGIMPLEMENTER_ID");
			}
		}

		private void TryBlockCursorService()
		{
			if (Model != null && Model.CursorService != null)
			{
				Model.CursorService.HideCustomCursor();
				Model.CursorService.BlockService("CS_PAGEDRAGGINGIMPLEMENTER_ID");
			}
		}

		private void TryUnblockCursorService()
		{
			if (Model != null && Model.CursorService != null)
			{
				Model.CursorService.UnblockService("CS_PAGEDRAGGINGIMPLEMENTER_ID");
			}
		}

		public void HandleMouseMove(System.Windows.Point position)
		{
			cursorPos = position;
			if (IsPageDraggingEnabled)
			{
				TrySetCursorPosition(cursorPos);
			}
			if (startDragPoint.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point value = cursorPos;
				double num = value.X - startDragPoint.Value.X;
				double num2 = value.Y - startDragPoint.Value.Y;
				startDragPoint = value;
				switch (PageDraggingType)
				{
				case PageDraggingType.DragViaScrollViewer:
					ScrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(ScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset - num);
					ScrollViewer.ScrollToVerticalOffset(ScrollViewer.VerticalOffset - num2);
					ScrollViewer.UpdateLayout();
					break;
				case PageDraggingType.DragViaTransform:
					DragOffset = new System.Windows.Point(DragOffset.X + num, DragOffset.Y + num2);
					((ScrollablePageView)ScrollableOwner).UpdatePagePosition();
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("PageDraggingType");
				}
			}
		}

		public void HandleKeyUp(Key pressedKey)
		{
			if (pressedKey == Key.Space)
			{
				isDraggingMode = false;
			}
			if (!startDragPoint.HasValue && pressedKey == Key.Space)
			{
				TrySetCursor(System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow);
				TryUnblockCursorService();
				((UIElement)ScrollableOwner).ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
		}

		public void HandleKeyDown(Key pressedKey)
		{
			if (!IsPageDraggingEnabled && pressedKey == Key.Space)
			{
				TryBlockCursorService();
				isDraggingMode = true;
				TrySetCursor(PreviewCustomCursors.HandCursor);
				TrySetCursorPosition(cursorPos);
				((UIElement)ScrollableOwner).CaptureMouse();
			}
		}

		public void HandleMouseUp(out bool handled)
		{
			startDragPoint = null;
			if (isDraggingMode)
			{
				handled = true;
				TrySetCursor(PreviewCustomCursors.HandCursor);
				return;
			}
			handled = false;
			TrySetCursor(System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow);
			TryUnblockCursorService();
			((UIElement)ScrollableOwner).ReleaseMouseCapture();
		}

		public void HandleMouseDown(System.Windows.Point position)
		{
			if (IsPageDraggingEnabled)
			{
				TrySetCursor(PreviewCustomCursors.HandDragCursor);
				startDragPoint = position;
			}
		}
	}

	public class OnLoadedScheduler
	{
		private Action action;

		public void Schedule(Action action, FrameworkElement target)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)action, "action");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)target, "target");
			this.action = action;
			if (IsReallyLoaded(target))
			{
				action();
			}
			else
			{
				target.Loaded += target_Loaded;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsReallyLoaded(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return element.IsLoaded;
		}

		private void target_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)sender;
			frameworkElement.Loaded -= target_Loaded;
			if (FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree(frameworkElement))
			{
				action();
			}
		}
	}

	{

		public Stream SaveToStream(Page page, int pageIndex, int pageCount)
		{
			if (page == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("page");
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			XamlExporter xamlExporter = new XamlExporter();
			xamlExporter.Export(memoryStream, page, pageIndex + 1, pageCount, XamlCompatibility, textMeasurementSystem);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			return memoryStream;
		}

		public override FrameworkElement Visualize(PSPage page, int pageIndex, int pageCount)
		{
			Stream source = SaveToStream((Page)(object)page, pageIndex, pageCount);
			return XamlReaderHelper.Load(source);
		}
	}

	public class SearchPanelViewModel : ISearchPanelViewModel, INotifyPropertyChanged

		public IDocumentPreviewModel Model

				}
				model = value;
				if (IsModelCorrect)
				{
					((PrintingSystemPreviewModel)Model).PrintingSystem.DocumentChanged += PrintingSystem_DocumentChanged;
				}
				RaiseFindCommandsCanExecute();
				Clear();
			}
		}

		private bool IsModelCorrect
		{
			get

		public Document Document
		{

				return null;
			}
		}

		private int MinBrickIndex => 0;

		private int MaxBrickIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (((CollectionBase)(object)brickPagePairs).Count != 0)
				{

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public SearchPanelViewModel()
		{
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Expected O, but got Unknown
			findNextCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create<object>(FindNext, CanFind, useCommandManager: false);
			findPrevCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create<object>(FindPrev, CanFind, useCommandManager: false);
			closeCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(Close, (object p) => true, useCommandManager: false);
			brickPagePairs = new BrickPagePairCollection();
		}

		private void PrintingSystem_DocumentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseFindCommandsCanExecute();
			Clear();
		}

		private void Close(object parameter)
		{
			if (Model != null && Model is DocumentPreviewModelBase)
			{
				ICommand toggleSearchPanelCommand = ((DocumentPreviewModelBase)Model).ToggleSearchPanelCommand;
				if (toggleSearchPanelCommand != null && toggleSearchPanelCommand.CanExecute(null))
				{
					toggleSearchPanelCommand.Execute(null);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanFind(object parameter)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchString) && Model != null)
			{
				return Document != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void FindNext(object parameter)
		{
			FindCore((SearchDirection)1);
		}

		private void FindPrev(object parameter)
		{
			FindCore((SearchDirection)0);
		}

		private void FindCore(SearchDirection searchDirection)
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((CollectionBase)(object)brickPagePairs).Count == 0)
			{
				PrintingSystemBase printingSystem = ((PrintingSystemPreviewModel)Model).PrintingSystem;
				TextBrickSelector val = new TextBrickSelector(SearchString, FindWholeWord, CaseSensitive, (IPrintingSystemContext)(object)printingSystem);
				brickPagePairs = NavigateHelper.SelectBrickPagePairs(Document, (IBrickSelector)(object)val, (IComparer)new BrickPagePairComparer((IPageRepository)(object)printingSystem.Pages));
			}
			if (((CollectionBase)(object)brickPagePairs).Count != 0)
			{
				CalcBrickIndex(searchDirection);
				BrickPagePair val2 = brickPagePairs[brickIndex];
				string tagByIndices = DocumentMapTreeViewNodeHelper.GetTagByIndices(((BrickPageInfo)val2).BrickIndices, ((BrickPageInfo)val2).PageIndex);
				Model.FoundBrickInfo = new BrickInfo(tagByIndices, ((BrickPageInfo)val2).PageIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				Model.FoundBrickInfo = BrickInfo.Empty;
				((DocumentPreviewModelBase)Model).DialogService.ShowInformation(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Search_EmptyResult), PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Information));
			}
		}

		private void CalcBrickIndex(SearchDirection searchDirection)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)searchDirection != 0)
			{
				if ((int)searchDirection != 1)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("searchDirection");
				}
				brickIndex++;
			}
			else
			{
				brickIndex--;
			}
			if (brickIndex < MinBrickIndex)
			{
				brickIndex = MaxBrickIndex;
			}
			if (brickIndex > MaxBrickIndex)
			{
				brickIndex = MinBrickIndex;
			}
		}

		private void Clear()
		{
			brickIndex = -1;
			((CollectionBase)(object)brickPagePairs).Clear();
			if (Model != null)
			{
				Model.FoundBrickInfo = null;
			}
		}

		private void RaiseFindCommandsCanExecute()
		{
			if (findNextCommand != null)
			{
				findNextCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}
			if (findPrevCommand != null)
			{
				findPrevCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged<T>(Expression<Func<T>> property)
		{
			PropertyExtensions.RaisePropertyChanged<T>((INotifyPropertyChanged)this, this.PropertyChanged, property);
		}
	}

		public LegacyWatermarkEditorViewModel()
		{
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0079: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UpdatePreviewCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(UpdateWatermarkPreview);
			watermark = new XpfWatermark();
			XpfWatermarkCollection val = new XpfWatermarkCollection();
			((Collection<Watermark>)val).Add((Watermark)(object)watermark);
			Watermarks = (WatermarkCollection)val;
			page = (Page)new PSPage(new ReadonlyPageData(new DXMargins(10f, 10f, 10f, 10f), new DXMargins(), DXPaperKind.Letter, (SizeF)DXPageSizeInfo.GetPageSize(DXPaperKind.Letter), false));
			ClearAll(null);
			loadImageCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create<object>(LoadImage, CanLoadImage, useCommandManager: false);
			clearAllCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create<object>(ClearAll, useCommandManager: false);
		}

		private void UpdateWatermarkPreview()
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IPreviewAreaProvider service = GetService<IPreviewAreaProvider>();
			if (service == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Size previewArea = service.PreviewArea;
			if (!previewArea.IsEmpty && !SizeHelper.IsZero(previewArea))
			{
				XpfWatermark copy = new XpfWatermark();
				if (DoActionSave(delegate
				{
					copy.CopyFrom(watermark);
				}))
				{
					Page.AssignWatermark((PageWatermark)(object)copy);
					PreviewImage = PreviewImageHelper.GetPreview(Page, previewArea, service.GetScaleX());
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadImage(object parameter)
		{
			string filter = "Image files (*.bmp,*.jpg,*.gif,*.png,*.dib,*.tif)|*.bmp;*.jpg;*.gif;*.png;*.dib;*.tif";
			string fileName = "";
			using Stream stream = DialogService.ShowOpenFileDialog("", filter, out fileName);
			if (stream == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[stream.Length];
			try
			{
				stream.Read(array, 0, (int)stream.Length);
				Picture = array;
				PictureFileName = fileName;
			}
			catch (IOException)
			{
				Picture = null;
				PictureFileName = "";
				DialogService.ShowError(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.WatermarkImageLoadError), PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Error));
			}
			finally
			{
				UpdateWatermarkPreview();
			}
		}

		private bool CanLoadImage(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void ProcessLoadImageError(string errorMessage)
		{
			watermark.ImageArray = null;
			DialogService.ShowError(errorMessage, PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.Error));
		}

		private bool DoActionSave(Action action)
		{
			try
			{
				action();
				return true;
			}
			catch (OutOfMemoryException ex)
			{
				ProcessLoadImageError(ex.Message);
			}
			catch (ExternalException ex2)
			{
				ProcessLoadImageError(ex2.Message);
			}
			catch
			{
				ProcessLoadImageError(PrintingLocalizer.GetString(PrintingStringId.WatermarkImageLoadError));
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ClearAll(object parameter)
		{
			//IL_0254: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0276: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0292: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_029c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			textTransparencyRange = new TransparencyRange

			pictureTransparencyRange = new TransparencyRange

			TextTransparency = 20.0;
			directionModeStandardValues = new LocalizedEnumWrapper<DirectionMode>[4]
			{
				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<DirectionMode>((DirectionMode)0, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeDirectionMode),
				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<DirectionMode>((DirectionMode)4, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeDirectionMode),
				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<DirectionMode>((DirectionMode)1, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeDirectionMode),

			{
				fontSizeStandardValues[i] = array[i].ToString();
			}
			pictureViewModeStandardValues = new LocalizedEnumWrapper<ImageViewMode>[3]
			{
				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<ImageViewMode>((ImageViewMode)0, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeImageViewMode),
				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<ImageViewMode>((ImageViewMode)1, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeImageViewMode),
				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<ImageViewMode>((ImageViewMode)2, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeImageViewMode)
			};
			pictureHorizontalAlignmentStandardValues = new LocalizedEnumWrapper<System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment>[3]
			{

				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment>(System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeHorizontalAlignment),
				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment>(System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeHorizontalAlignment)
			};
			pictureVerticalAlignmentStandardValues = new LocalizedEnumWrapper<VerticalAlignment>[3]

				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<VerticalAlignment>(VerticalAlignment.Center, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeVerticalAlignment),
				new LocalizedEnumWrapper<VerticalAlignment>(VerticalAlignment.Bottom, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeVerticalAlignment)
			};
			pictureVerticalAlignment = pictureVerticalAlignmentStandardValues[0];
			pictureVerticalAlignment = new LocalizedEnumWrapper<VerticalAlignment>(ContentAlignmentHelper.VerticalAlignmentFromContentAlignment(((PageWatermark)watermark).ImageAlign), WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeVerticalAlignment);
			pictureHorizontalAlignment = new LocalizedEnumWrapper<System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment>(ContentAlignmentHelper.HorizontalAlignmentFromContentAlignment(((PageWatermark)watermark).ImageAlign), WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeHorizontalAlignment);
			textDirectionMode = new LocalizedEnumWrapper<DirectionMode>(((PageWatermark)watermark).TextDirection, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeDirectionMode);
			pictureViewMode = new LocalizedEnumWrapper<ImageViewMode>(((PageWatermark)watermark).ImageViewMode, WatermarkLocalizers.LocalizeImageViewMode);
			Watermark = new XpfWatermark();
			PictureFileName = "";
			RaisePropertyChanged(() => Page);
			RaisePropertyChanged(() => TextIsNotEmpty);
			UpdateWatermarkPreview();
		}

		private static double RecalculateTransparencyRange(double transparency, TransparencyRange currentRange, TransparencyRange newRange)
		{
			return Math.Round((transparency - currentRange.Min) / currentRange.GetRange() * newRange.GetRange() + newRange.Min);
		}

		public static bool ValidatePageRange(string pageRange)
		{
			return pageRange == PageRangeParser.ValidateString(pageRange);
		}

		public static ValidationResult ValidateFontSize(float size)
		{
			if (size > 0f && size < 3500f)
			{
				return new ValidationResult(isValid: true);
			}
			return new ValidationResult(isValid: false, $"The Font size should be greater than {0}, and less than {3500}.");
		}
	}
	public class WatermarkPreviewAreaProvider : ServiceBase, IPreviewAreaProvider
	{
		public System.Windows.Size PreviewArea { get; private set; }

		public double GetScaleX()
		{
			return ((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject.GetScaleX();
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((ServiceBase)this).OnAttached();
			((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject.Loaded += OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
		}

		private void OnAssociatedObjectLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject.Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				PreviewArea = x.RenderSize;
			});
		}
	}
	public class XamlDocumentPaginator : PaginatorBase
	{
		private readonly string[] pages;

		public override int PageCount => pages.Length;

		public XamlDocumentPaginator(string[] pages)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)pages, "pages");
			this.pages = pages;
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement GetPageContent(int pageNumber)
		{
			return XamlReaderHelper.Load(pages[pageNumber]);
		}
	}
	public static class XamlReaderHelper
	{
		public static FrameworkElement Load(Stream source)
		{
			return (FrameworkElement)System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Load(source);
		}

		public static FrameworkElement Load(string source)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(memoryStream)
			{
				AutoFlush = true
			};
			streamWriter.Write(source);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			return (FrameworkElement)System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Load(memoryStream);
		}
	}

	public class OverlayWindow : DXWindow
	{
		public OverlayWindow()
		{
			((Window)this).SizeToContent = SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight;
			((Window)this).ShowInTaskbar = false;
			((Window)this).WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
			((Window)this).ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;
		}

		protected void OnOpened()
		{
			((Window)this).Left = 0.0;
			((Window)this).Top = 0.0;
			Stretch();
		}

		private void HostContent_Resized(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Stretch();
		}

		protected void OnClosed()
		{
		}

		private void Stretch()
		{
			((FrameworkElement)this).Width = System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow.Width;
			((FrameworkElement)this).Height = System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow.Height;
		}
	}
	public class ExportOptionsConfiguratorService : IExportOptionsConfiguratorService
	{
		public ExportOptionContext Context { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler<AsyncCompletedEventArgs> Completed;

		public void Configure(ExportOptionsBase options, PrintPreviewOptions previewOptions, AvailableExportModes availableExportModes, List<ExportOptionKind> hiddenOptions)
		{
			if (previewOptions.ShowOptionsBeforeExport)
			{
				ShowConfigurationWindow(options, availableExportModes, hiddenOptions);
			}
			else
			{
				RaiseCompleted(cancelled: false);
			}
		}

		private void ShowConfigurationWindow(ExportOptionsBase options, AvailableExportModes availableExportModes, List<ExportOptionKind> hiddenOptions)
		{
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ExportOptionsControllerBase controllerByOptions = ExportOptionsControllerBase.GetControllerByOptions(options);
			ExportOptionsBase clonedOptions = ExportOptionsHelper.CloneOptions(options);
			LineBase[] array = controllerByOptions.GetExportLines(clonedOptions, (LineFactoryBase)(object)new LineFactory(), availableExportModes, hiddenOptions).Cast<LineBase>().ToArray();
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				LinesWindow linesWindow = new LinesWindow
				{
					Title = PreviewLocalizer.GetString(controllerByOptions.CaptionStringId)
				};
				((Window)(object)linesWindow).Closed += delegate
				{
					OnLinesWindowClosed(linesWindow, options, clonedOptions);
				};
				linesWindow.SetLines(array);
				((Window)(object)linesWindow).ShowDialog();
			}
		}

		private void OnLinesWindowClosed(LinesWindow linesWindow, ExportOptionsBase options, ExportOptionsBase clonedOptions)
		{
			bool flag = !((Window)(object)linesWindow).DialogResult.HasValue || !((Window)(object)linesWindow).DialogResult.Value;
			if (!flag)
			{
				options.Assign(clonedOptions);
			}
			RaiseCompleted(flag);
		}

		private void RaiseCompleted(bool cancelled)
		{
			if (this.Completed != null)
			{
				this.Completed(this, new AsyncCompletedEventArgs(null, cancelled, null));
			}
		}
	}
	public struct ExportOptionContext
	{
		private ExportFormat currentFormat;

		private Action<ExportFormat> currentBeginExportAction;

		private Action<ExportFormat> currentExportAction;

		private Action currentEndExportAction;

		public ExportFormat Format => currentFormat;

		public Action<ExportFormat> BeginExportAction => currentBeginExportAction;

		public Action<ExportFormat> ExportAction => currentExportAction;

		public Action EndExportAction => currentEndExportAction;

		public ExportOptionContext(ExportFormat format, Action<ExportFormat> beginExportAction, Action<ExportFormat> exportAction, Action endExportAction)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			currentFormat = format;
			currentBeginExportAction = beginExportAction;
			currentExportAction = exportAction;
			currentEndExportAction = endExportAction;
		}
	}

	public class WatermarkService : IWatermarkService
	{

		private void EditInternal(Window ownerWindow, Page page, int pagesCount, XpfWatermark watermark)

			if (ownerWindow != null)

			((Window)(object)watermarkEditor).ShowDialog();
		}
