	public class LinesContainer : DXContentPresenter
	{
		private const int headerColumnIndex = 0;

		private const int editorColumnIndex = 2;

		private const int separatorColumnWidth = 4;

		private const int editorColumnMinWidth = 60;

		private const int rowSpacerHeight = 4;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LinesProperty;

		public IEnumerable<LineBase> Lines
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable<LineBase>)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(LinesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(LinesProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		static LinesContainer()
		{
			LinesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Lines", typeof(IEnumerable<LineBase>), typeof(LinesContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((LinesContainer)(object)d).OnLinesChanged((LineBase[])e.NewValue);
			}));
		}

		private void SetLines(LineBase[] lines, Window owner)
		{
			if (lines == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("lines");
			}
			LinesGrid linesGrid = new LinesGrid();
			((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)Interaction.GetBehaviors((DependencyObject)linesGrid)).Add((Behavior)(object)new AutoWidthColumnBehavior
			{
				AutoWidthColumnIndex = 0
			});
			linesGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = new GridLength(0.0)
			});
			linesGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = new GridLength(4.0)
			});
			linesGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star),
				MinWidth = 60.0
			});
			foreach (LineBase lineBase in lines)
			{
				if (lineBase is EmptyLine)
				{
					AddRowSpacer(linesGrid);
					AddRowSpacer(linesGrid);
				}
				else
				{
					AddRow(linesGrid, lineBase, linesGrid.RowDefinitions.Count);
				}
				AddRowSpacer(linesGrid);
				lineBase.RefreshContent();
				if (lineBase is PropertyLine propertyLine)
				{
					propertyLine.ValueChanged += OnLineValueChanged;
				}
				if (lineBase is ButtonEditPropertyLine buttonEditPropertyLine)
				{
					buttonEditPropertyLine.OwnerWindow = owner;
				}
			}
			((DXContentPresenter)this).Content = linesGrid;
		}

		private void OnLinesChanged(LineBase[] lines)
		{
			Window window = Window.GetWindow((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			SetLines(lines, window);
		}

		private void OnLineValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			PropertyLine propertyLine = (PropertyLine)sender;
			RefreshPropertiesAttribute refreshPropertiesAttribute = (RefreshPropertiesAttribute)propertyLine.Property.Attributes[typeof(RefreshPropertiesAttribute)];
			if (refreshPropertiesAttribute == null || refreshPropertiesAttribute.RefreshProperties != RefreshProperties.All)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LineBase line in Lines)
			{
				line.RefreshContent();
			}
		}

		private static void AddRow(System.Windows.Controls.Grid grid, LineBase line, int row)
		{
			grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition());
			if (line.Header != null)
			{
				line.Header.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Grid.RowProperty, row);
				line.Header.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Grid.ColumnProperty, 0);
				grid.Children.Add(line.Header);
				line.Content.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Grid.ColumnProperty, 2);
			}
			else
			{
				line.Content.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Grid.ColumnProperty, 0);
				line.Content.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Grid.ColumnSpanProperty, grid.ColumnDefinitions.Count);
			}
			line.Content.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Grid.RowProperty, row);
			grid.Children.Add(line.Content);
			AddInvisibleBorder(grid, line, row);
		}

		private static void AddInvisibleBorder(System.Windows.Controls.Grid grid, LineBase line, int row)
		{
			ComboBoxPropertyLine editorLine = line as ComboBoxPropertyLine;
			if (editorLine != null && !editorLine.IsDropDownMode)
			{
				Border border = new Border();
				border.SizeChanged += delegate(object o, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					SyncWidth((FrameworkElement)(object)editorLine.Editor, e.NewSize.Width);
				};
				border.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Grid.RowProperty, row);
				border.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Grid.ColumnProperty, 2);
				grid.Children.Add(border);
			}
		}

		private static void SyncWidth(FrameworkElement element, double width)
		{
			element.Width = Math.Max(0.0, width - element.Margin.Left - element.Margin.Right);
		}

		private void AddRowSpacer(System.Windows.Controls.Grid grid)
		{
			grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition
			{
				Height = new GridLength(4.0)
			});
		}
	}

	public abstract class PropertyLine : LineBase
	{
		private readonly PropertyDescriptor property;

		private readonly object obj;

		public PropertyDescriptor Property => property;

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return property.GetValue(obj);
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(value, Value))
				{
					property.SetValue(obj, value);
					OnValueSet();
				}
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler ValueChanged;

		protected PropertyLine(PropertyDescriptor property, object obj)
		{
			this.property = property;
			this.obj = obj;
		}

		public override void RefreshContent()
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (obj is ExportOptionsBase && property.Converter != null)
			{
				bool isEnabled = property.Converter.CanConvertFrom((ITypeDescriptorContext)new RuntimeTypeDescriptorContext(property, obj), typeof(string));
				Content.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
				if (Header != null)
				{
					Header.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnValueSet()
		{
			if (this.ValueChanged != null)
			{
				this.ValueChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public static class SystemFileDialogHelper
	{
		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static string GetDefaultDirectory()
		{
			OperatingSystem oSVersion = Environment.OSVersion;
			if (oSVersion.Platform != PlatformID.Win32NT || oSVersion.Version.Major < 6)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			try
			{
				NativeFileOpenDialog nativeFileOpenDialog = (NativeFileOpenDialog)new FileOpenDialogRCW();
				nativeFileOpenDialog.GetFolder(out var ppsi);
				ppsi.GetDisplayName(SIGDN.FILESYSPATH, out var ppszName);
				Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ppsi);
				Marshal.ReleaseComObject(nativeFileOpenDialog);
				return ppszName;
			}
			catch
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public static string CoerceDirectory(string directory)
		{
			string text = directory;
			if (!Directory.Exists(directory))
			{
				text = GetDefaultDirectory();
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory) || !Directory.Exists(text))
				{
					text = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.Personal);
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static void AssignImageFileFilter(this IOpenFileDialogService service, bool isImageSource = true)
		{
			ImageCodecInfo[] imageDecoders = ImageCodecInfo.GetImageDecoders();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder();
			ImageCodecInfo[] array = imageDecoders;
			foreach (ImageCodecInfo imageCodecInfo in array)
			{
				string text = imageCodecInfo.FilenameExtension.ToLower();
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat($"{imageCodecInfo.FormatDescription} ({text})|{text}|");
				if (stringBuilder2.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder2.Append(";");
				}
				stringBuilder2.Append(imageCodecInfo.FilenameExtension);
			}
			if (isImageSource)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("SVG (*.svg)|*.svg|");
				if (stringBuilder2.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder2.Append(";");
				}
				stringBuilder2.Append("*.svg");
			}
			string text2 = stringBuilder2.ToString().ToLower();
			stringBuilder.Append($"All image files ({text2})|{text2}|");
			stringBuilder.Append("All files (*.*)|*.*");
			service.Filter = stringBuilder.ToString();
			service.FilterIndex = imageDecoders.Length + ((!isImageSource) ? 1 : 2);
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.Exports
{
	internal class XpsExporter
	{
		public event EventHandler ProgressChanged;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void CreateDocument(DocumentPaginator paginator, Stream stream, XpsExportOptions options)
		{
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)paginator, "paginator");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)stream, "stream");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)options, "options");
			int[] indices = PageRangeParser.GetIndices(((PageByPageExportOptionsBase)options).PageRange, paginator.PageCount);
			PageRangeCustomPaginator documentPaginator = new PageRangeCustomPaginator(paginator, indices);
			using Package package = Package.Open(stream, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.ReadWrite);
			string text = string.Format("pack://document{0}.xps", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
			Uri uri = new Uri(text);
			PackageStore.AddPackage(uri, package);
			SetPackageProperties(options, package);
			try
			{
				using XpsDocument xpsDocument = new XpsDocument(package, (CompressionOption)options.Compression, text);
				XpsDocumentWriter xpsDocumentWriter = XpsDocument.CreateXpsDocumentWriter(xpsDocument);
				xpsDocumentWriter.WritingProgressChanged += Writer_WritingProgressChanged;
				xpsDocumentWriter.Write(documentPaginator);
			}
			finally
			{
				PackageStore.RemovePackage(uri);
			}
		}

		private static void SetPackageProperties(XpsExportOptions options, Package package)
		{
			if (options.DocumentOptions != null)
			{
				PackageProperties packageProperties = package.PackageProperties;
				XpsDocumentOptions documentOptions = options.DocumentOptions;
				packageProperties.Creator = documentOptions.Creator;
				packageProperties.Category = documentOptions.Category;
				packageProperties.Title = documentOptions.Title;
				packageProperties.Subject = documentOptions.Subject;
				packageProperties.Keywords = documentOptions.Keywords;
				packageProperties.Version = documentOptions.Version;
				packageProperties.Description = documentOptions.Description;
			}
		}

		private void Writer_WritingProgressChanged(object sender, WritingProgressChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ProgressChanged != null)
			{
				this.ProgressChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class XpsExportService : XpsExportServiceBase
	{
		private readonly DocumentPaginator paginator;

		private ProgressReflector progressReflector;

		public DocumentPaginator Paginator => paginator;

		public XpsExportService(DocumentPaginator paginator)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)paginator, "paginator");
			this.paginator = paginator;
		}

		public override void Export(Stream stream, XpsExportOptions options, ProgressReflector progressReflector)
		{
			try
			{
				this.progressReflector = progressReflector;
				progressReflector.InitializeRange(paginator.PageCount + 2);
				XpsExporter xpsExporter = new XpsExporter();
				xpsExporter.ProgressChanged += Exporter_ProgressChanged;
				xpsExporter.CreateDocument(paginator, stream, options);
				xpsExporter.ProgressChanged -= Exporter_ProgressChanged;
			}
			finally
			{
				progressReflector.MaximizeRange();
			}
		}

		private void Exporter_ProgressChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Action callback = delegate
			{
				ProgressReflector obj = progressReflector;
				float rangeValue = obj.RangeValue;
				obj.RangeValue = rangeValue + 1f;
			};
			Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.Invoke(callback, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.DataNodes

	internal abstract class DataNodeBase : IDataNode
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<int, IDataNode> childNodes;

		private IDataNode root;

		protected IDataNode Root
		{
			get
			{
				if (root == null)
				{
					root = GetRoot();
				}
				return root;
			}
		}

		public int Index { get; private set; }

		public IDataNode Parent { get; private set; }

		public virtual bool PageBreakAfter => false;

		public virtual bool PageBreakBefore => false;

		public virtual bool IsDetailContainer => false;

		private IDataNode GetRoot()
		{
			IDataNode val = (IDataNode)(object)this;
			while (val.Parent != null)
			{
				val = val.Parent;
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected DataNodeBase(IDataNode parent, int index)
		{
			childNodes = new Dictionary<int, IDataNode>();
			Parent = parent;
			Index = index;
		}

		public IDataNode GetChild(int index)
		{
			if (!CanGetChild(index))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (!childNodes.TryGetValue(index, out var value))
			{
				value = CreateChildNode(index);
				childNodes.Add(index, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public abstract bool CanGetChild(int index);

		protected abstract IDataNode CreateChildNode(int index);

		protected virtual int GetLevel()
		{
			int num = 0;
			IDataNode parent = Parent;
			while (parent.Parent != null)
			{
				num++;
				parent = parent.Parent;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal class GroupVisualNode : VisualNodeBase, IVisualGroupNode, IGroupNode, IDataNode
	{
		private readonly CollectionViewGroup group;

		private int level = -1;

		private int Level
		{
			get
			{
				if (level == -1)
				{
					level = GetLevel();
				}
				return level;
			}
		}

		public GroupUnion Union
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (GroupInfo == null)
				{
					return (GroupUnion)0;
				}
				return GroupInfo.Union;
			}
		}

		public bool RepeatHeaderEveryPage
		{
			get
			{
				if (GroupInfo == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return GroupInfo.RepeatHeaderEveryPage;
			}
		}

		public override bool PageBreakAfter
		{
			get
			{
				if (GroupInfo == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return GroupInfo.PageBreakAfter;
			}
		}

		public override bool PageBreakBefore
		{
			get
			{
				if (GroupInfo == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return GroupInfo.PageBreakBefore;
			}
		}

		internal GroupInfo GroupInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Root.GroupInfos.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.Root.GroupInfos[Math.Min(Level, base.Root.GroupInfos.Count - 1)];
			}
		}

		public override bool IsDetailContainer => !(group.Items[0] is CollectionViewGroup);

		public GroupVisualNode(IDataNode parent, int index, CollectionViewGroup group)
			: base(parent, index)
		{
			this.group = group;
		}

		public override bool CanGetChild(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				return index < group.Items.Count;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override IDataNode CreateChildNode(int index)
		{
			object obj = group.Items[index];
			if (!(obj is CollectionViewGroup collectionViewGroup))
			{
				return (IDataNode)(object)new VisualNode((IDataNode)(object)this, index, obj);
			}
			return (IDataNode)(object)new GroupVisualNode((IDataNode)(object)this, index, collectionViewGroup);
		}

		public RowViewInfo GetHeader(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (GroupInfo == null || GroupInfo.HeaderTemplate == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new RowViewInfo(GroupInfo.HeaderTemplate, (object)group);
		}

		public RowViewInfo GetFooter(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (GroupInfo == null || GroupInfo.FooterTemplate == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new RowViewInfo(GroupInfo.FooterTemplate, (object)group);
		}
	}

	internal class VisualRootNode : VisualNodeBase, IRootDataNode, IDataNode
	{
		private readonly ICollectionView collectionView;

		private int? count;

		public IList<GroupInfo> GroupInfos { get; private set; }

		internal DataTemplate ItemTemplate { get; private set; }

		private int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (!count.HasValue)
				{
					int? num = (count = collectionView.Cast<object>().Count());
					return num.Value;
				}
				return count.Value;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsDetailContainer => collectionView.Groups == null;

		public VisualRootNode(ICollectionView collectionView, DataTemplate itemTemplate, IList<GroupInfo> groupInfos)
			: base(null, -1)
		{
			this.collectionView = collectionView;
			ItemTemplate = itemTemplate;
			GroupInfos = groupInfos;
		}

		public override bool CanGetChild(int index)
		{
			if (collectionView.Groups != null)
			{
				if (index >= 0)
				{
					return index < collectionView.Groups.Count;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (index < 0 || index >= Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return collectionView.MoveCurrentToPosition(index);
		}

		protected override IDataNode CreateChildNode(int index)
		{
			if (IsDetailContainer)
			{
				return (IDataNode)(object)new VisualNode((IDataNode)(object)this, index, GetData(index));
			}
			return (IDataNode)(object)new GroupVisualNode((IDataNode)(object)this, index, (CollectionViewGroup)collectionView.Groups[index]);
		}

		private object GetData(int index)
		{
			if (!collectionView.MoveCurrentToPosition(index))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			return collectionView.CurrentItem;
		}

		protected override int GetLevel()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public int GetTotalDetailCount()
		{
			if (collectionView.SourceCollection is ICollection)
			{
				return ((ICollection)collectionView.SourceCollection).Count;
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.BrickCollection
{
	internal abstract class BrickCreator : IBrickCreator
	{
		protected readonly PrintingSystemBase ps;

		protected readonly Dictionary<BrickStyleKey, BrickStyle> brickStyles;

		private readonly Dictionary<IVisualBrick, IOnPageUpdater> onPageUpdaters;

		public BrickCreator(PrintingSystemBase ps, Dictionary<BrickStyleKey, BrickStyle> brickStyles, Dictionary<IVisualBrick, IOnPageUpdater> onPageUpdaters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)ps, "ps");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)brickStyles, "brickStyles");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)onPageUpdaters, "onPageUpdaters");
			this.ps = ps;
			this.brickStyles = brickStyles;
			this.onPageUpdaters = onPageUpdaters;
		}

		public abstract VisualBrick Create(UIElement source, UIElement parent);

		protected void InitializeBrickCore(UIElement source, UIElement parent, VisualBrick brick, IExportSettings exportSettings)
		{
			Rect elementRect = GetElementRect(source, parent);
			((Brick)brick).Initialize(ps, GraphicsUnitConverter2.PixelToDoc(new RectangleF((float)elementRect.X, (float)elementRect.Y, (float)elementRect.Width, (float)elementRect.Height)));
			((BrickBase)brick).RightToLeftLayout = ps.Document.RightToLeftLayout;
			((Brick)brick).Url = exportSettings.Url;
			string elementTag = ExportSettings.GetElementTag((DependencyObject)source);
			if (elementTag != null)
			{
				((Brick)brick).Value = elementTag;
			}
			BrickStyleKey brickStyleKey = CreateBrickStyleKey(exportSettings);
			BrickStyle value = null;
			if (!brickStyles.TryGetValue(brickStyleKey, out value))
			{
				value = CreateBrickStyle(brickStyleKey);
				brickStyles.Add(brickStyleKey, value);
			}
			brick.Style = value;
			if (exportSettings.MergeValue != null)
			{
				((Brick)brick).SetAttachedValue<object>(BrickAttachedProperties.MergeValue, exportSettings.MergeValue);
			}
			IOnPageUpdater onPageUpdater = exportSettings.OnPageUpdater;
			if (onPageUpdater != null)
			{
				onPageUpdaters[(IVisualBrick)(object)brick] = onPageUpdater;
			}
		}

		private static void InitializeBorder(BrickStyle style, Thickness thickness)
		{

			//IL_00eb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				if (num2 > 0.0)
				{
					num = num2;
					break;
				}
			}

				{
					if (num3 > 0.0 && num3 != num)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException("All rectangle borders must have the same thickness. In addition, any border can have a zero thickness, which means that this border is invisible.");
					}

			}

					style.Sides |= array5[k];
				}
			}
		}

		internal static BrickTextDecorations GetBrickTextDecorations(TextDecorationCollection decorations)
		{
			decorations = decorations ?? ExportSettingDefaultValue.CreateTextDecorations();
			BrickTextDecorations brickTextDecorations = BrickTextDecorations.None;
			if (decorations.Contains(TextDecorations.Underline.First()))
			{
				brickTextDecorations |= BrickTextDecorations.Underline;
			}
			if (decorations.Contains(TextDecorations.Strikethrough.First()))
			{
				brickTextDecorations |= BrickTextDecorations.Strikethrough;
			}
			return brickTextDecorations;
		}

		private static ImageSource GetImageSourceFromCache(ImagesContainer container, object key, Func<ImageSource> createIfNotExists, Func<ImageSource, object> getKey)

		}

		private ImageSource CreateImageSource(ImageSource image)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown

		private static ImageSizeMode GetImageSizeModeFromStretch(Stretch stretch)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ImageSizeMode result = (ImageSizeMode)0;
			switch (stretch)
			{
			case Stretch.None:
				result = (ImageSizeMode)0;
				break;
			case Stretch.Fill:
				result = (ImageSizeMode)1;
				break;
			case Stretch.Uniform:
				result = (ImageSizeMode)4;
				break;
			case Stretch.UniformToFill:
				throw new NotSupportedException("UniformToFill mode is not supported");
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CollectBricks(DependencyObject currentItem, DependencyObject parent, PanelBrick brickContainer)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				if (val != null)

					((Collection<Brick>)(object)((Brick)brickContainer).Bricks).Add((Brick)(object)val);
				}
			}

			{

				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(bookmark) && val != null)

					val.BookmarkInfo = GetBookmarkInfo(frameworkElement, bookmark);
				}
			}
			if (uIElement != null && uIElement.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return;
			}
			int childrenCount = VisualTreeWalker.GetChildrenCount(currentItem);
			for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
			{

				}
				else if (val == null)
				{
					CollectBricks(child, parent, brickContainer);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static TargetType GetEffectiveTargetType(DependencyObject item)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return (TargetType)(((??)GetAttachedTargetType(item)) ?? GetInheritedTargetType(item));
		}

		internal static TargetType? GetAttachedTargetType(DependencyObject item)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(item, ExportSettings.TargetTypeProperty).BaseValueSource > BaseValueSource.Default || ((Enum)ExportSettings.GetPropertiesHintMask(item)).HasFlag((Enum)(object)(ExportSettingsProperties)1))
			{
				return ExportSettings.GetTargetType(item);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static TargetType GetInheritedTargetType(DependencyObject item)
		{
			if (!(item is IPageNumberExportSettings))
			{
				if (!(item is IProgressBarExportSettings))
				{
					if (!(item is ITrackBarExportSettings))
					{
						if (!(item is ITextExportSettings))
						{
							if (!(item is IImageExportSettings))
							{
								if (!(item is IBooleanExportSettings))
								{
									return (TargetType)0;
								}
								return (TargetType)4;
							}
							return (TargetType)3;
						}
						return (TargetType)1;
					}
					return (TargetType)7;
				}
				return (TargetType)6;
			}
			return (TargetType)5;
		}

		internal IBrickCreator GetBrickCreator(TargetType targetType)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return brickCreators[targetType];
		}

		private BookmarkInfo GetBookmarkInfo(FrameworkElement item, string bookmark)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BookmarkInfo parentBookmarkInfo = GetParentBookmarkInfo(item);
			BookmarkInfo val = new BookmarkInfo((IBrickOwner)(object)NullBrickOwner.Instance, bookmark, parentBookmarkInfo);
			if (item.Name != null)
			{
				bookmarkInfos[item.Name] = val;
			}
			return val;
		}

		private BookmarkInfo GetParentBookmarkInfo(DependencyObject item)
		{
			string bookmarkParentName = ExportSettings.GetBookmarkParentName(item);
			BookmarkInfo value = null;
			if (bookmarkParentName != null && !bookmarkInfos.TryGetValue(bookmarkParentName, out value))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"No parent with the {bookmarkParentName} name was found for the bookmark.");
			}
			return value;
		}

		private T GetEffectiveExportValue<T>(DependencyProperty property, Func<IExportSettings, T> getValue, Func<T> getDefaultValue = null)
		{
			return GetEffectiveValue<T, IExportSettings>(property, getValue, (Func<T>)null);
		}

		protected T GetEffectiveValue<T, TInterface>(DependencyProperty property, Func<TInterface, T> getValue, Func<T> getDefaultValue = null) where TInterface : class, IExportSettings
		{
			if (DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(source, property).BaseValueSource > BaseValueSource.Default)
			{
				return (T)source.GetValue(property);
			}
			if (source is TInterface arg)
			{
				return getValue(arg);
			}
			if (getDefaultValue == null)
			{
				return (T)DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetDefaultValue(property);
			}
			return getDefaultValue();
		}
	}
